ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq
ArtinNormalisers.Artin.coxeterParabolic_.source_declaration:
/-- Agreement with the provider's standard Coxeter parabolic. -/
theorem coxeterParabolic_eq :
    coxeterParabolic M J = M.toCoxeterSystem.parabolic J := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · change Subgroup.closure (M.simple '' J) ≤ _
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    have h := M.toCoxeterSystem.simple_mem_parabolic hi
    rw [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple] at h
    exact h
  · apply M.toCoxeterSystem.parabolic_le_iff.2
    intro i hi
    rw [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple]
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Artin.exists_normalizer.name: ArtinNormalisers.Artin.exists_normalizer_lift
ArtinNormalisers.Artin.exists_normalizer.source_declaration:
/-- Every Coxeter normalizer element has an actual Artin normalizer preimage.
This is stronger than surjectivity after quotienting by the parabolics. -/
theorem exists_normalizer_lift {w : M.Group}
    (hw : w ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (coxeterParabolic M J : Set M.Group)) :
    ∃ a : Group M,
      a ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (parabolic M J : Set (Group M)) ∧ projection M a = w := by
  let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
  have hw' : w ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set M.Group) := by
    rwa [coxeterParabolic_eq] at hw
  obtain ⟨d, v, hv, hdw, hd, hmin⟩ := Coxeter.exists_minimal_normalizer cs hw'
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hprod'⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced d
  have hprod := hprod'.symm
  have hβ := wordProd_mem_normalizer_of_minimal M J hd hmin hδ hprod
  have hv' : v⁻¹ ∈ (parabolic M J).map (projection M) := by
    rw [map_parabolic, coxeterParabolic_eq]
    exact (cs.parabolic J).inv_mem hv
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbp⟩ := hv'
  refine ⟨wordProd M δ * b,
    (Subgroup.normalizer (parabolic M J : Set (Group M))).mul_mem hβ
      (Subgroup.le_normalizer hb), ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, projection_wordProd, hprod, hbp, hdw]
  simp

ArtinNormalisers.Artin.lemma_2_8.name: ArtinNormalisers.Artin.lemma_2_8
ArtinNormalisers.Artin.lemma_2_8.source_declaration:
/-- **Lemma 2.8, algebraic form.** For every Coxeter matrix and every set of
indices, the canonical projection gives the short exact sequence
`1 → N(P,J) → N_A(A_J)/A_J → N_W(W_J)/W_J → 1`.
Here short exactness means injectivity of the subgroup inclusion, equality of
its range with the kernel, and surjectivity of the quotient homomorphism.
There are no finiteness, sphericality, or normalizer-surjectivity premises. -/
theorem lemma_2_8 :
    Function.Injective (pureNormalizerInclusion M J) ∧
      (pureNormalizerInclusion M J).range = (normalizerQuotientMap M J).ker ∧
        Function.Surjective (normalizerQuotientMap M J) :=
  ⟨pureNormalizerInclusion_injective M J, pureNormalizerInclusion_range M J,
    normalizerQuotientMap_surjective M J⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Artin.map_parabolic.name: ArtinNormalisers.Artin.map_parabolic
ArtinNormalisers.Artin.map_parabolic.source_declaration:
/-- The image of a standard Artin parabolic is the corresponding Coxeter parabolic. -/
theorem map_parabolic (J : Set I) :
    (parabolic M J).map (projection M) = coxeterParabolic M J := by
  rw [parabolic, MonoidHom.map_closure, coxeterParabolic, Set.image_image]
  congr 1
  ext w
  simp only [Set.mem_image, projection_generator]

ArtinNormalisers.Artin.mem_normalizer_of.name: ArtinNormalisers.Artin.mem_normalizer_of_generator_relations
ArtinNormalisers.Artin.mem_normalizer_of.source_declaration:
/-- Two directions of the generator relations suffice even for an infinite
set of selected generators. -/
theorem mem_normalizer_of_generator_relations (a : Group M)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ j ∈ J, a * generator M i = generator M j * a)
    (hb : ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ j ∈ J, generator M i * a = a * generator M j) :
    a ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (parabolic M J : Set (Group M)) := by
  have hf' : ∀ i ∈ J, a * generator M i * a⁻¹ ∈ parabolic M J := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hrel⟩ := hf i hi
    rw [hrel, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  have hb' : ∀ i ∈ J, a⁻¹ * generator M i * (a⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ parabolic M J := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hrel⟩ := hb i hi
    have hconj : a⁻¹ * generator M i * a = generator M j := by
      rw [mul_assoc, hrel]
      simp
    rw [inv_inv, hconj]
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  apply Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff.mpr
  intro x
  constructor
  · exact conjugate_mem_parabolic M J a hf'
  · intro hx
    have := conjugate_mem_parabolic M J a⁻¹ hb' hx
    simpa [mul_assoc] using this

/-- The homomorphism induced by the canonical Artin--Coxeter projection.
The target is the quotient by the Coxeter parabolic itself, using the proved
equality `map_parabolic` rather than an assumed image identification. -/
def normalizerQuotientMap : normalizerQuotient M J →* coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J :=
  quotientMapTo (projection M) (parabolic M J) (coxeterParabolic M J)
    (map_parabolic M J)

ArtinNormalisers.Artin.normalizerQuotien.source_declaration:
/-- The induced map sends an Artin normalizer representative to its Coxeter
projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem normalizerQuotientMap_mk
    (n : Subgroup.normalizer (parabolic M J : Set (Group M))) :
    normalizerQuotientMap M J
        (QuotientGroup.mk'
          ((parabolic M J).subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (parabolic M J : Set (Group M)))) n) =
      QuotientGroup.mk'
        ((coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf
          (Subgroup.normalizer (coxeterParabolic M J : Set M.Group)))
        ⟨projection M n, by
          rw [← map_parabolic M J]
          exact (normalizerMap (projection M) (parabolic M J) n).property⟩ :=
  quotientMapTo_mk (projection M) (parabolic M J) (coxeterParabolic M J)
    (map_parabolic M J) n

ArtinNormalisers.Artin.normalizerQuotien.name: ArtinNormalisers.Artin.normalizerQuotientMap_surjective
ArtinNormalisers.Artin.normalizerQuotien.source_declaration:
/-- Terminal surjectivity follows from the proved lift of every Coxeter
normalizer element to the actual Artin normalizer. -/
theorem normalizerQuotientMap_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (normalizerQuotientMap M J) := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    ((coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf
      (Subgroup.normalizer (coxeterParabolic M J : Set M.Group))) x
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hpa⟩ := exists_normalizer_lift M J w.property
  refine ⟨QuotientGroup.mk'
    ((parabolic M J).subgroupOf
      (Subgroup.normalizer (parabolic M J : Set (Group M)))) ⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [normalizerQuotientMap_mk]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext hpa

ArtinNormalisers.Artin.wordProd_mem_norm.name: ArtinNormalisers.Artin.wordProd_mem_normalizer_of_minimal
ArtinNormalisers.Artin.wordProd_mem_norm.source_declaration:
/-- A reduced word for a minimal normalizing representative has a positive
Artin lift which normalizes the Artin parabolic. -/
theorem wordProd_mem_normalizer_of_minimal {d : M.Group}
    (hd : d ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (M.toCoxeterSystem.parabolic J : Set M.Group))
    (hmin : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep J d)
    {δ : List I} (hδ : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsReduced δ)
    (hprod : M.toCoxeterSystem.wordProd δ = d) :
    wordProd M δ ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (parabolic M J : Set (Group M)) := by
  let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
  change cs.wordProd δ = d at hprod
  have hbraid := TauCeti.ArtinGroup.prod_map_gen_braidWord M
  have hrel : ∀ i ∈ J, ∀ j ∈ J, d * cs.simple i = cs.simple j * d →
      wordProd M δ * generator M i = generator M j * wordProd M δ := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    have hright := Coxeter.isReduced_append_simple_of_minimal cs hmin hδ hprod hi
    have hleft := Coxeter.isReduced_prepend_simple_of_minimal cs hd hmin hδ hprod hj
    have heq : cs.wordProd (δ ++ [i]) = cs.wordProd (j :: δ) := by
      rw [cs.wordProd_append, cs.wordProd_singleton, cs.wordProd_cons, hprod]
      exact hij
    have hm := TauCeti.matsumoto cs (generator M) hbraid hright hleft heq
    simpa [wordProd, List.map_append, List.prod_append] using hm
  apply mem_normalizer_of_generator_relations M J (wordProd M δ)
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hij⟩ := Coxeter.exists_conjugate_simple_of_minimal cs hd hmin hi
    refine ⟨j, hj, hrel i hi j hj ?_⟩
    rw [← hij]
    simp [mul_assoc]
  · intro i hi
    have hd' := (Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set M.Group)).inv_mem hd
    have hmin' := Coxeter.minimal_inv_of_mem_normalizer cs hd hmin
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hij⟩ := Coxeter.exists_conjugate_simple_of_minimal cs hd' hmin' hi
    refine ⟨j, hj, (hrel j hj i hi ?_).symm⟩
    rw [← hij]
    simp [mul_assoc]

  ∃ (n : ℕ) (e : E ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)), S = e ⁻¹' positiveOrthant (Fin n)

ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.IsSimplici.name: ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.IsSimplicialRegion.exists_basis_and_closure
ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.IsSimplici.source_declaration:
/-- The orthant condition gives an actual finite basis, whose conic hull
is exactly the chamber closure, including dimension zero. -/
theorem IsSimplicialRegion.exists_basis_and_closure {S : Set E} (hS : IsSimplicialRegion S) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : Basis (Fin n) ℝ E),
      S = {x | ∀ i, 0 < b.repr x i} ∧
      closure S = (PointedCone.hull ℝ (Set.range b) : Set E) ∧
      (PointedCone.hull ℝ (Set.range b)).IsSimplicial := by
  obtain ⟨n, e, he⟩ := hS
  let b := Basis.ofEquivFun e.toLinearEquiv
  refine ⟨n, b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he]
    rfl
  · have hc : e ⁻¹' closure (positiveOrthant (Fin n)) =
        closure (e ⁻¹' positiveOrthant (Fin n)) := e.toHomeomorph.preimage_closure _
    rw [he, ← hc, closure_positiveOrthant]
    ext x
    exact (mem_hull_basis_iff b x).symm
  · exact PointedCone.IsSimplicial.hull (Set.finite_range b) b.linearIndependent.linearIndepOn_id

ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.IsSimplici.source_declaration:
theorem IsSimplicialRegion.exists_orthant_equiv {S : Set E} (hS : IsSimplicialRegion S) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (e : E ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)), e '' S = positiveOrthant (Fin n) := by
  obtain ⟨n, e, he⟩ := hS
  refine ⟨n, e, ?_⟩
  rw [he]
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hx
  · intro ha
    exact ⟨e.symm a, by simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using ha,
      e.apply_symm_apply a⟩

/-- Actual finite-basis generation of every actual chamber and its closure. -/
theorem actualChamber_basis_and_closure (C : ActualChamber M J) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : Basis (Fin n) ℝ (relativeSubspace J)),
      C.region = {x | ∀ i, 0 < b.repr x i} ∧
      closure C.region = (PointedCone.hull ℝ (Set.range b) : Set (relativeSubspace J)) ∧
      (PointedCone.hull ℝ (Set.range b)).IsSimplicial :=
  (actualChamber_isSimplicialRegion M J C).exists_basis_and_closure

simplicial region, for every spherical Coxeter type and every parabolic set. -/

  let : Finite I := finite_index M
  obtain ⟨L, rfl⟩ := actualChamberOfRawLabel_surjective M J C
  rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region]
  exact translatedFacet_isSimplicialRegion L

/-- The complete actual finite/central/proper/closed/codimension-one and
strict-basis chamber hypotheses, independently of the desired conclusion. -/
theorem actual_arrangement_simplicial_hypotheses [Finite M.Group] :
    (restrictedArrangement M J).Finite ∧
      (∀ H ∈ restrictedArrangement M J,
        H ≠ ⊤ ∧ IsClosed (H : Set (relativeSubspace J)) ∧
        (0 : relativeSubspace J) ∈ H ∧
        Module.finrank ℝ H + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ (relativeSubspace J)) ∧
      (∀ C : ActualChamber M J,
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℝ (relativeSubspace J)),
          C.region = {x | ∀ i, 0 < b.repr x i} ∧
          closure C.region = (PointedCone.hull ℝ (Set.range b) : Set (relativeSubspace J)) ∧
          (PointedCone.hull ℝ (Set.range b)).IsSimplicial) := by
  refine ⟨restrictedArrangement_finite M J, ?_, actualChamber_basis_and_closure M J⟩
  intro H hH
  refine ⟨restrictedArrangement_proper M J hH,
    restrictedArrangement_isClosed M J hH,
    restrictedArrangement_zero_mem M J hH, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hH
  exact restrictedHyperplane_finrank_add_one M J ⟨r, hr⟩

proved for the original spaces. Intersections are required to be nonempty

complement and is not declared contractible. -/

    IsCoveringMap (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J) ∧
      Function.Surjective (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J) ∧
      PathConnectedSpace (ComplementUniversalCover M J) ∧
      SimplyConnectedSpace (ComplementUniversalCover M J) ∧
      Finite (RelativeRoot M J → Fin 4) ∧
      (∀ σ : RelativeRoot M J → Fin 4, IsOpen (actualConvexCoverSet M J σ)) ∧
      ((⋃ σ : RelativeRoot M J → Fin 4, actualConvexCoverSet M J σ) = Set.univ) ∧
      (∀ s : Finset (RelativeRoot M J → Fin 4), s.Nonempty →
        (⋂ σ ∈ s, actualConvexCoverSet M J σ).Nonempty →
        ContractibleSpace (⋂ σ ∈ s, actualConvexCoverSet M J σ)) :=
  ⟨isCoveringMap_complementUniversalCoverProjection M J,
    complementUniversalCoverProjection_surjective M J,
    inferInstance, inferInstance,
    finite_actualConvexCoverIndex M J,
    isOpen_actualConvexCoverSet M J,
    iUnion_actualConvexCoverSet M J,

      (actualForms M J) F hF hne')

/-- Flattening the two actual subtypes preserves their subspace topologies.
A nonempty index family is needed: the empty intersection inside the
complement is the whole complement, which need not be contractible. -/
def convexCoverIntersectionHomeomorph (ℓ : H → E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (F : Set (H → Fin 4)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
    convexCoverIntersection ℓ F ≃ₜ ambientConvexCoverIntersection ℓ F where
  toFun p := ⟨p.val.val, (mem_convexCoverIntersection_iff ℓ F p.val).mp p.property⟩
  invFun p := ⟨⟨p.val, ambientConvexCoverIntersection_subset_complement ℓ hF p.property⟩,
    (mem_convexCoverIntersection_iff ℓ F _).mpr p.property⟩
  left_inv _p := rfl
  right_inv _p := rfl
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
  continuous_invFun := (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _).subtype_mk _

theorem exists_mem_convexCoverSet (ℓ : H → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) :
    ∃ σ : H → Fin 4, p ∈ convexCoverSet ℓ σ := by
  classical
  let σ : H → Fin 4 := fun h =>
    if 0 < ℓ h p.val.1 then 0 else if ℓ h p.val.1 < 0 then 1
    else if 0 < ℓ h p.val.2 then 2 else 3
  refine ⟨σ, Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun h => ?_⟩
  by_cases hrp : 0 < ℓ h p.val.1
  · simp [coordinateHalfSpace, σ, hrp]
  · by_cases hrn : ℓ h p.val.1 < 0
    · simp [coordinateHalfSpace, σ, hrp, hrn]
    · by_cases hip : 0 < ℓ h p.val.2
      · simp [coordinateHalfSpace, σ, hrp, hrn, hip]
      · have hr : ℓ h p.val.1 = 0 :=
          le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hrp) (le_of_not_gt hrn)
        have hi : ℓ h p.val.2 ≠ 0 := fun hz => p.property h ⟨hr, hz⟩
        have hin : ℓ h p.val.2 < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hip) hi
        simp [coordinateHalfSpace, σ, hrp, hrn, hip, hin]

/-- Reindex an arbitrary finite coordinate type to `Fin`, without restricting
the universe of the original Coxeter indexing type. -/
noncomputable def finiteCoordinateEquiv (ι : Type*) [Finite ι] :
    (ι → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin (Nat.card ι) → ℝ) where
  toLinearEquiv :=
    { toFun := fun a i => a ((Finite.equivFin ι).symm i)
      invFun := fun a i => a (Finite.equivFin ι i)
      left_inv := fun a => by funext i; simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      right_inv := fun a => by funext i; simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  continuous_toFun := continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply ((Finite.equivFin ι).symm i)
  continuous_invFun := continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply (Finite.equivFin ι i)

ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.finiteCoor.name: ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.finiteCoordinateEquiv_pos_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.finiteCoor.source_declaration:
theorem finiteCoordinateEquiv_pos_iff (ι : Type*) [Finite ι] (a : ι → ℝ) :
    finiteCoordinateEquiv ι a ∈ positiveOrthant (Fin (Nat.card ι)) ↔ a ∈ positiveOrthant ι := by
  change (∀ i, 0 < a ((Finite.equivFin ι).symm i)) ↔ ∀ i, 0 < a i
  constructor

ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.flatComple.source_declaration:
/-- The actual relative flat, with its inherited topology, has exactly the
complementary simple-root coordinates. No finiteness hypothesis is needed. -/
noncomputable def flatComplementCoordinates (K : Set I) :
    relativeSubspace K ≃L[ℝ] ({i : I // i ∉ K} → ℝ) where
  toLinearEquiv :=
    { toFun := fun φ i => φ.val (simpleRoot i)
      invFun := fun f => ⟨(dualCoordinates (I := I)).symm (flatCoordinateZeroExtension K f), by
        intro i hi
        change dualCoordinates ((dualCoordinates (I := I)).symm (flatCoordinateZeroExtension K f)) i = 0
        rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact flatCoordinateZeroExtension_of_mem K f hi⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro φ
        classical
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply (dualCoordinates (I := I)).injective
        rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        funext i
        change flatCoordinateZeroExtension K (fun j => φ.val (simpleRoot j)) i = φ.val (simpleRoot i)
        by_cases hi : i ∈ K
        · rw [flatCoordinateZeroExtension_of_mem K _ hi]
          exact (φ.property i hi).symm
        · simp [flatCoordinateZeroExtension, hi]
      right_inv := by
        intro f
        funext i
        change dualCoordinates ((dualCoordinates (I := I)).symm (flatCoordinateZeroExtension K f)) i = f i
        rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, flatCoordinateZeroExtension_apply]
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  continuous_toFun := continuous_pi fun i =>
    (continuous_evaluation (simpleRoot (i : I))).comp continuous_subtype_val
  continuous_invFun := by
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    exact (dualCoordinatesHomeomorph (I := I)).symm.continuous_toFun.comp
      (continuous_flatCoordinateZeroExtension K)

ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.genLoop_cl.source_declaration:
/-- Every actual generalized loop is homotopic relative to its boundary to
the constant loop: its compact image and basepoint lie in one cover member. -/
theorem genLoop_class_eq_const_of_directed_open_contractible_cover
    (N : Type v) [Finite N] (x : X) (f : GenLoop N X x) :
    (⟦f⟧ : HomotopyGroup N X x) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ := by
  classical
  let : Fintype N := Fintype.ofFinite N
  have hxcover : x ∈ ⋃ i, U i := by rw [hcover]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i₀, _⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxcover
  let : Nonempty ι := ⟨i₀⟩
  have hk : IsCompact ({x} ∪ Set.range f) :=
    isCompact_singleton.union (isCompact_range f.val.continuous)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hk.elim_directed_cover U hopen
    (by rw [hcover]; exact Set.subset_univ _) hdir
  have hx : x ∈ U i := hi (Or.inl (Set.mem_singleton x))
  have hf (z : I^N) : f z ∈ U i := hi (Or.inr ⟨z, rfl⟩)
  let xi : U i := ⟨x, hx⟩
  let fi : GenLoop N (U i) xi :=
    ⟨⟨fun z => ⟨f z, hf z⟩, f.val.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩,
      fun z hz => Subtype.ext (GenLoop.boundary f z hz)⟩
  let : ContractibleSpace (U i) := hcontract i
  have hzero : (⟦fi⟧ : HomotopyGroup N (U i) xi) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ :=
    (homotopyGroup_subsingleton_of_contractible N xi).elim _ _
  let inclusion : C(U i, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hfi : GenLoop.map inclusion rfl fi = f := by
    apply GenLoop.ext
    intro z
    rw [GenLoop.map_apply]
    change (fi z).val = f z
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (@GenLoop.mk_apply N (U i) _ xi _ _ z)
  have hm := congrArg (HomotopyGroup.map (N := N) inclusion rfl) hzero
  rw [HomotopyGroup.map_mk, HomotopyGroup.map_mk, hfi, GenLoop.map_const] at hm
  exact hm

ArtinNormalisers.Asphericity5.homotopyGr.source_declaration:
/-- A directed open cover by actual contractible subspaces kills every
finite-dimensional homotopy group, including dimensions zero and one. -/
theorem homotopyGroup_subsingleton_of_directed_open_contractible_cover

  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩

    U hopen hcover hdir hcontract N x f).trans

theorem mem_hull_basis_iff {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : E) :
    x ∈ PointedCone.hull ℝ (Set.range b) ↔ ∀ i, 0 ≤ b.repr x i := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hy
      intro i
      simp only [Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    | zero => simp
    | add y z hy hz ihy ihz =>
      intro i
      simpa only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply] using add_nonneg (ihy i) (ihz i)
    | smul a y hy ih =>
      intro i
      change 0 ≤ b.repr ((a : ℝ) • y) i
      rw [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_nonneg a.property (ih i)
  · intro hx
    rw [← b.sum_repr x]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    exact (PointedCone.hull ℝ (Set.range b)).smul_mem (hx i)
      (PointedCone.subset_hull ⟨i, rfl⟩)

    refine ⟨((facetFlatEquiv L).symm x).property, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    have hh := h ⟨i, hi⟩
    simpa only [rawFacetCoordinates, ContinuousLinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      flatComplementCoordinates_apply] using hh

codimension-one hyperplane, including in all degenerate parabolic cases. -/
theorem restrictedHyperplane_finrank_add_one [Finite M.Group] (r : RelativeRoot M J) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (restrictedHyperplane J r.val) + 1 =
      Module.finrank ℝ (relativeSubspace J) := by
  let : Finite I := finite_index M
  let : FiniteDimensional ℝ (relativeSubspace J) := finiteDimensional_relativeSubspace J
  have hf : (actualForms M J r).toLinearMap ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply actualForms_ne_zero M J r
    ext x
    exact congrArg (fun f : relativeSubspace J →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ => f x) hz
  exact Module.Dual.finrank_ker_add_one_of_ne_zero
    (K := ℝ) (V₁ := relativeSubspace J) (f := (actualForms M J r).toLinearMap) hf

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.Chamber.region.source_declaration:
/-- A chamber is exactly the connected component of each of its points in
the actual regular locus. This does not require a finite family of forms. -/
theorem region_eq_connectedComponentIn (C : Chamber ℓ) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ C.region) :
    C.region = connectedComponentIn (regularSet ℓ) x := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact C.isPreconnected_region.subset_connectedComponentIn hx C.region_subset_regularSet
  · intro y hy h
    have hzero : ∀ z ∈ connectedComponentIn (regularSet ℓ) x, ℓ h z ≠ 0 :=
      fun z hz => connectedComponentIn_subset (regularSet ℓ) x hz h
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (ℓ h) (connectedComponentIn (regularSet ℓ) x) :=
      (ℓ h).continuous.continuousOn
    have hxcomp : x ∈ connectedComponentIn (regularSet ℓ) x :=
      mem_connectedComponentIn (C.region_subset_regularSet hx)
    have hxh := hx h
    cases hs : C.signs h
    · have hn : ℓ h x < 0 := by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hxh
      have hyn := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.gt_of_ne hcont hzero
        ⟨x, hxcomp, hn⟩ hy
      simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hyn
    · have hp : 0 < ℓ h x := by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hxh
      have hyp := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.lt_of_ne hcont hzero
        ⟨x, hxcomp, hp⟩ hy
      simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hyp

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.CoverOrbitData.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.CoverOrbitData.descMap_comp
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.CoverOrbitData.source_declaration:
theorem descMap_comp {d e z : D} (f : d ⟶ e) (g : e ⟶ z) :
    S.descMap H hH (f ≫ g) = S.descMap H hH f ≫ S.descMap H hH g := by
  obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := S.obj_surjective d
  obtain ⟨⟨Y, p⟩, hp⟩ := (S.covering X).surjective ⟨e, f⟩
  have hY := (Sigma.mk.inj hp).1
  cases hY
  have hf : F.map p = f := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj hp).2
  subst f
  obtain ⟨⟨Z, q⟩, hq⟩ := (S.covering Y).surjective ⟨z, g⟩
  have hZ := (Sigma.mk.inj hq).1
  cases hZ
  have hg : F.map q = g := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj hq).2
  subst g
  rw [← F.map_comp]
  have hfg := S.descMap_image H hH (p ≫ q)
  rw [H.map_comp] at hfg
  have hc : HEq (S.descMap H hH (F.map p) ≫ S.descMap H hH (F.map q))
      (H.map p ≫ H.map q) :=
    heq_comp (S.descObj_image H hH X) (S.descObj_image H hH Y) (S.descObj_image H hH Z)
      (S.descMap_image H hH p) (S.descMap_image H hH q)
  exact eq_of_heq (hfg.trans hc.symm)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.CoverOrbitData.source_declaration:
/-- Image arrows of an invariant functor are independent of an outgoing
lift and of the representative object in the source fiber. -/
theorem map_eq {X Y X' Y' : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X' ⟶ Y'}
    (hX : F.obj X = F.obj X') (hY : F.obj Y = F.obj Y') (hf : HEq (F.map f) (F.map g)) :
    HEq (H.map f) (H.map g) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := S.fiber_transitive X X' hX
  let aq := A.functor q
  let f' : X' ⟶ aq.obj Y := eqToHom hq.symm ≫ aq.map f
  have htarget : F.obj (aq.obj Y) = F.obj Y' :=
    (Functor.congr_obj (S.invariant q) Y).trans hY
  have hFshift : HEq (F.map f') (F.map f) := by
    dsimp only [f']
    rw [F.map_comp, eqToHom_map]
    exact (eqToHom_comp_heq _ _).trans (Functor.hcongr_hom (S.invariant q) f)
  have ho : (⟨aq.obj Y, f'⟩ : Outgoing C X') = ⟨Y', g⟩ :=
    (S.covering X').injective (Sigma.ext htarget (hFshift.trans hf))
  have hHshift : HEq (H.map f') (H.map f) := by
    dsimp only [f']
    rw [H.map_comp, eqToHom_map]
    exact (eqToHom_comp_heq _ _).trans (Functor.hcongr_hom (hH q) f)
  have himage := map_heq H rfl (Sigma.mk.inj ho).1 (Sigma.mk.inj ho).2
  exact hHshift.symm.trans himage

theorem obj_eq {X Y : C} (h : F.obj X = F.obj Y) : H.obj X = H.obj Y := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := S.fiber_transitive X Y h
  have he := Functor.congr_obj (hH q) X
  change H.obj ((A.functor q).obj X) = H.obj X at he
  rw [hq] at he
  exact he.symm

/-- The actual invariant functor is a cocone on the full action diagram. -/
def orbitCocone : Cocone A.diagram where
  pt := Grpd.of D
  ι :=
    { app _ := F
      naturality _ _ q := by
        change A.functor q ⋙ F = F ⋙ 𝟭 D
        simpa only [Functor.comp_id] using S.invariant q }

theorem orbitCocone_invariant (c : Cocone A.diagram) (q : Q) :
    A.functor q ⋙ c.ι.app (SingleObj.star Q) = c.ι.app (SingleObj.star Q) := by
  have h := c.w (j := SingleObj.star Q) (j' := SingleObj.star Q) q
  change A.functor q ⋙ c.ι.app (SingleObj.star Q) = c.ι.app (SingleObj.star Q) at h
  exact h

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.CoverOrbitData.source_declaration:
/-- The actual target groupoid is the orbit colimit, because actual unique
outgoing lifts and orbit fibers give strict existence and uniqueness of descent. -/
noncomputable def orbitIsColimit : IsColimit S.orbitCocone where
  desc c := Classical.choose (coveringFunctor_descent_existsUnique A F S.covering
    S.obj_surjective S.invariant S.fiber_transitive
    (c.ι.app (SingleObj.star Q)) (orbitCocone_invariant c))
  fac c j := by
    cases j
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (coveringFunctor_descent_existsUnique A F S.covering
      S.obj_surjective S.invariant S.fiber_transitive
      (c.ι.app (SingleObj.star Q)) (orbitCocone_invariant c))).1
  uniq c m hm := by
    apply (Classical.choose_spec (coveringFunctor_descent_existsUnique A F S.covering
      S.obj_surjective S.invariant S.fiber_transitive
      (c.ι.app (SingleObj.star Q)) (orbitCocone_invariant c))).2 m
    exact hm (SingleObj.star Q)

theorem assoc (f : Hom A B) (g : Hom B C) (h : Hom C F) :
    comp (comp f g) h = comp f (comp g h) := by
  apply ext (f := comp (comp f g) h) (g := comp f (comp g h)) rfl
  intro a
  change HEq ((f.hom a ≫ g.hom (f.equiv a)) ≫ h.hom (g.equiv (f.equiv a)))
    (f.hom a ≫ (g.hom (f.equiv a) ≫ h.hom (g.equiv (f.equiv a))))
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rfl

theorem comp_inv (f : Hom A B) : comp f (inv f) = id A := by
  apply ext (Equiv.self_trans_symm f.equiv)
  intro a
  change HEq (f.hom a ≫
    (eqToHom (congrArg B.obj (f.equiv.apply_symm_apply (f.equiv a)).symm) ≫
      CategoryTheory.inv (f.hom (f.equiv.symm (f.equiv a))))) (𝟙 (A.obj a))
  have hn := eqToHom_naturality f.hom (f.equiv.symm_apply_apply a).symm
  rw [← Category.assoc, hn, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact eqToHom_heq_id_dom _ _ _

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.FamilyGroupoid.source_declaration:
/-- Heterogeneous coordinate equality accounts for the codomain dependence
on the indexing equivalence. -/
@[ext] theorem ext {f g : Hom A B} (he : f.equiv = g.equiv)
    (hh : ∀ a, HEq (f.hom a) (g.hom a)) : f = g := by
  rcases f with ⟨ef, hf⟩
  rcases g with ⟨eg, hg⟩
  cases he
  have hfg : hf = hg := by
    funext a
    exact eq_of_heq (hh a)
  cases hfg
  rfl

/-- The functor on actual indexed-family groupoids induced by an actual functor. -/
def mapFunctor : FamilyGroupoid.{u, v} D ⥤ FamilyGroupoid.{u, v'} C where
  obj := mapObject F
  map := mapHom F
  map_id A := by
    apply Hom.ext (f := mapHom F (𝟙 A)) (g := 𝟙 (mapObject F A)) rfl
    intro a
    exact heq_of_eq (F.map_id (A.obj a))
  map_comp f g := by
    apply Hom.ext (f := mapHom F (f ≫ g)) (g := mapHom F f ≫ mapHom F g) rfl
    intro a
    exact heq_of_eq (F.map_comp (f.hom a) (g.hom (f.equiv a)))

/-- One coordinate of a genuine family arrow recovers the specified actual

def Recovers (f : A ⟶ B) (a : A.index) (b : B.index) (δ : A.obj a ⟶ B.obj b) : Prop :=
  f.equiv a = b ∧ HEq (f.hom a) δ

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.FamilyRecovery.source_declaration:
theorem comp {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ C} {a : A.index} {b : B.index} {c : C.index}
    {δ : A.obj a ⟶ B.obj b} {ε : B.obj b ⟶ C.obj c}
    (hf : Recovers f a b δ) (hg : Recovers g b c ε) :
    Recovers (f ≫ g) a c (δ ≫ ε) := by
  obtain ⟨he, hh⟩ := hf
  subst b
  obtain ⟨hge, hgh⟩ := hg
  subst c
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  apply heq_of_eq
  change f.hom a ≫ g.hom (f.equiv a) = δ ≫ ε
  rw [eq_of_heq hh, eq_of_heq hgh]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.FamilyRecovery.source_declaration:
theorem inverse {f : A ⟶ B} {a : A.index} {b : B.index} {δ : A.obj a ⟶ B.obj b}
    (hf : Recovers f a b δ) : Recovers (inv f) b a (inv δ) := by
  obtain ⟨he, hh⟩ := hf
  subst b
  have hi : (inv f).equiv (f.equiv a) = a := by
    rw [FamilyGroupoid.inv_equiv]
    exact f.equiv.symm_apply_apply a
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  have hc := FamilyGroupoid.coordinate_heq_of_eq (IsIso.hom_inv_id f) a
  have hcomp : HEq (f.hom a ≫ (inv f).hom (f.equiv a)) (𝟙 (A.obj a)) := hc
  have hrec := inverse_heq_of_comp (congrArg A.obj hi) hcomp
  have hδ : f.hom a = δ := eq_of_heq hh
  exact hrec.trans (by rw [hδ])

/-- The complement-side counit, whose naturality is proved first inside
actual tubes and then on all path classes by the proved covering generation. -/
noncomputable def counitIso :
    descentFunctor ℓ ⋙ intervalForward c ≅ 𝟭 (FundamentalGroupoid (ComplexComplement ℓ)) :=
  natIsoOfTubeLocals _ _ (counitComponent c) (by
    intro C p q f
    change (intervalForward c).map
        ((descentFunctor ℓ).map
          ((FundamentalGroupoid.map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal (tubeSet C))).map f)) ≫
          (counitComponent c (FundamentalGroupoid.mk q.as.val)).hom =
      (counitComponent c (FundamentalGroupoid.mk p.as.val)).hom ≫
        (FundamentalGroupoid.map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal (tubeSet C))).map f
    rw [descentFunctor_map_local]
    simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_inv]
    simp [forward_tubeGauge c p.as.property, forward_tubeGauge c q.as.property,
      classInTube_inv, Category.assoc]
    exact (IntervalForward.classInTube_comp C _ _ _).trans (classInTube_eq_map C f))

theorem face_basepoint_same_piece {p : ComplexComplement ℓ} {C D : Chamber ℓ}
    (hpC : p ∈ tubeSet C) (hpD : p ∈ tubeSet D) :
    let B := faceChamber ℓ p.val.1 C
    p ∈ tubeIntersectionPiece ({C, D} : Set (Chamber ℓ)) B.signs ∧
      chamberBasepoint c B ∈ tubeIntersectionPiece ({C, D} : Set (Chamber ℓ)) B.signs := by

  dsimp only
  have hpI : p ∈ tubeIntersection ({C, D} : Set (Chamber ℓ)) := by
    intro A hA
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hA
    rcases hA with rfl | rfl
    · exact hpC
    · exact hpD
  constructor
  · refine ⟨hpI, fun h hd => ?_⟩
    have hn := tubeIntersection_real_ne_zero hpI hd
    rw [faceChamber_signs_nonzero ℓ p.val.1 C hn]
    by_cases hs : 0 < ℓ h p.val.1
    · simp [signHalfSpace, hs]
    · have hneg : ℓ h p.val.1 < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hs) hn
      simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hneg
  · refine ⟨fun A _ => chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c _ A, fun h _ => ?_⟩
    exact (c _).property h

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquiva.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquivalence.forward_faceIntervalConnector
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquiva.source_declaration:
/-- Actual overlap path classes agree with the image of the face connector.
The intermediate real point is connected to the given complex point inside
the literal overlap sign piece, whose contractibility was already proved. -/
theorem forward_faceIntervalConnector {p : ComplexComplement ℓ} {C D : Chamber ℓ}
    (hpC : p ∈ tubeSet C) (hpD : p ∈ tubeSet D) :
    (intervalForward c).map (faceIntervalConnector ℓ p.val.1 C D) =
      IntervalForward.classInTube C (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c C C) hpC ≫
        IntervalForward.classInTube D hpD (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c D D) := by
  let B := faceChamber ℓ p.val.1 C
  obtain ⟨hp, hB⟩ := face_basepoint_same_piece c hpC hpD
  have hfamily : ({C, D} : Set (Chamber ℓ)).Nonempty := ⟨C, by simp⟩
  have hconn := isPathConnected_tubeIntersectionPiece hfamily ⟨p, hp⟩
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hconn.joinedIn _ hB _ hp
  have hγC : ∀ t, γ t ∈ tubeSet C := fun t => (hγ t).1 C (by simp)
  have hγD : ∀ t, γ t ∈ tubeSet D := fun t => (hγ t).1 D (by simp)
  have hα :
      IntervalForward.classInTube C (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c B C) hpC =
        IntervalForward.classInTube D (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c B D) hpD :=
    (IntervalForward.classInTube_eq_path C _ _ γ hγC).trans
      (IntervalForward.classInTube_eq_path D _ _ γ hγD).symm
  have hC : IntervalForward.positiveClass c B C =
      IntervalForward.classInTube C (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c B C) hpC ≫
        IntervalForward.classInTube C hpC (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c C C) :=
    (IntervalForward.classInTube_comp C _ _ _).symm
  have hD : IntervalForward.positiveClass c B D =
      IntervalForward.classInTube C (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c B C) hpC ≫
        IntervalForward.classInTube D hpD (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c D D) := by
    rw [hα]
    exact (IntervalForward.classInTube_comp D _ _ _).symm
  change (intervalForward c).map (inv (intervalPositive B C) ≫ intervalPositive B D) = _
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_inv,
    intervalForward_positive]
  simp [hC, hD, classInTube_inv, Category.assoc]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, IntervalForward.classInTube_comp]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquiva.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquivalence.natIsoOfPositive
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquiva.source_declaration:
/-- Naturality on the primitive positive generators implies naturality on
every arrow of the genuinely presented interval groupoid. -/
noncomputable def natIsoOfPositive {T : Type*} [Groupoid T]
    (F G : IntervalGroupoid ℓ ⥤ T) (η : ∀ X, F.obj X ≅ G.obj X)
    (hpos : ∀ C D, F.map (intervalPositive C D) ≫ (η (intervalObject D)).hom =
      (η (intervalObject C)).hom ≫ G.map (intervalPositive C D)) : F ≅ G := by
  refine NatIso.ofComponents η ?_
  intro X Y f
  induction f using CategoryTheory.Quotient.induction with
  | h f =>
    induction f using Quiver.FreeGroupoid.hom_rec with
    | @of_map X Y e =>
      rcases X with ⟨C⟩
      rcases Y with ⟨D⟩
      have he : e = (PUnit.unit : (⟨C⟩ : IntervalVertex ℓ) ⟶ ⟨D⟩) :=
        @Subsingleton.elim PUnit inferInstance e PUnit.unit
      subst e
      exact hpos C D
    | @inv_of_map X Y e =>
      rcases X with ⟨C⟩
      rcases Y with ⟨D⟩
      have he : e = (PUnit.unit : (⟨C⟩ : IntervalVertex ℓ) ⟶ ⟨D⟩) :=
        @Subsingleton.elim PUnit inferInstance e PUnit.unit
      subst e
      rw [(CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor (IntervalRelation (ℓ := ℓ))).map_inv]
      change F.map (inv (intervalPositive C D)) ≫ (η (intervalObject C)).hom =
        (η (intervalObject D)).hom ≫ G.map (inv (intervalPositive C D))
      simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_inv]
      have hh := congrArg
        (fun k => inv (F.map (intervalPositive C D)) ≫ k ≫ inv (G.map (intervalPositive C D)))
        (hpos C D)
      simpa [Category.assoc] using hh.symm
    | id X =>
      change F.map (𝟙 _) ≫ _ = _ ≫ G.map (𝟙 _)
      simp
    | comp f g hf hg =>
      simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
      rw [hg, ← Category.assoc, hf]
      simp only [Category.assoc]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquiva.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquivalence.natIsoOfTubeLocals
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquiva.source_declaration:
/-- Actual tube images generate every path class, so naturality on those
images suffices for a natural isomorphism on the whole fundamental groupoid. -/
noncomputable def natIsoOfTubeLocals {T : Type*} [Groupoid T]
    (F G : FundamentalGroupoid (ComplexComplement ℓ) ⥤ T)
    (η : ∀ X, F.obj X ≅ G.obj X)
    (hloc : ∀ (C : Chamber ℓ) {p q : FundamentalGroupoid (Tubes.Space C)} (f : p ⟶ q),
      F.map ((FundamentalGroupoid.map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal (tubeSet C))).map f) ≫
          (η ((FundamentalGroupoid.map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal (tubeSet C))).obj q)).hom =
        (η ((FundamentalGroupoid.map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal (tubeSet C))).obj p)).hom ≫
          G.map ((FundamentalGroupoid.map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal (tubeSet C))).map f)) :
    F ≅ G := by
  let S : Subgroupoid (FundamentalGroupoid (ComplexComplement ℓ)) :=
    { arrows := fun x y => {f | F.map f ≫ (η y).hom = (η x).hom ≫ G.map f}
      inv := by
        intro x y f hf
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Groupoid.inv_eq_inv] at hf ⊢
        simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_inv]
        have hh := congrArg (fun k => inv (F.map f) ≫ k ≫ inv (G.map f)) hf
        simpa [Category.assoc] using hh.symm
      mul := by
        intro x y z f hf g hg
        change F.map (f ≫ g) ≫ (η z).hom = (η x).hom ≫ G.map (f ≫ g)
        change F.map f ≫ (η y).hom = (η x).hom ≫ G.map f at hf
        change F.map g ≫ (η z).hom = (η y).hom ≫ G.map g at hg
        simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
        rw [hg, ← Category.assoc, hf]
        simp only [Category.assoc] }
  have hU : ∀ p : ComplexComplement ℓ, ∃ C : Chamber ℓ, tubeSet C ∈ nhds p := by
    intro p
    obtain ⟨C, hp⟩ := exists_mem_tubeSet ℓ p
    exact ⟨C, (isOpen_tubeSet C).mem_nhds hp⟩
  have hS : S = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← TauCeti.FundamentalGroupoid.iSup_im_map_subtypeVal_eq_top hU]
    refine iSup_le fun C => ?_
    rw [Subgroupoid.im, Subgroupoid.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    rintro ⟨p, q, f⟩ _
    exact hloc C f
  refine NatIso.ofComponents η ?_
  intro x y f
  have hf : f ∈ S.arrows x y := by rw [hS]; trivial
  exact hf

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquiva.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquivalence.unitIso
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalEquiva.source_declaration:
/-- The interval-side unit, proved on the positive pair generators and
extended to every signed arrow by the actual presentation. -/
noncomputable def unitIso :
    𝟭 (IntervalGroupoid ℓ) ≅ intervalForward c ⋙ descentFunctor ℓ :=
  natIsoOfPositive _ _
    (fun X => asIso (intervalPositive (intervalChamber X)
      (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c (intervalChamber X))))) (by
        intro C D
        change intervalPositive C D ≫
            intervalPositive D (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c D)) =
          intervalPositive C (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c C)) ≫
            (descentFunctor ℓ).map ((intervalForward c).map (intervalPositive C D))
        have hC := tubeGauge_basepoint c C D
        have hD := tubeGauge_basepoint c D D
        have he := congrArg₂
          (fun (a : intervalObject (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c C)) ⟶ intervalObject D)
            (b : intervalObject (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c D)) ⟶ intervalObject D) =>
            intervalPositive C (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c C)) ≫ (a ≫ inv b)) hC hD
        have hP : (descentFunctor ℓ).map ((intervalForward c).map (intervalPositive C D)) =
            tubeGauge ℓ D (chamberBasepoint c C) ≫ inv (tubeGauge ℓ D (chamberBasepoint c D)) :=
          (congrArg (fun f => (descentFunctor ℓ).map f) (intervalForward_positive c C D)).trans
            (descent_classInTube D _ _)
        have hs : intervalPositive C D ≫
            intervalPositive D (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c D)) =
          intervalPositive C (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c C)) ≫
            (tubeGauge ℓ D (chamberBasepoint c C) ≫ inv (tubeGauge ℓ D (chamberBasepoint c D))) := by
          simpa [Category.assoc] using he.symm
        exact hs.trans
          (congrArg (fun f => intervalPositive C (chosenCoverChamber ℓ (chamberBasepoint c C)) ≫ f)
            hP.symm))

/-- The local class is the actual homotopy class of every path whose range
lies in the indicated tube; contractibility supplies independence of choice. -/
theorem classInTube_eq_path (D : Chamber ℓ) {p q : ComplexComplement ℓ}
    (hp : p ∈ tubeSet D) (hq : q ∈ tubeSet D) (γ : Path p q)
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ tubeSet D) :
    classInTube D hp hq = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ := by
  let γD : Path (⟨p, hp⟩ : Tubes.Space D) ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    { toFun t := ⟨γ t, hγ t⟩
      continuous_toFun := γ.continuous.subtype_mk _
      source' := Subtype.ext γ.source
      target' := Subtype.ext γ.target }
  have he : localClass D ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩ = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γD :=
    @Subsingleton.elim (Path.Homotopic.Quotient (⟨p, hp⟩ : Tubes.Space D) ⟨q, hq⟩)
      inferInstance _ _
  rw [classInTube, he]
  change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γD).map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal (tubeSet D)) = _
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_map]
  congr 1

/-- The interval relation holds for actual homotopy classes, using a path
in a genuine component of the intersection of the two target tubes. -/
theorem positiveClass_comp (C D F : Chamber ℓ) (hb : ChamberBetween C D F) :
    positiveClass c C F = positiveClass c C D ≫ positiveClass c D F := by
  obtain ⟨hC, hD⟩ := basepoint_mem_intervalPiece c C D F hb
  have hfamily : ({D, F} : Set (Chamber ℓ)).Nonempty := ⟨D, by simp⟩
  have hconn := isPathConnected_tubeIntersectionPiece hfamily ⟨_, hC⟩
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hconn.joinedIn _ hC _ hD
  have hγD : ∀ t, γ t ∈ tubeSet D := fun t => (hγ t).1 D (by simp)
  have hγF : ∀ t, γ t ∈ tubeSet F := fun t => (hγ t).1 F (by simp)
  have he : positiveClass c C D =
      classInTube F (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c C F)
        (chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet c D F) :=
    (classInTube_eq_path D _ _ γ hγD).trans (classInTube_eq_path F _ _ γ hγF).symm
  rw [he]
  exact (classInTube_comp F _ _ _).symm

/-- Universal extension from arbitrary groupoid-valued assignments satisfying
only the stated interval identities. No geometric comparison is a premise. -/
theorem exists_unique_extension (hA : A.RespectsIntervals) :
    ∃! F : IntervalGroupoid ℓ ⥤ T,
      F.obj = (fun X => A.obj (intervalChamber X)) ∧
      ∀ C D, HEq (F.map (intervalPositive C D)) (A.positive C D) := by

  · intro C D
    exact heq_of_eq (A.extensionFunctor_positive hA C D)

def extensionFunctor (hA : A.RespectsIntervals) : IntervalGroupoid ℓ ⥤ T :=
  CategoryTheory.Quotient.lift _ A.freeExtension (by
    intro X Y f g h
    cases h with

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalGenera.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalGeneratorData.extensionFunctor_unique
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.IntervalGenera.source_declaration:
/-- The positive generators determine genuine functors on the whole
presented groupoid, including inverses and all composite arrows. -/
theorem extensionFunctor_unique (hA : A.RespectsIntervals)
    (F : IntervalGroupoid ℓ ⥤ T)
    (hobj : F.obj = fun X => A.obj (intervalChamber X))
    (hpos : ∀ C D, HEq (F.map (intervalPositive C D)) (A.positive C D)) :
    F = A.extensionFunctor hA := by
  cases F with
  | mk fobj fmap fid fcomp =>
    dsimp only at hobj
    subst fobj
    let F : IntervalGroupoid ℓ ⥤ T :=
      { obj := fun X => A.obj (intervalChamber X)
        map := fmap
        map_id := fid
        map_comp := fcomp }
    change F = A.extensionFunctor hA
    have hpos' (C D : Chamber ℓ) :
        F.map (intervalPositive C D) = A.positive C D := eq_of_heq (hpos C D)
    apply Functor.hext (F := F) (G := A.extensionFunctor hA) (fun _ => rfl)
    intro X Y f
    apply heq_of_eq
    induction f using CategoryTheory.Quotient.induction with
    | h f =>
      induction f using Quiver.FreeGroupoid.hom_rec with
      | @of_map X Y e =>
        rcases X with ⟨C⟩
        rcases Y with ⟨D⟩
        have he : e = (PUnit.unit : (⟨C⟩ : IntervalVertex ℓ) ⟶ ⟨D⟩) := by
          exact @Subsingleton.elim PUnit inferInstance e PUnit.unit
        subst e
        exact (hpos' _ _).trans (A.extensionFunctor_positive hA _ _).symm
      | @inv_of_map X Y e =>
        rcases X with ⟨C⟩
        rcases Y with ⟨D⟩
        have he : e = (PUnit.unit : (⟨C⟩ : IntervalVertex ℓ) ⟶ ⟨D⟩) := by
          exact @Subsingleton.elim PUnit inferInstance e PUnit.unit
        subst e
        rw [(CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor (IntervalRelation (ℓ := ℓ))).map_inv]
        change F.map (inv (intervalPositive C D)) =
          (A.extensionFunctor hA).map (inv (intervalPositive C D))
        simp only [Functor.map_inv]
        simp only [hpos', A.extensionFunctor_positive]
        rfl
      | id X =>
        change F.map (𝟙 _) = (A.extensionFunctor hA).map (𝟙 _)
        exact (F.map_id _).trans ((A.extensionFunctor hA).map_id _).symm
      | comp f g hf hg =>
        simp only [Functor.map_comp]
        rw [hf, hg]
        rfl

  toFun tp := makePoint F ρ C0 hC0 tp.2.val.val.1
    ((1 - (tp.1 : ℝ)) • tp.2.val.val.2 + (tp.1 : ℝ) • c0) tp.2.property.2 (by
      intro C hC h hz
      exact (convex_signHalfSpace (ℓ h) (C.signs h))
        (tp.2.property.1 C hC h hz)
        (chosenImaginary_condition F ρ C0 hC0 c0 hc0 tp.2.property.2 C hC h hz)
        (sub_nonneg.mpr tp.1.property.2) tp.1.property.1 (sub_add_cancel 1 (tp.1 : ℝ)))
  continuous_toFun := by
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    fun_prop
  map_zero_left p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [makePoint]
  map_one_left p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [makePoint, stageOneMap, centerAt]

/-- The first stage stays in every required open halfspace whenever its
fixed real coordinate vanishes on the corresponding form. -/

    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (ContinuousMap.id (Space C)) (stageOneMap C) where
  toFun p := makePoint C p.2.val.val.1
    ((1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) • p.2.val.val.2 + (p.1 : ℝ) • chosenPoint C) (by
      intro h hx
      exact (convex_signHalfSpace (ℓ h) (C.signs h))
        (p.2.property h hx) (chosenPoint_mem C h)
        (sub_nonneg.mpr p.1.property.2) p.1.property.1 (sub_add_cancel 1 (p.1 : ℝ)))
  continuous_toFun := by
    have hp : Continuous (fun p : unitInterval × Space C =>
        (p.2.val.val.1,
          (1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) • p.2.val.val.2 + (p.1 : ℝ) • chosenPoint C)) := by
      fun_prop
    exact hp.subtype_mk _ |>.subtype_mk _
  map_zero_left p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (p.val.val.1, (1 - (0 : ℝ)) • p.val.val.2 + (0 : ℝ) • chosenPoint C) = p.val.val
    simp
  map_one_left p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (p.val.val.1, (1 - (1 : ℝ)) • p.val.val.2 + (1 : ℝ) • chosenPoint C) =

    · rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.actualInterval.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.actualIntervalForwardOfPoints_equivariant
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.actualInterval.source_declaration:
/-- Equivariant actual basepoints make the actual forward functor equivariant.
Only point covariance is a hypothesis; the arrow assertion is proved from paths. -/
theorem actualIntervalForwardOfPoints_equivariant
    (c : ChamberPointFamily (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J))
    (q : Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J)
    (hc : ∀ C, actualChamberBasepoint M J c (q • C) =
      q • actualChamberBasepoint M J c C) :
    intervalAction M J q ⋙ actualIntervalForwardOfPoints M J c =
      actualIntervalForwardOfPoints M J c ⋙
        FundamentalGroupoid.map (actualQuotientComplementMap M J q) := by
  apply intervalFunctor_ext
  · intro X
    rw [← intervalObject_intervalChamber X]
    change FundamentalGroupoid.mk (actualChamberBasepoint M J c (q • intervalChamber X)) =
      FundamentalGroupoid.mk (q • actualChamberBasepoint M J c (intervalChamber X))
    exact congrArg FundamentalGroupoid.mk (hc _)
  · intro C D
    let x : ↥(actualTubeSet M J D) :=
      ⟨actualChamberBasepoint M J c C, actualChamberBasepoint_mem_tube M J c C D⟩
    let y : ↥(actualTubeSet M J D) :=
      ⟨actualChamberBasepoint M J c D, actualChamberBasepoint_mem_tube M J c D D⟩
    let γ : Path (actualChamberBasepoint M J c C) (actualChamberBasepoint M J c D) :=
      (PathConnectedSpace.somePath x y).map continuous_subtype_val
    have hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ actualTubeSet M J D :=
      fun t => (PathConnectedSpace.somePath x y t).property
    let δ := (γ.map (actualQuotientComplementMap M J q).continuous).cast (hc C) (hc D)
    have hδ : ∀ t, δ t ∈ actualTubeSet M J (q • D) := by
      intro t
      exact (quotient_mem_actualTubeSet_iff M J q D (γ t)).2 (hγ t)
    change HEq ((actualIntervalForwardOfPoints M J c).map
      ((intervalAction M J q).map (intervalPositive C D)))
      ((FundamentalGroupoid.map (actualQuotientComplementMap M J q)).map
        ((actualIntervalForwardOfPoints M J c).map (intervalPositive C D)))
    rw [intervalAction_positive]
    change HEq ((actualIntervalForwardOfPoints M J c).map (intervalPositive (q • C) (q • D)))
      ((FundamentalGroupoid.map (actualQuotientComplementMap M J q)).map
        ((actualIntervalForwardOfPoints M J c).map (intervalPositive C D)))
    have hleft := actualIntervalForwardOfPoints_positive_eq_path M J c (q • C) (q • D) δ hδ
    have hright := congrArg
      (fun f : FundamentalGroupoid.mk (actualChamberBasepoint M J c C) ⟶
          FundamentalGroupoid.mk (actualChamberBasepoint M J c D) =>
        (FundamentalGroupoid.map (actualQuotientComplementMap M J q)).map f)
      (actualIntervalForwardOfPoints_positive_eq_path M J c C D γ hγ)
    have hpaths : HEq (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk δ)
        ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ).map (actualQuotientComplementMap M J q)) := by
      rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_map]
      exact Path.Homotopic.hpath_hext (fun _ => rfl)
    exact (heq_of_eq hleft).trans (hpaths.trans (heq_of_eq hright).symm)

/-- Distinct realized chambers have distinct chosen actual real basepoints. -/
theorem actualIntervalForwardOfPoints_obj_injective
    (c : ChamberPointFamily (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)) :
    Function.Injective (actualIntervalForwardOfPoints M J c).obj := by
  intro X Y h
  rw [← intervalObject_intervalChamber X, ← intervalObject_intervalChamber Y] at h ⊢
  have hp := congrArg (fun z : FundamentalGroupoid (Complement M J) => z.as.val.1) h
  change (c (intervalChamber X)).val = (c (intervalChamber Y)).val at hp
  apply congrArg intervalObject
  apply Chamber.eq_of_mem_region (c (intervalChamber X)).property
  rw [hp]
  exact (c (intervalChamber Y)).property

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.actualInterval.source_declaration:
/-- Every actual path in the indicated actual tube represents the positive arrow. -/
theorem actualIntervalForwardOfPoints_positive_eq_path
    (c : ChamberPointFamily (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J))
    (C D : ActualChamber M J)
    (γ : Path (actualChamberBasepoint M J c C) (actualChamberBasepoint M J c D))
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ actualTubeSet M J D) :
    (actualIntervalForwardOfPoints M J c).map (intervalPositive C D) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ := by
  change (FundamentalGroupoid.map
      ⟨(actualComplementHomeomorph M J).symm,
        (actualComplementHomeomorph M J).symm.continuous⟩).map
      ((intervalForward c).map (intervalPositive C D)) = _
  rw [intervalForward_positive_eq_path c C D
    (γ.map (actualComplementHomeomorph M J).continuous) hγ]
  change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
    (γ.map (actualComplementHomeomorph M J).continuous)).map _ = _
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_map]
  congr 1

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.actual_simple_.source_declaration:
/-- Actual positive factors of an actual simple positive lift are simple
positive lifts themselves. This uses the proved positive embedding. -/
theorem actual_simple_factors {a b : Artin.Group M} {d : M.Group}
    (ha : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hb : b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hab : a * b = transporterPositiveLift M d) :
    a = transporterPositiveLift M (Artin.projection M a) ∧
      b = transporterPositiveLift M (Artin.projection M b) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨ap, hap⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨bp, hbp⟩ := hb
  have he : ap * bp = positiveSimpleLift M d := by
    apply positiveToParent_injective M
    rw [map_mul, hap, hbp]
    exact hab
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := positive_simple_factors M ap bp d he
  have hprojA : positiveToCoxeter M ap = Artin.projection M a := by
    rw [← hap, projection_positiveToParent]
  have hprojB : positiveToCoxeter M bp = Artin.projection M b := by
    rw [← hbp, projection_positiveToParent]
  constructor
  · exact hap.symm.trans ((congrArg (positiveToParent M) hA).trans
      (congrArg (transporterPositiveLift M) hprojA))
  · exact hbp.symm.trans ((congrArg (positiveToParent M) hB).trans
      (congrArg (transporterPositiveLift M) hprojB))

theorem actual_simple_factors_length {a b : Artin.Group M} {d : M.Group}
    (ha : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hb : b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hab : a * b = transporterPositiveLift M d) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.length (Artin.projection M (a * b)) =
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (Artin.projection M a) +
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (Artin.projection M b) := by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := actual_simple_factors M ha hb hab
  have hdeg := degree_mul M a b
  rw [degree_eq_coxeterLength_of_simple M ⟨d, hab⟩,
    degree_eq_coxeterLength_of_simple M ⟨_, hA⟩,
    degree_eq_coxeterLength_of_simple M ⟨_, hB⟩] at hdeg
  exact_mod_cast hdeg

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.chamberBetween.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.chamberBetween_rawLabels_of_length
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.chamberBetween.source_declaration:
/-- The reverse geometric bridge: an ambient weak prefix between the
canonical relative elements forces actual sign betweenness of the chambers. -/
theorem chamberBetween_rawLabels_of_length (L K T : RawFacetLabel M J)
    (hlen : M.toCoxeterSystem.length (rawRelativeTransport M L T) =
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (rawRelativeTransport M L K) +
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length
          ((rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ * rawRelativeTransport M L T)) :
    ChamberBetween (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K)
      (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T) := by
  have hsub := rootInversions_subset_of_length_eq_add M
    (rawRelativeTransport M L K) (rawRelativeTransport M L T) hlen
  intro R hshared
  let r := M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative⁻¹ R.val
  have hrootR : R.val ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots := by
    obtain ⟨w, i, he⟩ := R.property.1
    exact M.toCoxeterSystem.mem_geometricRoots.mpr ⟨w, i, he⟩
  have hr : r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots :=
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff
      L.representative⁻¹).mpr hrootR
  have hbase : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R = true ↔ 0 < r := by
    simpa only [rawRelativeTransport_self, inv_one, map_one, one_apply_eq_self] using
      rawFacet_sign_iff M J L L R
  have hmid := rawFacet_sign_iff M J L K R
  have hend := rawFacet_sign_iff M J L T R
  rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
  · have hC := hbase.mpr hp
    have hE : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T).signs R = true := hshared.symm.trans hC
    have hEpos := hend.mp hE
    have hDpos : 0 < M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ r := by
      have hDroot := (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff
        (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹).mpr hr
      rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hDroot with hdp | hdn
      · exact hdp
      · exact False.elim (lt_asymm hEpos (hsub r hr hp hdn))
    exact (hmid.mpr hDpos).trans hC.symm
  · have hC : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R = false := by
      cases hc : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R
      · rfl
      · exact False.elim (lt_asymm (hbase.mp hc) hn)
    have hE : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T).signs R = false := hshared.symm.trans hC
    have hD : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).signs R = false := by
      cases hd : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).signs R
      · rfl
      · have hdp := hmid.mp hd
        have hnr : -r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots :=
          M.toCoxeterSystem.neg_mem_geometricRoots_iff.mpr hr
        have hnd : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹
            (-r) < 0 := by simpa only [map_neg, neg_lt_zero] using hdp
        have hnf := hsub (-r) hnr (neg_pos.mpr hn) hnd
        have hfp : 0 < M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation
            (rawRelativeTransport M L T)⁻¹ r := by
          simpa only [map_neg, neg_lt_zero] using hnf
        have hetrue := hend.mpr hfp
        rw [hE] at hetrue
        contradiction
    exact hD.trans hC.symm

/-- Essential surjectivity uses the genuine counit isomorphism, not a
purported strict surjectivity of the upstairs equivalence on objects. -/
theorem comparisonFunctor_essSurj : (comparisonFunctor S U E hE).EssSurj := by
  let B := comparisonFunctor S U E hE
  have sq : F ⋙ B = E.functor ⋙ P := comparison_square S U E hE
  change B.EssSurj
  constructor
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := U.obj_surjective y
  let c := E.inverse.obj x
  have hc : B.obj (F.obj c) = P.obj (E.functor.obj c) := Functor.congr_obj sq c
  exact ⟨F.obj c, ⟨eqToIso hc ≪≫ P.mapIso (E.counitIso.app x)⟩⟩

theorem comparisonFunctor_faithful (hobj : Function.Injective E.functor.obj) :

  let B := comparisonFunctor S U E hE
  change B.Faithful
  constructor
  intro d e f g h
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := S.obj_surjective d
  have hs : mapOutgoing B (F.obj c) ⟨e, f⟩ = mapOutgoing B (F.obj c) ⟨e, g⟩ :=
    congrArg (fun k : B.obj (F.obj c) ⟶ B.obj e =>
      (⟨B.obj e, k⟩ : Outgoing Y (B.obj (F.obj c)))) h
  have ho := comparison_outgoing_injective_at S U E hE hobj c hs
  exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj ho).2

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.comparisonFunc.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.comparisonFunctor_full
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.comparisonFunc.source_declaration:
/-- Fullness uses a literal outgoing lift downstairs and literal fiber
transitivity to bring its endpoint into the image of the upstairs equivalence. -/
theorem comparisonFunctor_full : (comparisonFunctor S U E hE).Full := by
  let B := comparisonFunctor S U E hE
  have sq : F ⋙ B = E.functor ⋙ P := comparison_square S U E hE
  change B.Full
  constructor
  intro d e γ
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := S.obj_surjective d
  obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := S.obj_surjective e
  let hc : B.obj (F.obj c) = P.obj (E.functor.obj c) := Functor.congr_obj sq c
  let hc' : B.obj (F.obj c') = P.obj (E.functor.obj c') := Functor.congr_obj sq c'
  let γ' : P.obj (E.functor.obj c) ⟶ P.obj (E.functor.obj c') :=
    eqToHom hc.symm ≫ γ ≫ eqToHom hc'
  obtain ⟨⟨z, φ⟩, hφ⟩ := (U.covering (E.functor.obj c)).surjective
    ⟨P.obj (E.functor.obj c'), γ'⟩
  have hz : P.obj z = P.obj (E.functor.obj c') := (Sigma.mk.inj hφ).1
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := U.fiber_transitive (E.functor.obj c') z hz.symm
  have he : E.functor.obj ((A.functor q).obj c') = z :=
    (Functor.congr_obj (hE q) c').trans hq
  let δ : c ⟶ (A.functor q).obj c' := E.functor.preimage (φ ≫ eqToHom he.symm)
  have hδ : E.functor.map δ = φ ≫ eqToHom he.symm := E.functor.map_preimage _
  let ht : F.obj ((A.functor q).obj c') = F.obj c' := Functor.congr_obj (S.invariant q) c'
  let α : F.obj c ⟶ F.obj c' := F.map δ ≫ eqToHom ht
  refine ⟨α, eq_of_heq ?_⟩
  have hBcast : HEq (B.map α) (B.map (F.map δ)) := by
    dsimp only [α]
    rw [B.map_comp, eqToHom_map]
    exact comp_eqToHom_heq _ _
  have hsquare : HEq (B.map (F.map δ)) (P.map (E.functor.map δ)) :=
    Functor.hcongr_hom sq δ
  have hPcast : HEq (P.map (E.functor.map δ)) (P.map φ) := by
    rw [hδ, P.map_comp, eqToHom_map]
    exact comp_eqToHom_heq _ _
  have hγ : HEq γ' γ := by
    dsimp only [γ']
    exact (eqToHom_comp_heq _ _).trans (comp_eqToHom_heq _ _)
  exact hBcast.trans (hsquare.trans (hPcast.trans ((Sigma.mk.inj hφ).2.trans hγ)))

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.componentRibbo.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.componentRibbonFunctor_isCovering
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.componentRibbo.source_declaration:
/-- The same actual covering with its target restricted to the proved full
associate component. No arrows or objects are supplied by a covering axiom. -/
theorem componentRibbonFunctor_isCovering : IsCoveringFunctor (componentRibbonFunctor M J) := by
  let G := intervalRibbonFunctor M J
  let F := componentRibbonFunctor M J
  let incl := (reducedAssociateProperty M J).ι
  intro X
  constructor
  · intro p q hpq
    apply (intervalRibbonFunctor_isCovering M J X).injective
    exact congrArg (mapOutgoing incl (F.obj X)) hpq
  · rintro ⟨Y, β⟩

    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (intervalRibbonFunctor_isCovering M J X).surjective p
    have ho : F.obj q.1 = Y := by
      apply ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.ext
      exact congrArg Sigma.fst hq
    subst Y

    have heF : F.map q.2 = β := ObjectProperty.hom_ext (reducedAssociateProperty M J) he

    (componentRibbonFunctor M J).obj (intervalObject C) =
        (componentRibbonFunctor M J).obj (intervalObject D) ↔
      actualChamberIndices M J C = actualChamberIndices M J D := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact congrArg (fun X : AssociateReducedRibbonObject M J => X.obj.val.indices) h
  · intro h
    apply ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.ext
    change actualRibbonObject M ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩ =
      actualRibbonObject M ⟨actualChamberIndices M J D⟩
    rw [h]

/-- The fiber statement on all objects of the actual interval groupoid,
in the strict form needed for the later quotient-cover comparison. -/
theorem componentRibbonFunctor_obj_eq_iff_exists_action
    (X Y : IntervalGroupoid (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)) :
    (componentRibbonFunctor M J).obj X = (componentRibbonFunctor M J).obj Y ↔
      ∃ q : Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J, (intervalAction M J q).obj X = Y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : (componentRibbonFunctor M J).obj (intervalObject (intervalChamber X)) =
        (componentRibbonFunctor M J).obj (intervalObject (intervalChamber Y)) := by
      simpa only [intervalObject_intervalChamber] using h
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (componentRibbonFunctor_obj_eq_iff_exists_smul M J
      (intervalChamber X) (intervalChamber Y)).mp h'
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    rw [intervalAction_obj, hq, intervalObject_intervalChamber]
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    have hch : q • intervalChamber X = intervalChamber Y := by
      simpa only [intervalAction_obj, intervalChamber_intervalObject] using
        congrArg intervalChamber hq
    have h' := (componentRibbonFunctor_obj_eq_iff_exists_smul M J
      (intervalChamber X) (intervalChamber Y)).mpr ⟨q, hch⟩
    simpa only [intervalObject_intervalChamber] using h'

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.conjugacy_dual.source_declaration:
theorem conjugacy_dualAction_mem_flat (M : CoxeterMatrix I) {K J : Set I} {w : M.Group}
    (hw : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M J) {φ : Dual I} (hφ : φ ∈ relativeSubspace K) :
    dualAction M w φ ∈ relativeSubspace J := by
  apply (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M J _).mpr
  intro g hg
  rw [← hw] at hg
  obtain ⟨h, hh, he⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hg
  have hfix := (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M K φ).mp hφ h hh
  change w * h * w⁻¹ = g at he
  rw [← he]
  calc
    dualAction M (w * h * w⁻¹) (dualAction M w φ) =
        dualAction M w (dualAction M h φ) := by
      simp only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul]
      congr 2
      group
    _ = dualAction M w φ := by rw [hfix]

theorem conjugacy_symm (M : CoxeterMatrix I) {K J : Set I} {w : M.Group}
    (hw : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M J) :
    (Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).map (MulAut.conj w⁻¹).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M K := by
  rw [← hw, Subgroup.map_map]
  have he : (MulAut.conj w⁻¹).toMonoidHom.comp (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      MonoidHom.id M.Group := by
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    change w⁻¹ * (w * g * w⁻¹) * (w⁻¹)⁻¹ = g
    simp [mul_assoc]
  rw [he, Subgroup.map_id]

/-- The actual reflection through an actual root has precisely its dual
evaluation hyperplane as its fixed locus. -/
theorem conjugate_simple_fixed_iff (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (a : M.Group) (i : I)
    (φ : Dual I) :
    dualAction M (a * M.simple i * a⁻¹) φ = φ ↔ φ (root M a i) = 0 := by
  have hc := (dualAction_stabilizer_conjugate M a⁻¹ φ (M.simple i)).symm
  simp only [inv_inv] at hc
  simpa only [dualAction_apply, inv_inv, root] using
    hc.trans (dualAction_simple_fixed_iff M i (dualAction M a⁻¹ φ))

/-- Retention rules out membership of the root's reflection in the standard
parabolic: that subgroup fixes every actual point of the relative flat. -/
theorem conjugate_simple_not_mem_parabolic_of_retained (M : CoxeterMatrix I)
    (J : Set I) (a : M.Group) (i : I) (hr : root M a i ∈ retainedRoots M J) :
    a * M.simple i * a⁻¹ ∉ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
  obtain ⟨_, ψ, hψ⟩ := hr
  intro ht
  have hfix := (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M J ψ.val).mp ψ.property _ ht
  exact hψ ((conjugate_simple_fixed_iff M a i ψ.val).mp hfix)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.connectedCompo.source_declaration:
/-- An open connected partition of a subset is precisely its connected-component
partition. Different labels may represent the same part. -/
theorem connectedComponentIn_eq_of_open_partition
    {E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] {L : Type*} (R : L → Set E) (U : Set E)
    (hopen : ∀ l, IsOpen (R l)) (hconn : ∀ l, IsPreconnected (R l))
    (hsub : ∀ l, R l ⊆ U) (hcover : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ l, x ∈ R l)
    (hmeet : ∀ l k, (R l ∩ R k).Nonempty → R l = R k)
    (l : L) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ R l) : connectedComponentIn U x = R l := by
  classical
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · let V : Set E := ⋃ k : {k : L // R k ≠ R l}, R k.val
    have hopenV : IsOpen V := isOpen_iUnion fun k => hopen k.val
    have hdisj : Disjoint (R l) V := by
      apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro y hyl hyV
      obtain ⟨k, hyk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hyV
      exact k.property (hmeet k.val l ⟨y, hyk, hyl⟩)
    have hcover' : connectedComponentIn U x ⊆ R l ∪ V := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨k, hyk⟩ := hcover y (connectedComponentIn_subset U x hy)
      by_cases he : R k = R l
      · exact Or.inl (he ▸ hyk)
      · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨k, he⟩, hyk⟩)
    exact isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.subset_left_of_subset_union
      (hopen l) hopenV hdisj hcover'
      ⟨x, mem_connectedComponentIn (hsub l hx), hx⟩
  · exact (hconn l).subset_connectedComponentIn hx (hsub l)

/-- Every realized sign piece is genuinely contractible in its actual
subspace topology. No finite dimension or sphericality assumption is used. -/
theorem contractibleSpace_tubeIntersectionPiece {F : Set (Chamber ℓ)}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) {ρ : H → Bool} (hne : (tubeIntersectionPiece F ρ).Nonempty) :
    ContractibleSpace ↥(tubeIntersectionPiece F ρ) := by
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hF
  obtain ⟨c0, hc0⟩ := C0.nonempty
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne
  apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).2
  exact ⟨TubeIntersections.centerAt F ρ C0 hC0 c0 hc0 p.val.1 hp.2,
    ⟨(TubeIntersections.imaginaryHomotopy F ρ C0 hC0 c0 hc0).trans
      (TubeIntersections.realHomotopy F ρ C0 hC0 c0 hc0 p.val.1 hp.2)⟩⟩

theorem convex_standardFacet (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I) :
    Convex ℝ (standardFacet M J) := by
  intro φ hφ ψ hψ a b ha hb hab
  refine ⟨(relativeSubspace J).add_mem ((relativeSubspace J).smul_mem a hφ.1)
    ((relativeSubspace J).smul_mem b hψ.1), ?_⟩

  change 0 < a * φ (simpleRoot i) + b * ψ (simpleRoot i)
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · subst a
    have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
    simpa [hb1] using hψ.2 i hi
  · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
      (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)) (hφ.2 i hi))
      (mul_nonneg hb (hψ.2 i hi).le)

/-- Every strictly invariant functor descends uniquely along the actual
covering with transitive object fibers. This is a proved quotient universal
property; it is not an assumption or a field of the action/cover data. -/
theorem coveringFunctor_descent_existsUnique
    (A : StrictGroupoidAction Q C) (F : C ⥤ D) (hcover : IsCoveringFunctor F)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective F.obj) (hF : ∀ q, A.functor q ⋙ F = F)
    (htrans : ∀ X Y, F.obj X = F.obj Y → ∃ q, (A.functor q).obj X = Y)
    (H : C ⥤ T) (hH : ∀ q, A.functor q ⋙ H = H) :
    ∃! desc : D ⥤ T, F ⋙ desc = H := by
  let S : CoverOrbitData A F := ⟨hcover, hsurj, hF, htrans⟩
  refine ⟨S.desc H hH, S.desc_fac H hH, ?_⟩
  intro G hG
  exact coveringFunctor_precomp_injective F hcover hsurj (hG.trans (S.desc_fac H hH).symm)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.coveringFuncto.source_declaration:
/-- A surjective-on-objects covering detects strict equality of functors
after precomposition, by lifting every outgoing arrow. -/
theorem coveringFunctor_precomp_injective (F : C ⥤ D) (hF : IsCoveringFunctor F)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective F.obj) :
    Function.Injective (fun G : D ⥤ T => F ⋙ G) := by
  intro G₁ G₂ h
  apply Functor.hext (fun d => by
    obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := hsurj d
    exact Functor.congr_obj h X)
  intro d e f
  obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := hsurj d
  obtain ⟨⟨Y, p⟩, hp⟩ := (hF X).surjective ⟨e, f⟩
  have hY := (Sigma.mk.inj hp).1
  cases hY
  have hf : F.map p = f := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj hp).2
  subst f
  exact Functor.hcongr_hom h p

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.dominant_trans.source_declaration:
/-- The actual closed dominant dual chamber meets each Coxeter orbit in at
most one point, for an arbitrary Coxeter matrix and arbitrary index universe. -/
theorem dominant_translate_eq (M : CoxeterMatrix I) {φ : Dual I}
    (hφ : IsDominant φ) (w : M.Group) (hw : IsDominant (dualAction M w φ)) :
    dualAction M w φ = φ := by
  have core : ∀ n (u : M.Group), M.toCoxeterSystem.length u = n →
      IsDominant (dualAction M u φ) → dualAction M u φ = φ := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | ind n ih =>
      intro u hn hu
      by_cases hu1 : u = 1
      · subst u
        simp
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := M.toCoxeterSystem.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hu1
      have hneg : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation u⁻¹ (simpleRoot i) < 0 :=
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff u⁻¹ i).2
          (M.toCoxeterSystem.isRightDescent_inv_iff.mpr hi)
      have hnonpos := evaluation_nonpos_of_nonpos hφ hneg.le
      have hzero : dualAction M u φ (simpleRoot i) = 0 :=
        le_antisymm hnonpos (hu i)
      have hsimple : dualAction M (M.simple i) (dualAction M u φ) = dualAction M u φ :=
        (dualAction_simple_fixed_iff M i (dualAction M u φ)).2 hzero
      have hshort : dualAction M (M.simple i * u) φ = dualAction M u φ := by
        rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, hsimple]
      have hlt : M.toCoxeterSystem.length (M.simple i * u) < n := by
        have hlen := M.toCoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hi
        change M.toCoxeterSystem.length (M.simple i * u) + 1 =
          M.toCoxeterSystem.length u at hlen
        omega
      have hshortDom : IsDominant (dualAction M (M.simple i * u) φ) := hshort.symm ▸ hu
      exact hshort.symm.trans (ih _ hlt (M.simple i * u) rfl hshortDom)
  exact core _ w rfl hw

on the vanishing simple coordinates of the starting point. -/
theorem dominant_translate_mem_parabolic (M : CoxeterMatrix I) {φ : Dual I}
    (hφ : IsDominant φ) (w : M.Group) (hw : IsDominant (dualAction M w φ)) :
    w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M (zeroIndices φ) :=

/-- Stabilizers of actual dual points transform by actual group conjugation. -/
theorem dualAction_stabilizer_conjugate (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (w : M.Group)
    (φ : Dual I) (g : M.Group) :
    dualAction M g (dualAction M w φ) = dualAction M w φ ↔
      dualAction M (w⁻¹ * g * w) φ = φ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hh := congrArg (dualAction M w⁻¹) h
    simpa only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel,
      map_one, one_apply_eq_self, mul_assoc] using hh
  · intro h
    apply (Representation.apply_bijective (dualAction M) w⁻¹).injective
    simpa only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel,
      map_one, one_apply_eq_self, mul_assoc] using h

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.elementaryMu_e.source_declaration:
/-- Each actual elementary ratio is itself the canonical simple positive
lift of its actual Coxeter projection. -/
theorem elementaryMu_eq_transporterPositiveLift (J : Set I) (a : I) :
    elementaryMu M J a = transporterPositiveLift M (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M J a)) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hp : elementaryMu M J a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
    Submonoid.closure_mono (Set.image_mono (Set.subset_univ (insert a J)))
      (elementaryMu_positive M J a)
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual] at hp
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hp
  have hfactor : positiveDelta M J * p = positiveDelta M (insert a J) := by
    apply positiveToParent_injective M
    rw [map_mul, positiveToParent_positiveDelta, positiveToParent_positiveDelta, hp]
    unfold elementaryMu
    group
  have hs := (positive_simple_factors M (positiveDelta M J) p
    (parabolicLongest M (insert a J)) hfactor).2
  have he : transporterPositiveLift M (positiveToCoxeter M p) = elementaryMu M J a := by
    change positiveToParent M (positiveSimpleLift M (positiveToCoxeter M p)) = _
    rw [← hs, hp]
  have hd : positiveToCoxeter M p = Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M J a) := by
    have h := congrArg (Artin.projection M) he
    simpa only [projection_transporterPositiveLift] using h
  rw [← hd]
  exact he.symm

    M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep J (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M J a))⁻¹ := by
  apply transporterPositiveLift_inv_minimal_of_leftReduced M
  rw [← elementaryMu_eq_transporterPositiveLift]

/-- The elementary Coxeter label is right-minimal for its actual endpoint,
including the empty/full parabolic edge cases. -/
theorem elementaryMu_projection_minimal (J : Set I) (a : I) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep (parabolicTwistImage M (insert a J) J)
      (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M J a)) := by
  have hd := actual_transporter_to_provider M
    (isRibbon_projection_transporter M (elementaryMu_isRibbon M J a))
  have h := minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter M.toCoxeterSystem
    (inverse_parabolic_transporter M.toCoxeterSystem hd)
    (elementaryMu_projection_inverse_minimal M J a)
  simpa only [inv_inv] using h

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.elementaryTarg.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.elementaryTargetLabel
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.elementaryTarg.source_declaration:
/-- The raw target of the actual elementary ribbon label, retaining its
proved index endpoint and using its actual Coxeter projection. -/
noncomputable def elementaryTargetLabel (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (a : I) :
    RawFacetLabel M J where
  indices := Ribbon2.parabolicTwistImage M (insert a L.indices) L.indices
  representative := L.representative * Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a)
  parabolic_conjugacy := by
    have hμ := isRibbon_projection_transporter M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu_isRibbon M L.indices a)
    have he : (MulAut.conj (L.representative *
        Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a))).toMonoidHom =
        (MulAut.conj L.representative).toMonoidHom.comp
          (MulAut.conj (Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a))).toMonoidHom := by
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro g
      change (L.representative * Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a)) * g *
          (L.representative * Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a))⁻¹ =
        L.representative * (Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a) * g *
          (Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a))⁻¹) * L.representative⁻¹
      group
    rw [he, ← Subgroup.map_map, hμ, L.parabolic_conjugacy]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_actualC.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_actualChamberIndices_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_actualC.source_declaration:
/-- Precisely the standard parabolics conjugate to the fixed parabolic occur
as chamber index sets. No transitivity of the normalizer quotient is assumed. -/
theorem exists_actualChamberIndices_iff (K : Set I) :
    (∃ C : ActualChamber M J, actualChamberIndices M J C = K) ↔
      ∃ w : M.Group, (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map
        (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom = Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hC⟩
    let L := Classical.choose (actualChamberOfRawLabel_surjective M J C)
    refine ⟨L.representative, ?_⟩
    have hLK : L.indices = K := hC
    rw [← hLK]
    exact L.parabolic_conjugacy
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    let L : RawFacetLabel M J := ⟨K, w, hw⟩
    exact ⟨actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L, actualChamberIndices_rawLabel M J L⟩

theorem exists_mem_actualTubeSet (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group]
    (J : Set I) (p : Complement M J) :
    ∃ C : ActualChamber M J, p ∈ actualTubeSet M J C := by
  change ∃ C : Chamber (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J),
    actualComplementHomeomorph M J p ∈ tubeSet C

    (actualComplementHomeomorph M J p)

theorem exists_mem_translatedFacet (φ : relativeSubspace J)
    (hφ : φ ∈ regularSet (actualForms M J)) :
    ∃ L : RawFacetLabel M J, φ ∈ translatedFacet L := by
  obtain ⟨K, w, hw, ψ, hψ, he⟩ := exists_standardFacet_transport M J φ
    ((mem_actual_regularSet_iff M J φ).mp hφ)
  exact ⟨⟨K, w, hw⟩, (mem_translatedFacet_iff _ φ).mpr ⟨ψ, hψ, he⟩⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_mem_tub.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_mem_tubeSet
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_mem_tub.source_declaration:
/-- Every actual complement point belongs to the tube of a realized chamber. -/
theorem exists_mem_tubeSet [Finite H] (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) :
    ∃ C : Chamber ℓ, p ∈ tubeSet C := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_regular_imag_add_smul_real ℓ p
  let c := p.val.2 + t • p.val.1
  let C := chamberOfRegular ℓ c ht
  have hc : c ∈ C.region := mem_chamberOfRegular_region ℓ c ht
  refine ⟨C, fun h hx => ?_⟩
  have heval : ℓ h c = ℓ h p.val.2 := by
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [map_add, map_smul, hx, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hsign := hc h
  change (if C.signs h then 0 < ℓ h c else ℓ h c < 0) at hsign
  change (if C.signs h then 0 < ℓ h p.val.2 else ℓ h p.val.2 < 0)
  rwa [heval] at hsign

/-- The preceding interval identities hold throughout an actual open
neighborhood, not merely at a chosen nearby regular point. -/
theorem exists_open_faceChamber_intervals [Finite H] {z : E} {C D : Chamber ℓ}
    (hzero : ∀ h, ℓ h z = 0 → C.signs h = D.signs h) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ z ∈ U ∧ ∀ z' ∈ U,
      ChamberBetween (faceChamber ℓ z' C) (faceChamber ℓ z C) C ∧
        ChamberBetween (faceChamber ℓ z' C) (faceChamber ℓ z C) D :=
  ⟨nonzeroSignRegion ℓ z, isOpen_nonzeroSignRegion ℓ z, mem_nonzeroSignRegion_self ℓ z,
    fun _ hz' => faceChamber_between_of_mem_nonzeroSignRegion ℓ hzero hz'⟩
