ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_open_fa.source_declaration:
/-- Each actual real overlap point has an open neighborhood on which its
interval connector is constant. No adjacency or gallery topology is assumed. -/
theorem exists_open_faceIntervalConnector_constant_of_overlap [Finite H]
    {z : E} {C D : Chamber ℓ} {ρ : H → Bool}
    (hz : z ∈ overlapRealRegion ({C, D} : Set (Chamber ℓ)) ρ) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ z ∈ U ∧ ∀ z' ∈ U,
      faceIntervalConnector ℓ z' C D = faceIntervalConnector ℓ z C D :=
  ⟨nonzeroSignRegion ℓ z, isOpen_nonzeroSignRegion ℓ z, mem_nonzeroSignRegion_self ℓ z,
    fun _ hz' => faceIntervalConnector_eq_of_mem_nonzeroSignRegion ℓ
      (chamber_signs_agree_on_zero_of_overlap ℓ hz) hz'⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_pos_par.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_pos_parameter_preserving_signs
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_pos_par.source_declaration:
/-- One positive real parameter preserves all specified nonzero signs. -/
theorem exists_pos_parameter_preserving_signs [Finite H] (a b : H → ℝ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ h, a h ≠ 0 →
      (if 0 < a h then 0 < a h + ε * b h else a h + ε * b h < 0) := by
  classical
  let S : H → Set ℝ := fun h =>
    if a h = 0 then Set.univ else
      {t | if 0 < a h then 0 < a h + t * b h else a h + t * b h < 0}
  have hopen (h : H) : IsOpen (S h) := by
    have hf : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => a h + t * b h) :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)
    by_cases hz : a h = 0
    · simp only [S, ite_eq_left hz]
      exact isOpen_univ
    · by_cases hp : 0 < a h
      · simpa only [S, ite_eq_right hz, ite_eq_left hp] using isOpen_lt continuous_const hf
      · simpa only [S, ite_eq_right hz, ite_eq_right hp] using isOpen_lt hf continuous_const
  have hzero (h : H) : (0 : ℝ) ∈ S h := by
    by_cases hz : a h = 0
    · simp [S, hz]
    · by_cases hp : 0 < a h
      · simp [S, hz, hp]
      · have hn : a h < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hp) hz
        simpa only [S, ite_eq_right hz, ite_eq_right hp, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, zero_mul, add_zero] using hn
  have hUopen : IsOpen (⋂ h, S h) := isOpen_iInter_of_finite hopen
  have hUzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ ⋂ h, S h := Set.mem_iInter.2 hzero
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hUopen 0 hUzero
  have heps : δ / 2 ∈ ⋂ h, S h := hball (by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < δ / 2)]
    linarith)
  refine ⟨δ / 2, by linarith, fun h hn => ?_⟩
  have hs := Set.mem_iInter.1 heps h
  simpa only [S, ite_eq_right hn, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using hs

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_regular.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_regular_imag_add_smul_real
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_regular.source_declaration:
/-- A complement point has a real regular linear combination of its real
and imaginary parts. Only finitely many scalar parameters are excluded. -/
theorem exists_regular_imag_add_smul_real [Finite H] (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, p.val.2 + t • p.val.1 ∈ regularSet ℓ := by
  classical
  let bad : H → ℝ := fun h => -(ℓ h p.val.2) / ℓ h p.val.1
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (Set.finite_range bad).exists_notMem
  refine ⟨t, fun h hzero => ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hzero
  by_cases hx : ℓ h p.val.1 = 0
  · apply p.property h
    exact ⟨hx, by simpa only [hx, mul_zero, add_zero] using hzero⟩
  · apply ht
    refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [bad]
    apply (div_eq_iff hx).2
    linarith

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_standar.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_standardFacet_transport
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.exists_standar.source_declaration:
/-- A regular point belongs to a transported standard facet whose actual
standard parabolic is conjugated onto the parabolic of the ambient flat. -/
theorem exists_standardFacet_transport (φ : relativeSubspace J)
    (hφ : realRelativeRegular M J φ) :
    ∃ (K : Set I) (w : M.Group),
      (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
        Artin.coxeterParabolic M J ∧
      φ.val ∈ dualAction M w '' standardFacet M K := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_dominant_dualAction M φ.val
  let ψ := dualAction M u φ.val
  let K := zeroIndices ψ
  have hψ : ψ ∈ standardFacet M K := mem_standardFacet_zeroIndices hu
  refine ⟨K, u⁻¹, ?_, ψ, hψ, ?_⟩
  · ext g
    rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply, inv_inv]
    rw [← dominant_fixed_iff M hu, ← realRelativeRegular_fixed_iff M J φ hφ g]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hc := congrArg (fun f : Dual I => dualAction M u⁻¹ f) h
      simp only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul] at hc
      simpa only [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left, mul_inv_cancel_left, inv_mul_cancel,
        mul_one,
        map_one, one_apply_eq_self] using hc
    · intro h
      have hc := congrArg (fun f : Dual I => dualAction M u f) h
      simp only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul]
      simpa only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel,
        mul_one] using hc
  · dsimp only [ψ]
    rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, one_apply_eq_self]

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

/-- The canonical realized chamber `x ∘ C`, specified by its signs. -/
noncomputable def faceChamber [Finite H] (x : E) (C : Chamber ℓ) : Chamber ℓ :=
  ⟨faceSigns ℓ x C, faceSigns_nonempty ℓ x C⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.faceChamber_be.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.faceChamber_between_of_mem_nonzeroSignRegion
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.faceChamber_be.source_declaration:
/-- Near `z`, a face projection at `z` lies in each of the two sign intervals
starting at the face projection at `z'`, provided the endpoint chambers agree
on every form vanishing at `z`. -/
theorem faceChamber_between_of_mem_nonzeroSignRegion [Finite H]
    {z z' : E} {C D : Chamber ℓ}
    (hzero : ∀ h, ℓ h z = 0 → C.signs h = D.signs h)
    (hz' : z' ∈ nonzeroSignRegion ℓ z) :
    ChamberBetween (faceChamber ℓ z' C) (faceChamber ℓ z C) C ∧
      ChamberBetween (faceChamber ℓ z' C) (faceChamber ℓ z C) D := by
  have hstable (h : H) (hh : ℓ h z ≠ 0) :
      (faceChamber ℓ z' C).signs h = (faceChamber ℓ z C).signs h := by
    have hs := hz' h hh
    have hne := signHalfSpace_nonzero hs
    rw [faceChamber_signs_nonzero ℓ z' C hne, faceChamber_signs_nonzero ℓ z C hh]
    exact decide_sign_of_mem_signHalfSpace (ℓ h) hs
  have key (F : Chamber ℓ) (hF : ∀ h, ℓ h z = 0 → C.signs h = F.signs h) :
      ChamberBetween (faceChamber ℓ z' C) (faceChamber ℓ z C) F := by
    intro h hshared
    by_cases hh : ℓ h z = 0
    · calc
        (faceChamber ℓ z C).signs h = C.signs h := faceChamber_signs_zero ℓ z C hh
        _ = F.signs h := hF h hh
        _ = (faceChamber ℓ z' C).signs h := hshared.symm
    · exact (hstable h hh).symm
  exact ⟨key C (fun _ _ => rfl), key D hzero⟩

theorem faceChamber_eq_of_signs_on_zero [Finite H] (x : E) (C D : Chamber ℓ)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.faceChamber_in.source_declaration:
/-- A real point in an actual two-tube overlap sign piece satisfies the
vanishing-form agreement needed by the local interval theorem. -/
theorem faceChamber_intervals_of_overlap [Finite H] {z z' : E} {C D : Chamber ℓ}
    {ρ : H → Bool} (hz : z ∈ overlapRealRegion ({C, D} : Set (Chamber ℓ)) ρ)
    (hz' : z' ∈ nonzeroSignRegion ℓ z) :

/-- At an actual common tube point, the face connectors satisfy the cocycle. -/
theorem faceIntervalConnector_cocycle {A B C : Chamber ℓ} {p : ComplexComplement ℓ}
    (hA : p ∈ tubeSet A) (hB : p ∈ tubeSet B) (_hC : p ∈ tubeSet C) :
    faceIntervalConnector ℓ p.val.1 A B ≫ faceIntervalConnector ℓ p.val.1 B C =
      faceIntervalConnector ℓ p.val.1 A C := by
  have hface := faceChamber_eq_of_mem_tubes ℓ hB hA
  have he := congrArg (fun F : Chamber ℓ =>
    inv (intervalPositive F B) ≫ intervalPositive F C) hface
  change faceIntervalConnector ℓ p.val.1 A B ≫
    (inv (intervalPositive (faceChamber ℓ p.val.1 B) B) ≫
      intervalPositive (faceChamber ℓ p.val.1 B) C) = _
  rw [he]
  simp [faceIntervalConnector, Category.assoc]

/-- The local interval identities cancel their common prefix, proving actual
equality of the overlap connectors in the presented interval groupoid. -/
theorem faceIntervalConnector_eq_of_mem_nonzeroSignRegion [Finite H]
    {z z' : E} {C D : Chamber ℓ}
    (hzero : ∀ h, ℓ h z = 0 → C.signs h = D.signs h)
    (hz' : z' ∈ nonzeroSignRegion ℓ z) :
    faceIntervalConnector ℓ z' C D = faceIntervalConnector ℓ z C D := by
  obtain ⟨hC, hD⟩ := faceChamber_between_of_mem_nonzeroSignRegion ℓ hzero hz'
  have h₁ := intervalPositive_comp (faceChamber ℓ z' C) (faceChamber ℓ z C) C hC
  have h₂ := intervalPositive_comp (faceChamber ℓ z' C) (faceChamber ℓ z C) D hD
  unfold faceIntervalConnector
  simp [h₁, h₂, Category.assoc]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.faceSigns_none.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.faceSigns_nonempty
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.faceSigns_none.source_declaration:
/-- A positive perturbation toward a realized chamber realizes the face signs. -/
theorem faceSigns_nonempty [Finite H] (x : E) (C : Chamber ℓ) :
    (signCell ℓ (faceSigns ℓ x C)).Nonempty := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := C.region_nonempty
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsign⟩ := exists_pos_parameter_preserving_signs (H := H)
    (fun h => ℓ h x) (fun h => ℓ h c)
  refine ⟨x + ε • c, fun h => ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : ℓ h x = 0
  · have hh := hc h
    cases hs : C.signs h
    · have hn : ℓ h c < 0 := by simpa only [signHalfSpace, hs, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using hh
      have hp := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hε hn
      simpa only [faceSigns, hz, ite_eq_left, hs, signHalfSpace, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, zero_add] using hp
    · have hn : 0 < ℓ h c := by simpa only [signHalfSpace, hs, ↓reduceIte,
        Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using hh
      have hp := mul_pos hε hn
      simpa only [faceSigns, hz, ite_eq_left, hs, signHalfSpace, ↓reduceIte,
        Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, zero_add] using hp
  · have hh := hsign h hz
    by_cases hp : 0 < ℓ h x
    · simpa only [faceSigns, ite_eq_right hz, decide_eq_true hp, signHalfSpace, ↓reduceIte,
        Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ite_eq_left hp] using hh
    · simpa only [faceSigns, ite_eq_right hz, decide_eq_false hp, signHalfSpace, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ite_eq_right hp] using hh

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.facetFlatEquiv.source_declaration:
/-- Actual action transport of the relative flats. -/
noncomputable def facetFlatEquiv {M : CoxeterMatrix I} {J : Set I} (L : RawFacetLabel M J) :
    relativeSubspace L.indices ≃L[ℝ] relativeSubspace J where
  toLinearEquiv :=
    { toFun := fun φ => ⟨dualAction M L.representative φ.val,
        conjugacy_dualAction_mem_flat M L.parabolic_conjugacy φ.property⟩
      invFun := fun φ => ⟨dualAction M L.representative⁻¹ φ.val,
        conjugacy_dualAction_mem_flat M (conjugacy_symm M L.parabolic_conjugacy) φ.property⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro φ
        apply Subtype.ext
        change dualAction M L.representative⁻¹ (dualAction M L.representative φ.val) = φ.val
        rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
      right_inv := by
        intro φ
        apply Subtype.ext
        change dualAction M L.representative (dualAction M L.representative⁻¹ φ.val) = φ.val
        rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
      map_add' := fun φ ψ => Subtype.ext (map_add (dualAction M L.representative) φ.val ψ.val)
      map_smul' := fun c φ => Subtype.ext (map_smul (dualAction M L.representative) c φ.val) }
  continuous_toFun :=
    ((continuous_dualAction M L.representative).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
  continuous_invFun :=
    ((continuous_dualAction M L.representative⁻¹).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _

/-- The fiber index bijection of an actual Coxeter transporter, with inverse
given by its actual inverse and the proved reverse parabolic conjugacy. -/
noncomputable def fiberEquiv {X Y : RibbonObject M} (w : M.Group)
    (hw : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y.indices).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices) : ChamberFiber M J X ≃ ChamberFiber M J Y where
  toFun := fiberTarget M J w hw
  invFun := fiberTarget M J w⁻¹ (conjugacy_symm M hw)
  left_inv C := by
    rw [fiberTarget_comp]
    simpa only [mul_inv_cancel] using fiberTarget_one M J _ C
  right_inv C := by
    rw [fiberTarget_comp]
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel] using fiberTarget_one M J _ C

  ⟨actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (fiberTargetLabel M J w hw C),

    (hw : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y.indices).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices) (C : ChamberFiber M J X) : RawFacetLabel M J :=

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.fiberTarget_co.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.fiberTarget_comp
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.fiberTarget_co.source_declaration:
theorem fiberTarget_comp {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} (u v : M.Group)
    (hu : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y.indices).map (MulAut.conj u).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices)
    (hv : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Z.indices).map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y.indices) (C : ChamberFiber M J X) :
    fiberTarget M J v hv (fiberTarget M J u hu C) =
      fiberTarget M J (u * v) (transporter_comp M hu hv) C := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  let L := fiberTargetLabel M J u hu C
  have hchosen : actualChamberOfRawLabel M J
      (chamberRawLabel M J (fiberTarget M J u hu C).val) = actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L :=
    chamberRawLabel_chamber M J _
  have he := rightTransportRawLabel_independent M J hchosen Z.indices v
    (by simpa only [chamberRawLabel_indices, (fiberTarget M J u hu C).property] using hv) hv
  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (fiberTargetLabel M J v hv (fiberTarget M J u hu C)) = _
  refine he.trans ?_
  congr 1
  apply rawFacetLabel_ext M J
  · rfl
  · dsimp [L, fiberTargetLabel, rightTransportRawLabel]
    group

theorem fiberTarget_one {X : RibbonObject M}
    (h1 : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices).map (MulAut.conj (1 : M.Group)).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices) (C : ChamberFiber M J X) :
    fiberTarget M J 1 h1 C = C := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he : fiberTargetLabel M J 1 h1 C = chamberRawLabel M J C.val := by
    apply rawFacetLabel_ext M J
    · exact C.property.symm
    · dsimp [fiberTargetLabel, rightTransportRawLabel]
      exact mul_one _
  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (fiberTargetLabel M J 1 h1 C) = C.val
  rw [he, chamberRawLabel_chamber]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.fiberTarget_re.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.fiberTarget_relativeTransport
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.fiberTarget_re.source_declaration:
/-- Transport by the canonical relative element has precisely the actual
target chamber, not merely a chamber with the same index set. -/
theorem fiberTarget_relativeTransport (C D : ActualChamber M J) :
    (fiberTarget M J (X := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩) (Y := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J D⟩)
      (relativeTransport M J C D) (relativeTransport_conjugacy M J C D)
      (⟨C, rfl⟩ : ChamberFiber M J ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩)).val = D := by
  let L := chamberRawLabel M J C
  let K := chamberRawLabel M J D
  have hlabel : fiberTargetLabel M J
      (X := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩) (Y := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J D⟩)
      (relativeTransport M J C D)
      (relativeTransport_conjugacy M J C D)
      (⟨C, rfl⟩ : ChamberFiber M J ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩) =
        relativeTargetLabel M L K := by
    apply rawFacetLabel_ext M J
    · rfl
    · rfl
  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (fiberTargetLabel M J _ _ _) = D
  rw [hlabel]
  have he : actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (relativeTargetLabel M L K) =
      actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K :=
    (actualChamberOfRawLabel_eq_iff M J _ _).mpr
      ((translatedFacet_eq_iff _ _).mp (relativeTargetLabel_region M L K))
  exact he.trans (chamberRawLabel_chamber M J D)

theorem intervalAction_mul (q r : Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J) :
    intervalAction M J (q * r) = intervalAction M J r ⋙ intervalAction M J q := by
  symm
  apply (intervalActionData M J (q * r)).extensionFunctor_unique
    (intervalActionData_respects M J (q * r))
  · funext X
    simp only [Functor.comp_obj, intervalAction_obj, intervalChamber_intervalObject,
      intervalActionData, mul_smul]
  · intro C D
    change HEq ((intervalAction M J q).map (intervalPositive (r • C) (r • D)))
      (intervalPositive ((q * r) • C) ((q * r) • D))
    rw [intervalAction_positive, mul_smul, mul_smul]
    rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalFuncto.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalFunctor_ext
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalFuncto.source_declaration:
/-- Equality on objects and positive generators determines the full functor. -/
theorem intervalFunctor_ext (F G : IntervalGroupoid ℓ ⥤ T)
    (hobj : ∀ X, F.obj X = G.obj X)
    (hpos : ∀ C D, HEq (F.map (intervalPositive C D)) (G.map (intervalPositive C D))) :
    F = G := by
  let A : IntervalGeneratorData ℓ T :=
    { obj C := G.obj (intervalObject C)
      positive C D := G.map (intervalPositive C D) }
  have hA : A.RespectsIntervals := by
    constructor
    · intro C
      change G.map (intervalPositive C C) = 𝟙 _
      rw [intervalPositive_self, G.map_id]
    · intro C D K h
      change G.map (intervalPositive C K) =
        G.map (intervalPositive C D) ≫ G.map (intervalPositive D K)
      rw [intervalPositive_comp C D K h, G.map_comp]
  have hGobj : G.obj = fun X => A.obj (intervalChamber X) := by
    funext X
    dsimp only [A]
    rw [intervalObject_intervalChamber]
  have hFobj : F.obj = fun X => A.obj (intervalChamber X) :=
    (funext hobj).trans hGobj
  exact (A.extensionFunctor_unique hA F hFobj hpos).trans
    (A.extensionFunctor_unique hA G hGobj (fun _ _ => HEq.rfl)).symm

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalLiftRe.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalLiftRecovers
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalLiftRe.source_declaration:
/-- Recovery holds for every signed arrow of the actual interval groupoid,
not only the positive intervals used in its presentation. -/
theorem intervalLiftRecovers
    {X Y : IntervalGroupoid (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)} (δ : X ⟶ Y) :
    IntervalLiftRecovers M J δ := by
  induction δ using CategoryTheory.Quotient.induction with
  | h f =>
    induction f using Quiver.FreeGroupoid.hom_rec with
    | @of_map X Y e =>
      rcases X with ⟨C⟩
      rcases Y with ⟨D⟩
      have he : e = (PUnit.unit :
          (⟨C⟩ : IntervalVertex (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)) ⟶
          (⟨D⟩ : IntervalVertex (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J))) :=
        @Subsingleton.elim PUnit inferInstance e PUnit.unit
      subst e
      exact intervalLiftRecovers_positive M J C D
    | @inv_of_map X Y e =>
      rcases X with ⟨C⟩
      rcases Y with ⟨D⟩
      have he : e = (PUnit.unit :
          (⟨C⟩ : IntervalVertex (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)) ⟶
          (⟨D⟩ : IntervalVertex (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J))) :=
        @Subsingleton.elim PUnit inferInstance e PUnit.unit
      subst e
      rw [(CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor
        (IntervalRelation (E := relativeSubspace J) (ℓ := actualForms M J))).map_inv]
      change FamilyRecovery.Recovers
        ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J ⋙ ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (inv (intervalPositive C D))) _ _ _
      rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_inv]
      exact FamilyRecovery.inverse (intervalLiftRecovers_positive M J C D)
    | id X =>
      change FamilyRecovery.Recovers
        ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J ⋙ ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (𝟙 _)) _ _ _
      rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
      exact FamilyRecovery.identity _
    | @comp X Y Z f g hf hg =>
      let Q := CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor
        (IntervalRelation (E := relativeSubspace J) (ℓ := actualForms M J))
      exact intervalLiftRecovers_comp M J
        (X := Q.obj X) (Y := Q.obj Y) (Z := Q.obj Z)
        (f := Q.map f) (g := Q.map g) hf hg

    intervalAction M J q ⋙ intervalRibbonFunctor M J = intervalRibbonFunctor M J := by

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalRibbon.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalRibbonFunctor_object_associate
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.intervalRibbon.source_declaration:
/-- The object image lies in the actual parabolic-associate component of
`J`; no surjectivity onto unrelated components is asserted. -/
theorem intervalRibbonFunctor_object_associate (C : ActualChamber M J) :
    ParabolicAssociate M (actualChamberIndices M J C) J := by
  let L := chamberRawLabel M J C
  refine ⟨L.representative⁻¹, ?_⟩
  intro a
  change a ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices ↔

    (hbet : ChamberBetween C D E) :

      intervalRibbonPositive M J C D ≫ intervalRibbonPositive M J D E := by
  classical
  let : Finite I := finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  change transporterPositiveLift M (relativeTransport M J C E) =
    transporterPositiveLift M (relativeTransport M J C D) *
      transporterPositiveLift M (relativeTransport M J D E)

        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (relativeTransport M J D E) := by
    rw [← relativeTransport_comp_of_between M J hbet]
    exact relativeTransport_length_of_between M J hbet
  rw [relativeTransport_comp_of_between M J hbet]
  unfold transporterPositiveLift
  rw [positiveSimpleLift_mul M _ _ hlen, map_mul]

/-- A positive inversion root of a representative left-minimal at `K`
cannot vanish on the whole actual relative flat. -/
theorem inversionRoot_retained {K : Set I} {d : M.Group}
    (hmin : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep K d⁻¹)
    {r : Vector I} (hr : r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots) (hp : 0 < r)
    (hn : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ r < 0) :
    r ∈ retainedRoots M K := by
  have hroot : r ∈ roots M := by
    obtain ⟨w, i, he⟩ := M.toCoxeterSystem.mem_geometricRoots.mp hr
    exact ⟨w, i, he⟩
  refine ⟨hroot, ⟨canonicalDominant K, canonicalDominant_mem_relativeSubspace K⟩, ?_⟩
  intro hz
  have hs := canonical_eval_zero_support K hp.le hz
  have hgens : ∀ i ∈ K,
      0 ≤ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ (simpleRoot i) := by
    intro i hi
    exact ((M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_single_pos_iff d⁻¹ i).mpr
      (M.toCoxeterSystem.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hmin i hi)).le
  exact (representation_nonneg_of_supported M d⁻¹ K hgens hp.le hs).not_gt hn

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.isCoveringFunc.source_declaration:
/-- A genuine covering map induces unique outgoing-arrow lifting on the
actual Mathlib fundamental groupoids, including uniqueness of the endpoint. -/
theorem isCoveringFunctor_fundamentalGroupoid_map {p : E → X} (hp : IsCoveringMap p) :
    IsCoveringFunctor (FundamentalGroupoid.map ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩) := by
  intro e
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨y⟩, γ⟩ ⟨⟨z⟩, δ⟩ h
    have hyz : y = z := by
      have h' := congrArg (fun a : Outgoing (FundamentalGroupoid X)
          ((FundamentalGroupoid.map ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩).obj e) =>
        (hp.monodromy a.2 ⟨e.as, rfl⟩).val) h
      change (hp.monodromy (γ.map ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩) ⟨e.as, rfl⟩).val =
        (hp.monodromy (δ.map ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩) ⟨e.as, rfl⟩).val at h'
      simpa only [hp.monodromy_map] using h'
    subst z
    apply congrArg (fun a : e ⟶ FundamentalGroupoid.mk y =>
      (⟨FundamentalGroupoid.mk y, a⟩ : Outgoing (FundamentalGroupoid E) e))
    apply hp.injective_path_homotopic_map e.as y
    exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2
  · rintro ⟨⟨y⟩, γ⟩
    let ey := hp.monodromy γ ⟨e.as, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨FundamentalGroupoid.mk ey.val, hp.liftPathQuotient γ ⟨e.as, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    have hey : p ey.val = y := ey.property
    apply Sigma.ext
    · exact congrArg (fun x : X => FundamentalGroupoid.mk x) hey
    · change HEq ((hp.liftPathQuotient γ ⟨e.as, rfl⟩).map ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩) γ
      rw [hp.map_liftPathQuotient]
      exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.cast_heq rfl hey

theorem landmark_3 :
    (actualIntervalForward M J).IsEquivalence ∧
    IsCoveringFunctor (componentRibbonFunctor M J) ∧
    IsCoveringFunctor (orbitFundamentalGroupoidFunctor M J) ∧
    (∀ q : Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J,
      (actualIntervalGroupoidAction M J).functor q ⋙ actualIntervalForward M J =
        actualIntervalForward M J ⋙ (actualFundamentalGroupoidAction M J).functor q) ∧
    Nonempty (AssociateReducedRibbonObject M J ≌
      FundamentalGroupoid (OrbitSpace M J)) ∧
    (componentRibbonFunctor M J ⋙ (actualRibbonOrbitEquivalence M J).functor =
      actualIntervalForward M J ⋙ orbitFundamentalGroupoidFunctor M J) ∧
    Nonempty (IsColimit (actualRibbonOrbitData M J).orbitCocone) ∧
    Nonempty (IsColimit (actualSpaceOrbitData M J).orbitCocone) :=
  ⟨actualIntervalForward_isEquivalence M J,
    componentRibbonFunctor_isCovering M J,
    isCoveringFunctor_orbitFundamentalGroupoidFunctor M J,
    actualComparison_equivariant M J,
    ⟨actualRibbonOrbitEquivalence M J⟩,
    actualComparison_square M J,
    ⟨actualRibbonOrbitIsColimit M J⟩,
    ⟨actualSpaceOrbitIsColimit M J⟩⟩

      M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ r < 0 →
      M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation f⁻¹ r < 0) :

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.length_eq_add_.source_declaration:
/-- Inversion inclusion for the actual geometric roots implies that `d` is
an initial factor of `f` with additive Coxeter lengths. -/
theorem length_eq_add_of_rootInversions_subset_system (cs : CoxeterSystem M W)
    (d f : W)
    (hsub : ∀ r ∈ cs.geometricRoots, 0 < r →
      cs.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ r < 0 → cs.geometricRepresentation f⁻¹ r < 0) :
    cs.length f = cs.length d + cs.length (d⁻¹ * f) := by
  induction hn : cs.length d using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing d f with
  | ind n ih =>
    by_cases hd : d = 1
    · subst d
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by simpa using hn.symm
      simp [hn0]
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hd
    have hdi : cs.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ (Finsupp.single i 1) < 0 :=
      (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff d⁻¹ i).2
        (cs.isRightDescent_inv_iff.2 hi)
    have hα : (0 : I →₀ ℝ) < Finsupp.single i 1 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one)
        (Finsupp.single_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero).symm
    have hfi : cs.IsLeftDescent f i :=
      cs.isRightDescent_inv_iff.1 ((cs.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff f⁻¹ i).1
        (hsub _ (cs.single_mem_geometricRoots i) hα hdi))
    have hnew : ∀ r ∈ cs.geometricRoots, 0 < r →
        cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple i * d)⁻¹ r < 0 →
        cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple i * f)⁻¹ r < 0 := by
      intro r hr hpos hneg
      have hne : r ≠ Finsupp.single i 1 := by
        intro heq
        subst r
        have he : cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple i * d)⁻¹ (Finsupp.single i 1) =
            -cs.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ (Finsupp.single i 1) := by
          rw [mul_inv_rev, cs.inv_simple, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp,
            cs.geometricRepresentation_simple, M.geometricReflection_apply_single_self, map_neg]
        rw [he] at hneg
        exact (neg_pos.mpr hdi).not_gt hneg
      have hr' : M.geometricReflection i r ∈ cs.geometricRoots :=
        (cs.geometricReflection_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff i).2 hr
      have hp' : 0 < M.geometricReflection i r :=
        cs.geometricReflection_pos_of_mem_geometricRoots hr hpos hne
      have hd' : cs.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ (M.geometricReflection i r) < 0 := by
        simpa only [mul_inv_rev, cs.inv_simple, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp,
          cs.geometricRepresentation_simple] using hneg
      have hf' := hsub _ hr' hp' hd'
      simpa only [mul_inv_rev, cs.inv_simple, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp,
        cs.geometricRepresentation_simple] using hf'
    have hld : cs.length (cs.simple i * d) + 1 = cs.length d :=
      cs.isLeftDescent_iff.1 hi
    have hlf : cs.length (cs.simple i * f) + 1 = cs.length f :=
      cs.isLeftDescent_iff.1 hfi
    have hind := ih (cs.length (cs.simple i * d)) (by omega)
      (cs.simple i * d) (cs.simple i * f) hnew rfl
    have hcancel : (cs.simple i * d)⁻¹ * (cs.simple i * f) = d⁻¹ * f := by
      rw [mul_inv_rev, cs.inv_simple, mul_assoc, cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
    rw [hcancel] at hind
    omega

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.lifting_wordIm.source_declaration:
/-- Each actual atomic word evaluating to a simple lift acts by one
positive interval arrow at every chamber in its actual source fiber. -/
theorem lifting_wordImage_of_simple {X Y : RibbonObject M} (p : AtomicWord M X Y)
    (hs : ∃ d : M.Group, p.eval = transporterPositiveLift M d) :
    (ribbonLiftingData M J).wordImage p =
      positiveFiberHom M J (Artin.projection M p.eval) (isRibbon_projection_transporter M p.isRibbon) := by
  induction p with
  | nil X =>
    symm
    exact positiveFiberHom_one M J X _
  | @cons X Y a ha p ih =>
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hs
    have hμpos : elementaryMu M X.indices a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
      Submonoid.closure_mono (Set.image_mono (Set.subset_univ (insert a X.indices)))
        (elementaryMu_positive M X.indices a)
    have htotal : elementaryMu M X.indices a * p.eval = transporterPositiveLift M d := hd
    obtain ⟨hμ, hp⟩ := actual_simple_factors M hμpos p.positive htotal
    have hlen := actual_simple_factors_length M hμpos p.positive htotal
    have hcan : (AtomicWord.cons a ha p).eval =
        transporterPositiveLift M (Artin.projection M (AtomicWord.cons a ha p).eval) := by
      rw [hd, projection_transporterPositiveLift]
    have htotalmin := simple_reduced_projection_minimal M
      (AtomicWord.cons a ha p).isRibbon (AtomicWord.cons a ha p).leftReduced hcan
    have hμmin := elementaryMu_projection_minimal M X.indices a
    have hbet : ∀ C : ChamberFiber M J X,
        ChamberBetween C.val
          (fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M X.indices a))
            (isRibbon_projection_transporter M (elementaryMu_isRibbon M X.indices a)) C).val
          (fiberTarget M J
            (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M X.indices a) * Artin.projection M p.eval)
            (transporter_comp M
              (isRibbon_projection_transporter M (elementaryMu_isRibbon M X.indices a))
              (isRibbon_projection_transporter M p.isRibbon)) C).val := by
      intro C
      apply (chamberBetween_iff_relativeTransport_length M J _ _ _).mpr
      rw [relativeTransport_fiberTarget M J _ _ hμmin,
        relativeTransport_fiberTarget M J _ _ (by simpa only [AtomicWord.eval_cons, map_mul] using htotalmin)]
      simpa only [map_mul, inv_mul_cancel_left] using hlen
    rw [RibbonGeneratorData.wordImage_cons, ih ⟨_, hp⟩]
    symm
    change positiveFiberHom M J (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M X.indices a * p.eval)) _ =
      positiveFiberHom M J (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M X.indices a)) _ ≫
        positiveFiberHom M J (Artin.projection M p.eval) _
    simpa only [map_mul] using positiveFiberHom_comp M J
      (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M X.indices a)) (Artin.projection M p.eval)
      (isRibbon_projection_transporter M (elementaryMu_isRibbon M X.indices a))
      (isRibbon_projection_transporter M p.isRibbon) hbet

/-- Transported chamber regions are the images under the actual flat action. -/
theorem mem_transportedChamber_iff (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J)
    (C : ActualChamber M J) (x : relativeSubspace J) :
    normalizerRepresentation M J w x ∈ (transportedChamber M J w C).region ↔
      x ∈ C.region := by
  constructor
  · intro hx r
    have h := hx (retainedRootEquiv M J w r)
    change (if (transportedChamber M J w C).signs (retainedRootEquiv M J w r) then
      0 < actualForms M J (retainedRootEquiv M J w r) (normalizerFlatEquiv M J w x)
      else actualForms M J (retainedRootEquiv M J w r) (normalizerFlatEquiv M J w x) < 0) at h
    simpa only [transportedChamber_signs, actualForms_transport, signHalfSpace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using h
  · intro hx r
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := (retainedRootEquiv M J w).surjective r
    change (if (transportedChamber M J w C).signs (retainedRootEquiv M J w s) then
      0 < actualForms M J (retainedRootEquiv M J w s) (normalizerFlatEquiv M J w x)
      else actualForms M J (retainedRootEquiv M J w s) (normalizerFlatEquiv M J w x) < 0)
    simpa only [transportedChamber_signs, actualForms_transport, signHalfSpace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using hx s

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimalCosetRe.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimalCosetRep_transports_parabolic
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimalCosetRe.source_declaration:
/-- Choosing the canonical representative in the right parabolic coset
preserves the original transporter equality. -/
theorem minimalCosetRep_transports_parabolic {w : W}
    (hw : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J) :
    (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj (cs.minimalCosetRep K w)).toMonoidHom =
      cs.parabolic J := by
  let d := cs.minimalCosetRep K w
  let v := w⁻¹ * d
  have hv : v ∈ cs.parabolic K := cs.inv_mul_minimalCosetRep_mem K w
  have hnv : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic K :=
    Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mp ((cs.parabolic K).le_normalizer hv)
  have hdeq : d = w * v := by dsimp [v]; group
  have hc : (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom =
      (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom.comp (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom := by
    ext x
    change d * x * d⁻¹ = w * (v * x * v⁻¹) * w⁻¹
    rw [hdeq]
    group
  change (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J
  rw [hc, ← Subgroup.map_map, hnv, hw]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimal_inv_of.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.minimal_inv_of.source_declaration:
/-- The inverse is minimal for the other actual standard parabolic. -/
theorem minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter
    (hd : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J)
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep K d) : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d⁻¹ := by
  apply cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
  intro i hi hdesc
  have hleft := cs.isRightDescent_inv_iff.mp hdesc
  have hc : d⁻¹ * cs.simple i * d ∈ cs.parabolic K := by
    have hm := cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi
    rw [← hd, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hm
    exact hm
  have hlen := cs.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep hmin hc
  have heq : d * (d⁻¹ * cs.simple i * d) = cs.simple i * d := by group
  rw [heq] at hlen
  have hshort := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hleft
  omega

/-- The actual normalizer acts on the actual realized chamber type. -/
noncomputable def normalizerChamberAction :
    CoxeterNormalizer M J →* Equiv.Perm (ActualChamber M J) where
  toFun w :=
    { toFun := transportedChamber M J w
      invFun := transportedChamber M J w⁻¹
      left_inv C := by
        rw [← transportedChamber_mul, inv_mul_cancel, transportedChamber_one]
      right_inv C := by
        rw [← transportedChamber_mul, mul_inv_cancel, transportedChamber_one] }
  map_one' := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    exact transportedChamber_one M J
  map_mul' w z := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    exact transportedChamber_mul M J w z

/-- The actual restricted contragredient action as a linear homeomorphism. -/
noncomputable def normalizerFlatEquiv (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J) :
    relativeSubspace J ≃L[ℝ] relativeSubspace J where
  toFun := normalizerRepresentation M J w
  invFun := normalizerRepresentation M J w⁻¹
  left_inv x := by
    simp only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel,
      map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
  right_inv x := by
    simp only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel,
      map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
  map_add' := (normalizerRepresentation M J w).map_add
  map_smul' := (normalizerRepresentation M J w).map_smul
  continuous_toFun := continuous_normalizerRepresentation M J w
  continuous_invFun := continuous_normalizerRepresentation M J w⁻¹

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.normalizerRawF.source_declaration:
/-- Left normalizer multiplication preserves the actual parabolic-conjugacy
condition while retaining the source index set. -/
noncomputable def normalizerRawFacetLabel (n : CoxeterNormalizer M J) (L : RawFacetLabel M J) :
    RawFacetLabel M J where
  indices := L.indices
  representative := n.val * L.representative
  parabolic_conjugacy := by
    have he : (MulAut.conj (n.val * L.representative)).toMonoidHom =
        (MulAut.conj n.val).toMonoidHom.comp (MulAut.conj L.representative).toMonoidHom := by
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro g
      change (n.val * L.representative) * g * (n.val * L.representative)⁻¹ =
        n.val * (L.representative * g * L.representative⁻¹) * n.val⁻¹
      group
    rw [he, ← Subgroup.map_map, L.parabolic_conjugacy]
    exact Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mp n.property

theorem normalizerRawFacetLabel_point (n : CoxeterNormalizer M J) (L : RawFacetLabel M J) :
    rawCanonicalFacetPoint (normalizerRawFacetLabel M J n L) =
      normalizerRepresentation M J n (rawCanonicalFacetPoint L) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change dualAction M (n.val * L.representative) (canonicalDominant L.indices) =
    dualAction M n.val (dualAction M L.representative (canonicalDominant L.indices))

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.normalizerRawF.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.normalizerRawFacetLabel_region
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.normalizerRawF.source_declaration:
theorem normalizerRawFacetLabel_region (n : CoxeterNormalizer M J) (L : RawFacetLabel M J) :
    translatedFacet (normalizerRawFacetLabel M J n L) =
      normalizerFlatEquiv M J n '' translatedFacet L := by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ, he⟩ := (mem_translatedFacet_iff _ p).mp hp
    let x : relativeSubspace J := facetFlatEquiv L ⟨φ, hφ.1⟩
    refine ⟨x, ⟨⟨φ, hφ.1⟩, hφ, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change dualAction M n.val (dualAction M L.representative φ) = p.val
    rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul]
    exact he
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ, he⟩ := (mem_translatedFacet_iff L p).mp hp
    apply (mem_translatedFacet_iff _ _).mpr
    refine ⟨φ, hφ, ?_⟩
    change dualAction M (n.val * L.representative) φ = dualAction M n.val p.val
    rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, he]

/-- Exact geometric image of a realized chamber region. -/
theorem normalizer_image_chamber_region (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.normalizer_mem.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.normalizer_mem_actualTubeSet_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.normalizer_mem.source_declaration:
/-- Covariance uses the previously defined actual complement action. -/
theorem normalizer_mem_actualTubeSet_iff (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J)
    (C : ActualChamber M J) (p : Complement M J) :
    normalizerComplementAction M J w p ∈ actualTubeSet M J (transportedChamber M J w C) ↔
      p ∈ actualTubeSet M J C := by
  change (∀ r, actualForms M J r (normalizerRepresentation M J w p.val.1) = 0 →
    normalizerRepresentation M J w p.val.2 ∈
      signHalfSpace (actualForms M J r) ((transportedChamber M J w C).signs r)) ↔
    (∀ r, actualForms M J r p.val.1 = 0 →
      p.val.2 ∈ signHalfSpace (actualForms M J r) (C.signs r))
  constructor
  · intro hp r hr
    have hz : actualForms M J (retainedRootEquiv M J w r)
        (normalizerRepresentation M J w p.val.1) = 0 := by
      rw [← normalizerFlatEquiv_apply, actualForms_transport, hr]
    have h := hp (retainedRootEquiv M J w r) hz
    simpa only [signHalfSpace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, transportedChamber_signs,
      ← normalizerFlatEquiv_apply, actualForms_transport] using h
  · intro hp r hr
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := (retainedRootEquiv M J w).surjective r
    have hz : actualForms M J s p.val.1 = 0 := by
      rwa [← normalizerFlatEquiv_apply, actualForms_transport] at hr
    simpa only [signHalfSpace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, transportedChamber_signs,
      ← normalizerFlatEquiv_apply, actualForms_transport] using hp s hz

/-- The functor induced by the actual finite-type normalizer orbit covering. -/

    FundamentalGroupoid (Theorem18.Complement M J) ⥤
      FundamentalGroupoid (Theorem18.OrbitSpace M J) :=
  FundamentalGroupoid.map ⟨Theorem18.orbitProjection M J,

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.orbitFundament.source_declaration:
/-- Object fibers of the actual orbit functor are exactly actual action orbits. -/
theorem orbitFundamentalGroupoidFunctor_obj_eq_iff
    (X Y : FundamentalGroupoid (Complement M J)) :
    (orbitFundamentalGroupoidFunctor M J).obj X =
      (orbitFundamentalGroupoidFunctor M J).obj Y ↔
      ∃ q : Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J, (actualSpaceAction M J q).obj X = Y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hp : orbitProjection M J X.as = orbitProjection M J Y.as :=
      congrArg FundamentalGroupoid.as h
    have hr : MulAction.orbitRel (Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J)
        (Complement M J) Y.as X.as := Quotient.exact hp.symm
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.1 (MulAction.orbitRel_apply.1 hr)
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    change FundamentalGroupoid.mk (q • X.as) = Y
    rw [hq]
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    have hp : q • X.as = Y.as := congrArg FundamentalGroupoid.as hq
    change FundamentalGroupoid.mk (orbitProjection M J X.as) =
      FundamentalGroupoid.mk (orbitProjection M J Y.as)
    rw [← hp, orbitProjection_smul]

  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep y
  refine ⟨FundamentalGroupoid.mk p, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (fun z : OrbitSpace M J => FundamentalGroupoid.mk z) hp

/-- Pointwise triviality on the actual flat implies triviality on its chambers. -/
theorem parabolic_le_normalizerChamberAction_ker :
    (Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf (CoxeterNormalizer M J) ≤
      (normalizerChamberAction M J).ker := by
  intro w hw
  have hflat := parabolic_le_normalizerRepresentation_ker M J hw
  change normalizerRepresentation M J w = 1 at hflat
  apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro C
  change transportedChamber M J w C = C
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := C.region_nonempty
  apply Chamber.eq_of_mem_region (x := x) _ hx
  have h := (mem_transportedChamber_iff M J w C x).2 hx
  simpa only [hflat, one_apply_eq_self] using h

No multiplicativity is asserted without its geometric interval condition. -/

      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices) : ribbonChamberFamily M J X ⟶ ribbonChamberFamily M J Y where

theorem positiveFiberHom_comp {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} (u v : M.Group)
    (hu : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y.indices).map (MulAut.conj u).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices)
    (hv : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Z.indices).map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y.indices)
    (hb : ∀ C : ChamberFiber M J X,
      ChamberBetween C.val (fiberTarget M J u hu C).val
        (fiberTarget M J (u * v) (transporter_comp M hu hv) C).val) :
    positiveFiberHom M J (u * v) (transporter_comp M hu hv) =
      positiveFiberHom M J u hu ≫ positiveFiberHom M J v hv := by
  apply FamilyGroupoid.Hom.ext
  · apply Equiv.ext
    intro C
    exact (fiberTarget_comp M J u v hu hv C).symm
  · intro C
    change HEq (intervalPositive C.val (fiberTarget M J (u * v) (transporter_comp M hu hv) C).val)
      (intervalPositive C.val (fiberTarget M J u hu C).val ≫
        intervalPositive (fiberTarget M J u hu C).val
          (fiberTarget M J v hv (fiberTarget M J u hu C)).val)
    exact (heq_of_eq (intervalPositive_comp _ _ _ (hb C))).trans
      (intervalPositive_comp_heq M J (congrArg Subtype.val (fiberTarget_comp M J u v hu hv C).symm))

      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices) :

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.projectedRibbo.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.projectedRibbonValueFunctor
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.projectedRibbo.source_declaration:
/-- Explicit Coxeter-projection index transport and original Artin values
form a genuine functor on all actual signed reduced ribbon arrows. -/
noncomputable def projectedRibbonValueFunctor : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M ⥤
    FamilyGroupoid (SingleObj (Artin.Group M)ᵐᵒᵖ) where
  obj := (liftedRibbonValueFunctor M J).obj
  map β :=
    { equiv := fiberEquiv M J (Artin.projection M β.val.val)
        (isRibbon_projection_transporter M β.val.property)
      hom _ := MulOpposite.op β.val.val }
  map_id X := by
    apply FamilyGroupoid.Hom.ext
    · apply Equiv.ext
      intro C
      change fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M 1) _ C = C
      simpa only [map_one] using fiberTarget_one M J _ C
    · intro C
      rfl
  map_comp β γ := by
    apply FamilyGroupoid.Hom.ext
    · apply Equiv.ext
      intro C
      change fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M (β.val.val * γ.val.val)) _ C =
        fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M γ.val.val) _
          (fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M β.val.val) _ C)
      symm
      simpa only [map_mul] using fiberTarget_comp M J
        (Artin.projection M β.val.val) (Artin.projection M γ.val.val)
        (isRibbon_projection_transporter M β.val.property)
        (isRibbon_projection_transporter M γ.val.property) C
    · intro C
      rfl

theorem projectedRibbonValueFunctor_atom (X : RibbonObject M) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices) :
    (projectedRibbonValueFunctor M J).map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha) =
      (liftedRibbonValueFunctor M J).map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha) := by
  calc
    _ = (tautologicalRibbonValueFunctor M J).map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha) := by
      apply FamilyGroupoid.Hom.ext
      · change fiberEquiv M J (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M X.indices a)) _ =
          ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha)).equiv
        rw [ribbonLiftingFunctor_atom]
        rfl
      · intro C
        rfl
    _ = _ := tautologicalRibbonValueFunctor_atom M J X a ha

/-- The actual quotient action on the actual relative chamber set is free. -/
theorem quotientChamber_smul_fixed_iff (q : Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J)
    (C : ActualChamber M J) : q • C = C ↔ q = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
      ((Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf (CoxeterNormalizer M J)) q
    obtain ⟨L, rfl⟩ := actualChamberOfRawLabel_surjective M J C
    change transportedChamber M J w (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) =
      actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L at h
    rw [transportedChamber_rawLabel] at h
    have hc := ((actualChamberOfRawLabel_eq_iff M J L (normalizerRawLabel M J w L)).mp h.symm).2
    have hw : w.val ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
      rw [← L.parabolic_conjugacy]
      apply Subgroup.mem_map.mpr
      refine ⟨L.representative⁻¹ * (w.val * L.representative), hc, ?_⟩
      change L.representative * (L.representative⁻¹ * (w.val * L.representative)) *
        L.representative⁻¹ = w.val
      group
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff w).mpr hw
  · rintro rfl
    exact one_smul _ _

theorem quotient_image_actualTubeSet (q : Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J)
    (C : ActualChamber M J) :

      actualTubeSet M J (q • C) := by

  · intro hp

    have h := (quotient_mem_actualTubeSet_iff M J q⁻¹ (q • C) p).2 hp
    simpa only [inv_smul_smul] using h

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawCanonicalFa.source_declaration:
/-- The actual right source parabolic fixes the canonical dominant point. -/
theorem rawCanonicalFacetPoint_eq_of_related (L K : RawFacetLabel M J)
    (h : (rawFacetSetoid M J).r L K) : rawCanonicalFacetPoint L = rawCanonicalFacetPoint K := by
  obtain ⟨hIK, hc⟩ := h
  apply Subtype.ext
  change dualAction M L.representative (canonicalDominant L.indices) =
    dualAction M K.representative (canonicalDominant K.indices)
  rw [← hIK]
  have hfix := (canonicalDominant_fixed_iff M L.indices
    (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative)).mpr hc
  calc
    dualAction M L.representative (canonicalDominant L.indices) =
      dualAction M L.representative
        (dualAction M (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative) (canonicalDominant L.indices)) := by
          rw [hfix]
    _ = dualAction M K.representative (canonicalDominant L.indices) := by
      rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left]

/-- Raw labels are quotiented by actual equality of right parabolic cosets,
with the source index set retained. No minimal representative is chosen. -/
def rawFacetSetoid (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I) : Setoid (RawFacetLabel M J) where
  r L K := L.indices = K.indices ∧ L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative ∈
    Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices
  iseqv :=
    ⟨fun L => (translatedFacet_eq_iff L L).mp rfl,
      fun {L K} h => (translatedFacet_eq_iff K L).mp ((translatedFacet_eq_iff L K).mpr h).symm,
      fun {L K T} h₁ h₂ => (translatedFacet_eq_iff L T).mp
        (((translatedFacet_eq_iff L K).mpr h₁).trans ((translatedFacet_eq_iff K T).mpr h₂))⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawFacet_sign_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawFacet_sign_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawFacet_sign_.source_declaration:
/-- Actual signs at a transported facet agree with the signs of the actual
inverse-transformed roots at the standard facet. -/
theorem rawFacet_sign_iff (L K : RawFacetLabel M J) (R : RelativeRoot M J) :
    (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).signs R = true ↔
      0 < M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative⁻¹ R.val) := by
  let r := M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative⁻¹ R.val
  have hrootR : R.val ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots := by
    obtain ⟨w, i, he⟩ := R.property.1
    exact M.toCoxeterSystem.mem_geometricRoots.mpr ⟨w, i, he⟩
  have hr := (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff
    L.representative⁻¹).mpr hrootR
  have hs := (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff
    (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹).mpr hr
  have heR : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r = R.val := by
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
  have hD : facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K) ∈
      (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).region := by
    rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region, ← relativeTargetLabel_region M L K]
    exact facetCanonicalPoint_mem M _
  have heval : actualForms M J R (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K)) =
      canonicalDominant K.indices
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ r) := by
    calc
      _ = (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K)).val
          (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r) :=
        congrArg (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K)).val heR.symm
      _ = _ := relativeTargetLabel_pairing M L K r
  have hz := (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).region_subset_regularSet hD R
  rw [heval] at hz
  rw [Chamber.signs_eq_true_iff hD R, heval]
  exact root_eval_pos_iff M (canonicalDominant_isDominant K.indices) hs hz

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawLabels_same.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawLabels_same_indices_normalizer
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawLabels_same.source_declaration:
/-- Two raw labels with the same standard-facet index set differ by an
actual normalizer on the left. -/
theorem rawLabels_same_indices_normalizer (L K : RawFacetLabel M J)
    (hI : L.indices = K.indices) :
    ∃ w : CoxeterNormalizer M J,
      transportedChamber M J w (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) =
        actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K := by
  let n := K.representative * L.representative⁻¹
  have hcomp : (MulAut.conj n).toMonoidHom.comp (MulAut.conj L.representative).toMonoidHom =
      (MulAut.conj K.representative).toMonoidHom := by
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    change n * (L.representative * g * L.representative⁻¹) * n⁻¹ =
      K.representative * g * K.representative⁻¹
    dsimp only [n]
    group
  have hnmap : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).map (MulAut.conj n).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
    calc
      _ = ((Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices).map
          (MulAut.conj L.representative).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj n).toMonoidHom := by
        rw [L.parabolic_conjugacy]
      _ = (Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices).map
          (MulAut.conj K.representative).toMonoidHom := by rw [Subgroup.map_map, hcomp]
      _ = _ := by rw [hI, K.parabolic_conjugacy]
  let w : CoxeterNormalizer M J := ⟨n, Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mpr hnmap⟩
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  rw [transportedChamber_rawLabel]
  apply (actualChamberOfRawLabel_eq_iff M J _ K).mpr
  refine ⟨hI, ?_⟩
  change (n * L.representative)⁻¹ * K.representative ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices
  have he : n * L.representative = K.representative := by dsimp only [n]; group
  rw [he, inv_mul_cancel]
  exact Subgroup.one_mem _

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawRelativeTra.source_declaration:
/-- Composition through a chamber between the endpoints is actual
multiplication of the canonical minimal relative Coxeter elements. -/
theorem rawRelativeTransport_comp_of_between (L K T : RawFacetLabel M J)
    (hbet : ChamberBetween (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L)
      (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K) (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T)) :
    rawRelativeTransport M L T = rawRelativeTransport M L K * rawRelativeTransport M K T := by
  have hlen := rawRelativeTransport_length_of_between M J L K T hbet
  have hmin := minimal_suffix_of_length_add M (rawRelativeTransport_minimal M L T) hlen
  have he : rawRelativeTransport M K T =
      (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ * rawRelativeTransport M L T := by
    calc
      rawRelativeTransport M K T = rawRelativeTransport M
          (relativeTargetLabel M L K) (relativeTargetLabel M L T) :=
        rawRelativeTransport_eq_of_regions M (relativeTargetLabel_region M L K).symm
          (relativeTargetLabel_region M L T).symm
      _ = (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ * rawRelativeTransport M L T := by
        unfold rawRelativeTransport
        change M.toCoxeterSystem.minimalCosetRep T.indices
          ((L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ *
            (L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L T)) = _
        have hc : (L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ *
            (L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L T) =
            (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ * rawRelativeTransport M L T := by group
        rw [hc]
        exact hmin.minimalCosetRep_eq _
  rw [he]
  group

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawRelativeTra.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawRelativeTransport_eq_of_regions
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawRelativeTra.source_declaration:
/-- Changing either facet representative by its right source parabolic does
not change canonical relative transport. -/
theorem rawRelativeTransport_eq_of_regions
    {L L' K K' : RawFacetLabel M J}
    (hL : translatedFacet L = translatedFacet L')
    (hK : translatedFacet K = translatedFacet K') :
    rawRelativeTransport M L K = rawRelativeTransport M L' K' := by
  obtain ⟨hLI, ha⟩ := (translatedFacet_eq_iff L L').mp hL
  obtain ⟨hKI, hb⟩ := (translatedFacet_eq_iff K K').mp hK
  unfold rawRelativeTransport
  rw [← hKI]
  apply M.toCoxeterSystem.minimalCosetRep_eq_minimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
  rw [← Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq]
  have hconj := (relativeRawLabel M L K).parabolic_conjugacy
  change (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K.indices).map
    (MulAut.conj (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative)).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices at hconj
  have ha' : (L.representative⁻¹ * L'.representative)⁻¹ ∈
      (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K.indices).map
        (MulAut.conj (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative)).toMonoidHom := by
    rw [hconj]
    exact (Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices).inv_mem ha
  rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at ha'
  have hp := (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K.indices).mul_mem ha' hb
  convert hp using 1; group

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawRelativeTra.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawRelativeTransport_length_of_between
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rawRelativeTra.source_declaration:
/-- Actual chamber betweenness gives ambient root-inversion inclusion, hence
Coxeter length additivity. Restricted hyperplanes need not be distinct root
labels, and no count of restricted gallery edges enters this argument. -/
theorem rawRelativeTransport_length_of_between (L K T : RawFacetLabel M J)
    (hbet : ChamberBetween (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L)
      (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K) (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T)) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.length (rawRelativeTransport M L T) =
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (rawRelativeTransport M L K) +
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length
          ((rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ * rawRelativeTransport M L T) := by
  apply length_eq_add_of_rootInversions_subset
  intro r hr hp hn
  have hrI := inversionRoot_retained M (rawRelativeTransport_inv_minimal M L K) hr hp hn
  let R : RelativeRoot M J :=
    ⟨M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r,
      facetTransport_retained M L hrI⟩
  have hC : facetCanonicalPoint M L ∈ (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).region := by
    rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region]
    exact facetCanonicalPoint_mem M L
  have hD : facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K) ∈
      (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).region := by
    rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region, ← relativeTargetLabel_region M L K]
    exact facetCanonicalPoint_mem M _
  have hE : facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L T) ∈
      (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T).region := by
    rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region, ← relativeTargetLabel_region M L T]
    exact facetCanonicalPoint_mem M _
  have hposC : 0 < actualForms M J R (facetCanonicalPoint M L) := by
    change 0 < (facetCanonicalPoint M L).val
      (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r)
    rw [facetCanonicalPoint_pairing]
    exact canonical_eval_pos_of_retained M hrI hp
  have hnonposD : actualForms M J R
      (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K)) ≤ 0 := by
    change (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K)).val
      (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r) ≤ 0
    rw [relativeTargetLabel_pairing]
    exact evaluation_nonpos_of_nonpos (canonicalDominant_isDominant K.indices) hn.le
  have hnegD : actualForms M J R
      (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K)) < 0 :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne hnonposD
      ((actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).region_subset_regularSet hD R)
  have hsC : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R = true :=
    (Chamber.signs_eq_true_iff hC R).mpr hposC
  have hsD : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).signs R = false := by
    cases hs : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K).signs R
    · rfl
    · exact False.elim (lt_asymm ((Chamber.signs_eq_true_iff hD R).mp hs) hnegD)
  have hsE : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T).signs R = false := by
    cases hs : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T).signs R
    · rfl
    · have hh := hbet R (hsC.trans hs.symm)
      rw [hsD, hsC] at hh
      contradiction
  have hnegE : actualForms M J R
      (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L T)) < 0 := by
    have hh := hE R
    change (if (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J T).signs R then
      0 < actualForms M J R (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L T)) else
      actualForms M J R (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L T)) < 0) at hh
    simpa only [hsE, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false] using hh
  change (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L T)).val
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r) < 0 at hnegE
  rw [relativeTargetLabel_pairing] at hnegE
  have hroot := (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff
    (rawRelativeTransport M L T)⁻¹).mpr hr
  rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hroot with hpos | hneg
  · exact False.elim ((eval_nonneg_of_nonneg (canonicalDominant_isDominant T.indices)
      hpos.le).not_gt hnegE)
  · exact hneg

/-- In finite Coxeter type, regularity of the actual relative arrangement is
equivalent to the full point-stabilizer statement. -/
theorem realRelativeRegular_iff_stabilizer (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group]
    (J : Set I) (φ : relativeSubspace J) :
    realRelativeRegular M J φ ↔ ∀ w : M.Group,
      dualAction M w φ.val = φ.val ↔ w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
  constructor
  · intro h w
    exact realRelativeRegular_fixed_iff M J φ h w
  · exact realRelativeRegular_of_stabilizer M J φ

    (L : RawFacetLabel M J) {p : relativeSubspace J} (hp : p ∈ translatedFacet L) :
    realRelativeRegular M J p := by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, he⟩ := (mem_translatedFacet_iff L p).mp hp
  exact realRelativeRegular_of_translated_standardFacet M J p hφ L.representative
    L.parabolic_conjugacy he.symm

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.realRelativeRe.source_declaration:
/-- A relative point with exactly the actual standard parabolic stabilizer
avoids every retained root hyperplane. No finite-type assumption is needed
for this direction. -/
theorem realRelativeRegular_of_stabilizer (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I)
    (φ : relativeSubspace J)
    (hstab : ∀ w : M.Group, dualAction M w φ.val = φ.val ↔
      w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J) : realRelativeRegular M J φ := by
  intro r hr hz
  obtain ⟨hr, ψ, hψ⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨a, i, rfl⟩ := hr
  have hret : root M a i ∈ retainedRoots M J := ⟨⟨a, i, rfl⟩, ψ, hψ⟩
  have hfix := (conjugate_simple_fixed_iff M a i φ.val).mpr hz
  exact conjugate_simple_not_mem_parabolic_of_retained M J a i hret
    ((hstab _).mp hfix)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.realRelativeRe.source_declaration:
/-- Any concrete representation of the transported point in the actual flat
is regular. The explicit value equality makes this independent of a chosen
proof used to construct that subtype. -/
theorem realRelativeRegular_of_translated_standardFacet (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I)
    (ψ : relativeSubspace J) {K : Set I} {φ : Dual I}
    (hφ : φ ∈ standardFacet M K) (w : M.Group)
    (hconj : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M J) (he : ψ.val = dualAction M w φ) :
    realRelativeRegular M J ψ := by
  apply realRelativeRegular_of_stabilizer M J ψ
  intro g
  rw [he]
  exact standardFacet_translate_stabilizer M hφ w hconj g

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.relativeRawLab.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.relativeRawLabel
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.relativeRawLab.source_declaration:
/-- Relative raw transport conjugates the target source parabolic onto the
starting source parabolic. -/
noncomputable def relativeRawLabel (L K : RawFacetLabel M J) : RawFacetLabel M L.indices where
  indices := K.indices
  representative := L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative
  parabolic_conjugacy := by
    have he : (MulAut.conj (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative)).toMonoidHom =
        (MulAut.conj L.representative⁻¹).toMonoidHom.comp
          (MulAut.conj K.representative).toMonoidHom := by
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro g
      change (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative) * g *
          (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative)⁻¹ =
        L.representative⁻¹ * (K.representative * g * K.representative⁻¹) *
          (L.representative⁻¹)⁻¹
      group
    rw [he, ← Subgroup.map_map, K.parabolic_conjugacy]
    exact conjugacy_symm M L.parabolic_conjugacy

/-- Replace the target label by the canonical relative representative,
without changing its actual endpoint chamber. -/
noncomputable def relativeTargetLabel (L K : RawFacetLabel M J) : RawFacetLabel M J where
  indices := K.indices
  representative := L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L K
  parabolic_conjugacy := by
    have he : (MulAut.conj (L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L K)).toMonoidHom =
        (MulAut.conj L.representative).toMonoidHom.comp
          (MulAut.conj (rawRelativeTransport M L K)).toMonoidHom := by
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro g
      change (L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L K) * g *
        (L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ =
        L.representative * (rawRelativeTransport M L K * g *
          (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹) * L.representative⁻¹
      group
    rw [he, ← Subgroup.map_map, rawRelativeTransport_conjugacy, L.parabolic_conjugacy]

theorem relativeTargetLabel_pairing (L K : RawFacetLabel M J) (r : Vector I) :
    (facetCanonicalPoint M (relativeTargetLabel M L K)).val
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r) =
      canonicalDominant K.indices
        (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (rawRelativeTransport M L K)⁻¹ r) := by
  change dualAction M (L.representative * rawRelativeTransport M L K)
      (canonicalDominant K.indices)
      (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r) = _
  rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, dualAction_pairing]
  rfl

/-- On an actual elementary ribbon step, canonical geometric relative
transport is exactly the Coxeter projection of that elementary label. -/
theorem relativeTransport_elementary (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (a : I) :
    relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L)
      (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (elementaryTargetLabel M J L a)) =
        Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a) := by
  rw [relativeTransport_eq_raw]
  unfold rawRelativeTransport
  change M.toCoxeterSystem.minimalCosetRep
      (Ribbon2.parabolicTwistImage M (insert a L.indices) L.indices)
      (L.representative⁻¹ *
        (L.representative * Artin.projection M (Ribbon2.elementaryMu M L.indices a))) = _
  rw [inv_mul_cancel_left]
  exact (elementaryMu_projection_minimal M L.indices a).minimalCosetRep_eq _

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.relativeTransp.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.relativeTransport_fiberTarget
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.relativeTransp.source_declaration:
theorem relativeTransport_fiberTarget {X Y : RibbonObject M} (w : M.Group)
    (hw : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y.indices).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices)
    (hmin : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep Y.indices w) (C : ChamberFiber M J X) :
    relativeTransport M J C.val (fiberTarget M J w hw C).val = w := by
  let L := chamberRawLabel M J C.val
  change relativeTransport M J C.val (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (fiberTargetLabel M J w hw C)) = w
  calc
    _ = relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L)
        (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (fiberTargetLabel M J w hw C)) := by
      rw [chamberRawLabel_chamber]
    _ = rawRelativeTransport M L (fiberTargetLabel M J w hw C) := relativeTransport_eq_raw M J _ _
    _ = M.toCoxeterSystem.minimalCosetRep Y.indices w := by
      change M.toCoxeterSystem.minimalCosetRep Y.indices
        (L.representative⁻¹ * (L.representative * w)) = _
      rw [inv_mul_cancel_left]
    _ = w := hmin.minimalCosetRep_eq _

theorem relativeTransport_length_of_between {C D E : ActualChamber M J}
    (hbet : ChamberBetween C D E) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.length (relativeTransport M J C E) =
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (relativeTransport M J C D) +
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (relativeTransport M J D E) := by
  have hlen := rawRelativeTransport_length_of_between M J (chamberRawLabel M J C)
    (chamberRawLabel M J D) (chamberRawLabel M J E)
    (by simpa only [chamberRawLabel_chamber] using hbet)
  change M.toCoxeterSystem.length (relativeTransport M J C E) =
    M.toCoxeterSystem.length (relativeTransport M J C D) +
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length ((relativeTransport M J C D)⁻¹ * relativeTransport M J C E)
    at hlen
  have hc : (relativeTransport M J C D)⁻¹ * relativeTransport M J C E =
      relativeTransport M J D E := by
    rw [relativeTransport_comp_of_between M J hbet, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  rw [hc] at hlen
  exact hlen

theorem relativeTransport_transported (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J) (C D : ActualChamber M J) :

/-- The actual primal action permutes the retained root labels. -/
noncomputable def retainedRootEquiv (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J) :
    RelativeRoot M J ≃ RelativeRoot M J where

    geometricAction_mem_retainedRoots M J w r.property⟩

    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_inv, ← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul,
      inv_mul_cancel, map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
  right_inv r := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_inv, ← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul,

/-- The projected coordinate arrow has exactly the original actual Artin value. -/
theorem ribbonLiftArrow_ribbon_value {X Y : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M}
    (β : X ⟶ Y) (C : ChamberFiber M J X.val) :
    ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (ribbonLiftArrow M J β C)).val.val = β.val.val := by
  have hm : (liftedRibbonValueFunctor M J).map β =
      (tautologicalRibbonValueFunctor M J).map β :=
    eq_of_heq (functor_map_heq (liftedRibbonValueFunctor_eq M J) β)

    ribbonLiftEndpoint M J β C =
      fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M β.val.val)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.ribbonLiftEndp.source_declaration:
/-- The lifted endpoint of an actual reduced ribbon loop is given by the
same existing Coxeter normalizer-quotient projection of its actual Artin label. -/
theorem ribbonLiftEndpoint_reducedLoop (r : reducedRibbonLoops M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :
    (ribbonLiftEndpoint M J (actualReducedHom M r.property) (standardActualChamberFiber M J)).val =
      reducedRibbonCoxeterProjection M ⟨J⟩ r • standardActualChamber M J := by
  rw [ribbonLiftEndpoint_projection]
  let L := standardRawFacetLabel M J
  let w : CoxeterNormalizer M J := reducedRibbonCoxeterNormalizerMap M ⟨J⟩ r
  have hw := isRibbon_projection_transporter M r.property.isRibbon
  have hchosen : actualChamberOfRawLabel M J
      (chamberRawLabel M J (standardActualChamber M J)) = actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L :=
    chamberRawLabel_chamber M J _
  have hreplace := rightTransportRawLabel_independent M J hchosen J (Artin.projection M r.val)
    (by simpa only [chamberRawLabel_indices, standardActualChamber_indices] using hw) hw
  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M J
      (fiberTargetLabel M J (Artin.projection M r.val) hw (standardActualChamberFiber M J)) =
    transportedChamber M J w (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L)
  rw [transportedChamber_rawLabel]
  refine hreplace.trans ?_
  apply (actualChamberOfRawLabel_eq_iff M J _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  change ((1 : M.Group) * Artin.projection M r.val)⁻¹ * (w.val * 1) ∈
    Artin.coxeterParabolic M J
  have hwval : w.val = Artin.projection M r.val := rfl
  rw [hwval, one_mul, mul_one, inv_mul_cancel]
  exact Subgroup.one_mem _

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.ribbonLiftingD.source_declaration:
/-- Only the fixed chosen pair-lcm relations are checked. Their two
actual simple total evaluations give the same lifted positive intervals. -/
theorem ribbonLiftingData_respects : (ribbonLiftingData M J).RespectsLcm := by
  intro X a b ha hb hab
  let p := AtomicWord.cons a ha (chosenLcmLeftTail M X a b ha hb hab)
  let q := AtomicWord.cons b hb (chosenLcmRightTail M X a b ha hb hab)
  have hp : p.eval = pairRibbonLcm M X.indices a b := by
    exact chosenLcmLeft_eval M X a b ha hb hab
  have hq : q.eval = pairRibbonLcm M X.indices a b := by
    exact chosenLcmRight_eval M X a b ha hb hab
  have hs : pairRibbonLcm M X.indices a b = transporterPositiveLift M
      ((parabolicLongest M X.indices)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M (insert b (insert a X.indices))) :=
    parabolicDelta_ratio_eq_simpleLift M X.indices (insert b (insert a X.indices))
      (fun _ h => Set.mem_insert_of_mem b (Set.mem_insert_of_mem a h))
  change (ribbonLiftingData M J).wordImage p = (ribbonLiftingData M J).wordImage q
  rw [lifting_wordImage_of_simple M J p ⟨_, hp.trans hs⟩,
    lifting_wordImage_of_simple M J q ⟨_, hq.trans hs⟩]
  congr 1
  exact congrArg (Artin.projection M) (hp.trans hq.symm)

/-- The index bijection of every signed actual ribbon lift is precisely
the equivalence induced by its actual Artin--Coxeter projection. -/
theorem ribbonLiftingFunctor_index_projection {X Y : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M}
    (β : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map β).equiv =
      fiberEquiv M J (Artin.projection M β.val.val)
        (isRibbon_projection_transporter M β.val.property) := by
  have hm : (liftedRibbonValueFunctor M J).map β =
      (projectedRibbonValueFunctor M J).map β :=
    eq_of_heq (functor_map_heq (liftedRibbonValueFunctor_eq_projected M J) β)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.ribbonLiftingF.source_declaration:
/-- On every actual positive interval, the signed lifting functor gives
the corresponding actual relative-transporter family arrow. -/
theorem ribbonLiftingFunctor_intervalPositive (C D : ActualChamber M J) :
    (ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map
      ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (intervalPositive C D)) =
        positiveFiberHom M J (X := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩) (Y := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J D⟩)
          (relativeTransport M J C D) (relativeTransport_conjugacy M J C D) := by
  rw [intervalRibbonFunctor_positive]
  change (ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (actualReducedHom M
    (transporterPositiveLift_generated M (relativeTransport_conjugacy M J C D)
      (relativeTransport_minimal M J C D)).toReducedArrow) = _
  have h := ribbonLiftingFunctor_positive_simple M J
    (transporterPositiveLift_generated M (relativeTransport_conjugacy M J C D)
      (relativeTransport_minimal M J C D)) ⟨_, rfl⟩
  simpa only [projection_transporterPositiveLift] using h

theorem ribbonLiftingFunctor_positive_simple {X Y : RibbonObject M} {β : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y β)
    (hs : ∃ d : M.Group, β = transporterPositiveLift M d) :
    (ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (actualReducedHom M hp.toReducedArrow) =
      positiveFiberHom M J (Artin.projection M β) (isRibbon_projection_transporter M hp.isRibbon) := by
  let p := hp.atomicWord M
  have he : actualReducedHom M hp.toReducedArrow =
      actualReducedHom M p.toPositiveReducedArrow.toReducedArrow := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (hp.atomicWord_eval M).symm
  rw [he, ribbonLiftingFunctor_word]
  have hsimple : ∃ d : M.Group, p.eval = transporterPositiveLift M d := by
    simpa only [p, hp.atomicWord_eval M] using hs
  have h := lifting_wordImage_of_simple M J p hsimple
  simpa only [p, hp.atomicWord_eval M] using h

/-- Every signed interval arrow is recovered exactly after mapping it to
the actual ribbon groupoid and applying the constructed lift. -/

    (X : IntervalGroupoid (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)) :
    Function.LeftInverse (ribbonOutgoingLift M J X) (ribbonOutgoingMap M J X) := by
  intro p
  obtain ⟨Y, δ⟩ := p
  unfold ribbonOutgoingLift ribbonOutgoingMap
  have ho : intervalObject (ribbonLiftEndpoint M J ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ)
      (distinguishedRibbonIndex M J X)).val = Y :=
    (congrArg (fun (C : ChamberFiber M J ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).obj Y).val) => intervalObject C.val)
      (ribbonLiftInterval_endpoint_all M J δ)).trans (intervalObject_intervalChamber Y)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rightTransport.source_declaration:
/-- Right multiplication of a raw label by an actual parabolic transporter. -/
noncomputable def rightTransportRawLabel (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (K : Set I)
    (w : M.Group)
    (hw : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices) : RawFacetLabel M J where
  indices := K
  representative := L.representative * w
  parabolic_conjugacy := by
    have he : (MulAut.conj (L.representative * w)).toMonoidHom =
        (MulAut.conj L.representative).toMonoidHom.comp (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom := by
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro g
      change (L.representative * w) * g * (L.representative * w)⁻¹ =
        L.representative * (w * g * w⁻¹) * L.representative⁻¹
      group
    rw [he, ← Subgroup.map_map, hw, L.parabolic_conjugacy]

theorem rightTransportRawLabel_independent {L K : RawFacetLabel M J}
    (hLK : actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L = actualChamberOfRawLabel M J K)
    (T : Set I) (w : M.Group)
    (hL : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M T).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices)
    (hK : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M T).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M K.indices) :
    actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (rightTransportRawLabel M J L T w hL) =
      actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (rightTransportRawLabel M J K T w hK) := by
  obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := (actualChamberOfRawLabel_eq_iff M J L K).mp hLK
  apply (actualChamberOfRawLabel_eq_iff M J _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [← hL, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply] at hc
  change (L.representative * w)⁻¹ * (K.representative * w) ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M T
  convert hc using 1

theorem rootInversions_subset_of_length_eq_add (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (d f : M.Group)
    (hadd : M.toCoxeterSystem.length f = M.toCoxeterSystem.length d +
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (d⁻¹ * f)) :
    ∀ r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots, 0 < r →
      M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ r < 0 →
      M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation f⁻¹ r < 0 :=
  rootInversions_subset_of_length_eq_add_system M.toCoxeterSystem d f hadd
