ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rootInversions.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rootInversions_subset_of_length_eq_add_system
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.rootInversions.source_declaration:
/-- An additive initial factor has a subset of the inverse root inversions. -/
theorem rootInversions_subset_of_length_eq_add_system (cs : CoxeterSystem M W)
    (d f : W) (hadd : cs.length f = cs.length d + cs.length (d⁻¹ * f)) :
    ∀ r ∈ cs.geometricRoots, 0 < r →
      cs.geometricRepresentation d⁻¹ r < 0 → cs.geometricRepresentation f⁻¹ r < 0 := by
  induction hn : cs.length d using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing d f with
  | ind n ih =>
    by_cases hd : d = 1
    · subst d
      intro r _ hpos hneg
      simp only [inv_one, map_one, one_apply_eq_self] at hneg
      exact False.elim (lt_asymm hpos hneg)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cs.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hd
    have hld : cs.length (cs.simple i * d) + 1 = cs.length d :=
      cs.isLeftDescent_iff.1 hi
    have hprod : (cs.simple i * d) * (d⁻¹ * f) = cs.simple i * f := by
      simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left]
    have hbound := cs.length_mul_le (cs.simple i * d) (d⁻¹ * f)
    rw [hprod] at hbound
    have hfi : cs.IsLeftDescent f i := by
      change cs.length (cs.simple i * f) < cs.length f
      omega
    have hlf : cs.length (cs.simple i * f) + 1 = cs.length f :=
      cs.isLeftDescent_iff.1 hfi
    have hcancel : (cs.simple i * d)⁻¹ * (cs.simple i * f) = d⁻¹ * f := by
      rw [mul_inv_rev, cs.inv_simple, mul_assoc, cs.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left]
    have hadd' : cs.length (cs.simple i * f) = cs.length (cs.simple i * d) +
        cs.length ((cs.simple i * d)⁻¹ * (cs.simple i * f)) := by
      rw [hcancel]
      omega
    have hind := ih (cs.length (cs.simple i * d)) (by omega)
      (cs.simple i * d) (cs.simple i * f) hadd' rfl
    intro r hr hpos hneg
    by_cases heq : r = Finsupp.single i 1
    · subst r
      exact (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff f⁻¹ i).2
        (cs.isRightDescent_inv_iff.2 hfi)
    have hreflect (g : W) (v : I →₀ ℝ) :
        cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple i * g)⁻¹ (M.geometricReflection i v) =
          cs.geometricRepresentation g⁻¹ v := by
      rw [mul_inv_rev, cs.inv_simple, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp,
        cs.geometricRepresentation_simple]
      have hreflection := LinearMap.congr_fun (M.geometricReflection_mul_self i) v
      change M.geometricReflection i (M.geometricReflection i v) = v at hreflection
      rw [hreflection]
    have hr' : M.geometricReflection i r ∈ cs.geometricRoots :=
      (cs.geometricReflection_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff i).2 hr
    have hp' : 0 < M.geometricReflection i r :=
      cs.geometricReflection_pos_of_mem_geometricRoots hr hpos heq
    have hn' : cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.simple i * d)⁻¹
        (M.geometricReflection i r) < 0 := by
      rwa [hreflect]
    have hf := hind _ hr' hp' hn'
    rwa [hreflect] at hf

    (hs : x ∈ signCell ℓ s) (ht : x ∈ signCell ℓ t) : s = t := by
  funext h
  have hsh := hs h
  have hth := ht h
  cases hs' : s h <;> cases ht' : t h <;> try rfl
  · have hneg : ℓ h x < 0 := by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs'] using hsh
    have hpos : 0 < ℓ h x := by simpa [signHalfSpace, ht'] using hth
    exact False.elim (lt_asymm hneg hpos)
  · have hpos : 0 < ℓ h x := by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs'] using hsh
    have hneg : ℓ h x < 0 := by simpa [signHalfSpace, ht'] using hth
    exact False.elim (lt_asymm hpos hneg)

theorem simple_reduced_projection_minimal {X Y : RibbonObject M} {β : Artin.Group M}
    (hβ : IsRibbon M X Y β) (hred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices β)
    (hs : β = transporterPositiveLift M (Artin.projection M β)) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep Y.indices (Artin.projection M β) := by
  have hinv : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep X.indices (Artin.projection M β)⁻¹ := by
    apply transporterPositiveLift_inv_minimal_of_leftReduced M
    rw [← hs]
    exact hred
  have hproj := isRibbon_projection_transporter M hβ
  have hproj' : (M.toCoxeterSystem.parabolic Y.indices).map
      (MulAut.conj (Artin.projection M β)).toMonoidHom =
        M.toCoxeterSystem.parabolic X.indices := by
    simpa only [Artin.coxeterParabolic_eq] using hproj
  simpa only [inv_inv] using minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter M.toCoxeterSystem
    (inverse_parabolic_transporter M.toCoxeterSystem hproj') hinv

/-- Conjugating an actual standard parabolic transports the full stabilizer
of every point in its standard facet, not merely the stabilizer of a chosen
canonical point. -/
theorem standardFacet_translate_stabilizer (M : CoxeterMatrix I) {K J : Set I}
    {φ : Dual I} (hφ : φ ∈ standardFacet M K) (w : M.Group)
    (hconj : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M J) (g : M.Group) :
    dualAction M g (dualAction M w φ) = dualAction M w φ ↔
      g ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
  calc
    dualAction M g (dualAction M w φ) = dualAction M w φ ↔
        dualAction M (w⁻¹ * g * w) φ = φ := dualAction_stabilizer_conjugate M w φ g
    _ ↔ w⁻¹ * g * w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M K := by
      simpa only [zeroIndices_of_mem_standardFacet M hφ] using
        dominant_fixed_iff M (standardFacet_isDominant M hφ) (w⁻¹ * g * w)
    _ ↔ g ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
      rw [← hconj, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.tautologicalRi.source_declaration:
/-- A genuine comparison functor with the constructed geometric index
bijections and the original ribbon's actual Artin value at each coordinate. -/
noncomputable def tautologicalRibbonValueFunctor : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M ⥤
    FamilyGroupoid (SingleObj (Artin.Group M)ᵐᵒᵖ) where
  obj := (liftedRibbonValueFunctor M J).obj
  map β :=
    { equiv := ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map β).equiv
      hom _ := MulOpposite.op β.val.val }
  map_id X := by
    apply FamilyGroupoid.Hom.ext
    · change ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (𝟙 X)).equiv = Equiv.refl _
      exact FamilyGroupoid.equiv_eq_of_eq ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map_id X)
    · intro C
      rfl
  map_comp β γ := by
    apply FamilyGroupoid.Hom.ext
    · change ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (β ≫ γ)).equiv =
        ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map β).equiv.trans ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map γ).equiv
      exact FamilyGroupoid.equiv_eq_of_eq ((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map_comp β γ)
    · intro C
      rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.tautologicalRi.source_declaration:
/-- The value comparison agrees on every actual outside elementary ribbon. -/
theorem tautologicalRibbonValueFunctor_atom (X : RibbonObject M) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices) :
    (tautologicalRibbonValueFunctor M J).map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha) =
      (liftedRibbonValueFunctor M J).map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha) := by
  apply FamilyGroupoid.Hom.ext
  · rfl
  · intro C
    change HEq (MulOpposite.op (elementaryMu M X.indices a))
      ((intervalRibbonValueFunctor M J).map
        (((ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha)).hom C))
    rw [ribbonLiftingFunctor_atom]
    apply heq_of_eq
    change MulOpposite.op (elementaryMu M X.indices a) =
      MulOpposite.op (((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map
        (intervalPositive C.val
          (fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M (elementaryMu M X.indices a))
            (isRibbon_projection_transporter M (elementaryMu_isRibbon M X.indices a)) C).val)).val.val)
    rw [intervalRibbonFunctor_positive, intervalRibbonPositive_value]
    congr 1
    rw [relativeTransport_fiberTarget M J _ _ (elementaryMu_projection_minimal M X.indices a)]
    exact elementaryMu_eq_transporterPositiveLift M X.indices a

theorem translatedFacet_eq_iff {M : CoxeterMatrix I} {J : Set I}
    (L K : RawFacetLabel M J) : translatedFacet L = translatedFacet K ↔
      L.indices = K.indices ∧ L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative ∈
        Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := translatedFacet_nonempty L
    exact translatedFacet_intersection_indices_coset L K ⟨p, hp, he ▸ hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hIK, hc⟩
    exact translatedFacet_eq_of_indices_coset L K hIK hc

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.translatedFace.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.translatedFacet_eq_of_indices_coset
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.translatedFace.source_declaration:
/-- Representatives differing by the right source parabolic act identically
on its entire relative flat, hence have exactly the same actual facet image. -/
theorem translatedFacet_eq_of_indices_coset {M : CoxeterMatrix I} {J : Set I}
    (L K : RawFacetLabel M J) (hIK : L.indices = K.indices)
    (hc : L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices) :
    translatedFacet L = translatedFacet K := by
  have hact {φ : Dual I} (hφ : φ ∈ relativeSubspace L.indices) :
      dualAction M K.representative φ = dualAction M L.representative φ := by
    have hfix := (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M L.indices φ).mp hφ _ hc
    calc
      dualAction M K.representative φ =
        dualAction M (L.representative * (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative)) φ := by
          rw [mul_inv_cancel_left]
      _ = dualAction M L.representative
          (dualAction M (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative) φ) := by
        rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]
      _ = dualAction M L.representative φ := by rw [hfix]
  ext p
  rw [mem_translatedFacet_iff, mem_translatedFacet_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ, he⟩
    refine ⟨φ, hIK ▸ hφ, ?_⟩
    exact (hact hφ.1).trans he
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ, he⟩
    have hφ' : φ ∈ standardFacet M L.indices := hIK.symm ▸ hφ
    exact ⟨φ, hφ', (hact hφ'.1).symm.trans he⟩

      L.indices = K.indices ∧ L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative ∈

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.translatedFace.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.translatedFacet_intersection_indices_coset
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.translatedFace.source_declaration:
/-- An intersection of actual translated facets forces equality of their
standard facet indices and equality of representatives modulo the right
standard parabolic. No finiteness assumption is used. -/
theorem translatedFacet_intersection_indices_coset {M : CoxeterMatrix I} {J : Set I}
    (L K : RawFacetLabel M J) (h : (translatedFacet L ∩ translatedFacet K).Nonempty) :
    L.indices = K.indices ∧ L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative ∈
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M L.indices := by
  obtain ⟨p, hpL, hpK⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hwφ⟩ := (mem_translatedFacet_iff L p).mp hpL
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hvψ⟩ := (mem_translatedFacet_iff K p).mp hpK
  have htrans : dualAction M (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative) ψ = φ := by
    rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, hvψ, ← hwφ]
    rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
  have hdom : IsDominant (dualAction M (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative) ψ) :=
    htrans.symm ▸ standardFacet_isDominant M hφ
  have hfix := dominant_translate_eq M (standardFacet_isDominant M hψ)
    (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative) hdom
  have hφψ : φ = ψ := htrans.symm.trans hfix
  have hIK : L.indices = K.indices :=
    standardFacet_indices_unique M hφ (hφψ.symm ▸ hψ)
  refine ⟨hIK, ?_⟩
  have hmem := dominant_translate_mem_parabolic M (standardFacet_isDominant M hψ)
    (L.representative⁻¹ * K.representative) hdom
  rw [zeroIndices_of_mem_standardFacet M hψ, ← hIK] at hmem
  exact hmem

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transportedCha.source_declaration:
/-- Transport the signs of a realized chamber by the actual root permutation. -/
noncomputable def transportedChamber (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J)
    (C : ActualChamber M J) : ActualChamber M J where
  signs r := C.signs ((retainedRootEquiv M J w).symm r)
  nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := C.region_nonempty
    refine ⟨normalizerFlatEquiv M J w x, fun r => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := (retainedRootEquiv M J w).surjective r
    change (if C.signs ((retainedRootEquiv M J w).symm
      (retainedRootEquiv M J w s)) then
        0 < actualForms M J (retainedRootEquiv M J w s) (normalizerFlatEquiv M J w x)
      else actualForms M J (retainedRootEquiv M J w s) (normalizerFlatEquiv M J w x) < 0)
    simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, actualForms_transport, signHalfSpace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using hx s

theorem transportedChamber_mul (w z : CoxeterNormalizer M J)
    (C : ActualChamber M J) :

  have h := (mem_transportedChamber_iff M J w (transportedChamber M J z C)
    (normalizerRepresentation M J z x)).2 ((mem_transportedChamber_iff M J z C x).2 hx)
  simpa only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp] using h

theorem transportedChamber_rawLabel (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J) (L : RawFacetLabel M J) :
    transportedChamber M J w (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) =
      actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (normalizerRawLabel M J w L) := by
  let p := facetCanonicalPoint M L
  have hp : p ∈ (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).region := by
    rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region]
    exact facetCanonicalPoint_mem M L
  apply Chamber.eq_of_mem_region
    ((mem_transportedChamber_iff M J w _ p).mpr hp)
  rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region]
  apply (mem_translatedFacet_iff _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨canonicalDominant L.indices, canonicalDominant_mem_standardFacet M L.indices, ?_⟩
  change dualAction M (w.val * L.representative) (canonicalDominant L.indices) =
    dualAction M w.val (dualAction M L.representative (canonicalDominant L.indices))
  rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPos.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPositiveLift_generator_relation
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPos.source_declaration:
/-- Both Coxeter products are length-additive, so their canonical positive
simple lifts obey the same generator relation. -/
theorem transporterPositiveLift_generator_relation
    (hd : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M J)
    (hmin : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep K d) {i j : I} (hi : i ∈ K) (hj : j ∈ J)
    (hij : d * M.simple i = M.simple j * d) :
    transporterPositiveLift M d * Artin.generator M i =
      Artin.generator M j * transporterPositiveLift M d := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hd' := actual_transporter_to_provider M hd
  have hright := M.toCoxeterSystem.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep hmin
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple_mem_parabolic hi)
  have hleft := M.toCoxeterSystem.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep
    (minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter M.toCoxeterSystem hd' hmin)
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple_mem_parabolic hj)
  have hinv : d⁻¹ * M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j = (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j * d)⁻¹ := by
    rw [mul_inv_rev, M.toCoxeterSystem.inv_simple]
  rw [hinv, M.toCoxeterSystem.length_inv, M.toCoxeterSystem.length_inv] at hleft
  have hleft' : M.toCoxeterSystem.length (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j * d) =
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j) + M.toCoxeterSystem.length d := by omega
  have hij' : d * M.toCoxeterSystem.simple i = M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j * d := by
    simpa only [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple] using hij
  have he := congrArg (positiveSimpleLift M) hij'
  rw [positiveSimpleLift_mul M d (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple i) hright,
    positiveSimpleLift_mul M (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j) d hleft',
    positiveSimpleLift_simple, positiveSimpleLift_simple] at he
  have h := congrArg (positiveToParent M) he
  simpa only [map_mul, positiveToParent_generator, transporterPositiveLift] using h

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPos.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPositiveLift_inv_minimal_of_leftReduced
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPos.source_declaration:
/-- Conversely, left reduction of a canonical simple lift rules out every
source left descent, hence makes its inverse a minimal representative. -/
theorem transporterPositiveLift_inv_minimal_of_leftReduced
    (hred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J (transporterPositiveLift M d)) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep J d⁻¹ := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  apply M.toCoxeterSystem.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr
  intro i hi hdesc
  have hleft := M.toCoxeterSystem.isRightDescent_inv_iff.mp hdesc
  have hweak := (weakPrefix_simple_iff M.toCoxeterSystem i d).mpr
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hleft)
  have hp := (positivePrefix_simple_iff M _ _).mpr hweak
  rw [positiveSimpleLift_simple] at hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hp
  apply hred i hi (positiveToParent M q) (positiveActualHom M q).property
  have he := congrArg (positiveToParent M) hq
  simpa only [map_mul, positiveToParent_generator, transporterPositiveLift] using he.symm

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPos.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPositiveLift_isRibbon
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPos.source_declaration:
theorem transporterPositiveLift_isRibbon
    (hd : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M J)
    (hmin : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep K d) :
    IsRibbon M ⟨J⟩ ⟨K⟩ (transporterPositiveLift M d) := by
  have hd' := actual_transporter_to_provider M hd
  apply isRibbon_of_two_generator_relations M J K
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := transporter_conjugates_simple M.toCoxeterSystem hd' hmin hi
    simp only [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple] at he
    refine ⟨j, hj, transporterPositiveLift_generator_relation M hd hmin hi hj ?_⟩
    rw [← he]
    simp [mul_assoc]
  · intro j hj
    obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := transporter_inverse_conjugates_simple M.toCoxeterSystem hd' hmin hj
    simp only [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple] at he
    refine ⟨i, hi, (transporterPositiveLift_generator_relation M hd hmin hi hj ?_).symm⟩
    rw [← he]
    simp [mul_assoc]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPos.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPositiveLift_leftReduced
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporterPos.source_declaration:
theorem transporterPositiveLift_leftReduced
    (hd : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).map (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M J)
    (hmin : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep K d) :
    IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J (transporterPositiveLift M d) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hinv := minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter M.toCoxeterSystem
    (actual_transporter_to_provider M hd) hmin
  intro i hi q hq he
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual] at hq
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hq
  have hp : PositivePrefix M (positiveSimpleLift M (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple i))
      (positiveSimpleLift M d) := by
    rw [positiveSimpleLift_simple]
    refine ⟨q, positiveToParent_injective M ?_⟩
    simpa only [map_mul, positiveToParent_generator, transporterPositiveLift] using he.symm
  have hweak := (positivePrefix_simple_iff M _ _).mp hp
  have hdesc := M.toCoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_iff.mpr
    ((weakPrefix_simple_iff M.toCoxeterSystem i d).mp hweak)
  exact (M.toCoxeterSystem.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hinv i hi)
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.isRightDescent_inv_iff.mpr hdesc)

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporter_co.source_declaration:
theorem transporter_comp {X Y Z : Set I} {u v : M.Group}
    (hu : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y).map (MulAut.conj u).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X)
    (hv : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Z).map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y) :
    (Artin.coxeterParabolic M Z).map (MulAut.conj (u * v)).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M X := by
  have he : (MulAut.conj (u * v)).toMonoidHom =
      (MulAut.conj u).toMonoidHom.comp (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom := by
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    change (u * v) * g * (u * v)⁻¹ = u * (v * g * v⁻¹) * u⁻¹
    group
  rw [he, ← Subgroup.map_map, hv, hu]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporter_co.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporter_conjugates_simple
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.transporter_co.source_declaration:
/-- A minimal transporter permutes the selected simple generators between
its two actual standard parabolics. -/
theorem transporter_conjugates_simple
    (hd : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J)
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep K d) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ K) :
    ∃ j ∈ J, d * cs.simple i * d⁻¹ = cs.simple j := by
  let c := d * cs.simple i * d⁻¹
  have hc : c ∈ cs.parabolic J := by
    rw [← hd]
    exact ⟨cs.simple i, cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi, rfl⟩
  have hright := cs.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep hmin (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi)
  have hleft := cs.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep
    (minimal_inv_of_parabolic_transporter cs hd hmin) (inv_mem hc)
  rw [← mul_inv_rev, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv] at hleft
  have heq : c * d = d * cs.simple i := by dsimp [c]; group
  rw [heq] at hleft
  rw [cs.length_simple] at hright
  have hclen : cs.length c = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨ω, hred, hJ, hprod⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced_wordProd_eq_of_mem_parabolic hc
  have hlen : ω.length = 1 := by rw [← hred.eq, hprod, hclen]
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
  exact ⟨j, hJ j (by simp), by simpa only [cs.wordProd_singleton] using hprod.symm⟩

theorem transporter_inverse_conjugates_simple
    (hd : (cs.parabolic K).map (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J)
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep K d) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ J) :
    ∃ j ∈ K, d⁻¹ * cs.simple i * d = cs.simple j := by

/-- These pieces are exactly the connected components in the actual tube
intersection, including when forms repeat or the form family is empty. -/
theorem tubeIntersectionPiece_eq_connectedComponentIn {F : Set (Chamber ℓ)}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) {ρ : H → Bool} {p : ComplexComplement ℓ}
    (hp : p ∈ tubeIntersectionPiece F ρ) :
    tubeIntersectionPiece F ρ = connectedComponentIn (tubeIntersection F) p := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · have hpre := (isPathConnected_tubeIntersectionPiece hF ⟨p, hp⟩).isConnected.isPreconnected
    exact hpre.subset_connectedComponentIn hp (fun _ h => h.1)
  · intro q hq
    refine ⟨connectedComponentIn_subset (tubeIntersection F) p hq, ?_⟩
    intro h hd
    let f : ComplexComplement ℓ → ℝ := fun z => ℓ h z.val.1
    have hcont : ContinuousOn f (connectedComponentIn (tubeIntersection F) p) :=
      ((ℓ h).continuous.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val)).continuousOn
    have hzero : ∀ z ∈ connectedComponentIn (tubeIntersection F) p, f z ≠ 0 :=
      fun z hz => tubeIntersection_real_ne_zero
        (connectedComponentIn_subset (tubeIntersection F) p hz) hd
    have hpc : p ∈ connectedComponentIn (tubeIntersection F) p := mem_connectedComponentIn hp.1
    have hph := hp.2 h hd
    cases hs : ρ h
    · have hn : f p < 0 := by simpa [f, signHalfSpace, hs] using hph
      have hqn := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.gt_of_ne hcont hzero ⟨p, hpc, hn⟩ hq
      simpa [f, signHalfSpace, hs] using hqn
    · have hn : 0 < f p := by simpa [f, signHalfSpace, hs] using hph
      have hqp := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.lt_of_ne hcont hzero ⟨p, hpc, hn⟩ hq
      simpa [f, signHalfSpace, hs] using hqp

  · intro hp
    refine ⟨hp.1, fun h hd => ?_⟩

    exact hp.2 h hd
  · intro hp

/-- Two sign pieces can overlap only if their signs agree on every
disagreeing form. Values of the sign functions elsewhere are immaterial. -/
theorem tubeIntersectionPiece_signs_eq {F : Set (Chamber ℓ)} {ρ σ : H → Bool}
    {p : ComplexComplement ℓ} (hρ : p ∈ tubeIntersectionPiece F ρ)
    (hσ : p ∈ tubeIntersectionPiece F σ) {h : H} (hd : tubeDisagreement F h) :
    ρ h = σ h :=

theorem tubeIntersection_eq_iUnion_pieces (F : Set (Chamber ℓ)) :
    tubeIntersection F = ⋃ ρ : H → Bool, tubeIntersectionPiece F ρ := by
  classical
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨fun h => decide (0 < ℓ h p.val.1), hp, ?_⟩
    intro h hd
    have hn := tubeIntersection_real_ne_zero hp hd
    by_cases hpos : 0 < ℓ h p.val.1
    · simp [signHalfSpace, hpos]
    · have hneg : ℓ h p.val.1 < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) hn
      simpa [signHalfSpace, hpos] using hneg
  · rintro hp
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
    exact hρ.1

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.tubeLocalFunct.source_declaration:
/-- Actual overlap paths make the two local functors strictly equal. -/
theorem tubeLocalFunctor_agree (C D : Chamber ℓ) :
    FundamentalGroupoid.map
        (ContinuousMap.inclusion (Set.inter_subset_left : tubeSet C ∩ tubeSet D ⊆ tubeSet C)) ⋙
          tubeLocalFunctor ℓ C =
      FundamentalGroupoid.map
        (ContinuousMap.inclusion (Set.inter_subset_right : tubeSet C ∩ tubeSet D ⊆ tubeSet D)) ⋙
          tubeLocalFunctor ℓ D := by
  refine Functor.hext ?_ ?_
  · intro p; rfl
  intro p q γ
  apply heq_of_eq
  change tubeGauge ℓ C p.as.val ≫ inv (tubeGauge ℓ C q.as.val) =
    tubeGauge ℓ D p.as.val ≫ inv (tubeGauge ℓ D q.as.val)
  obtain ⟨γ, _⟩ := Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective γ
  have hconn := tubeConnector_eq_of_path ℓ C D γ
  have hp := tubeGauge_change ℓ p.as.property.1 p.as.property.2
  have hq := tubeGauge_change ℓ q.as.property.1 q.as.property.2
  simp [hp, hq, ← hconn, Category.assoc]

ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.tubeSet_transp.name: ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.tubeSet_transport_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.tubeSet_transp.source_declaration:
/-- Covariance of actual tubes under a specified linear homeomorphism and
form permutation, with the corresponding chamber-sign transport. -/
theorem tubeSet_transport_iff (e : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (σ : H ≃ H)
    (hforms : ∀ h x, ℓ (σ h) (e x) = ℓ h x)
    {C D : Chamber ℓ} (hsigns : ∀ h, D.signs (σ h) = C.signs h)
    {p q : ComplexComplement ℓ}
    (hreal : q.val.1 = e p.val.1) (himag : q.val.2 = e p.val.2) :
    q ∈ tubeSet D ↔ p ∈ tubeSet C := by
  constructor
  · intro hq h hx
    have hz : ℓ (σ h) q.val.1 = 0 := by rw [hreal, hforms, hx]
    have hs := hq (σ h) hz
    change (if D.signs (σ h) then 0 < ℓ (σ h) q.val.2 else ℓ (σ h) q.val.2 < 0) at hs
    change (if C.signs h then 0 < ℓ h p.val.2 else ℓ h p.val.2 < 0)
    rwa [hsigns, himag, hforms] at hs
  · intro hp k hk
    let h := σ.symm k
    have hσ : σ h = k := σ.apply_symm_apply k
    have hx : ℓ h p.val.1 = 0 := by
      have hv := hforms h p.val.1
      rw [hσ, ← hreal, hk] at hv
      exact hv.symm
    have hs := hp h hx
    have hs' : D.signs k = C.signs h := by rw [← hσ, hsigns]
    have hy : ℓ k q.val.2 = ℓ h p.val.2 := by rw [← hσ, himag, hforms]
    change (if C.signs h then 0 < ℓ h p.val.2 else ℓ h p.val.2 < 0) at hs
    change (if D.signs k then 0 < ℓ k q.val.2 else ℓ k q.val.2 < 0)
    rw [hs', hy]
    exact hs

ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.exists_conjugat.name: ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.exists_conjugate_simple_of_minimal
ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.exists_conjugat.source_declaration:
/-- A minimal normalizer representative conjugates a simple generator of the
parabolic to another simple generator of that parabolic. -/
theorem exists_conjugate_simple_of_minimal
    (hd : d ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W))
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ J) :
    ∃ j ∈ J, d * cs.simple i * d⁻¹ = cs.simple j := by
  let c := d * cs.simple i * d⁻¹
  have hc : c ∈ cs.parabolic J :=
    (Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff.mp hd (cs.simple i)).mp (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi)
  have hright := cs.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep hmin (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi)
  have hleft := cs.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep
    (minimal_inv_of_mem_normalizer cs hd hmin) (inv_mem hc)
  rw [← mul_inv_rev, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv] at hleft
  have heq : c * d = d * cs.simple i := by dsimp [c]; group
  rw [heq] at hleft
  rw [cs.length_simple] at hright
  have hclen : cs.length c = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨ω, hred, hJ, hprod⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced_wordProd_eq_of_mem_parabolic hc
  have hlen : ω.length = 1 := by rw [← hred.eq, hprod, hclen]
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
  refine ⟨j, hJ j (by simp), ?_⟩
  simpa only [cs.wordProd_singleton] using hprod.symm

ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.exists_inverse_.source_declaration:
/-- The reverse generator permutation is obtained from the inverse minimal
normalizer representative. -/
theorem exists_inverse_conjugate_simple_of_minimal
    (hd : d ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W))
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ J) :
    ∃ j ∈ J, d⁻¹ * cs.simple i * d = cs.simple j := by
  simpa only [inv_inv] using
    exists_conjugate_simple_of_minimal cs (inv_mem hd)
      (minimal_inv_of_mem_normalizer cs hd hmin) hi

ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.exists_minimal_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.exists_minimal_normalizer
ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.exists_minimal_.source_declaration:
/-- A normalizer element can be adjusted on the right by a parabolic element
to obtain a minimal representative which still normalizes the parabolic. -/
theorem exists_minimal_normalizer {w : W}
    (hw : w ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W)) :
    ∃ d v, v ∈ cs.parabolic J ∧ d = w * v ∧
      d ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W) ∧ cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hmin⟩ := cs.exists_isMinimalCosetRep J w
  exact ⟨w * v, v, hv, rfl,
    mul_mem hw ((cs.parabolic J).le_normalizer hv), hmin⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.isReduced_appen.source_declaration:
/-- Appending a parabolic simple generator to a reduced word of a minimal
representative preserves reducedness. -/
theorem isReduced_append_simple_of_minimal
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d) {ω : List I}
    (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (hprod : cs.wordProd ω = d) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ J) :
    cs.IsReduced (ω ++ [i]) := by
  have hlen := cs.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep hmin (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi)
  rw [cs.length_simple] at hlen
  change cs.length (cs.wordProd (ω ++ [i])) = (ω ++ [i]).length
  rw [cs.wordProd_append, cs.wordProd_singleton, hprod, hlen,
    List.length_append, List.length_singleton, ← hω.eq, hprod]

ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.isReduced_prepe.name: ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.isReduced_prepend_simple_of_minimal
ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.isReduced_prepe.source_declaration:
/-- Prepending a parabolic simple generator to a reduced word of a minimal
normalizer representative preserves reducedness. -/
theorem isReduced_prepend_simple_of_minimal
    (hd : d ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W))
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d) {ω : List I}
    (hω : cs.IsReduced ω) (hprod : cs.wordProd ω = d) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ J) :
    cs.IsReduced (i :: ω) := by
  have hlen := cs.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep
    (minimal_inv_of_mem_normalizer cs hd hmin) (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi)
  have heq : d⁻¹ * cs.simple i = (cs.simple i * d)⁻¹ := by simp
  rw [heq, cs.length_inv, cs.length_inv, cs.length_simple] at hlen
  change cs.length (cs.wordProd (i :: ω)) = (i :: ω).length
  rw [cs.wordProd_cons, hprod, hlen, List.length_cons, ← hω.eq, hprod]

ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.minimal_inv_of_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.minimal_inv_of_mem_normalizer
ArtinNormalisers.Coxeter.minimal_inv_of_.source_declaration:
/-- Inversion preserves minimality for an element normalizing the parabolic. -/
theorem minimal_inv_of_mem_normalizer
    (hd : d ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (cs.parabolic J : Set W))
    (hmin : cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d) :
    cs.IsMinimalCosetRep J d⁻¹ := by
  refine cs.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr ?_
  intro i hi hdesc
  have hleft : cs.IsLeftDescent d i := cs.isRightDescent_inv_iff.mp hdesc
  have hc : d⁻¹ * cs.simple i * d ∈ cs.parabolic J :=
    (Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff''.mp hd (cs.simple i)).mp (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hi)
  have hlen := cs.length_mul_of_isMinimalCosetRep hmin hc
  have heq : d * (d⁻¹ * cs.simple i * d) = cs.simple i * d := by group
  rw [heq] at hlen
  have hshort := cs.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hleft
  omega

structure CarrierFamily (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) where
  map : ∀ F : Finset P, F.Nonempty → D.admissible F → C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y)
  carried : ∀ F hne hF x, map F hne hF x ∈ D.carrier F

    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (x : StdSimplex ℝ A),

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.CarrierFamily..source_declaration:
/-- Global continuity follows from genuine finite-chart finality on the
literal hereditary subspace. -/
theorem continuous_descendFun : Continuous (family.descendFun S had) := by
  apply (continuous_subcomplex_iff_canonical S hS _).mpr
  intro F hF hne hSF
  let c := subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF
  let f : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (F.card - 1 + 1)), OrderWeights P) :=
    ⟨fun z => (c z).val,
      continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF)⟩
  have hf (z) : (f z).weights.support ⊆ F := by
    change (orderWeightsOfChain (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) z).weights.support ⊆ F
    exact (chainWeights_support (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) z).trans
      (by rw [finiteChainOrder_range])
  have hc := (family.map F hne (had F hF hSF)).continuous.comp
    (continuous_weightFaceCoordinates F f hf)
  apply hc.congr
  intro z
  exact (family.descendFun_eq S had (c z) F hF hne hSF (hf z)).symm

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.CarrierFamily..source_declaration:
/-- Full-family coherence implies equality at every actual geometric overlap. -/
lemma CarrierFamily.eq_of_map_eq {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} (f : CarrierFamily D)
    {A B C : Finset P} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C)
    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
    f.map A hA ha x = f.map B hB hb y := by
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := carrierFace_intersection_preimage hAC hBC x y hxy
  obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := z.support_weights_nonempty
  have hne : (A ∩ B).Nonempty := ⟨a.val, a.property⟩
  have had : D.admissible (A ∩ B) := D.hereditary Finset.inter_subset_left ha
  rw [← hzx, ← hzy,
    f.compatible hne hA had ha Finset.inter_subset_left,
    f.compatible hne hB had hb Finset.inter_subset_right]

/-- The overlap may also be tested in the original ambient vertex simplex. -/
lemma CarrierFamily.eq_of_map_val_eq {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} (f : CarrierFamily D)
    {A B : Finset P} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
    (hxy : x.map Subtype.val = y.map Subtype.val) :
    f.map A hA ha x = f.map B hB hb y := by
  apply f.eq_of_map_eq hA hB ha hb (Finset.subset_union_left) (Finset.subset_union_right) x y
  apply StdSimplex.simplex_map_injective (f := (Subtype.val : (A ∪ B : Finset P) → P))
    Subtype.val_injective
  simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, carrierFaceInclusion] using hxy

/-- Any two carried coherent families admit an actual coherent homotopy in
all finite dimensions, retaining the whole original carrier on each face. -/
noncomputable def CarrierFamily.homotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y}
    (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) : CarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ where
  hom F hne hF := (PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages D f₀ f₁ F.card).hom F hne hF le_rfl
  carried F hne hF := (PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages D f₀ f₁ F.card).carried F hne hF le_rfl
  compatible {A B} hA hB ha hb hAB t x := by
    have hn := Finset.card_le_card hAB
    exact ((PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages D f₀ f₁ B.card).compatible
      hA hB ha hb hn le_rfl hAB t x).trans
      (congrArg (fun H ↦ H (t, x))
        (PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages_hom_stable D f₀ f₁ hn A hA ha le_rfl))

/-- Coherent carried homotopies, constructed below from two carried families. -/
structure CarrierHomotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) where
  hom : ∀ F : Finset P, (hne : F.Nonempty) → (hF : D.admissible F) →
    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF)
  carried : ∀ F hne hF t x, hom F hne hF (t, x) ∈ D.carrier F
  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (t : I) (x : StdSimplex ℝ A),
    hom B hB hb (t, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) = hom A hA ha (t, x)

theorem continuous_descendFun :
    Continuous (fun p : unitInterval × SubcomplexWeights S => H.descendFun S had p.1 p.2) := by
  apply (continuous_subcomplex_prod_iff_canonical S hS _).mpr
  intro F hF hne hSF
  let c := subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF
  let f : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (F.card - 1 + 1)), OrderWeights P) :=
    ⟨fun z => (c z).val,
      continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF)⟩
  have hf (z) : (f z).weights.support ⊆ F := by
    change (orderWeightsOfChain (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) z).weights.support ⊆ F
    exact (chainWeights_support (finiteChainOrder F hF hne) z).trans
      (by rw [finiteChainOrder_range])
  have hc := (H.hom F hne (had F hF hSF)).continuous.comp
    (continuous_fst.prodMk ((continuous_weightFaceCoordinates F f hf).comp continuous_snd))
  apply hc.congr
  intro p
  exact (H.descendFun_eq S had p.1 (c p.2) F hF hne hSF (hf p.2)).symm

/-- Descent retains both exact endpoint maps. Product continuity follows from
the proved locally compact parameter version of hereditary chart finality. -/
noncomputable def descend :
    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.descend S hS had) (f₁.descend S hS had) where
  toFun p := H.descendFun S had p.1 p.2
  continuous_toFun := H.continuous_descendFun S hS had
  map_zero_left _w := (H.hom _ _ _).apply_zero _
  map_one_left _w := (H.hom _ _ _).apply_one _

    (had _ (orderWeights_support_isChain w.val) w.property)

theorem descend_carried (t : unitInterval) (w : SubcomplexWeights S) (F : Finset P)

/-- The supplied carrier data contain contractibility and monotonicity only,
not maps, extensions, homotopies, or coherence conclusions. -/
structure FiniteCarrierData (P : Type u) (Y : Type v) [TopologicalSpace Y] where
  admissible : Finset P → Prop
  hereditary : ∀ {A B}, A ⊆ B → admissible B → admissible A
  carrier : Finset P → Set Y
  contractible : ∀ F, F.Nonempty → admissible F → ContractibleSpace (carrier F)
  monotone : ∀ {A B}, A ⊆ B → A.Nonempty → admissible B → carrier A ⊆ carrier B

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteCarrierD.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteCarrierData.descendedMap
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteCarrierD.source_declaration:
/-- A continuous map obtained directly from contractibility and monotonicity
data, through the proved all-dimensional coherent-family construction. -/
noncomputable def FiniteCarrierData.descendedMap (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) :
    C(SubcomplexWeights D.admissible, Y) :=
  D.family.descend D.admissible (fun {_ _} hAB hB => D.hereditary hAB hB) (fun _ _ h => h)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteCarrierD.source_declaration:
/-- Monotone actual contractible carriers admit coherent geometric simplex
maps in every finite dimension. No coherent family is an input. -/
noncomputable def FiniteCarrierData.family (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) : CarrierFamily D where
  map F hne hF := (PartialCarrierFamily.stages D F.card).map F hne hF le_rfl
  carried F hne hF := (PartialCarrierFamily.stages D F.card).carried F hne hF le_rfl
  compatible {A B} hA hB ha hb hAB x := by
    have hn := Finset.card_le_card hAB
    exact ((PartialCarrierFamily.stages D B.card).compatible hA hB ha hb hn le_rfl hAB x).trans
      (ContinuousMap.congr_fun (PartialCarrierFamily.stages_map_stable D hn A hA ha le_rfl) x)

theorem continuous_weight (i : Sigma F) : Continuous (weight p W ρ i) := by
  classical
  apply continuous_of_tsupport
  intro y hy
  have hs := (tsupport_weight_subset p hp T W ho hd hc ρ hT i hy).1
  apply ((ρ i.1).continuous.comp hp).continuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [(ho i.1 i.2).mem_nhds hs] with z hz
  simp only [weight, ite_eq_left hz, Function.comp_def]

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteSheetPar.source_declaration:
theorem exists_local_unique (s : S) (y : Y) :
    ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 y, ∀ e f : F s,
      (supportPiece p W ρ ⟨s, e⟩ ∩ N).Nonempty →
      (supportPiece p W ρ ⟨s, f⟩ ∩ N).Nonempty → e = f := by
  by_cases hs : p y ∈ tsupport (ρ s)
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hc s y (hT s hs)
    refine ⟨W s e, (ho s e).mem_nhds he, ?_⟩
    rintro f g ⟨z, hz, hze⟩ ⟨w, hw, hwe⟩
    exact (sheet_eq_of_mem W hd hz.1 hze).trans (sheet_eq_of_mem W hd hw.1 hwe).symm
  · refine ⟨p ⁻¹' (tsupport (ρ s))ᶜ,
      ((isClosed_tsupport (ρ s)).isOpen_compl.preimage hp).mem_nhds hs, ?_⟩
    rintro e f ⟨z, hz, hzn⟩ _
    exact (hzn hz.2).elim

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteSheetPar.source_declaration:
theorem isClosed_supportPiece (i : Sigma F) : IsClosed (supportPiece p W ρ i) := by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff]
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  intro y hy
  by_cases hs : p y ∈ tsupport (ρ i.1)
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hc i.1 y (hT i.1 hs)
    have hne : e ≠ i.2 := by
      intro h
      exact hy ⟨h ▸ he, hs⟩
    filter_upwards [(ho i.1 e).mem_nhds he] with z hz
    exact fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp (hd i.1 hne) hz h.1
  · filter_upwards [((isClosed_tsupport (ρ i.1)).isOpen_compl.preimage hp).mem_nhds hs] with z hz
    exact fun h => hz h.2

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteSheetPar.source_declaration:
theorem locallyFinite_supportPiece [Finite S] : LocallyFinite (supportPiece p W ρ) := by
  intro y
  choose N hN hu using exists_local_unique p hp T W ho hd hc ρ hT (y := y)
  refine ⟨⋂ s, N s, Filter.iInter_mem.mpr hN, ?_⟩
  apply Set.Finite.of_finite_image (f := Sigma.fst) (Set.toFinite _)
  rintro ⟨s, e⟩ he ⟨t, f⟩ hf hst
  dsimp at hst
  subst t
  have he' : (supportPiece p W ρ ⟨s, e⟩ ∩ N s).Nonempty :=
    he.mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ (Set.iInter_subset N s))
  have hf' : (supportPiece p W ρ ⟨s, f⟩ ∩ N s).Nonempty :=
    hf.mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ (Set.iInter_subset N s))
  exact congrArg (Sigma.mk s) (hu s e f he' hf')

/-- The split functions form an actual partition on the total space. -/
def partition [Finite S] : PartitionOfUnity (Sigma F) Y where
  toFun i := ⟨weight p W ρ i, continuous_weight p hp T W ho hd hc ρ hT i⟩
  locallyFinite' := locallyFinite_support_weight p hp T W ho hd hc ρ hT
  nonneg' i y := by
    classical
    change 0 ≤ weight p W ρ i y
    unfold weight
    split_ifs
    · exact ρ.nonneg _ _
    · exact le_rfl
  sum_eq_one' y _ := (sum_weight p T W hd hc ρ hT y).trans (ρ.sum_eq_one (Set.mem_univ _))
  sum_le_one' y := (sum_weight p T W hd hc ρ hT y).trans_le (ρ.sum_le_one _)

theorem sheet_eq_of_mem {s : S} {e f : F s} {y : Y}

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteSheetPar.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteSheetPartition.sum_weight
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteSheetPar.source_declaration:
theorem sum_weight (y : Y) : (∑ᶠ i : Sigma F, weight p W ρ i y) = ∑ᶠ s, ρ s (p y) := by
  classical
  have hmap : Set.MapsTo Sigma.fst (Function.support fun i => weight p W ρ i y)
      (Function.support fun s => ρ s (p y)) := by
    intro i hi
    have hs := support_weight_subset p W ρ i hi
    simpa only [Function.mem_support, weight, ite_eq_left hs.1] using hi
  have hinj : Set.InjOn Sigma.fst (Function.support fun i => weight p W ρ i y) := by
    rintro ⟨s, e⟩ he ⟨t, f⟩ hf hst
    dsimp at hst
    subst t
    exact congrArg (Sigma.mk s) (sheet_eq_of_mem W hd
      (support_weight_subset p W ρ ⟨s, e⟩ he).1
      (support_weight_subset p W ρ ⟨s, f⟩ hf).1)
  have hsurj : Set.SurjOn Sigma.fst (Function.support fun i => weight p W ρ i y)
      (Function.support fun s => ρ s (p y)) := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hc s y (hT s (subset_tsupport (ρ s) hs))
    exact ⟨⟨s, e⟩, by simpa only [Function.mem_support, weight, ite_eq_left he] using hs, rfl⟩
  rw [← finsum_mem_support (fun i => weight p W ρ i y),
    ← finsum_mem_support (fun s => ρ s (p y))]
  apply finsum_mem_eq_of_bijOn Sigma.fst ⟨hmap, hinj, hsurj⟩
  intro i hi
  simp only [weight, ite_eq_left (support_weight_subset p W ρ i hi).1]

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteWeightCo.source_declaration:
/-- No single-chain carrier assumption is needed in a finite vertex set. -/
theorem continuous_iff_coordinates [Finite P] {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : X → OrderWeights P) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ p, Continuous (fun x => (f x).weights p) := by
  constructor
  · intro h p
    exact (weightEval_continuous p).comp h
  · intro h
    exact (isClosedEmbedding_coordinates (P := P)).isEmbedding.isInducing.continuous_iff.mpr
      (continuous_pi h)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteWeightCo.source_declaration:
/-- The actual finite weighted realization embeds in its real coordinates. -/
theorem isClosedEmbedding_coordinates [Finite P] :
    IsClosedEmbedding (fun w : OrderWeights P => fun p => w.weights p) := by
  apply (continuous_pi weightEval_continuous).isClosedEmbedding
  intro u v h
  apply OrderWeights.ext
  exact DFunLike.ext' h

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteWeightTr.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteWeightTransfer.continuous_moveOrderWeights
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteWeightTr.source_declaration:
theorem continuous_moveOrderWeights {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (p q : P) (f : C(X, OrderWeights P))
    (hcone : ∀ x, p ∈ (f x).weights.support → ∀ i ∈ (f x).weights.support, i ≤ q) :
    Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => moveOrderWeights p q z.1 (f z.2) (hcone z.2)) := by
  apply (FiniteWeightCoordinates.continuous_iff_coordinates _).mpr
  intro i
  have hwi : Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => (f z.2).weights i) :=
    (weightEval_continuous i).comp (f.continuous.comp continuous_snd)
  have hwp : Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => (f z.2).weights p) :=
    (weightEval_continuous p).comp (f.continuous.comp continuous_snd)
  have ht : Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => (z.1 : ℝ)) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
  change Continuous (fun z : unitInterval × X => movedWeights p q z.1 (f z.2) i)
  simp only [movedWeights_apply]
  split_ifs
  · exact (hwi.add (ht.mul hwp)).sub (ht.mul hwp)
  · exact (hwi.add (ht.mul hwp)).sub continuous_const
  · exact (hwi.add continuous_const).sub (ht.mul hwp)
  · exact (hwi.add continuous_const).sub continuous_const

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteWeightTr.source_declaration:
noncomputable def moveOrderWeights (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P)
    (hcone : p ∈ w.weights.support → ∀ i ∈ w.weights.support, i ≤ q) : OrderWeights P where
  weights := movedWeights p q t w
  nonneg := movedWeights_nonneg p q t w
  total := movedWeights_total p q t w
  chain := by
    intro i hi j hj
    by_cases hp : p ∈ w.weights.support
    · rcases movedWeights_support p q t w hi with hiold | hiq
      · rcases movedWeights_support p q t w hj with hjold | hjq
        · exact w.chain i hiold j hjold
        · exact Or.inl (hjq.symm ▸ hcone hp i hiold)
      · rcases movedWeights_support p q t w hj with hjold | hjq
        · exact Or.inr (hiq.symm ▸ hcone hp j hjold)
        · exact Or.inl (le_of_eq (hiq.trans hjq.symm))
    · rw [movedWeights_eq_of_notMem p q t w hp] at hi hj
      exact w.chain i hi j hj

    w.weights i + (if i = q then (t : ℝ) * w.weights p else 0) -
      (if i = p then (t : ℝ) * w.weights p else 0))

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteWeightTr.source_declaration:
theorem movedWeights_nonneg (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P) (i : P) :
    0 ≤ movedWeights p q t w i := by
  classical
  rw [movedWeights_apply]
  by_cases hp : i = p
  · subst i
    by_cases hq : p = q
    · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte, add_sub_cancel_right]
      exact w.nonneg q
    · simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
      have h := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr t.property.2) (w.nonneg p)
      nlinarith
  · simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
    split_ifs
    · exact add_nonneg (w.nonneg i) (mul_nonneg t.property.1 (w.nonneg p))
    · simpa only [add_zero] using w.nonneg i

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.FiniteWeightTr.source_declaration:
theorem movedWeights_support (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P)
    {i : P} (hi : i ∈ (movedWeights p q t w).support) :
    i ∈ w.weights.support ∨ i = q := by
  classical
  by_cases hq : i = q
  · exact Or.inr hq
  · left
    by_contra hno
    have hw : w.weights i = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hno
    have hz : movedWeights p q t w i = 0 := by
      rw [movedWeights_apply]
      by_cases hp : i = p
      · subst i
        simp only [hw, mul_zero, ite_self, sub_zero, add_zero]
      · simp only [hw, hq, hp, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, sub_zero]
    exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) hz

theorem movedWeights_total (p q : P) (t : unitInterval) (w : OrderWeights P) :
    (movedWeights p q t w).sum (fun _ a => a) = 1 := by
  classical
  let : Fintype P := Fintype.ofFinite P
  have hsum : (∑ i, w.weights i) = 1 := by
    rw [← Finsupp.sum_fintype w.weights (fun _ a => a) (by intro; rfl)]
    exact w.total
  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by intro; rfl)]
  simp only [movedWeights_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  linarith

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.GarsideWeights.source_declaration:
/-- Every compact map factors through an actual finite positive head-closed
contractible carrier and its unshifted inclusion. -/
theorem GarsideWeights.compact_map_contractible_carrier
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : C(X, GarsideWeights M B0)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)),
      incomingRoot M B0 ∈ B ∧
      (∀ u ∈ B, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) ∧
      (∀ u ∈ B, headStep M B0 u ∈ B) ∧
      ContractibleSpace (GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) ∧
      ∃ g : C(X, GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))),
        (unshiftedCarrierMap M B0 n B).comp g = f := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A, hA, a, ha⟩ := GarsideWeights.compact_map_finite_carrier M B0 f
  have hfA (x : X) (u : IncomingVertex M B0) (hu : u ∈ (f x).val.weights.support) : u ∈ A := by
    have he := congrArg (fun F : C(X, GarsideWeights M B0) => (F x).val) ha
    change weightMap (weightInclusion A) (a x).val = (f x).val at he
    rw [← he, weightMap_support_embedding (weightInclusion A) Subtype.val_injective] at hu
    obtain ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    exact v.property
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IncomingVertex.finite_eventually_positive hA.toFinset
  let e := IncomingVertex.cofinalShift (M := M) (B0 := B0) n
  let C := hA.toFinset.image e
  have hC : ∀ u ∈ C, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    exact hn v hv n le_rfl
  obtain ⟨B, hCB, hrB, hpos, hclosed⟩ := exists_finite_positive_head_closed M B0 C hC
  have hcontract : ContractibleSpace (GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) :=
    contractibleSpace_finite_positive_head_closed M B0
      (fun u => hpos u.val u.property) (fun u => hclosed u.val u.property)
      ⟨incomingRoot M B0, hrB⟩ rfl
  let sf : C(X, GarsideWeights M B0) :=
    ⟨fun x => cofinalWeightsShift M B0 n (f x),
      (cofinalWeightsShift M B0 n).continuous.comp f.continuous⟩
  have hs (x : X) : ∀ u ∈ (sf x).val.weights.support,
      u ∈ (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)) := by
    intro u hu
    change u ∈ (weightMap (e : IncomingVertex M B0 →o IncomingVertex M B0) (f x).val).weights.support at hu
    rw [weightMap_support_embedding _ e.injective] at hu
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    exact hCB (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hA.mem_toFinset.mpr (hfA x v hv), rfl⟩)
  let g : C(X, GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) :=
    ⟨fun x => GarsideWeights.restrict M B0 B (sf x) (hs x),
      GarsideWeights.continuous_restrict_finite M B0 B B.finite_toSet sf hs⟩
  refine ⟨n, B, hrB, hpos, hclosed, hcontract, g, ?_⟩
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  change (cofinalWeightsShift M B0 n).symm
    (GarsideWeightsOn.include M B0 B (GarsideWeights.restrict M B0 B (sf x) (hs x))) = f x
  rw [GarsideWeights.include_restrict]
  exact (cofinalWeightsShift M B0 n).symm_apply_apply (f x)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.GarsideWeights.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.GarsideWeights.compact_map_finite_carrier
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.GarsideWeights.source_declaration:
/-- Compact actual simple-chain maps factor through a finite actual subposet.
The geometric simple-chain condition is retained by the factorization. -/
theorem GarsideWeights.compact_map_finite_carrier
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : C(X, GarsideWeights M B0)) :
    ∃ (A : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)) (_ : A.Finite)
      (g : C(X, GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A)),
      (⟨GarsideWeightsOn.include M B0 A,
        GarsideWeightsOn.continuous_include M B0 A⟩ :
        C(GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A, GarsideWeights M B0)).comp g = f := by
  classical
  let f₀ : C(X, OrderWeights (IncomingVertex M B0)) :=
    ⟨fun x => (f x).val, continuous_subtype_val.comp f.continuous⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA, g₀, hg⟩ := OAI.HarmonicArtin.compact_map_finite_carrier f₀
  have hpoint (x : X) : weightMap (weightInclusion A) (g₀ x) = (f x).val :=
    congrArg (fun F : C(X, OrderWeights (IncomingVertex M B0)) => F x) hg
  have hallowed (x : X) : g₀ x ∈ garsideWeightsOnSet M B0 A := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    have hu' : u.val ∈ (f x).val.weights.support := by
      rw [← hpoint x, weightMap_support_embedding (weightInclusion A) Subtype.val_injective]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hv' : v.val ∈ (f x).val.weights.support := by
      rw [← hpoint x, weightMap_support_embedding (weightInclusion A) Subtype.val_injective]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact (f x).property u.val hu' v.val hv' huv
  let g : C(X, GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A) :=
    ⟨fun x => ⟨g₀ x, hallowed x⟩, g₀.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
  refine ⟨A, hA, g, ?_⟩
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hpoint x

    · subst w

/-- Inverse-arrow clearing and cofinal naturality give actual lower bounds. -/
theorem eventually_cofinalLower_le (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, n ≤ m → cofinalLowerVertex (M := M) B0 m ≤ u := by
  let v : IncomingVertex M u.source := ⟨B0, u.value⁻¹, .inverse u.reduced⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := v.eventually_positive
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro m hnm
  have hpos := hn m hnm
  have he : u.value⁻¹ * cofinalLoop M u.source.indices ^ m =
      cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ m * u.value⁻¹ :=
    (u.reduced.isRibbon.inv M).cofinalLoop_pow_mul M m
  change PositiveReducedArrow M B0 u.source
    (cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ m * u.value⁻¹)
  simpa only [v, cofinalShift_value, he] using hpos

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.source_declaration:
/-- Every signed incoming vertex becomes positive after sufficiently large
actual cofinal shifts; the conclusion retains positive ribbon generation. -/
theorem eventually_positive (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, n ≤ m →
      PositiveReducedArrow M u.source B0 ((cofinalShift m u).value) := by
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, hpa⟩ := u.reduced.positive_fraction M
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro m hnm
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
  have he : (cofinalShift (n + k) u).value = a * cofinalLoop M B0.indices ^ k := by
    rw [cofinalShift_value, hpa, pow_add]
    group
  rw [he]
  exact .comp ha (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M B0 k)

theorem exists_join (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.exists_join_of_common_lower
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.source_declaration:
/-- Above an actual common lower vertex, the actual positive ribbon lcm
constructs a least upper bound of the two incoming vertices. -/
theorem exists_join_of_common_lower (u v a : IncomingVertex M B0) (hau : a ≤ u) (hav : a ≤ v) :
    ∃ j : IncomingVertex M B0, u ≤ j ∧ v ≤ j ∧
      ∀ w : IncomingVertex M B0, u ≤ w → v ≤ w → j ≤ w := by
  obtain ⟨U, l, hl, ⟨ru, hru, hlu⟩, ⟨rv, hrv, hlv⟩, hleast⟩ :=
    positive_reduced_ribbon_lcm_left M hau hav
  let j : IncomingVertex M B0 :=
    ⟨U, l⁻¹ * a.value, .comp (.inverse hl.toReducedArrow) a.reduced⟩
  have huj : u.difference j = ru := by
    change u.value * (l⁻¹ * a.value)⁻¹ = ru
    rw [hlu]
    dsimp only [difference]
    group
  have hvj : v.difference j = rv := by
    change v.value * (l⁻¹ * a.value)⁻¹ = rv
    rw [hlv]
    dsimp only [difference]
    group
  refine ⟨j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change PositiveReducedArrow M u.source U (u.difference j)
    rw [huj]
    exact hru
  · change PositiveReducedArrow M v.source U (v.difference j)
    rw [hvj]
    exact hrv
  · intro w huw hvw
    have haw : a ≤ w := hau.trans huw
    have hpu : RibbonPrefix M (a.difference u) (a.difference w) :=
      ⟨u.difference w, huw.positive, (difference_mul a u w).symm⟩
    have hpv : RibbonPrefix M (a.difference v) (a.difference w) :=
      ⟨v.difference w, hvw.positive, (difference_mul a v w).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hwt⟩ := positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M hl haw
      (hleast _ haw.positive hpu hpv)
    have hjw : j.difference w = t := by
      change (l⁻¹ * a.value) * w.value⁻¹ = t
      calc
        _ = l⁻¹ * (a.difference w) := by dsimp only [difference]; group
        _ = t := by rw [hwt]; group
    change PositiveReducedArrow M U w.source (j.difference w)
    rw [hjw]
    exact ht

theorem exists_meet (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :
    ∃ m : IncomingVertex M B0, m ≤ u ∧ m ≤ v ∧

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.exists_meet_of_common_lower
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.source_declaration:
/-- A common lower chart and the genuine generated ribbon gcd construct a
meet with the full global greatest-lower-bound property. -/
theorem exists_meet_of_common_lower (u v a : IncomingVertex M B0) (hau : a ≤ u) (hav : a ≤ v) :
    ∃ m : IncomingVertex M B0, m ≤ u ∧ m ≤ v ∧
      ∀ w : IncomingVertex M B0, w ≤ u → w ≤ v → w ≤ m := by
  obtain ⟨U, d, hd, ⟨ru, hru, hdu⟩, ⟨rv, hrv, hdv⟩, hgreatest⟩ :=
    positive_reduced_ribbon_gcd_left_with_tails M hau hav
  let m : IncomingVertex M B0 :=
    ⟨U, d⁻¹ * a.value, .comp (.inverse hd.toReducedArrow) a.reduced⟩
  have hmu : m.difference u = ru := by
    change (d⁻¹ * a.value) * u.value⁻¹ = ru
    calc
      _ = d⁻¹ * (a.difference u) := by dsimp only [difference]; group
      _ = ru := by rw [hdu]; group
  have hmv : m.difference v = rv := by
    change (d⁻¹ * a.value) * v.value⁻¹ = rv
    calc
      _ = d⁻¹ * (a.difference v) := by dsimp only [difference]; group
      _ = rv := by rw [hdv]; group
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change PositiveReducedArrow M U u.source (m.difference u)
    rw [hmu]
    exact hru
  · change PositiveReducedArrow M U v.source (m.difference v)
    rw [hmv]
    exact hrv
  · intro w hwu hwv
    let s : IncomingVertex M B0 := w ⊔ a
    have has : a ≤ s := le_sup_right
    have hsu : s ≤ u := sup_le hwu hau
    have hsv : s ≤ v := sup_le hwv hav
    have hpu : RibbonPrefix M (a.difference s) (a.difference u) :=
      ⟨s.difference u, hsu.positive, (difference_mul a s u).symm⟩
    have hpv : RibbonPrefix M (a.difference s) (a.difference v) :=
      ⟨s.difference v, hsv.positive, (difference_mul a s v).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := hgreatest s.source (a.difference s) has hpu hpv
    have hsm : s.difference m = t := by
      change s.value * (d⁻¹ * a.value)⁻¹ = t
      rw [hdt]
      dsimp only [difference]
      group
    have hsmle : s ≤ m := by
      change PositiveReducedArrow M s.source U (s.difference m)
      rw [hsm]
      exact ht
    exact le_trans le_sup_left hsmle

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.source_declaration:
/-- The incoming chamber definition agrees with actual signed fiber transport. -/
theorem fiberTarget_chamber (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :
    (fiberTarget M B0.indices (Artin.projection M (difference u v))
      (isRibbon_projection_transporter M (difference_reduced u v).isRibbon) u.chamberFiber).val =
        v.chamber := by
  let w := Artin.projection M (difference u v)
  have hw := isRibbon_projection_transporter M (difference_reduced u v).isRibbon
  have hchosen : actualChamberOfRawLabel M B0.indices
      (chamberRawLabel M B0.indices u.chamber) =
        actualChamberOfRawLabel M B0.indices u.rawFacetLabel :=
    chamberRawLabel_chamber M B0.indices _
  have hreplace := rightTransportRawLabel_independent M B0.indices hchosen
    v.source.indices w
    (by simpa only [chamberRawLabel_indices, chamber_indices] using hw) hw
  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M B0.indices
    (fiberTargetLabel M B0.indices w hw u.chamberFiber) = v.chamber
  refine hreplace.trans ?_
  apply (actualChamberOfRawLabel_eq_iff M B0.indices _ v.rawFacetLabel).mpr
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  change (((Artin.projection M u.value)⁻¹ * w)⁻¹ *
    (Artin.projection M v.value)⁻¹) ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M v.source.indices
  have he : (Artin.projection M u.value)⁻¹ * w = (Artin.projection M v.value)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [w, difference, map_mul, map_inv]
    group
  rw [he, inv_mul_cancel]
  exact Subgroup.one_mem _

/-- The finite join remains inside an actual simple interval containing a
nonempty packet. Both bounding factors and all packet-to-join factors are simple. -/
theorem finiteJoin_simple_interval (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (a b : IncomingVertex M B0) (ha : ∀ v ∈ F, a ≤ v) (hb : ∀ v ∈ F, v ≤ b)
    (hs : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b)) :
    a ≤ finiteJoin F hF ∧ finiteJoin F hF ≤ b ∧
      SimpleRibbon M a.source (finiteJoin F hF).source (a.difference (finiteJoin F hF)) ∧
      SimpleRibbon M (finiteJoin F hF).source b.source ((finiteJoin F hF).difference b) ∧
      ∀ v ∈ F, SimpleRibbon M v.source (finiteJoin F hF).source
        (v.difference (finiteJoin F hF)) := by
  let v := hF.choose
  have hv : v ∈ F := hF.choose_spec
  have haj : a ≤ finiteJoin F hF := (ha v hv).trans (le_finiteJoin F hF hv)
  have hjb : finiteJoin F hF ≤ b := finiteJoin_le F hF hb
  refine ⟨haj, hjb,
    simple_difference_of_interval hs le_rfl haj hjb,
    simple_difference_of_interval hs haj hjb le_rfl, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  exact simple_difference_of_interval hs (ha w hw) (le_finiteJoin F hF hw) hjb

any actual simple interval containing the packet. -/
theorem finiteMeetJoin_simple_interval (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (a b : IncomingVertex M B0) (ha : ∀ v ∈ F, a ≤ v) (hb : ∀ v ∈ F, v ≤ b)
    (hs : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b)) :
    a ≤ finiteMeet F hF ∧ finiteMeet F hF ≤ finiteJoin F hF ∧ finiteJoin F hF ≤ b ∧
      SimpleRibbon M (finiteMeet F hF).source (finiteJoin F hF).source
        ((finiteMeet F hF).difference (finiteJoin F hF)) := by
  have ham := le_finiteMeet F hF ha
  have hmj := finiteMeet_le_finiteJoin F hF
  have hjb := finiteJoin_le F hF hb
  exact ⟨ham, hmj, hjb, simple_difference_of_interval hs ham hmj hjb⟩

/-- One actual cofinal lower vertex bounds an arbitrary finite packet below;
all sufficiently large powers work, including degenerate cofinal loops. -/
theorem finite_eventually_cofinalLower_le (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ u ∈ F, ∀ m : ℕ, n ≤ m → cofinalLowerVertex (M := M) B0 m ≤ u := by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | @insert u F _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := u.eventually_cofinalLower_le
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨max n k, ?_⟩
    intro v hv m hm
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hv with rfl | hv
    · exact hn m ((le_max_left _ _).trans hm)
    · exact hk v hv m ((le_max_right _ _).trans hm)

/-- Invert actual signed ribbons to give outgoing arrows in the pre-existing
actual reduced ribbon groupoid. No paths or vertex groups are replaced. -/
def outgoingEquiv (B : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M) :
    IncomingVertex M B.val ≃ Outgoing (ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M) B where
  toFun u := ⟨actualRibbonObject M u.source,
    ⟨⟨u.value⁻¹, u.reduced.isRibbon.inv M⟩, .inverse u.reduced⟩⟩
  invFun p := ⟨p.1.val, p.2.val.val⁻¹, .inverse p.2.property⟩
  left_inv u := ext_value (inv_inv u.value)
  right_inv := by
    rintro ⟨⟨X, hX⟩, ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hr⟩⟩
    dsimp only
    refine Sigma.ext (Subtype.ext rfl) ?_
    apply heq_of_eq
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subtype.ext (inv_inv p)

instance partialOrder : PartialOrder (IncomingVertex M B0) where
  le u v := PositiveReducedArrow M u.source v.source (difference u v)
  le_refl u := by
    rw [difference_self]
    exact .identity u.source
  le_trans u v w huv hvw := by
    have h := PositiveReducedArrow.comp huv hvw
    simpa only [difference_mul] using h
  le_antisymm u v huv hvu := by
    have hn := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ huv.positive
    have hn' := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hvu.positive
    have hz : degree M (difference u v) = 0 := by
      simp only [difference, degree_mul, degree_inv] at hn hn' ⊢
      omega
    exact (difference_eq_one_iff u v).mp
      ((degree_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ huv.positive).mp hz)

/-- Every signed target loop acts by an actual order automorphism. -/
def rightMulOrderIso (b : Artin.Group M) (hb : ReducedArrow M B0 B0 b) :
    IncomingVertex M B0 ≃o IncomingVertex M B0 where
  toFun := rightMul b hb
  invFun := rightMul b⁻¹ (.inverse hb)
  left_inv u := ext_value (by simp only [rightMul_value]; group)
  right_inv u := ext_value (by simp only [rightMul_value]; group)
  map_rel_iff' := by
    intro u v
    change PositiveReducedArrow M u.source v.source
      ((u.value * b) * (v.value * b)⁻¹) ↔
        PositiveReducedArrow M u.source v.source (u.value * v.value⁻¹)
    have he : (u.value * b) * (v.value * b)⁻¹ = u.value * v.value⁻¹ := by group
    rw [he]

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.source_declaration:
/-- Every ordered subinterval of an actual simple incoming interval is simple. -/
theorem simple_difference_of_interval {a b u v : IncomingVertex M B0}
    (hs : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b))
    (hau : a ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hvb : v ≤ b) :
    SimpleRibbon M u.source v.source (u.difference v) := by
  have htotal : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference u * u.difference b) := by
    simpa only [difference_mul] using hs
  have htail := (SimpleRibbon.factors M htotal hau (huv.trans hvb)).2
  have htail' : SimpleRibbon M u.source b.source (u.difference v * v.difference b) := by
    simpa only [difference_mul] using htail
  exact (SimpleRibbon.factors M htail' huv hvb).1

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.IncomingVertex.source_declaration:
/-- A fixed actual incoming label determines its source by genuine positive
parabolic conjugation, rather than by an injectivity field. -/
theorem source_eq_of_value_eq {u v : IncomingVertex M B0} (h : u.value = v.value) :
    u.source = v.source := by
  have hu := u.reduced.isRibbon.inv M
  have hv := v.reduced.isRibbon.inv M
  rw [h] at hu
  exact congrArg (fun J : Set I => (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))
    (isRibbon_target_indices_unique M hu hv)

theorem they will be constructed by parameterized face induction. -/

  ∀ {A B : Finset ι} (hneA : A.Nonempty) (hneB : B.Nonempty)

    (t : I) (x : coverFaceParameter W B) (z : StdSimplex ℝ A),
    H B hneB hB (t, (x, z.map (numerableFaceInclusion hAB))) =

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedC.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedCarrierFamily
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedC.source_declaration:
/-- Given endpoint maps on varying actual parameter domains. Coherence here is
only coherence of the given endpoint maps, not a homotopy or extension premise. -/
structure ParameterizedCarrierFamily (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y)
    (R : Finset P → Set X) (hR : Antitone R) where
  map : ∀ F : Finset P, F.Nonempty → D.admissible F → C(R F × StdSimplex ℝ F, Y)
  carried : ∀ F hne hF x z, map F hne hF (x, z) ∈ D.carrier F
  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
    (x : R B) (z : StdSimplex ℝ A),
    map B hB hb (x, z.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) =
      map A hA ha (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB x, z)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedC.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedCarrierFamily.homotopy
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedC.source_declaration:
/-- Actual all-dimensional parameterized carrier homotopies, with source
pieces varying antitonically. Neither local compactness nor contractibility
of the parameter spaces is required. -/
noncomputable def ParameterizedCarrierFamily.homotopy
    {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y} {R : Finset P → Set X} {hR : Antitone R}
    (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) : ParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ where
  hom F hne hF := (PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.stages f₀ f₁ F.card).hom F hne hF le_rfl
  carried F hne hF := (PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.stages f₀ f₁ F.card).carried F hne hF le_rfl
  compatible {A B} hA hB ha hb hAB t p x := by
    have hn := Finset.card_le_card hAB
    exact ((PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.stages f₀ f₁ B.card).compatible
      hA hB ha hb hn le_rfl hAB t p x).trans
      (congrArg (fun H ↦ H (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB p, x)))
        (PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.stages_hom_stable f₀ f₁ hn A hA ha le_rfl))

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedC.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedCarrierHomotopy
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.ParameterizedC.source_declaration:
/-- The result of the varying-parameter construction, containing actual
homotopies with the given endpoint maps and all face restrictions. -/
structure ParameterizedCarrierHomotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y}
    {R : Finset P → Set X} {hR : Antitone R}
    (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) where
  hom : ∀ F : Finset P, (hne : F.Nonempty) → (hF : D.admissible F) →
    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF)
  carried : ∀ F hne hF t x z, hom F hne hF (t, (x, z)) ∈ D.carrier F
  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
    (t : I) (x : R B) (z : StdSimplex ℝ A),
    hom B hB hb (t, (x, z.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB))) =
      hom A hA ha (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB x, z))

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierFamily
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- A finite-cardinality stage of the construction. -/
structure PartialCarrierFamily (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) (n : ℕ) where
  map : ∀ F : Finset P, F.Nonempty → D.admissible F → F.card ≤ n →
    C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y)
  carried : ∀ F hne hF hn x, map F hne hF hn x ∈ D.carrier F
  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (x : StdSimplex ℝ A),
    map B hB hb hBn (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) = map A hA ha hAn x

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierFamily.empty
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- The empty stage contains no nonempty face. -/
def empty (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) : PartialCarrierFamily D 0 where
  map _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
  carried _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
  compatible hA _ _ _ hAn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hAn) hA.card_pos)

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierFamily.eq_of_map_eq
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- Coherence on smaller faces already gives equality on every actual overlap. -/
lemma eq_of_map_eq (f : PartialCarrierFamily D n) {A B C : Finset P}
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n)
    (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C)
    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
    f.map A hA ha hAn x = f.map B hB hb hBn y := by
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := carrierFace_intersection_preimage hAC hBC x y hxy
  obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := z.support_weights_nonempty
  have hne : (A ∩ B).Nonempty := ⟨a.val, a.property⟩
  have had : D.admissible (A ∩ B) := D.hereditary Finset.inter_subset_left ha
  have hcard : (A ∩ B).card ≤ n := (Finset.card_le_card Finset.inter_subset_left).trans hAn
  rw [← hzx, ← hzy,
    f.compatible hne hA had ha hcard hAn Finset.inter_subset_left,
    f.compatible hne hB had hb hcard hBn Finset.inter_subset_right]

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierFamily.exists_face_extension
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- Extend one new finite face using only the already constructed lower faces.
The conclusion retains compatibility with every smaller face, not only facets. -/
theorem exists_face_extension (f : PartialCarrierFamily D n)
    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hc : F.card = n + 1) :
    ∃ g : C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y),
      (∀ x, g x ∈ D.carrier F) ∧
      ∀ G (hneG : G.Nonempty) (hG : D.admissible G) (hGn : G.card ≤ n)
        (hGF : G ⊆ F) (x : StdSimplex ℝ G),
        g (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)) = f.map G hneG hG hGn x := by
  classical
  let _ := D.contractible F hne hF
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨z, _⟩ := id_nullhomotopic (D.carrier F)
    refine ⟨ContinuousMap.const _ z.val, fun _ ↦ z.property, ?_⟩
    intro G hneG hG hGn
    have := hneG.card_pos
    omega
  | succ k =>
    let e : Fin (k + 2) ≃ F := (F.equivFinOfCardEq hc).symm
    let A (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Finset P := F.erase (e i).val
    have hAF (i : Fin (k + 2)) : A i ⊆ F := Finset.erase_subset _ _
    have hAc (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card = k + 1 := by
      dsimp [A]
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (e i).property, hc]
      omega
    have hAn (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card ≤ k + 1 := (hAc i).le
    have hAe (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).Nonempty :=
      Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hAc]; omega)
    have hAd (i : Fin (k + 2)) : D.admissible (A i) := D.hereditary (hAF i) hF
    let v (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Fin (k + 1) → A i := fun j ↦
      ⟨(e (i.succAbove j)).val, Finset.mem_erase.mpr
        ⟨fun he ↦ Fin.succAbove_ne i j (e.injective (Subtype.ext he)),
          (e (i.succAbove j)).property⟩⟩
    have hv (i : Fin (k + 2)) : carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i) ∘ v i = e ∘ i.succAbove := rfl
    let H (i : Fin (k + 2)) : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1)) × I, D.carrier F) :=
      ⟨fun q ↦ ⟨f.map (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i) (q.1.map (v i)),
        D.monotone (hAF i) (hAe i) hF (f.carried _ _ _ _ _)⟩,
        ((f.map (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i)).continuous.comp
          ((StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ (v i)).comp continuous_fst)).subtype_mk _⟩
    have hcompat (i j : Fin (k + 2)) (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) (t : I)
        (hxy : x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove) : H i (x, t) = H j (y, t) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) (hAe j) (hAd i) (hAd j) (hAn i) (hAn j)
        (hAF i) (hAF j) (x.map (v i)) (y.map (v j)) (by
          simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
            congrArg (StdSimplex.map e) hxy)
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := StdSimplex.exists_simplex_boundary_track k H hcompat
    let b : C(PUnit.{1} × StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1), D.carrier F) :=
      ⟨fun q ↦ B (q.2, 0), by fun_prop⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_parameterized_simplex_extension (k + 1) b
    let g : C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y) :=
      ⟨fun q ↦ (L (PUnit.unit, q.map e.symm)).val, by fun_prop⟩
    refine ⟨g, fun q ↦ (L (PUnit.unit, q.map e.symm)).property, ?_⟩
    intro G hneG hG hGn hGF x
    have hlt : G.card < F.card := by omega
    have hnsub : ¬F ⊆ G := fun h ↦ (not_lt_of_ge (Finset.card_le_card h)) hlt
    obtain ⟨a, haF, haG⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hnsub
    let i : Fin (k + 2) := e.symm ⟨a, haF⟩
    let q := (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)).map e.symm
    have hqi : q.weights i = 0 := by
      rw [show q = x.map (e.symm ∘ carrierFaceInclusion hGF) from
        (StdSimplex.map_map _ _ _)]
      apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
      rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      have he := congrArg (fun t ↦ (e t).val) hj
      exact haG (show a ∈ G from (by simpa [i] using he) ▸ j.property)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q).mpr hqi
    have hqe : q.map e = x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := by
      dsimp [q]
      rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
      rw [show (fun a : F ↦ e (e.symm a)) = id from funext e.apply_symm_apply,
        StdSimplex.map_id]
    have hfz : (z.map (v i)).map (carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i)) =
        x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := by
      rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
      change z.map (e ∘ i.succAbove) = _
      rw [StdSimplex.map_comp, hz, hqe]
    have hface : g (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)) =
        f.map (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i) (z.map (v i)) := by
      change (L (PUnit.unit, q)).val = _
      have hbq : (⟨q, i, hqi⟩ : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) =
          StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z := Subtype.ext hz.symm
      have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hL PUnit.unit ⟨q, i, hqi⟩)
      change (L (PUnit.unit, q)).val = _ at h
      rw [show b (PUnit.unit, ⟨q, i, hqi⟩) = B (⟨q, i, hqi⟩, 0) from rfl,
        hbq, hB] at h
      exact h
    exact hface.trans (f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) hneG (hAd i) hG (hAn i) hGn
      (hAF i) hGF (z.map (v i)) x hfz)

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierFamily.next
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- One cardinality step, with every filler obtained from actual HEP. -/
noncomputable def next (f : PartialCarrierFamily D n) : PartialCarrierFamily D (n + 1) := by
  classical
  let g (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) :
      C(StdSimplex ℝ F, Y) :=
    if h : F.card ≤ n then f.map F hne hF h
    else (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (by omega)).choose
  have hg (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F)
      (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) (h : ¬F.card ≤ n) :=
    (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (show F.card = n + 1 by omega)).choose_spec
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro F hne hF hn x
    by_cases h : F.card ≤ n
    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_left h] using f.carried F hne hF h x
    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right h] using (hg F hne hF hn h).1 x
  · intro A B hA hB ha hb hAn hBn hAB x
    by_cases hBsmall : B.card ≤ n
    · have hAsmall := (Finset.card_le_card hAB).trans hBsmall
      simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
        f.compatible hA hB ha hb hAsmall hBsmall hAB x
    · by_cases hAsmall : A.card ≤ n
      · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
          (hg B hB hb hBn hBsmall).2 A hA ha hAsmall hAB x
      · have heq : A = B := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hAB (by omega)
        subst B
        have hi : carrierFaceInclusion hAB = id := rfl
        rw [hi, StdSimplex.map_id]

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierFamily.next_map_old
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
lemma next_map_old (f : PartialCarrierFamily D n) (F : Finset P)
    (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hn : F.card ≤ n) :
    f.next.map F hne hF (hn.trans (Nat.le_succ n)) = f.map F hne hF hn := by
  simp only [next, dite_eq_left hn]

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierFamily.stages
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- Cardinal recursion supplies stages in every dimension. -/
noncomputable def stages (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) : (n : ℕ) → PartialCarrierFamily D n
  | 0 => empty D
  | n + 1 => (stages D n).next
