ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierFamily.stages_map_stable
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
lemma stages_map_stable (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFm : F.card ≤ m) :
    (stages D n).map F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn) = (stages D m).map F hne hF hFm := by
  induction n, hmn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ n hmn ih =>
    exact ((stages D n).next_map_old F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn)).trans ih

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierHomotopy
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- Finite stages of coherent endpoint-preserving homotopies. -/
structure PartialCarrierHomotopy (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y)
    (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) (n : ℕ) where
  hom : ∀ F : Finset P, (hne : F.Nonempty) → (hF : D.admissible F) → F.card ≤ n →
    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF)
  carried : ∀ F hne hF hn t x, hom F hne hF hn (t, x) ∈ D.carrier F
  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n) (hAB : A ⊆ B) (t : I) (x : StdSimplex ℝ A),
    hom B hB hb hBn (t, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB)) = hom A hA ha hAn (t, x)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierHomotopy.empty
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- No nonempty face occurs at homotopy stage zero. -/
def empty (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) :
    PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ 0 where
  hom _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
  carried _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
  compatible hA _ _ _ hAn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hAn) hA.card_pos)

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierHomotopy.eq_of_map_eq
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
lemma eq_of_map_eq (f : PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n) {A B C : Finset P}
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n)
    (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C) (t : I)
    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
    f.hom A hA ha hAn (t, x) = f.hom B hB hb hBn (t, y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := carrierFace_intersection_preimage hAC hBC x y hxy
  obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := z.support_weights_nonempty
  have hne : (A ∩ B).Nonempty := ⟨a.val, a.property⟩
  have had : D.admissible (A ∩ B) := D.hereditary Finset.inter_subset_left ha
  have hcard : (A ∩ B).card ≤ n := (Finset.card_le_card Finset.inter_subset_left).trans hAn
  rw [← hzx, ← hzy,
    f.compatible hne hA had ha hcard hAn Finset.inter_subset_left,
    f.compatible hne hB had hb hcard hBn Finset.inter_subset_right]

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierHomotopy.exists_face_extension
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- A single new homotopy face is filled by actual endpoint-relative HEP. -/
theorem exists_face_extension (f : PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n)
    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hc : F.card = n + 1) :
    ∃ g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF),
      (∀ t x, g (t, x) ∈ D.carrier F) ∧
      ∀ G (hneG : G.Nonempty) (hG : D.admissible G) (hGn : G.card ≤ n)
        (hGF : G ⊆ F) (t : I) (x : StdSimplex ℝ G),
        g (t, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)) = f.hom G hneG hG hGn (t, x) := by
  classical
  let _ := D.contractible F hne hF
  let a₀ : C(StdSimplex ℝ F, D.carrier F) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ ⟨f₀.map F hne hF x, f₀.carried F hne hF x⟩,
      (f₀.map F hne hF).continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
  let a₁ : C(StdSimplex ℝ F, D.carrier F) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ ⟨f₁.map F hne hF x, f₁.carried F hne hF x⟩,
      (f₁.map F hne hF).continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨z, ⟨L⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic (D.carrier F)
    let L₀ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy a₀ (ContinuousMap.const _ z) :=
      (L.compContinuousMap a₀).cast (by ext; rfl) (by ext; rfl)
    let L₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy a₁ (ContinuousMap.const _ z) :=
      (L.compContinuousMap a₁).cast (by ext; rfl) (by ext; rfl)
    let K := L₀.trans L₁.symm
    let g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
      ⟨⟨fun p ↦ (K p).val, by fun_prop⟩,
        fun x ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (K.apply_zero x),
        fun x ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (K.apply_one x)⟩
    refine ⟨g, fun t x ↦ (K (t, x)).property, ?_⟩
    intro G hneG hG hGn
    have := hneG.card_pos
    omega
  | succ k =>
    let e : Fin (k + 2) ≃ F := (F.equivFinOfCardEq hc).symm
    let A (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Finset P := F.erase (e i).val
    have hAF (i : Fin (k + 2)) : A i ⊆ F := Finset.erase_subset _ _
    have hAc (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card = k + 1 := by
      dsimp [A]
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (e i).property, hc]
      omega
    have hAn (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card ≤ k + 1 := (hAc i).le
    have hAe (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).Nonempty :=
      Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hAc]; omega)
    have hAd (i : Fin (k + 2)) : D.admissible (A i) := D.hereditary (hAF i) hF
    let v (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Fin (k + 1) → A i := fun j ↦
      ⟨(e (i.succAbove j)).val, Finset.mem_erase.mpr
        ⟨fun he ↦ Fin.succAbove_ne i j (e.injective (Subtype.ext he)),
          (e (i.succAbove j)).property⟩⟩
    have hv (i : Fin (k + 2)) : carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i) ∘ v i = e ∘ i.succAbove := rfl
    let H (i : Fin (k + 2)) : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1)) × I, D.carrier F) :=
      ⟨fun q ↦ ⟨f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i) (q.2, q.1.map (v i)),
        D.monotone (hAF i) (hAe i) hF (f.carried _ _ _ _ _ _)⟩,
        ((f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i)).continuous.comp
          (continuous_snd.prodMk ((StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ (v i)).comp continuous_fst))).subtype_mk _⟩
    have hcompat (i j : Fin (k + 2)) (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) (t : I)
        (hxy : x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove) : H i (x, t) = H j (y, t) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) (hAe j) (hAd i) (hAd j) (hAn i) (hAn j)
        (hAF i) (hAF j) t (x.map (v i)) (y.map (v j)) (by
          simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
            congrArg (StdSimplex.map e) hxy)
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := StdSimplex.exists_simplex_boundary_track k H hcompat
    let b : C(I × StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1), D.carrier F) :=
      ⟨fun q ↦ B (q.2, q.1), by fun_prop⟩
    let g₀ : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 2)), D.carrier F) :=
      a₀.comp ⟨StdSimplex.map e, StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ e⟩
    let g₁ : C(StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 2)), D.carrier F) :=
      a₁.comp ⟨StdSimplex.map e, StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ e⟩
    have hb₀ (q : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) : b (0, q) = g₀ q.val := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := q.property
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q.val).mpr hi
      have heq : StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z = q := Subtype.ext hz
      change B (q, 0) = _
      rw [← heq, hB]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change f.hom _ _ _ _ (0, z.map (v i)) = f₀.map F hne hF ((z.map i.succAbove).map e)
      rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero]
      simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
        (f₀.compatible (hAe i) hne (hAd i) hF (hAF i) (z.map (v i))).symm
    have hb₁ (q : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) : b (1, q) = g₁ q.val := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := q.property
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q.val).mpr hi
      have heq : StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z = q := Subtype.ext hz
      change B (q, 1) = _
      rw [← heq, hB]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change f.hom _ _ _ _ (1, z.map (v i)) = f₁.map F hne hF ((z.map i.succAbove).map e)
      rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_one]
      simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
        (f₁.compatible (hAe i) hne (hAd i) hF (hAF i) (z.map (v i))).symm
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_simplex_boundary_homotopy_extension (k + 1) g₀ g₁ b hb₀ hb₁
    let g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
      ⟨⟨fun p ↦ (L (p.1, p.2.map e.symm)).val, by fun_prop⟩,
        fun x ↦ (congrArg Subtype.val (L.apply_zero (x.map e.symm))).trans
          (congrArg (f₀.map F hne hF) (map_equiv_cancel e x)),
        fun x ↦ (congrArg Subtype.val (L.apply_one (x.map e.symm))).trans
          (congrArg (f₁.map F hne hF) (map_equiv_cancel e x))⟩
    refine ⟨g, fun t x ↦ (L (t, x.map e.symm)).property, ?_⟩
    intro G hneG hG hGn hGF t x
    have hlt : G.card < F.card := by omega
    have hnsub : ¬F ⊆ G := fun h ↦ (not_lt_of_ge (Finset.card_le_card h)) hlt
    obtain ⟨a, haF, haG⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hnsub
    let i : Fin (k + 2) := e.symm ⟨a, haF⟩
    let q := (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)).map e.symm
    have hqi : q.weights i = 0 := by
      rw [show q = x.map (e.symm ∘ carrierFaceInclusion hGF) from
        (StdSimplex.map_map _ _ _)]
      apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
      rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      have he := congrArg (fun s ↦ (e s).val) hj
      exact haG (show a ∈ G from (by simpa [i] using he) ▸ j.property)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q).mpr hqi
    have hqe : q.map e = x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := map_equiv_cancel e _
    have hfz : (z.map (v i)).map (carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i)) =
        x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := by
      rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
      change z.map (e ∘ i.succAbove) = _
      rw [StdSimplex.map_comp, hz, hqe]
    have hface : g (t, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)) =
        f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i) (t, z.map (v i)) := by
      change (L (t, q)).val = _
      have hbq : (⟨q, i, hqi⟩ : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) =
          StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z := Subtype.ext hz.symm
      have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hL t ⟨q, i, hqi⟩)
      change (L (t, q)).val = _ at h
      rw [show b (t, ⟨q, i, hqi⟩) = B (⟨q, i, hqi⟩, t) from rfl,
        hbq, hB] at h
      exact h
    exact hface.trans (f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) hneG (hAd i) hG (hAn i) hGn
      (hAF i) hGF t (z.map (v i)) x hfz)

lemma map_equiv_cancel {A : Type*} {B : Type*} (e : A ≃ B) (x : StdSimplex ℝ B) :
    (x.map e.symm).map e = x := by
  rw [StdSimplex.map_map,
    show (fun a ↦ e (e.symm a)) = id from funext e.apply_symm_apply,
    StdSimplex.map_id]

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierHomotopy.next
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- A homotopy stage is extended by the proved relative cylinder filler. -/
noncomputable def next (f : PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n) :
    PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ (n + 1) := by
  classical
  let g (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) :
      ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
    if h : F.card ≤ n then f.hom F hne hF h
    else (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (by omega)).choose
  have hg (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F)
      (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) (h : ¬F.card ≤ n) :=
    (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (show F.card = n + 1 by omega)).choose_spec
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro F hne hF hn t x
    by_cases h : F.card ≤ n
    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_left h] using f.carried F hne hF h t x
    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right h] using (hg F hne hF hn h).1 t x
  · intro A B hA hB ha hb hAn hBn hAB t x
    by_cases hBsmall : B.card ≤ n
    · have hAsmall := (Finset.card_le_card hAB).trans hBsmall
      simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
        f.compatible hA hB ha hb hAsmall hBsmall hAB t x
    · by_cases hAsmall : A.card ≤ n
      · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
          (hg B hB hb hBn hBsmall).2 A hA ha hAsmall hAB t x
      · have heq : A = B := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hAB (by omega)
        subst B
        have hi : carrierFaceInclusion hAB = id := rfl
        rw [hi, StdSimplex.map_id]

lemma next_hom_old (f : PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n) (F : Finset P)
    (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hn : F.card ≤ n) :
    f.next.hom F hne hF (hn.trans (Nat.le_succ n)) = f.hom F hne hF hn := by
  simp only [next, dite_eq_left hn]

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrierHomotopy.stages
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialCarrier.source_declaration:
/-- All-dimensional homotopy stages are recursively constructed. -/
noncomputable def stages (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D) :
    (n : ℕ) → PartialCarrierHomotopy D f₀ f₁ n
  | 0 => empty D f₀ f₁
  | n + 1 => (stages D f₀ f₁ n).next

lemma stages_hom_stable (D : FiniteCarrierData P Y) (f₀ f₁ : CarrierFamily D)
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFm : F.card ≤ m) :
    (stages D f₀ f₁ n).hom F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn) =
      (stages D f₀ f₁ m).hom F hne hF hFm := by
  induction n, hmn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ n hmn ih =>
    exact ((stages D f₀ f₁ n).next_hom_old F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn)).trans ih

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.source_declaration:
/-- Finite stages for the homotopies, with no contractibility requirement on
any parameter domain. -/
structure PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy {D : FiniteCarrierData P Y}
    {R : Finset P → Set X} {hR : Antitone R}
    (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) (n : ℕ) where
  hom : ∀ F : Finset P, (hne : F.Nonempty) → (hF : D.admissible F) → F.card ≤ n →
    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF)
  carried : ∀ F hne hF hn t x z, hom F hne hF hn (t, (x, z)) ∈ D.carrier F
  compatible : ∀ {A B} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B)
    (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
    (t : I) (x : R B) (z : StdSimplex ℝ A),
    hom B hB hb hBn (t, (x, z.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAB))) =
      hom A hA ha hAn (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAB x, z))

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.empty
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.source_declaration:
/-- No nonempty face occurs at homotopy stage zero. -/
def empty (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR) :
    PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ 0 where
  hom _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
  carried _F hne _ hn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hn) hne.card_pos)
  compatible hA _ _ _ hAn := False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hAn) hA.card_pos)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.source_declaration:
/-- Actual geometric overlaps in a common parameter domain have equal values
at every already constructed homotopy stage. -/
lemma eq_of_map_eq (f : PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ n)
    {A B C : Finset P} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (ha : D.admissible A) (hb : D.admissible B) (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hBn : B.card ≤ n)
    (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C) (t : I) (p : R C)
    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
    f.hom A hA ha hAn (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hAC p, x)) =
      f.hom B hB hb hBn (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hBC p, y)) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := carrierFace_intersection_preimage hAC hBC x y hxy
  obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := z.support_weights_nonempty
  have hne : (A ∩ B).Nonempty := ⟨a.val, a.property⟩
  have had : D.admissible (A ∩ B) := D.hereditary Finset.inter_subset_left ha
  have hcard : (A ∩ B).card ≤ n := (Finset.card_le_card Finset.inter_subset_left).trans hAn
  rw [← hzx, ← hzy,
    f.compatible hne hA had ha hcard hAn Finset.inter_subset_left,
    f.compatible hne hB had hb hcard hBn Finset.inter_subset_right]
  rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.source_declaration:
/-- A single new homotopy face is filled by actual endpoint-relative HEP. -/
theorem exists_face_extension (f : PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ n)
    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hc : F.card = n + 1) :
    ∃ g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF),
      (∀ t p x, g (t, (p, x)) ∈ D.carrier F) ∧
      ∀ G (hneG : G.Nonempty) (hG : D.admissible G) (hGn : G.card ≤ n)
        (hGF : G ⊆ F) (t : I) (p : R F) (x : StdSimplex ℝ G),
        g (t, (p, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF))) =
          f.hom G hneG hG hGn (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR hGF p, x)) := by
  classical
  let _ := D.contractible F hne hF
  let a₀ : C(R F × StdSimplex ℝ F, D.carrier F) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ ⟨f₀.map F hne hF x, f₀.carried F hne hF x.1 x.2⟩,
      (f₀.map F hne hF).continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
  let a₁ : C(R F × StdSimplex ℝ F, D.carrier F) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ ⟨f₁.map F hne hF x, f₁.carried F hne hF x.1 x.2⟩,
      (f₁.map F hne hF).continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨z, ⟨L⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic (D.carrier F)
    let L₀ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy a₀ (ContinuousMap.const _ z) :=
      (L.compContinuousMap a₀).cast (by ext; rfl) (by ext; rfl)
    let L₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy a₁ (ContinuousMap.const _ z) :=
      (L.compContinuousMap a₁).cast (by ext; rfl) (by ext; rfl)
    let K := L₀.trans L₁.symm
    let g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
      ⟨⟨fun p ↦ (K p).val, by fun_prop⟩,
        fun x ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (K.apply_zero x),
        fun x ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (K.apply_one x)⟩
    refine ⟨g, fun t p x ↦ (K (t, (p, x))).property, ?_⟩
    intro G hneG hG hGn
    have := hneG.card_pos
    omega
  | succ k =>
    let e : Fin (k + 2) ≃ F := (F.equivFinOfCardEq hc).symm
    let A (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Finset P := F.erase (e i).val
    have hAF (i : Fin (k + 2)) : A i ⊆ F := Finset.erase_subset _ _
    have hAc (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card = k + 1 := by
      dsimp [A]
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (e i).property, hc]
      omega
    have hAn (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).card ≤ k + 1 := (hAc i).le
    have hAe (i : Fin (k + 2)) : (A i).Nonempty :=
      Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hAc]; omega)
    have hAd (i : Fin (k + 2)) : D.admissible (A i) := D.hereditary (hAF i) hF
    let v (i : Fin (k + 2)) : Fin (k + 1) → A i := fun j ↦
      ⟨(e (i.succAbove j)).val, Finset.mem_erase.mpr
        ⟨fun he ↦ Fin.succAbove_ne i j (e.injective (Subtype.ext he)),
          (e (i.succAbove j)).property⟩⟩
    have hv (i : Fin (k + 2)) : carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i) ∘ v i = e ∘ i.succAbove := rfl
    let H (i : Fin (k + 2)) :
        C(R F × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1)) × I), D.carrier F) :=
      ⟨fun q ↦ ⟨f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i)
          (q.2.2, (carrierParameterRestrict hR (hAF i) q.1, q.2.1.map (v i))),
        D.monotone (hAF i) (hAe i) hF (f.carried _ _ _ _ _ _ _)⟩,
        ((f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i)).continuous.comp
          ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).prodMk
            (((continuous_carrierParameterRestrict hR (hAF i)).comp continuous_fst).prodMk
              ((StdSimplex.continuous_map ℝ (v i)).comp
                (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd))))).subtype_mk _⟩
    have hcompat (i j : Fin (k + 2)) (p : R F) (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) (t : I)
        (hxy : x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove) : H i (p, (x, t)) = H j (p, (y, t)) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) (hAe j) (hAd i) (hAd j) (hAn i) (hAn j)
        (hAF i) (hAF j) t p (x.map (v i)) (y.map (v j)) (by
          simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
            congrArg (StdSimplex.map e) hxy)
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_parameterized_simplex_boundary_track k H hcompat
    let b : C(I × (R F × StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)), D.carrier F) :=
      ⟨fun q ↦ B (q.2.1, (q.2.2, q.1)), by fun_prop⟩
    let g₀ : C(R F × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 2)), D.carrier F) :=
      a₀.comp ⟨fun p ↦ (p.1, p.2.map e), by fun_prop⟩
    let g₁ : C(R F × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 2)), D.carrier F) :=
      a₁.comp ⟨fun p ↦ (p.1, p.2.map e), by fun_prop⟩
    have hb₀ (p : R F) (q : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) : b (0, (p, q)) = g₀ (p, q.val) := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := q.property
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q.val).mpr hi
      have heq : StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z = q := Subtype.ext hz
      change B (p, (q, 0)) = _
      rw [← heq, hB]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change f.hom _ _ _ _ (0, (carrierParameterRestrict hR (hAF i) p, z.map (v i))) =
        f₀.map F hne hF (p, (z.map i.succAbove).map e)
      rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero]
      simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
        (f₀.compatible (hAe i) hne (hAd i) hF (hAF i) p (z.map (v i))).symm
    have hb₁ (p : R F) (q : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) : b (1, (p, q)) = g₁ (p, q.val) := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := q.property
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q.val).mpr hi
      have heq : StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z = q := Subtype.ext hz
      change B (p, (q, 1)) = _
      rw [← heq, hB]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change f.hom _ _ _ _ (1, (carrierParameterRestrict hR (hAF i) p, z.map (v i))) =
        f₁.map F hne hF (p, (z.map i.succAbove).map e)
      rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_one]
      simpa only [StdSimplex.map_map, ← Function.comp_def, hv] using
        (f₁.compatible (hAe i) hne (hAd i) hF (hAF i) p (z.map (v i))).symm
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_parameterized_simplex_homotopy_extension (k + 1) g₀ g₁ b hb₀ hb₁
    let g : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
      ⟨⟨fun p ↦ (L (p.1, (p.2.1, p.2.2.map e.symm))).val, by fun_prop⟩,
        fun x ↦ (congrArg Subtype.val (L.apply_zero (x.1, x.2.map e.symm))).trans
          (congrArg (fun z ↦ f₀.map F hne hF (x.1, z)) (PartialCarrierHomotopy.map_equiv_cancel e x.2)),
        fun x ↦ (congrArg Subtype.val (L.apply_one (x.1, x.2.map e.symm))).trans
          (congrArg (fun z ↦ f₁.map F hne hF (x.1, z)) (PartialCarrierHomotopy.map_equiv_cancel e x.2))⟩
    refine ⟨g, fun t p x ↦ (L (t, (p, x.map e.symm))).property, ?_⟩
    intro G hneG hG hGn hGF t p x
    have hlt : G.card < F.card := by omega
    have hnsub : ¬F ⊆ G := fun h ↦ (not_lt_of_ge (Finset.card_le_card h)) hlt
    obtain ⟨a, haF, haG⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hnsub
    let i : Fin (k + 2) := e.symm ⟨a, haF⟩
    let q := (x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF)).map e.symm
    have hqi : q.weights i = 0 := by
      rw [show q = x.map (e.symm ∘ carrierFaceInclusion hGF) from
        (StdSimplex.map_map _ _ _)]
      apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
      rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      have he := congrArg (fun s ↦ (e s).val) hj
      exact haG (show a ∈ G from (by simpa [i] using he) ▸ j.property)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_succAbove_iff i q).mpr hqi
    have hqe : q.map e = x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := PartialCarrierHomotopy.map_equiv_cancel e _
    have hfz : (z.map (v i)).map (carrierFaceInclusion (hAF i)) =
        x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF) := by
      rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
      change z.map (e ∘ i.succAbove) = _
      rw [StdSimplex.map_comp, hz, hqe]
    have hface : g (t, (p, x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hGF))) =
        f.hom (A i) (hAe i) (hAd i) (hAn i)
          (t, (carrierParameterRestrict hR (hAF i) p, z.map (v i))) := by
      change (L (t, (p, q))).val = _
      have hbq : (⟨q, i, hqi⟩ : StdSimplex.boundary (k + 1)) =
          StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace k i z := Subtype.ext hz.symm
      have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hL t p ⟨q, i, hqi⟩)
      change (L (t, (p, q))).val = _ at h
      rw [show b (t, (p, ⟨q, i, hqi⟩)) = B (p, (⟨q, i, hqi⟩, t)) from rfl,
        hbq, hB] at h
      exact h
    exact hface.trans (f.eq_of_map_eq (hAe i) hneG (hAd i) hG (hAn i) hGn
      (hAF i) hGF t p (z.map (v i)) x hfz)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy.next
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.source_declaration:
/-- A homotopy stage is extended by the proved relative cylinder filler. -/
noncomputable def next (f : PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ n) :
    PartialParameterizedCarrierHomotopy f₀ f₁ (n + 1) := by
  classical
  let g (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) :
      ContinuousMap.Homotopy (f₀.map F hne hF) (f₁.map F hne hF) :=
    if h : F.card ≤ n then f.hom F hne hF h
    else (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (by omega)).choose
  have hg (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F)
      (hFn : F.card ≤ n + 1) (h : ¬F.card ≤ n) :=
    (f.exists_face_extension F hne hF (show F.card = n + 1 by omega)).choose_spec
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro F hne hF hn t p x
    by_cases h : F.card ≤ n
    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_left h] using f.carried F hne hF h t p x
    · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right h] using (hg F hne hF hn h).1 t p x
  · intro A B hA hB ha hb hAn hBn hAB t p x
    by_cases hBsmall : B.card ≤ n
    · have hAsmall := (Finset.card_le_card hAB).trans hBsmall
      simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
        f.compatible hA hB ha hb hAsmall hBsmall hAB t p x
    · by_cases hAsmall : A.card ≤ n
      · simpa only [g, dite_eq_right hBsmall, dite_eq_left hAsmall] using
          (hg B hB hb hBn hBsmall).2 A hA ha hAsmall hAB t p x
      · have heq : A = B := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hAB (by omega)
        subst B
        have hi : carrierFaceInclusion hAB = id := rfl
        rw [hi, StdSimplex.map_id]
        rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.PartialParamet.source_declaration:
lemma stages_hom_stable (f₀ f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR)
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (F : Finset P) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hF : D.admissible F) (hFm : F.card ≤ m) :
    (stages f₀ f₁ n).hom F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn) =
      (stages f₀ f₁ m).hom F hne hF hFm := by
  induction n, hmn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ n hmn ih =>
    exact ((stages f₀ f₁ n).next_hom_old F hne hF (hFm.trans hmn)).trans ih

theorem SimpleRibbon.factors {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} {a b : Artin.Group M}

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.active_center_.source_declaration:
/-- Real cancellation at an overlap forces every active center onto that
real wall. This is stronger than cancellation in the ambient complement. -/
theorem active_center_real_eq_zero (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ) (p : ComplexComplement ℓ)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hp : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i))
    {h : H} (hz : ℓ h (centerCombination ℓ c w).1 = 0)
    (i : ι) (hi : w i ≠ 0) : ℓ h (c i).val.1 = 0 := by
  classical
  have hreal : ∑ i, w i * ℓ h (c i).val.1 = 0 := by
    simpa only [centerCombination, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using hz
  have hnonneg (j : ι) : 0 ≤ w j * (ℓ h (c j).val.1 * ℓ h p.val.1) := by
    by_cases hj : w j = 0
    · simp only [hj, zero_mul, le_refl]
    · exact mul_nonneg (hw j) (canonicalCell_real_product_nonneg ℓ (hp j hj) h)
  have hsumzero : ∑ j, w j * (ℓ h (c j).val.1 * ℓ h p.val.1) = 0 := by
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul, hreal, zero_mul]
  have hterms := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => hnonneg j)).mp hsumzero
  by_contra hn
  have hpos := mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hw i) (Ne.symm hi))
    (canonicalCell_real_product_pos ℓ (hp i hi) hn)
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) (hterms i (Finset.mem_univ i))

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.active_le_head.source_declaration:
/-- In a positive carrier, a maximal-degree active vertex is the minimum
of every active simple chain containing it. -/
theorem active_le_headStep {A : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)}
    (hpos : ∀ u : A, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u.val)
    (w : GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A) (p : A) (hp : p ∈ w.val.weights.support)
    (hmax : ∀ i ∈ w.val.weights.support, degree M i.val.value ≤ degree M p.val.value)
    (hne : p.val.value ≠ 1) (i : A) (hi : i ∈ w.val.weights.support) :
    i.val ≤ headStep M B0 p.val ∧
      SimpleRibbon M i.val.source (headStep M B0 p.val).source
        (i.val.difference (headStep M B0 p.val)) := by
  have hpi : p ≤ i := by
    rcases w.val.chain p hp i hi with hpi | hip
    · exact hpi
    · by_contra hnot
      have hlt : i.val < p.val := (lt_iff_le_not_ge).mpr ⟨hip, hnot⟩
      have hh := IncomingVertex.height_lt hlt
      have hb := hmax i hi
      dsimp only [IncomingVertex.height] at hh
      omega
  exact headStep_cone M B0 p.val (hpos p) hne i.val (hpos i) hpi
    (w.property p hp i hi hpi)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.actualClassInT.source_declaration:
theorem actualClassInTube_eq_path (C : ActualChamber M J) {p q : Complement M J}
    (hp : p ∈ actualTubeSet M J C) (hq : q ∈ actualTubeSet M J C)
    (γ : Path p q) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ actualTubeSet M J C) :
    actualClassInTube M J C hp hq = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ := by
  unfold actualClassInTube
  rw [IntervalForward.classInTube_eq_path C hp hq
    (γ.map (actualComplementHomeomorph M J).continuous) hγ]
  change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk

theorem actualForward_faceIntervalConnector (p : Complement M J) (C D : ActualChamber M J)
    (hpC : p ∈ actualTubeSet M J C) (hpD : p ∈ actualTubeSet M J D) :
    (actualIntervalForward M J).map
      (faceIntervalConnector (actualForms M J) p.val.1 C D) =

      FundamentalGroupoid.mk (chamberBasepoint (actualChamberPointFamily M J) C) ⟶
        FundamentalGroupoid.mk (chamberBasepoint (actualChamberPointFamily M J) D) =>
      (FundamentalGroupoid.map (show C(ComplexComplement (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J),

          (actualComplementHomeomorph M J).symm.continuous⟩)).map f) h
  simpa only [actualIntervalForward, actualIntervalForwardOfPoints, CategoryTheory.Functor.comp_map,

interval carrier into the corresponding actual component upstairs. -/

    (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty)
    (w : GarsideWeights M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))

    w.val.weights.support hne ⟨hc, w.property⟩ hw

      Landmark1.orbitMonodromy M J x (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x a) =
        MulOpposite.op ((Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J a)⁻¹)) ∧

        FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath
          (projectedBasepointPath M J (standardBasepointPath M J x))
          (standardRibbonVertexEquiv M J (componentEndOfLoop M J r)))

      (ContinuousMap.id (ComplementUniversalCover M J)) := by
  exact numerableCarrierHomotopy (liftedCanonicalSet M J)
    (isOpen_liftedCanonicalSet M J) (actualLiftedCanonicalPartition M J)
    (actualLiftedCanonicalPartition_subordinate M J)
    (canonicalPacketCarrier M J)
    (fun F hF hface => contractibleSpace_canonicalPacketCarrier M J F hF
      (by obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hface
          exact ⟨q, (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mpr hq⟩))
    (fun {_ _} hFG hF hface =>
      canonicalPacketCarrier_mono M J hFG hF (hF.mono hFG)
        (by obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hface
            exact ⟨q, (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J _ q).mpr hq⟩))
    (fun F hF _ q hq => mem_canonicalPacketCarrier_of_common M J F hF q hq)
    ((actualGarsideReturn M J).comp (canonicalGarsideMap M J))
    (fun F hF hface w hw => canonicalGarsideMap_return_carried M J w F hF hface hw)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.bool_sign_orde.source_declaration:
/-- A Boolean sequence with no alternating subtriple has one sign order.
No strict monotonicity of the indexing-to-vertex map is assumed. -/
theorem bool_sign_order_separated {κ : Type*} [LinearOrder κ] (s : κ → Bool)
    (hb : ∀ i j k, i ≤ j → j ≤ k → s i = s k → s j = s i) :
    (∀ i j, s i = false → s j = true → i < j) ∨
      (∀ i j, s i = true → s j = false → i < j) := by
  classical
  by_cases hn : ∀ i j, s i = false → s j = true → i < j
  · exact Or.inl hn
  · right
    push Not at hn
    obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hji⟩ := hn
    have hji' : j ≤ i := hji
    intro k l hk hl
    by_contra hkl
    have hlk : l ≤ k := le_of_not_gt hkl
    rcases le_total l j with hlj | hjl
    · have he := hb l j i hlj hji' (by rw [hl, hi])
      simp only [hj, hl, Bool.true_eq_false] at he
    · have he := hb j l k hjl hlk (by rw [hj, hk])
      simp only [hl, hj, Bool.false_eq_true] at he

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalCell_.source_declaration:
/-- An upper bound of the center chamber in the phase interval carries the
whole actual canonical cell, not merely its chosen center or common point. -/
theorem canonicalCell_subset_tubeSet {c p : ComplexComplement ℓ}
    (hp : p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ c) (D : Chamber ℓ)
    (h₁ : ChamberBetween (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p) (tubeLowerChamber ℓ c) D)
    (h₂ : ChamberBetween (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p) D (phaseUpperChamber ℓ p)) :
    canonicalCell ℓ c ⊆ tubeSet D := by
  intro x hx h hxreal
  have hr : ℓ h c.val.1 = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    exact signHalfSpace_nonzero (canonicalCell_real ℓ hx hn) hxreal
  have hcb := canonicalCell_lower_eq_upper ℓ hp hr
  have hd : D.signs h = (tubeLowerChamber ℓ c).signs h :=
    bool_upper_interval (h₁ h) (fun hac => h₂ h (hac.trans hcb))
  rw [hd, tubeLowerChamber_signs_imag ℓ c hr]
  exact canonicalCell_imag ℓ hx hr

theorem canonicalCoordinate_mem_iff (c p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (h : H) :

  · by_cases hi : 0 < ℓ h c.val.2 <;>
      simp [canonicalCellChoice, coordinateHalfSpace, signHalfSpace, hr, hi]

      simp [canonicalCellChoice, coordinateHalfSpace, signHalfSpace, hr, hp]

/-- The literal Garside subspace carried by the meet/join interval. The
empty face has no simplex and is assigned the empty set. -/
def canonicalGarsideCarrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :
    Set (GarsideWeights M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :=
  if hF : F.Nonempty then
    garsideIntervalCarrier M ⟨J⟩
      (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF))
      (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF))
  else ∅

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsi.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsideCarrierData
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsi.source_declaration:
/-- Every field is proved from the actual cover and actual ribbon lattice.
The generic family construction will construct the maps and all coherence. -/
def canonicalGarsideCarrierData :
    FiniteCarrierData (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (GarsideWeights M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) where
  admissible := IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J)
  hereditary hAB hB := hB.mono hAB
  carrier := canonicalGarsideCarrier M J
  contractible := contractibleSpace_canonicalGarsideCarrier M J
  monotone hAB hA _ := canonicalGarsideCarrier_mono M J hAB hA

theorem canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
    canonicalGarsideCarrier M J F = garsideIntervalCarrier M ⟨J⟩
      (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF))
      (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)) := dite_eq_left hF

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsi.source_declaration:
theorem canonicalGarsideCarrier_mono {F G : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)}
    (hFG : F ⊆ G) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
    canonicalGarsideCarrier M J F ⊆ canonicalGarsideCarrier M J G := by
  have hG : G.Nonempty := hF.mono hFG
  rw [canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq M J F hF, canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq M J G hG]
  exact garsideIntervalCarrier_mono M ⟨J⟩
    (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet_antitone (Finset.image_subset_image hFG) _ _)
    (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin_mono (Finset.image_subset_image hFG) _ _)

/-- The genuine all-dimensional coherent family, constructed through
contractible interval carriers rather than chosen independently on faces. -/

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsi.source_declaration:
/-- The continuous forward map on the literal actual-cover weight space.
It uses the single cover-index order fixed in `CanonicalCoverWeights`. -/
def canonicalGarsideMap :
    C(ActualCoverWeights M J, GarsideWeights M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :=
  (canonicalGarsideFamily M J).descend (IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J))
    (fun {_ _} hAB hB => hB.mono hAB) (fun _ _ h => h)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsi.source_declaration:
/-- Any original nerve face containing the support carries the map value.
No chain premise is needed on this containing face. -/
theorem canonicalGarsideMap_carried (w : ActualCoverWeights M J)
    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
    canonicalGarsideMap M J w ∈ canonicalGarsideCarrier M J F :=
  (canonicalGarsideFamily M J).descend_carried_of_admissible
    (IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J)) (fun {_ _} hAB hB => hB.mono hAB)
    (fun _ _ h => h) w F hF hface hw

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsi.source_declaration:
/-- The return composed with the canonical continuous forward map obeys
all nonempty canonical nerve-face carriers, including proper containing faces. -/
theorem canonicalGarsideMap_return_carried (w : ActualCoverWeights M J)
    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
    actualGarsideReturn M J (canonicalGarsideMap M J w) ∈ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := canonicalNerveFace_commonPoint M J F hface
  exact actualGarsideReturn_mem_canonicalPacketCarrier M J F hF
    ⟨q, (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mpr hq⟩ _
    (canonicalGarsideMap_carried M J w F hF hface hw)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsi.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsideMap_support
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalGarsi.source_declaration:
/-- The carried conclusion in literal support coordinates of the existing
Garside space, with the actual meet and join as its endpoints. -/
theorem canonicalGarsideMap_support (w : ActualCoverWeights M J)
    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) (hw : w.val.weights.support ⊆ F) :
    ∀ u ∈ (canonicalGarsideMap M J w).val.weights.support,
      IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
          (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF) ≤ u ∧
        u ≤ IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
          (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF) := by
  have h := canonicalGarsideMap_carried M J w F hF hface hw
  rw [canonicalGarsideCarrier_eq M J F hF] at h
  exact h

      canonicalIncomingLabel M J A ≤ sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q := by

theorem canonicalNerveFace_commonPoint (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))

    ∃ q : ComplementUniversalCover M J, ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A := by

/-- All actual simple upper labels that carry every whole packet cell. -/
def canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) :

  {u | ∀ A ∈ F, canonicalIncomingLabel M J A ≤ u ∧
    SimpleRibbon M (canonicalIncomingLabel M J A).source u.source
      ((canonicalIncomingLabel M J A).difference u) ∧
    liftedCanonicalSet M J A ⊆ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u}

theorem canonicalPacketCarrier_eq_component_at_center

    (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty)
    (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F) :

      (liftedCanonicalCenter M J A) :=

/-- Any actual point of any packet cell selects exactly the same component. -/
theorem canonicalPacketCarrier_eq_component_of_mem_cell
    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty)
    (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F = connectedComponentIn (canonicalPacketUpperIntersection M J F) q := by
  have hqC := liftedCanonicalSet_subset_packetCarrier M J F hF hover A hA hq

  exact connectedComponentIn_eq hqC

    (hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J G).Nonempty) :
    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J G := by
  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF,
    canonicalPacketCarrier_eq_component_at_center M J G hG hover hF.choose (hFG hF.choose_spec)]
  exact connectedComponentIn_mono _ (canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_mono M J hFG)

    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ G, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J G :=
  canonicalPacketCarrier_mono M J hFG hF hG

/-- Every admissible upper sheet contains the entire actual carrier. -/
theorem canonicalPacketCarrier_subset_incomingSheet
    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))
    (hu : u ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F) :
    canonicalPacketCarrier M J F ⊆ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u := by

  exact Set.mem_iInter.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp
    (canonicalPacketCarrier_subset_upperIntersection M J F hF hq) u) hu

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacke.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacketCarrier_subset_upperIntersection

theorem canonicalPacketCarrier_subset_upperIntersection

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacke.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacketJoin_carrier
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacke.source_declaration:
/-- At every common lift, the actual finite join lies in the same simple
phase interval and its original sheet carries every whole lifted cell. -/
theorem canonicalPacketJoin_carrier (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
    sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF ∧
      canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF ≤ sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q ∧
      SimpleRibbon M (sheetLowerVertex M J q).source (canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF).source
        ((sheetLowerVertex M J q).difference (canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF)) ∧
      q ∈ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J (canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF) ∧
      ∀ A ∈ F, liftedCanonicalSet M J A ⊆ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J (canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF) := by
  classical
  have hbounds : ∀ u ∈ canonicalPacketLabels M J F,
      sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ u ∧ u ≤ sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    exact canonicalIncomingLabel_phase_bounds M J A q (hq A hAF)
  have hj := IncomingVertex.finiteJoin_simple_interval
    (canonicalPacketLabels M J F) (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)
    (sheetLowerVertex M J q) (sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q)
    (fun u hu => (hbounds u hu).1) (fun u hu => (hbounds u hu).2) (sheetPhaseInterval_simple M J q)
  refine ⟨hj.1, hj.2.1, hj.2.2.1,
    ((mem_sheet_phase_interval_iff M J q _).mp ⟨hj.1, hj.2.1⟩).1, ?_⟩
  intro A hAF
  exact liftedCanonicalSet_subset_incomingSheet M J A q (hq A hAF) _
    (IncomingVertex.le_finiteJoin _ _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩)) hj.2.1

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacke.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacketJoin_mem_admissible
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacke.source_declaration:
/-- The genuine finite join is admissible whenever the actual packet overlaps. -/
theorem canonicalPacketJoin_mem_admissible (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A) :
    canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F := by
  classical
  have hj := canonicalPacketJoin_carrier M J F hF q hq
  intro A hAF
  have hle : canonicalIncomingLabel M J A ≤ canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF :=
    IncomingVertex.le_finiteJoin _ _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨hle, IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval (sheetPhaseInterval_simple M J q)
    (canonicalIncomingLabel_phase_bounds M J A q (hq A hAF)).1 hle hj.2.1,
    hj.2.2.2.2 A hAF⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacke.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacketMeetJoin_simple
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.canonicalPacke.source_declaration:
/-- The actual meet/join factor of the labels of any nonempty nerve face
is simple, as a consequence of geometric sheet incidence. -/
theorem canonicalPacketMeetJoin_simple (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (hface : IsNerveFace (liftedCanonicalSet M J) F) :
    SimpleRibbon M
      (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)).source
      (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)).source
      ((IncomingVertex.finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
        (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)).difference
        (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
          (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF))) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := canonicalNerveFace_commonPoint M J F hface
  have hb : ∀ u ∈ canonicalPacketLabels M J F,
      sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ u ∧ u ≤ sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    exact canonicalIncomingLabel_phase_bounds M J A q (hq A hAF)
  exact (IncomingVertex.finiteMeetJoin_simple_interval
    (canonicalPacketLabels M J F) (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF)
    (sheetLowerVertex M J q) (sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q)
    (fun u hu => (hb u hu).1) (fun u hu => (hb u hu).2)
    (sheetPhaseInterval_simple M J q)).2.2.2

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.carrierFace_in.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.carrierFace_intersection_preimage
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.carrierFace_in.source_declaration:
/-- Equal points of two geometric faces have an actual common preimage in
 their intersection. No intersection compatibility is assumed. -/
lemma carrierFace_intersection_preimage {A B C : Finset P}
    (hAC : A ⊆ C) (hBC : B ⊆ C)
    (x : StdSimplex ℝ A) (y : StdSimplex ℝ B)
    (hxy : x.map (carrierFaceInclusion hAC) = y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)) :
    ∃ z : StdSimplex ℝ (↥(A ∩ B : Finset P)),
      z.map (carrierFaceInclusion Finset.inter_subset_left) = x ∧
      z.map (carrierFaceInclusion Finset.inter_subset_right) = y := by
  classical
  have hxrange : x ∈ Set.range (StdSimplex.map
      (carrierFaceInclusion (Finset.inter_subset_left : A ∩ B ⊆ A))) := by
    apply (StdSimplex.mem_range_map_iff _ x).mpr
    intro a ha
    have haB : a.val ∉ B := by
      intro h
      exact ha ⟨⟨a.val, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨a.property, h⟩⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
    have hn : carrierFaceInclusion hAC a ∉ Set.range (carrierFaceInclusion hBC) := by
      rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
      exact haB ((congrArg (fun z : C ↦ z.val) hb) ▸ b.property)
    have hz : (y.map (carrierFaceInclusion hBC)).weights (carrierFaceInclusion hAC a) = 0 :=
      Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range y.weights _ hn
    rw [← hxy, StdSimplex.map_apply_injective (carrierFaceInclusion_injective hAC)] at hz
    exact hz
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hxrange
  refine ⟨z, hz, StdSimplex.simplex_map_injective (carrierFaceInclusion_injective hBC) ?_⟩
  rw [StdSimplex.map_map, ← hxy, ← hz, StdSimplex.map_map]
  rfl

/-- Common canonical-cell incidence prevents simultaneous vanishing under
every nonnegative affine combination, including zero coefficients. -/
theorem centerCombination_mem_complement_of_active (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ)
    (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hp : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i)) :
    centerCombination ℓ c w ∈ complexComplementSet ℓ := by
  classical
  intro h hz
  have hreal : ∑ i, w i * ℓ h (c i).val.1 = 0 := by
    simpa only [centerCombination, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using hz.1
  have hnonneg (i : ι) : 0 ≤ w i * (ℓ h (c i).val.1 * ℓ h p.val.1) := by
    by_cases hi : w i = 0
    · simp only [hi, zero_mul, le_refl]
    · exact mul_nonneg (hw i) (canonicalCell_real_product_nonneg ℓ (hp i hi) h)
  have hsumzero : ∑ i, w i * (ℓ h (c i).val.1 * ℓ h p.val.1) = 0 := by
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul, hreal, zero_mul]
  have hterms := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hnonneg i)).mp hsumzero
  have active_zero (i : ι) (hi : w i ≠ 0) : ℓ h (c i).val.1 = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hpos := mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hw i) (Ne.symm hi))
      (canonicalCell_real_product_pos ℓ (hp i hi) hn)
    exact (ne_of_gt hpos) (hterms i (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hactive : ∃ i, 0 < w i := by
    by_contra hn
    have hall (i : ι) : w i = 0 := le_antisymm
      (le_of_not_gt (fun hi => hn ⟨i, hi⟩)) (hw i)
    have hzero : ∑ i, w i = 0 := by simp only [hall, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hactive
  have himnonneg (i : ι) : 0 ≤ w i * (ℓ h (c i).val.2 * ℓ h p.val.2) := by
    by_cases hi : w i = 0
    · simp only [hi, zero_mul, le_refl]
    · exact (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hw i) (Ne.symm hi))
        (canonicalCell_imag_product_pos ℓ (hp i hi) (active_zero i hi))).le
  have himpos : 0 < ∑ i, w i * (ℓ h (c i).val.2 * ℓ h p.val.2) :=
    Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => himnonneg i)
      ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, mul_pos hj
        (canonicalCell_imag_product_pos ℓ (hp j (ne_of_gt hj)) (active_zero j (ne_of_gt hj)))⟩
  have himzero : ∑ i, w i * ℓ h (c i).val.2 = 0 := by
    simpa only [centerCombination, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using hz.2
  have hzprod : ∑ i, w i * (ℓ h (c i).val.2 * ℓ h p.val.2) = 0 := by
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul, himzero, zero_mul]
  exact (ne_of_gt himpos) hzprod

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.centerCombinat.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.centerCombination_mem_tubeSet_of_active
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.centerCombinat.source_declaration:
/-- A convex combination of centers carried by one tube remains in that
tube whenever their active canonical cells have a common point. -/
theorem centerCombination_mem_tubeSet_of_active (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ)
    (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hp : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i)) (D : Chamber ℓ)
    (hD : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → c i ∈ tubeSet D) :
    (⟨centerCombination ℓ c w,
      centerCombination_mem_complement_of_active ℓ c p w hw hwone hp⟩ : ComplexComplement ℓ)
      ∈ tubeSet D := by
  classical
  intro h hz
  have hactive : ∃ i, 0 < w i := by
    by_contra hn
    have hall (i : ι) : w i = 0 := le_antisymm
      (le_of_not_gt (fun hi => hn ⟨i, hi⟩)) (hw i)
    have hzero : ∑ i, w i = 0 := by simp only [hall, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hactive
  have hsign (i : ι) (hi : w i ≠ 0) :
      (c i).val.2 ∈ signHalfSpace (ℓ h) (D.signs h) :=
    hD i hi h (active_center_real_eq_zero ℓ c p w hw hp hz i hi)
  have hsum : ℓ h (centerCombination ℓ c w).2 = ∑ i, w i * ℓ h (c i).val.2 := by
    simp only [centerCombination, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  cases hs : D.signs h
  · change ℓ h (centerCombination ℓ c w).2 < 0
    rw [hsum]
    apply Finset.sum_neg' _ ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hj (by
      simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hsign j (ne_of_gt hj))⟩
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : w i = 0
    · simp only [hi, zero_mul, le_refl]
    · exact (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (lt_of_le_of_ne (hw i) (Ne.symm hi))
        (by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hsign i hi)).le
  · change 0 < ℓ h (centerCombination ℓ c w).2
    rw [hsum]
    apply Finset.sum_pos' _ ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, mul_pos hj (by
      simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hsign j (ne_of_gt hj))⟩
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : w i = 0
    · simp only [hi, zero_mul, le_refl]
    · exact (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hw i) (Ne.symm hi))
        (by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hsign i hi)).le

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.centerCombinat.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.centerCombination_with_commonPoint_mem
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.centerCombinat.source_declaration:
/-- The common point itself can be added as an extra center. -/
theorem centerCombination_with_commonPoint_mem (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ)
    (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (hp : ∀ i, p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i))
    (w : Option ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    centerCombination ℓ (fun o : Option ι => o.elim p c) w ∈ complexComplementSet ℓ := by
  apply centerCombination_mem_complement ℓ _ p _ w hw hwone
  intro o
  cases o with
  | none => exact canonicalCell_self ℓ p
  | some i => exact hp i

noncomputable def chainCarrierRestriction {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (F : Finset P) :

  let g : C(chainCarrierFace x F, OrderWeights P) :=

  exact ⟨fun z => weightRestrict (F : Set P) (g z) z.property,
    weightRestrict_continuous_finite (F : Set P) F.finite_toSet g (fun z => z.property)⟩

  intro a ha b hb _hab
  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
  obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
  exact (le_total i j).imp (fun h => x.monotone h) (fun h => x.monotone h)

/-- A simple product gives a genuine chamber-between relation at its actual
intermediate endpoint. This is the local geometric input for all subchains. -/
theorem chamberBetween_of_simple_product (J : Set I)
    {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} {a b : Artin.Group M}
    (ha : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y a) (hb : PositiveReducedArrow M Y Z b)
    (hab : SimpleRibbon M X Z (a * b)) (C : ChamberFiber M J X) :
    ChamberBetween C.val
      (fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M a)
        (isRibbon_projection_transporter M ha.isRibbon) C).val
      (fiberTarget M J (Artin.projection M (a * b))
        (isRibbon_projection_transporter M hab.1.isRibbon) C).val := by
  have has := (SimpleRibbon.factors M hab ha hb).1
  rw [chamberBetween_iff_relativeTransport_length,
    relativeTransport_simpleFiberTarget M J has C,
    relativeTransport_simpleFiberTarget M J hab C]
  rw [map_mul, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  simpa only [map_mul] using
    actual_simple_factors_length M ha.positive hb.positive (SimpleRibbon.eq_simpleLift M hab)

    {c : relativeSubspace J} (hc : c ∈ C.region) (R : RelativeRoot M J)
    (hn : actualForms M J R c < 0) : C.signs R = false := by

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.chamber_sign_t.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.chamber_sign_true_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.chamber_sign_t.source_declaration:
/-- A chamber's sign is exactly the strict sign of any of its actual points. -/
theorem chamber_sign_true_iff (J : Set I) (C : ActualChamber M J)
    {c : relativeSubspace J} (hc : c ∈ C.region) (R : RelativeRoot M J) :
    C.signs R = true ↔ 0 < actualForms M J R c := by
  have h := hc R
  change (if C.signs R then 0 < actualForms M J R c else actualForms M J R c < 0) at h
  cases hs : C.signs R
  · rw [hs] at h
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    exact not_lt_of_ge h.le
  · rw [hs] at h
    simp only [↓reduceIte] at h
    simp only [true_iff]
    exact h

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.component_proj.source_declaration:
/-- Projection of the actual upstairs component stays in the precise
base sign piece, by continuous images of connected components. -/
theorem component_projection_mem_basePiece {F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) {q : ComplementUniversalCover M J}
    (hq : q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J F)
    {z : ComplementUniversalCover M J}
    (hz : z ∈ connectedComponentIn (liftedTubeIntersection M J F) q) :
    complementUniversalCoverProjection M J z ∈ liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q := by
  let f : ComplementUniversalCover M J →
      ComplexComplement (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J) :=
    liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J
  have hf : Continuous f := (actualComplementHomeomorph M J).continuous.comp
    (continuous_complementUniversalCoverProjection M J)
  have hsub : f '' liftedTubeIntersection M J F ⊆
      tubeIntersection (liftedTubeChambers M J F) := by
    rintro p ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact projectionPoint_mem_tubeIntersection M J hy
  have hmem := (hf.continuousOn.image_connectedComponentIn_subset hq) ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  have hmem' := connectedComponentIn_mono (f q) hsub hmem
  have he := tubeIntersectionPiece_eq_connectedComponentIn
    (liftedTubeChambers_nonempty M J hF) (projection_mem_liftedTubeBasePiece M J hq)
  change f z ∈ tubeIntersectionPiece (liftedTubeChambers M J F) (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q)
  rw [he]
  exact hmem'

/-- The ordinary finite-face coordinates are continuous; no global
coordinate-continuity criterion is being invoked for the weak realization. -/
theorem continuous_carrierSimplex {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (F : Finset P) (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty)
    (g : C(X, OrderWeights P)) (hg : ∀ x, (g x).weights.support ⊆ F) :
    Continuous (fun x => carrierSimplex F hF hne (g x) (hg x)) := by
  rw [(StdSimplex.isEmbedding_toFun_comp_weights ℝ (Fin (F.card - 1 + 1))).continuous_iff]
  change Continuous (fun x i => (g x).weights (finiteChainOrder F hF hne i))
  exact continuous_pi fun i => (weightEval_continuous _).comp g.continuous

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_fin.source_declaration:
theorem continuous_finite_face_of_canonical (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : SubcomplexWeights S → Y)
    (F : Finset P) (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F)
    (hc : Continuous (fun z => f (subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF z))) :
    Continuous (fun w : OrderWeights (F : Set P) => f (subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hSF w)) := by
  let g : C(OrderWeights (F : Set P), OrderWeights P) :=
    weightMapContinuous (weightInclusion (F : Set P))
  have hg : ∀ w, (g w).weights.support ⊆ F := weightInclusion_support_subset F
  have ht := hc.comp (continuous_carrierSimplex F hF hne g hg)
  apply ht.congr
  intro w
  apply congrArg f
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact carrierSimplex_reconstruct F hF hne (g w) (hg w)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_fin.source_declaration:
/-- Admissible simplex tests imply continuity on each admissible finite
chain face, by its canonical finite enumeration and actual coordinates. -/
theorem continuous_finite_face_of_charts (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : SubcomplexWeights S → Y)
    (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (hx : S (Finset.univ.image x)),
      Continuous (fun z => f (subcomplexChart S hS x hx z)))
    (F : Finset P) (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F) :
    Continuous (fun w : OrderWeights (F : Set P) => f (subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hSF w)) := by
  classical
  let x := finiteChainOrder F hF hne
  have hx : S (Finset.univ.image x) := by rw [finiteChainOrder_range]; exact hSF
  let g : C(OrderWeights (F : Set P), OrderWeights P) :=
    weightMapContinuous (weightInclusion (F : Set P))
  have hg : ∀ w, (g w).weights.support ⊆ F := weightInclusion_support_subset F
  have ht := (hc (F.card - 1) x hx).comp (continuous_carrierSimplex F hF hne g hg)
  apply ht.congr
  intro w
  apply congrArg f
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact carrierSimplex_reconstruct F hF hne (g w) (hg w)

theorem continuous_garsideCanonicalChart (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0))
    (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) (hne : F.Nonempty)
    (hSF : garsideSupportPredicate M B0 F) :

/-- Local continuity comes from one finite closed-support chart and its
actual common-intersection parameter space. -/
theorem continuous_partitionTrackValue (W : ι → Set X) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i))
    (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W)
    (hH : NumerableFaceTracks.Compatible W H) : Continuous (partitionTrackValue W ρ hρ H) := by
  classical
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro p₀
  let F := ρ.fintsupport p₀.2
  have hne : F.Nonempty :=
    (partition_finsupport_nonempty ρ p₀.2).mono (ρ.finsupport_subset_fintsupport p₀.2)
  have hpF : p₀.2 ∈ coverFaceParameter W F := by
    intro i hi
    exact hρ i ((ρ.mem_fintsupport_iff p₀.2 i).mp hi)
  have hF : IsNerveFace W F := ⟨p₀.2, hpF⟩
  let V : Set X := coverFaceParameter W F ∩ chartDomain ρ F
  have hV : V ∈ 𝓝 p₀.2 :=
    Filter.inter_mem ((isOpen_coverFaceParameter W hW F).mem_nhds hpF)
      (chartDomain_mem_nhds ρ p₀.2)
  let U : Set (I × X) := Prod.snd ⁻¹' V
  have hU : U ∈ 𝓝 p₀ := continuous_snd.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hV
  let g : U → I × (coverFaceParameter W F × StdSimplex ℝ F) := fun q ↦
    (q.val.1, (⟨q.val.2, q.property.1⟩,
      finiteChart ρ F ⟨q.val.2, q.property.2⟩))
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    refine (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val).prodMk ?_
    refine ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _).prodMk ?_
    exact (finiteChart ρ F).continuous.comp
      ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)
  have hc : Continuous (U.domRestrict (partitionTrackValue W ρ hρ H)) := by
    apply ((H F hne hF).continuous.comp hg).congr
    intro q
    exact (partitionTrackValue_eq_finite W ρ hρ H hH F hne hF q.val.1
      ⟨q.val.2, q.property.1⟩ q.property.2).symm
  exact (continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mpr hc).continuousAt hU

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_sub.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_subcomplex_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_sub.source_declaration:
/-- The genuine final-continuity criterion for the inherited subspace. -/
theorem continuous_subcomplex_iff (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : SubcomplexWeights S → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (hx : S (Finset.univ.image x)),
      Continuous (fun z => f (subcomplexChart S hS x hx z)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf n x hx
    exact hf.comp (continuous_subcomplexChart S hS x hx)
  · intro hc
    apply continuous_iff_isClosed.mpr
    intro T hT
    have hclosed : IsClosed ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) '' (f ⁻¹' T)) :=
      isClosed_image_of_finite_face_preimages S hS (f ⁻¹' T) (by
        intro F hF hne hSF
        exact hT.preimage (continuous_finite_face_of_charts S hS f hc F hF hne hSF))
    have hpre : IsClosed ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) ⁻¹'
        ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) '' (f ⁻¹' T))) :=
      hclosed.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    simpa only [Set.preimage_image_eq (f ⁻¹' T) Subtype.val_injective] using hpre

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_sub.source_declaration:
/-- Canonical finite-chain charts alone determine the actual subspace
continuity; no separate nondegenerate/degenerate chart topology is assumed. -/
theorem continuous_subcomplex_iff_canonical (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : SubcomplexWeights S → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ (F : Finset P) (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P))
      (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F),
      Continuous (fun z => f (subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF z)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf F hF hne hSF
    exact hf.comp (continuous_subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF)
  · intro hc
    apply continuous_iff_isClosed.mpr
    intro T hT
    have hclosed : IsClosed ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) '' (f ⁻¹' T)) :=
      isClosed_image_of_finite_face_preimages S hS (f ⁻¹' T) (by
        intro F hF hne hSF
        exact hT.preimage (continuous_finite_face_of_canonical S hS f F hF hne hSF
          (hc F hF hne hSF)))
    have hpre : IsClosed ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) ⁻¹'
        ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) '' (f ⁻¹' T))) :=
      hclosed.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    simpa only [Set.preimage_image_eq (f ⁻¹' T) Subtype.val_injective] using hpre

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_sub.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_subcomplex_prod_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_sub.source_declaration:
/-- Locally compact parameters may be included in every actual chart test. -/
theorem continuous_subcomplex_prod_iff (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
    {Z Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Z] [LocallyCompactSpace Z] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : Z × SubcomplexWeights S → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) →o P) (hx : S (Finset.univ.image x)),
      Continuous (fun p : Z × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) =>
        f (p.1, subcomplexChart S hS x hx p.2)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf n x hx
    exact hf.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk
      ((continuous_subcomplexChart S hS x hx).comp continuous_snd))
  · intro hc
    have ht (w : SubcomplexWeights S) : Continuous (fun z => f (z, w)) := by
      let x := weightChain w.val
      have hx : S (Finset.univ.image x) := by
        have he : Finset.univ.image x = w.val.weights.support := by
          ext p
          constructor
          · intro hp
            obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
            exact (weightEnum w.val i).property
          · intro hp
            exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(weightEnum w.val).symm ⟨p, hp⟩, Finset.mem_univ _,
              congrArg Subtype.val ((weightEnum w.val).apply_symm_apply _)⟩
        rw [he]
        exact w.property
      have h : Continuous (fun z : Z =>
          f (z, subcomplexChart S hS x hx (weightSimplex w.val))) :=
        (hc (weightDim w.val) x hx).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      have he : subcomplexChart S hS x hx (weightSimplex w.val) = w :=
        Subtype.ext (orderWeightsOfChain_canonical w.val)
      simpa only [he] using h
    let F : SubcomplexWeights S → C(Z, Y) := fun w => ⟨fun z => f (z, w), ht w⟩
    have hF : Continuous F := by
      apply (continuous_subcomplex_iff S hS F).mpr
      intro n x hx
      apply ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry
      exact (hc n x hx).comp continuous_swap
    exact (ContinuousMap.continuous_uncurry_of_continuous ⟨F, hF⟩).comp continuous_swap

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_sub.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_subcomplex_prod_iff_canonical
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.continuous_sub.source_declaration:
/-- Canonical-chart continuity also determines actual homotopies and other
families parametrized by a locally compact space. -/
theorem continuous_subcomplex_prod_iff_canonical (S : Finset P → Prop)
    (hS : SupportHereditary S)
    {Z Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Z] [LocallyCompactSpace Z] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : Z × SubcomplexWeights S → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ (F : Finset P) (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P))
      (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F),
      Continuous (fun p : Z × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (F.card - 1 + 1)) =>
        f (p.1, subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF p.2)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf F hF hne hSF
    exact hf.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk
      ((continuous_subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF).comp continuous_snd))
  · intro hc
    have ht (w : SubcomplexWeights S) : Continuous (fun z => f (z, w)) := by
      obtain ⟨F, hF, hne, hSF, c, he⟩ := exists_subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS w
      have h : Continuous (fun z : Z => f (z, subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF c)) :=
        (hc F hF hne hSF).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      simpa only [he] using h
    let G : SubcomplexWeights S → C(Z, Y) := fun w => ⟨fun z => f (z, w), ht w⟩
    have hG : Continuous G := by
      apply (continuous_subcomplex_iff_canonical S hS G).mpr
      intro F hF hne hSF
      apply ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry
      exact (hc F hF hne hSF).comp continuous_swap
    exact (ContinuousMap.continuous_uncurry_of_continuous ⟨G, hG⟩).comp continuous_swap

/-- Every finite carrier below `u`, containing `u` and closed under its actual
relative heads, contracts by transporting the already proved positive folds. -/
theorem contractibleSpace_finite_relative_head_closed (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
    (B : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0))
    (hbelow : ∀ v ∈ B, v ≤ u) (hu : u ∈ B)
    (hclosed : ∀ v ∈ B, relativeHeadStep M u v ∈ B) :
    ContractibleSpace (GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) := by
  classical
  let C : Set (IncomingVertex M u.source) := incomingRetarget M u '' (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))
  have hC : C.Finite := B.finite_toSet.image (incomingRetarget M u)
  let : Fintype C := hC.fintype
  have hpos (w : C) : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M u.source w.val := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := w.property
    rw [← he]
    exact (incomingRetarget_positive_iff M u v).2 (hbelow v hv)
  have hhead (w : C) : headStep M u.source w.val ∈ C := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := w.property
    refine ⟨relativeHeadStep M u v, hclosed v hv, ?_⟩
    simpa only [he] using incomingRetarget_relativeHeadStep M u v (hbelow v hv)
  let root : C := ⟨incomingRoot M u.source, ⟨u, hu, incomingRetarget_self M u⟩⟩
  have hcontract : ContractibleSpace (GarsideWeightsOn M u.source C) :=
    contractibleSpace_finite_positive_head_closed M u.source hpos hhead root rfl
  exact (relativeGarsideWeightsHomeomorph M u (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))).contractibleSpace_iff.mpr
    hcontract

/-- Side data with both endpoint maps glued on the actual cylinder-boundary
pushout. The domain is not replaced by an assumed boundary filler. -/
def cylinderBoundaryData
    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} (i : A ⟶ B) (f₀ f₁ : C(B, Z))
    (H : C(I × A, Z))
    (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ (i a))
    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ (i a)) : TopCat.CylinderBoundary i ⟶ Z :=
  pushout.desc
    (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p ↦ H (p.2, p.1), by fun_prop⟩)
    (TopCat.ofHom ⟨Sum.elim f₀ f₁, f₀.continuous.sumElim f₁.continuous⟩)
    (by
      ext a
      cases a with
      | inl a => exact h₀ a
      | inr a => exact h₁ a)

    (H : C(I × A, Z)) (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ (i a))
    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ (i a)) (b : B) :
    cylinderBoundaryData i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁

      pushout.inr_desc _ _ _
    simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.deleteVertex.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.deleteVertex
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.deleteVertex.source_declaration:
/-- The genuine finite-coordinate weight transfer, now constrained to the
actual simple-chain subspace at every time. -/
noncomputable def deleteVertex (t : unitInterval) (x : X) : GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A := by
  classical
  let w := f x
  let w' := FiniteWeightTransfer.moveOrderWeights p q t w.val
    (deletion_cone M B0 hpos p q hq hne f hmax x)
  refine ⟨w', ?_⟩
  intro i hi j hj hij
  by_cases hp : p ∈ w.val.weights.support
  · have hsimple (k : A) (hk : k ∈ w.val.weights.support) :
        SimpleRibbon M k.val.source q.val.source (k.val.difference q.val) := by
      have h := (active_le_headStep M B0 hpos w p hp (hmax x) hne k hk).2
      rwa [← hq] at h
    rcases FiniteWeightTransfer.movedWeights_support p q t w.val hi with hiold | hiq
    · rcases FiniteWeightTransfer.movedWeights_support p q t w.val hj with hjold | hjq
      · exact w.property i hiold j hjold hij
      · subst j
        exact hsimple i hiold
    · subst i
      rcases FiniteWeightTransfer.movedWeights_support p q t w.val hj with hjold | hjq
      · have hjq' : j = q := le_antisymm
          (deletion_cone M B0 hpos p q hq hne f hmax x hp j hjold) hij
        subst j
        simpa only [IncomingVertex.difference_self] using simpleRibbon_one M q.val.source
      · subst j
        simpa only [IncomingVertex.difference_self] using simpleRibbon_one M q.val.source
  · have he := FiniteWeightTransfer.movedWeights_eq_of_notMem p q t w.val hp
    change i ∈ (FiniteWeightTransfer.movedWeights p q t w.val).support at hi
    change j ∈ (FiniteWeightTransfer.movedWeights p q t w.val).support at hj
    rw [he] at hi hj
    exact w.property i hi j hj hij

/-- This is an actual homotopy of the given continuous map, not merely a
pointwise deletion or a combinatorial collapse claim. -/
noncomputable def deleteVertexHomotopy :
    f.Homotopy
      ⟨fun x => deleteVertex M B0 hpos p q hq hne f hmax 1 x,
        (continuous_deleteVertex M B0 hpos p q hq hne f hmax).comp
          (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)⟩ where
  toFun z := deleteVertex M B0 hpos p q hq hne f hmax z.1 z.2
  continuous_toFun := continuous_deleteVertex M B0 hpos p q hq hne f hmax
  map_zero_left := deleteVertex_zero M B0 hpos p q hq hne f hmax
  map_one_left _ := rfl

/-- The unique actual fiber point indexing the sheet over `C` through `q`. -/
theorem existsUnique_fiberPoint_at (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (C : ActualChamber M J)
    (hC : complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q ∈ actualTubeSet M J C) :
    ∃! e : {z : ComplementUniversalCover M J //

  subst D
  refine ⟨e, he, ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  by_contra hne
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_liftedTubeSheet_same_chamber M J C hne) hf he

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.existsUnique_l.source_declaration:
/-- Exactly one actual sheet over a fixed tube contains a specified lift. -/
theorem existsUnique_liftedTubeIndex_at (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (C : ActualChamber M J) (hC : complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q ∈ actualTubeSet M J C) :
    ∃! A : LiftedTubeIndex M J, A.chamber = C ∧ q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A := by
  have hcover := TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet_exhaustive
    (isSimplyConnected_actualTube M J C).isPathConnected (tubeBasepoint_mem M J C) hC
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hcover
  let A : LiftedTubeIndex M J :=
    ⟨C, (universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses (standardComplementPoint M J)
      (tubeBasepoint M J C)).symm r⟩
  have hA : q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A := by
    change q ∈ TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet (actualTubeSet M J C) (tubeBasepoint_mem M J C)
      ((universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses _ _) ((universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses _ _).symm r))
    rwa [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine ⟨A, ⟨rfl, hA⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨D, e⟩ ⟨hD, he⟩
  dsimp only at hD
  subst D
  have hef : e = A.fiberPoint := by
    by_contra hne
    have hd := disjoint_liftedTubeSheet_same_chamber M J C hne
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd he hA
  cases hef
  rfl

/-- The finite canonical cover has an ordinary base partition in the original topology. -/
theorem exists_canonicalBasePartition :
    ∃ ρ : PartitionOfUnity (actualCanonicalType M J) (Complement M J),
      ρ.IsSubordinate (actualCanonicalTypeSet M J) := by

/-- A contractible target extends every map across a map having HEP. -/
theorem exists_extension_of_hep
    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} [ContractibleSpace Z]
    (i : A ⟶ B) (hi : TopCat.HomotopyExtensionProperty i) (h : C(A, Z)) :
    ∃ F : C(B, Z), ∀ a, F (i a) = h a := by
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨L⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic Z
  let H : C(I × A, Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ L.symm (p.1, h p.2), by fun_prop⟩
  obtain ⟨K, _, hK⟩ := TopCat.homotopyExtensionProperty_continuous hi Z
    (ContinuousMap.const B z) H (fun a ↦ L.symm.apply_zero (h a))
  refine ⟨⟨fun b ↦ K (1, b), by fun_prop⟩, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (hK 1 a).trans (L.symm.apply_one (h a))

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_finite_.source_declaration:
/-- Close a finite set under a deterministic, terminating reduction without
introducing points outside a proved invariant property. -/
theorem exists_finite_closed_ancestry {P : Type u} (step : P → P) (measure : P → ℕ)
    (Q : P → Prop) (hstep : ∀ x, step x = x ∨ measure (step x) < measure x)
    (hQ : ∀ x, Q x → Q (step x)) :
    ∀ A : Finset P, (∀ x ∈ A, Q x) →
      ∃ B : Finset P, A ⊆ B ∧ (∀ x ∈ B, Q x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ B, step x ∈ B := by
  classical
  have single : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : P, measure x = n → Q x →
      ∃ B : Finset P, x ∈ B ∧ (∀ y ∈ B, Q y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, step y ∈ B := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | ind n ih =>
      intro x hn hx
      rcases hstep x with hfix | hdec
      · refine ⟨{x}, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro y hy
          simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy] using hx
        · intro y hy
          rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy, hfix]
          simp
      · obtain ⟨B, hfx, hBQ, hclosed⟩ :=
          ih (measure (step x)) (by omega) (step x) rfl (hQ x hx)
        refine ⟨insert x B, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro y hy
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
          · exact hx
          · exact hBQ y hy
        · intro y hy
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
          · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hfx
          · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hclosed y hy)
  intro A
  induction A using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro _
    exact ⟨∅, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  | @insert x A hx ih =>
    intro hA
    obtain ⟨B, hAB, hBQ, hBclosed⟩ :=
      ih (fun y hy => hA y (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hy))
    obtain ⟨C, hxC, hCQ, hCclosed⟩ :=
      single (measure x) x rfl (hA x (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
    refine ⟨B ∪ C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hxC
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (hAB hy)
    · intro y hy
      exact (Finset.mem_union.mp hy).elim (hBQ y) (hCQ y)
    · intro y hy
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hy with hy | hy
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (hBclosed y hy)
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (hCclosed y hy)

/-- The earlier finite-ancestry construction supplies all hypotheses of the
finite contraction, for each actual finite positive packet. -/
theorem exists_finite_contractible_positive_enlargement
    (A : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0))
    (hA : ∀ u ∈ A, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) :
    ∃ B : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0), A ⊆ B ∧
      (∀ u ∈ B, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) ∧
      ContractibleSpace (GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hAB, hrB, hBpos, hBclosed⟩ := exists_finite_positive_head_closed M B0 A hA
  refine ⟨B, hAB, hBpos, ?_⟩
  let r : (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)) := ⟨incomingRoot M B0, hrB⟩
  exact contractibleSpace_finite_positive_head_closed M B0
    (fun u => hBpos u.val u.property)
    (fun u => hBclosed u.val u.property) r rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_finite_.source_declaration:
/-- Finite boundary data already satisfying `Q` have a finite contractible
relative-head enlargement in `↓u ∩ Q`. Upward closure is required only within
that actual downset. Neither contraction nor any positive global target
height is assumed. -/
theorem exists_finite_contractible_relative_enlargement (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
    (A : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0)) (Q : IncomingVertex M B0 → Prop)
    (hA_below : ∀ v ∈ A, v ≤ u) (hAQ : ∀ v ∈ A, Q v) (hQu : Q u)
    (hQ : ∀ v w, v ≤ w → w ≤ u → Q v → Q w) :
    ∃ B : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0), A ⊆ B ∧ u ∈ B ∧
      (∀ v ∈ B, v ≤ u ∧ Q v) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ B, relativeHeadStep M u v ∈ B) ∧
      ContractibleSpace (GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) := by
  classical
  have invariant (v : IncomingVertex M B0) (hv : v ≤ u ∧ Q v) :
      relativeHeadStep M u v ≤ u ∧ Q (relativeHeadStep M u v) := by
    have hb := relativeHeadStep_interval M u v hv.1
    exact ⟨hb.2, hQ v (relativeHeadStep M u v) hb.1 hb.2 hv.2⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hAB, hBQ, hclosed⟩ := exists_finite_closed_ancestry
    (relativeHeadStep M u) (relativeHeadMeasure M u) (fun v => v ≤ u ∧ Q v)
    (relativeHeadStep_terminates M u) invariant (insert u A) (by
      intro v hv
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hv with rfl | hv
      · exact ⟨le_rfl, hQu⟩
      · exact ⟨hA_below v hv, hAQ v hv⟩)
  have huB : u ∈ B := hAB (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  exact ⟨B, (Finset.subset_insert _ _).trans hAB, huB, hBQ, hclosed,
    contractibleSpace_finite_relative_head_closed M u B (fun v hv => (hBQ v hv).1) huB hclosed⟩
