ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_finite_.source_declaration:
/-- Finite positive carriers have genuine finite head-closed enlargements,
containing the actual identity vertex and no nonpositive vertices. -/
theorem exists_finite_positive_head_closed (A : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0))
    (hA : ∀ u ∈ A, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) :
    ∃ B : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0), A ⊆ B ∧ incomingRoot M B0 ∈ B ∧
      (∀ u ∈ B, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) ∧
      ∀ u ∈ B, headStep M B0 u ∈ B := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hAB, hBpos, hBclosed⟩ := exists_finite_closed_ancestry
    (headStep M B0) (fun u => (degree M u.value).toNat)
    (IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0) (headStep_measure M B0) (headStep_positive M B0)
    (insert (incomingRoot M B0) A) (by
      intro u hu
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hu with rfl | hu
      · exact incomingRoot_positive M B0
      · exact hA u hu)
  exact ⟨B, Finset.Subset.trans (Finset.subset_insert _ _) hAB,
    hAB (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _), hBpos, hBclosed⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_homotop.source_declaration:
/-- Every prescribed boundary homotopy between two maps into a contractible
space extends, retaining both complete endpoint maps and the exact side data. -/
theorem exists_homotopy_extension_of_hep
    {A B Z : TopCat.{u}} [ContractibleSpace Z]
    (i : A ⟶ B) (hi : TopCat.HomotopyExtensionProperty i)
    (f₀ f₁ : C(B, Z)) (H : C(I × A, Z))
    (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ (i a))
    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ (i a)) :
    ∃ K : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁, ∀ t a, K (t, i a) = H (t, a) := by
  let h := cylinderBoundaryData i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_extension_of_hep
    (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryMap i)
    (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.homotopyExtensionProperty_cylinderBoundaryMap i hi) h.hom
  have hside (a : A) (t : I) : F (i a, t) = H (t, a) := by
    have he := hF (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySide i (a, t))
    have hm : TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryMap i
        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySide i (a, t)) = (i a, t) := by
      simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySide_map i) (a, t)
    rw [hm] at he
    exact he.trans (cylinderBoundaryData_side i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ a t)
  have hzero (b : B) : F (b, 0) = f₀ b := by
    have he := hF (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inl b))
    have hm : TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryMap i
        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inl b)) = (b, 0) := by
      simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps_map i) (Sum.inl b)
    rw [hm] at he
    exact he.trans (cylinderBoundaryData_cap_zero i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ b)
  have hone (b : B) : F (b, 1) = f₁ b := by
    have he := hF (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inr b))
    have hm : TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryMap i
        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps i (Sum.inr b)) = (b, 1) := by
      simpa only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, TopCat.ofHom, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundarySideMap,
      TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryEnds] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (TopCat.CylinderBoundary.cylinderBoundaryCaps_map i) (Sum.inr b)
    rw [hm] at he
    exact he.trans (cylinderBoundaryData_cap_one i f₀ f₁ H h₀ h₁ b)
  exact ⟨⟨⟨fun p ↦ F (p.2, p.1), by fun_prop⟩, hzero, hone⟩,
    fun t a ↦ hside a t⟩

    ((universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses (standardComplementPoint M J)
      (tubeBasepoint M J C)) ((universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses (standardComplementPoint M J)

/-- Actual face tracks glue continuously with their whole arbitrary parameter
and time coordinates, under equality on geometric overlaps. -/
theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_boundary_track
    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z] (d : ℕ)
    (H : Fin (d + 2) → C(X × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I), Z))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i j : Fin (d + 2)) (p : X)
      (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (t : I),
      x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove → H i (p, (x, t)) = H j (p, (y, t))) :
    ∃ B : C(X × (StdSimplex.boundary (d + 1) × I), Z),
      ∀ (i : Fin (d + 2)) (p : X) (x : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (t : I),
        B (p, (StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace d i x, t)) = H i (p, (x, t)) := by
  let G₀ : C(Fin (d + 2) × (X × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I)), Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ H p.1 p.2, continuous_prod_of_discrete_left.mpr (fun i ↦ (H i).continuous)⟩
  let G : C(X × (Fin (d + 2) × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I)), Z) :=
    G₀.comp ⟨fun p ↦ (p.2.1, (p.1, p.2.2)), by fun_prop⟩
  let q : C(X × (Fin (d + 2) × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I)),
      X × (StdSimplex.boundary (d + 1) × I)) :=
    ⟨Prod.map id (StdSimplex.simplexFaceCylinderCover d),
      continuous_id.prodMap (StdSimplex.simplexFaceCylinderCover d).continuous⟩
  have hG : Function.FactorsThrough G q := by
    rintro ⟨p, i, x, t⟩ ⟨r, j, y, s⟩ h
    have hpr : p = r := congrArg Prod.fst h
    subst r
    have hts : t = s := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.2.2) h
    subst s
    exact hcompat i j p x y t (congrArg (fun z ↦ z.2.1.val) h)
  let hq : IsQuotientMap q := isQuotientMap_parameterized_simplexFaceCylinderCover X d
  let B := hq.lift G hG
  refine ⟨B, fun i p x t ↦ ?_⟩
  exact ContinuousMap.congr_fun (hq.lift_comp G hG) (p, i, x, t)

/-- The same genuine gluing theorem in the conventional homotopy product
parenthesization. No restriction is imposed on the parameter space. -/
theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_boundary_track_assoc
    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z] (d : ℕ)
    (H : Fin (d + 2) → C((X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) × I, Z))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i j : Fin (d + 2)) (p : X)
      (x y : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (t : I),
      x.map i.succAbove = y.map j.succAbove → H i ((p, x), t) = H j ((p, y), t)) :
    ∃ B : C((X × StdSimplex.boundary (d + 1)) × I, Z),
      ∀ (i : Fin (d + 2)) (p : X) (x : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1))) (t : I),
        B ((p, StdSimplex.simplexBoundaryFace d i x), t) = H i ((p, x), t) := by
  let H' : Fin (d + 2) → C(X × (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (d + 1)) × I), Z) :=
    fun i => ⟨fun p => H i ((p.1, p.2.1), p.2.2), by fun_prop⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_parameterized_simplex_boundary_track d H' hcompat
  refine ⟨⟨fun p => B (p.1.1, (p.1.2, p.2)), by fun_prop⟩, ?_⟩
  exact hB

/-- Arbitrary continuous boundary data over any parameter space extends into a
contractible target. Source and target universes are independent. -/
theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_extension
    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z]
    [ContractibleSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
    (h : C(X × StdSimplex.boundary n, Z)) :
    ∃ F : C(X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z),
      ∀ x (b : StdSimplex.boundary n), F (x, b.val) = h (x, b) := by
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨L⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic Z
  let H : C((X × StdSimplex.boundary n) × I, Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ L.symm (p.2, h p.1), by fun_prop⟩
  obtain ⟨K, _, hK⟩ := StdSimplex.simplexBoundary_homotopy_extension n
    (ContinuousMap.const _ z) H (fun x b ↦ L.symm.apply_zero (h (x, b)))
  refine ⟨⟨fun p ↦ K (p, 1), by fun_prop⟩, fun x b ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (hK x b 1).trans (L.symm.apply_one (h (x, b)))

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_paramet.source_declaration:
/-- Universe-independent parameterized endpoint-relative extension. The lifts
only reconcile the categorical universe and are removed from the conclusion. -/
theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_homotopy_extension
    {X : Type u} {Z : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z]
    [ContractibleSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
    (f₀ f₁ : C(X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z))
    (H : C(I × (X × StdSimplex.boundary n), Z))
    (h₀ : ∀ x b, H (0, (x, b)) = f₀ (x, b.val))
    (h₁ : ∀ x b, H (1, (x, b)) = f₁ (x, b.val)) :
    ∃ K : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁,
      ∀ t x (b : StdSimplex.boundary n), K (t, (x, b.val)) = H (t, (x, b)) := by
  let _ : ContractibleSpace (ULift.{u} Z) :=
    (Homeomorph.ulift : ULift.{u} Z ≃ₜ Z).contractibleSpace
  let g₀ : C(ULift.{v} X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), ULift.{u} Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ ULift.up (f₀ (p.1.down, p.2)), by fun_prop⟩
  let g₁ : C(ULift.{v} X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), ULift.{u} Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ ULift.up (f₁ (p.1.down, p.2)), by fun_prop⟩
  let B : C(I × (ULift.{v} X × StdSimplex.boundary n), ULift.{u} Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ ULift.up (H (p.1, (p.2.1.down, p.2.2))), by fun_prop⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_parameterized_simplex_homotopy_extension_same_universe n
    g₀ g₁ B (fun x b ↦ congrArg ULift.up (h₀ x.down b))
    (fun x b ↦ congrArg ULift.up (h₁ x.down b))
  let L : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁ :=
    ⟨⟨fun p ↦ (K (p.1, (ULift.up p.2.1, p.2.2))).down, by fun_prop⟩,
      fun x ↦ congrArg ULift.down (K.apply_zero (ULift.up x.1, x.2)),
      fun x ↦ congrArg ULift.down (K.apply_one (ULift.up x.1, x.2))⟩
  exact ⟨L, fun t x b ↦ congrArg ULift.down (hK t (ULift.up x) b)⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_paramet.source_declaration:
/-- The whole parameterized side homotopy extends while retaining both complete
endpoint maps. This statement permits an arbitrary parameter topology. -/
theorem exists_parameterized_simplex_homotopy_extension_same_universe
    {X Z : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Z]
    [ContractibleSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
    (f₀ f₁ : C(X × StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z))
    (H : C(I × (X × StdSimplex.boundary n), Z))
    (h₀ : ∀ x b, H (0, (x, b)) = f₀ (x, b.val))
    (h₁ : ∀ x b, H (1, (x, b)) = f₁ (x, b.val)) :
    ∃ K : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁,
      ∀ t x (b : StdSimplex.boundary n), K (t, (x, b.val)) = H (t, (x, b)) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_homotopy_extension_of_hep (Z := TopCat.of Z)
    (TopCat.parameterizedSimplexBoundaryInclusion (TopCat.of X) n)
    (TopCat.homotopyExtensionProperty_simplexBoundary (TopCat.of X) n)
    f₀ f₁ H (fun a ↦ h₀ a.1 a.2) (fun a ↦ h₁ a.1 a.2)
  exact ⟨K, fun t x b ↦ hK t (x, b)⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_path_si.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_path_simpleUpperIntersection
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_path_si.source_declaration:
/-- Genuine positive paths to a chain vertex lift simultaneously inside
all simple-upper sheets, with their actual source and target fiber points. -/
theorem exists_path_simpleUpperIntersection
    {s : Finset (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))}
    (hne : s.Nonempty) (hs : garsideTubeAdmissible M J s)
    (a v : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) (ha : a ∈ s) (hv : v ∈ s)
    (hle : ∀ w ∈ s, a ≤ w) :
    ∃ Γ : Path (incomingVertexPoint M J a) (incomingVertexPoint M J v),
      ∀ t, Γ t ∈ simpleUpperIntersection M J s := by
  let U : Set (ActualChamber M J) := (fun u => u.chamber) '' simpleUpperSet M J s
  have hb : ∀ C ∈ U, ChamberBetween a.chamber v.chamber C := by
    rintro C ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    exact incoming_chamberBetween M (hle v hv) (hu v hv).1 (hu a ha).2
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := exists_actualPositivePath_sharedUpper M J
    (actualChamberPointFamily M J) a.chamber v.chamber U hb
  have hγu (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) (hu : u ∈ simpleUpperSet M J s)
      (t : unitInterval) : γ t ∈ actualTubeSet M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u).chamber := by
    rw [incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber]
    exact hγ t u.chamber (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩)
  let f (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) (hu : u ∈ simpleUpperSet M J s) :
      C(unitInterval, ComplementUniversalCover M J) :=
    (liftedTubeSection M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u)).comp
      ⟨fun t => ⟨γ t, hγu u hu t⟩, γ.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
  have hstart (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) (hu : u ∈ simpleUpperSet M J s) :
      f u hu 0 = incomingVertexPoint M J a := by
    have hmem := incomingVertexPoint_mem_upperSheet M J (hu a ha).2
    change liftedTubeSection M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u) ⟨γ 0, _⟩ = _
    have he : (⟨γ 0, hγu u hu 0⟩ : actualTubeSet M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u).chamber) =
        ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (incomingVertexPoint M J a),
          liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J _ hmem⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (γ.source.trans (incomingVertexPoint_projection M J a).symm)
    rw [he]
    exact liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J _ _ hmem
  have hend (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) (hu : u ∈ simpleUpperSet M J s) :
      f u hu 1 = incomingVertexPoint M J v := by
    have hmem := incomingVertexPoint_mem_upperSheet M J (hu v hv).2
    change liftedTubeSection M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u) ⟨γ 1, _⟩ = _
    have he : (⟨γ 1, hγu u hu 1⟩ : actualTubeSet M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u).chamber) =
        ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (incomingVertexPoint M J v),
          liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J _ hmem⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (γ.target.trans (incomingVertexPoint_projection M J v).symm)
    rw [he]
    exact liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J _ _ hmem
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := simpleUpperSet_nonempty M J hne hs
  have heq (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) (hu : u ∈ simpleUpperSet M J s) :
      f u₀ hu₀ = f u hu := by
    apply ContinuousMap.coe_injective
    apply (isCoveringMap_complementUniversalCoverProjection M J).eq_of_comp_eq
      (f u₀ hu₀).continuous (f u hu).continuous
      (funext fun t => (liftedTubeSection_projection M J _ ⟨γ t, hγu u₀ hu₀ t⟩).trans
        (liftedTubeSection_projection M J _ ⟨γ t, hγu u hu t⟩).symm) (0 : unitInterval)
    exact (hstart u₀ hu₀).trans (hstart u hu).symm
  let Γ : Path (incomingVertexPoint M J a) (incomingVertexPoint M J v) :=
    ⟨f u₀ hu₀, hstart u₀ hu₀, hend u₀ hu₀⟩
  refine ⟨Γ, ?_⟩
  intro t
  apply (mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J _ _).mpr
  rintro A ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  change f u₀ hu₀ t ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u)
  rw [heq u hu]
  exact (liftedTubeHomeomorph M J _ _).property

/-- A single genuine path represents the positive A-to-B arrow while
remaining in every specified upper tube. -/
theorem exists_positivePath_sharedUpper (c : ChamberPointFamily ℓ)
    (A B : Chamber ℓ) (U : Set (Chamber ℓ)) (hb : ∀ C ∈ U, ChamberBetween A B C) :
    ∃ γ : Path (chamberBasepoint c A) (chamberBasepoint c B),
      (∀ t, γ t ∈ tubeIntersectionPiece (insert B U) A.signs) ∧
      IntervalForward.positiveClass c A B = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ := by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := basepoints_mem_sharedUpperPiece c A B U hb
  have hfamily : (insert B U).Nonempty := ⟨B, Set.mem_insert B U⟩
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := (isPathConnected_tubeIntersectionPiece hfamily ⟨_, hA⟩).joinedIn _ hA _ hB
  exact ⟨γ, hγ, IntervalForward.classInTube_eq_path B _ _ γ
    (fun t => (hγ t).1 B (Set.mem_insert B U))⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_positiv.source_declaration:
/-- Removing a greatest simple head gives an actual positive cone vertex. -/
theorem exists_positive_headTail (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
    (hu : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) :
    ∃ v : IncomingVertex M B0,
      IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 v ∧ u ≤ v ∧
      SimpleRibbon M u.source v.source (u.difference v) ∧
      (∀ q : IncomingVertex M B0, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 q → u ≤ q →
        SimpleRibbon M u.source q.source (u.difference q) →
        q ≤ v ∧ SimpleRibbon M q.source v.source (q.difference v)) ∧
      (u.value ≠ 1 → degree M v.value < degree M u.value) := by
  obtain ⟨U, d, a, hd, ha, hpa, hgreat, hstrict⟩ :=
    greatest_simple_ribbon_prefix_with_tail M hu
  let v : IncomingVertex M B0 := ⟨U, a, ha.toReducedArrow⟩
  have hdiff : u.difference v = d := by
    dsimp only [IncomingVertex.difference, v]
    rw [hpa]
    group
  refine ⟨v, ha, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change PositiveReducedArrow M u.source U (u.difference v)
    rw [hdiff]
    exact hd.1
  · simpa only [hdiff] using hd
  · intro q hq huq hsq
    have hrp : RibbonPrefix M (u.difference q) u.value :=
      ⟨q.value, hq.positive, by dsimp only [IncomingVertex.difference]; group⟩
    have hrhead := hgreat q.source (u.difference q) hsq hrp
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M hsq.1 hd.1 hrhead
    have hqa : q.value = t * a := by
      calc
        q.value = (u.difference q)⁻¹ * u.value := by
          dsimp only [IncomingVertex.difference]
          group
        _ = t * a := by rw [hpa, hdt]; group
    have hqv : q.difference v = t := by
      dsimp only [IncomingVertex.difference, v]
      rw [hqa]
      group
    constructor
    · change PositiveReducedArrow M q.source U (q.difference v)
      rw [hqv]
      exact ht
    · rw [hqv]
      have hsimple : SimpleRibbon M u.source U (u.difference q * t) := by
        simpa only [← hdt] using hd
      exact SimpleRibbon.tail M hsimple hsq.1 ht
  · intro hne
    exact (hstrict hne).2

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_simple_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_simple_interval_of_garsideSupport
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_simple_.source_declaration:
/-- Every nonempty admissible finite chain has actual simple interval bounds
chosen from the chain itself. No total order on all incoming vertices is used. -/
theorem exists_simple_interval_of_garsideSupport
    (F : Finset (IncomingVertex M B0))
    (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))) (hne : F.Nonempty)
    (hSF : garsideSupportPredicate M B0 F) :
    ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ b ∈ F,
      (∀ u ∈ F, a ≤ u ∧ u ≤ b) ∧ SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b) := by
  let x := finiteChainOrder F hF hne
  let a := x 0
  let b := x (Fin.last (F.card - 1))
  have ha : a ∈ F := (finiteChainEnum F hF hne 0).property
  have hb : b ∈ F := (finiteChainEnum F hF hne (Fin.last (F.card - 1))).property
  have hbounds : ∀ u ∈ F, a ≤ u ∧ u ≤ b := by
    intro u hu
    let i := (finiteChainEnum F hF hne).symm ⟨u, hu⟩
    have hi : x i = u :=
      congrArg Subtype.val ((finiteChainEnum F hF hne).apply_symm_apply ⟨u, hu⟩)
    rw [← hi]
    exact ⟨x.monotone (Fin.zero_le i), x.monotone (Fin.le_last i)⟩
  exact ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hbounds, hSF a ha b hb (hbounds b hb).1⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_simplex.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_simplex_boundary_homotopy_extension
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.exists_simplex.source_declaration:
/-- Two prescribed maps of the literal geometric simplex extend any homotopy
on its literal boundary, with equality on the whole side. This also includes
the empty boundary of the zero-dimensional simplex. -/
theorem exists_simplex_boundary_homotopy_extension
    {Z : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Z] [ContractibleSpace Z] (n : ℕ)
    (f₀ f₁ : C(Convexity.StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z))
    (H : C(I × Convexity.StdSimplex.boundary n, Z))
    (h₀ : ∀ a, H (0, a) = f₀ a.1)
    (h₁ : ∀ a, H (1, a) = f₁ a.1) :
    ∃ K : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f₀ f₁,
      ∀ t (a : Convexity.StdSimplex.boundary n), K (t, a.1) = H (t, a) := by
  let X : TopCat.{u} := TopCat.of PUnit.{u + 1}
  let g₀ : C(X × Convexity.StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ f₀ p.2, by fun_prop⟩
  let g₁ : C(X × Convexity.StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ f₁ p.2, by fun_prop⟩
  let G : C(I × (X × Convexity.StdSimplex.boundary n), Z) :=
    ⟨fun p ↦ H (p.1, p.2.2), by fun_prop⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_homotopy_extension_of_hep (Z := TopCat.of Z)
    (TopCat.parameterizedSimplexBoundaryInclusion X n)
    (TopCat.homotopyExtensionProperty_simplexBoundary X n)
    g₀ g₁ G (fun a ↦ h₀ a.2) (fun a ↦ h₁ a.2)
  refine ⟨⟨⟨fun p ↦ L (p.1, (PUnit.unit, p.2)), by fun_prop⟩,
    fun a ↦ L.apply_zero (PUnit.unit, a),
    fun a ↦ L.apply_one (PUnit.unit, a)⟩, ?_⟩
  intro t a
  exact hL t (PUnit.unit, a)

theorem exists_subcomplexCanonicalChart (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)
    (w : SubcomplexWeights S) :
    ∃ (F : Finset P) (hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P)) (hne : F.Nonempty) (hSF : S F)
      (z : StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (F.card - 1 + 1))),
      subcomplexCanonicalChart S hS F hF hne hSF z = w := by
  let F := w.val.weights.support
  have hF : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P) := fun a ha b hb _ => w.val.chain a ha b hb
  have hne : F.Nonempty := w.val.support_nonempty
  refine ⟨F, hF, hne, w.property,
    carrierSimplex F hF hne w.val (Finset.Subset.refl _), ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact carrierSimplex_reconstruct F hF hne w.val (Finset.Subset.refl _)

/-- A local connector between chambers ordered from the common lower face
is the actual positive interval generator. -/
theorem faceConnector_eq_positive_of_between (p : Complement M J) (C D : ActualChamber M J)
    (hpC : p ∈ actualTubeSet M J C)
    (hbet : ChamberBetween (sheetLowerChamber M J p) C D) :
    faceIntervalConnector (actualForms M J) p.val.1 C D = intervalPositive C D := by
  have he := congrArg (fun F : ActualChamber M J =>
    inv (intervalPositive F C) ≫ intervalPositive F D) (faceChamber_eq_sheetLower M J p C hpC)
  change inv (intervalPositive (faceChamber (actualForms M J) p.val.1 C) C) ≫
    intervalPositive (faceChamber (actualForms M J) p.val.1 C) D = _
  refine he.trans ?_
  rw [intervalPositive_comp _ _ _ hbet]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]

theorem finiteMeet_mem_of_garsideTubeAdmissible
    {s : Finset (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))}
    (hne : s.Nonempty) (hs : garsideTubeAdmissible M J s) : IncomingVertex.finiteMeet s hne ∈ s := by

    (IncomingVertex.finiteMeet_le s hne ha)

    (F : Finset ι) (hF : F.Nonempty) (x : chartDomain ρ F) : OrderWeights ι :=

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.finitePartitio.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.finitePartitionWeights_apply
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.finitePartitio.source_declaration:
theorem finitePartitionWeights_apply (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
    (F : Finset ι) (hF : F.Nonempty) (x : chartDomain ρ F) (i : ι) :
    (finitePartitionWeights ρ F hF x).weights i = ρ i x.val := by
  classical
  change chainWeights (partitionChain F hF)
    ((finiteChart ρ F x).map (F.orderIsoOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)).symm) i = _
  rw [chainWeights_apply]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ F
  · let e := F.orderIsoOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)
    let j : F := ⟨i, hi⟩
    let k := e.symm j
    have hk : partitionChain F hF k = i :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply j)
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
    · rw [ite_eq_left hk, StdSimplex.weights_map]
      change Finsupp.mapDomain e.symm (finiteChart ρ F x).weights (e.symm j) = _
      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective e.symm.injective]
      rfl
    · intro l _ hl
      have hli : partitionChain F hF l ≠ i := by
        intro he
        apply hl
        exact (F.orderEmbOfFin (finiteFace_card F hF)).injective (he.trans hk.symm)
      exact ite_eq_right hli
    · intro hn
      exact False.elim (hn (Finset.mem_univ k))
  · have hρ : ρ i x.val = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hi (x.property ((ρ.mem_finsupport x.val).mpr hn))
    rw [hρ]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k _
    have hk : partitionChain F hF k ≠ i := by
      intro he
      apply hi
      exact he ▸ F.orderEmbOfFin_mem (finiteFace_card F hF) k
    exact ite_eq_right hk

/-- An actual finite head-closed positive carrier contracts by successive
maximal-degree deletions. The proof explicitly decreases the remaining
carrier cardinality and retains the continuous deletion homotopies. -/
theorem finite_positive_head_closed_homotopic_const
    {A : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)} [Finite A]
    (hpos : ∀ u : A, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u.val)
    (hclosed : ∀ u : A, headStep M B0 u.val ∈ A)
    (r : A) (hr : r.val = incomingRoot M B0)
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A)) :
    f.Homotopic (ContinuousMap.const X (GarsideWeightsOn.vertex M B0 r)) := by
  classical
  let δ : A → A := fun u => ⟨headStep M B0 u.val, hclosed u⟩
  let ν : A → ℕ := fun u => (degree M u.val.value).toNat
  have hνzero (u : A) : ν u = 0 ↔ u = r := by
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hn := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ (hpos u).positive
      have hd : degree M u.val.value = 0 := by change (degree M u.val.value).toNat = 0 at hz; omega
      have hv := (degree_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ
        (hpos u).positive).mp hd
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact ((incoming_value_eq_one_iff M B0 u.val).mp hv).trans hr.symm
    · rintro rfl
      simp only [ν, hr, incomingRoot_value, degree_one, Int.toNat_zero]
  have hδ (u : A) : δ u = u ∨ ν (δ u) < ν u := by
    rcases headStep_measure M B0 u.val with he | hd
    · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext he)
    · exact Or.inr hd
  have hcore : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ F : Finset A, F.card = n → r ∈ F →
      (∀ u ∈ F, δ u ∈ F) →
      ∀ g : C(X, GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A),
        (∀ x, ∀ u ∈ (g x).val.weights.support, u ∈ F) →
        g.Homotopic (ContinuousMap.const X (GarsideWeightsOn.vertex M B0 r)) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | ind n ih =>
      intro F hcard hrF hFclosed g hgF
      by_cases honly : ∀ u ∈ F, u = r
      · have heq : g = ContinuousMap.const X (GarsideWeightsOn.vertex M B0 r) := by
          apply ContinuousMap.ext
          intro x
          exact eq_vertex_of_support_singleton M B0 (g x) r (fun u hu => honly u (hgF x u hu))
        exact ⟨ContinuousMap.Homotopy.refl g |>.cast rfl heq⟩
      · push Not at honly
        obtain ⟨i, hiF, hir⟩ := honly
        obtain ⟨p, hpF, hmaxν⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image F ν ⟨r, hrF⟩
        have hνi : 0 < ν i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun hz => hir ((hνzero i).mp hz))
        have hνp : 0 < ν p := hνi.trans_le (hmaxν i hiF)
        have hpr : p ≠ r := fun he => (ne_of_gt hνp) ((hνzero p).mpr he)
        have hpne : p.val.value ≠ 1 := by
          intro he
          apply hpr
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact ((incoming_value_eq_one_iff M B0 p.val).mp he).trans hr.symm
        have hmaxdeg (u : A) (hu : u ∈ F) : degree M u.val.value ≤ degree M p.val.value := by
          have hb := hmaxν u hu
          have hu0 := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ (hpos u).positive
          have hp0 := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ (hpos p).positive
          change (degree M u.val.value).toNat ≤ (degree M p.val.value).toNat at hb
          omega
        have hmaxactive : ∀ x, ∀ u ∈ (g x).val.weights.support,
            degree M u.val.value ≤ degree M p.val.value :=
          fun x u hu => hmaxdeg u (hgF x u hu)
        let q : A := δ p
        have hq : q.val = headStep M B0 p.val := rfl
        let g' : C(X, GarsideWeightsOn M B0 A) :=
          ⟨fun x => deleteVertex M B0 hpos p q hq hpne g hmaxactive 1 x,
            (continuous_deleteVertex M B0 hpos p q hq hpne g hmaxactive).comp
              (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)⟩
        have hg' : ∀ x, ∀ u ∈ (g' x).val.weights.support, u ∈ F.erase p := by
          intro x u hu
          have hup : u ≠ p := by
            intro he
            subst u
            exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hu)
              (deleteVertex_one_source M B0 hpos p q hq hpne g hmaxactive x)
          have huF : u ∈ F := by
            rcases FiniteWeightTransfer.movedWeights_support p q 1 (g x).val hu with huold | he
            · exact hgF x u huold
            · subst u
              exact hFclosed p hpF
          exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hup, huF⟩
        have hrF' : r ∈ F.erase p := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hpr, hrF⟩
        have hFclosed' : ∀ u ∈ F.erase p, δ u ∈ F.erase p := by
          intro u hu
          obtain ⟨hup, huF⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hu
          have hδup : δ u ≠ p := by
            intro he
            rcases hδ u with hfix | hdrop
            · exact hup (hfix.symm.trans he)
            · have hb := hmaxν u huF
              rw [he] at hdrop
              omega
          exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hδup, hFclosed u huF⟩
        have hless : (F.erase p).card < n := by
          rw [← hcard]
          exact Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hpF
        have hrest := ih (F.erase p).card hless (F.erase p) rfl hrF' hFclosed' g' hg'
        exact (show g.Homotopic g' from
          ⟨deleteVertexHomotopy M B0 hpos p q hq hpne g hmaxactive⟩).trans hrest
  let : Fintype A := Fintype.ofFinite A
  exact hcore Finset.univ.card Finset.univ rfl (Finset.mem_univ r)
    (fun u _ => Finset.mem_univ (δ u)) f (fun _ u _ => Finset.mem_univ u)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.finite_simple_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.finite_simple_interval
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.finite_simple_.source_declaration:
/-- Simple intervals have finitely many actual vertices: their projections
are injective because each actual difference is its canonical simple lift. -/
theorem finite_simple_interval {a b : IncomingVertex M B0}
    (hs : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b)) : Finite (Set.Icc a b) := by
  let f : Set.Icc a b → M.Group := fun u => Artin.projection M (a.difference u.val)
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro u v huv
  have hu := IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval hs le_rfl u.property.1 u.property.2
  have hv := IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval hs le_rfl v.property.1 v.property.2
  have hd : a.difference u.val = a.difference v.val :=
    (SimpleRibbon.eq_simpleLift M hu).trans
      ((congrArg (transporterPositiveLift M) huv).trans (SimpleRibbon.eq_simpleLift M hv).symm)
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply IncomingVertex.ext_value
  exact inv_injective (mul_left_cancel hd)

/-- Face inclusion enlarges the upper-sheet intersection. All actual face
vertices already lie in the larger selected component, so components nest. -/
theorem garsideTubeCarrier_mono
    {s t : Finset (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))}
    (hst : s ⊆ t) (hne : s.Nonempty) (ht : garsideTubeAdmissible M J t) :
    garsideTubeCarrier M J s ⊆ garsideTubeCarrier M J t := by
  have hnet : t.Nonempty := hne.mono hst
  have hs := garsideTubeAdmissible_hereditary M J hst ht
  have hanchor := incomingVertexPoint_mem_garsideTubeCarrier M J hnet ht
    (hst (finiteMeet_mem_of_garsideTubeAdmissible M J hne hs))
  rw [garsideTubeCarrier_eq M J s hne, garsideTubeCarrier_eq M J t hnet]
  rw [garsideTubeCarrier_eq M J t hnet] at hanchor
  rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hanchor]
  exact connectedComponentIn_mono _ (simpleUpperIntersection_mono M J hst)

/-- The selected component for any small chain in a packet interval lies
in the literal canonical packet carrier. -/
theorem garsideTubeCarrier_subset_canonicalPacketCarrier
    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
    (s : Finset (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)))
    (hne : s.Nonempty) (hs : garsideTubeAdmissible M J s)
    (hpacket : ∀ v ∈ s, v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
    garsideTubeCarrier M J s ⊆ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
  have hanchor := incomingVertexPoint_mem_canonicalPacketCarrier M J F hF q hq
    (hpacket _ (finiteMeet_mem_of_garsideTubeAdmissible M J hne hs))
  rw [garsideTubeCarrier_eq M J s hne, canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF]
  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF] at hanchor
  rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hanchor]
  exact connectedComponentIn_mono _
    (simpleUpperIntersection_subset_packetUpperIntersection M J F hF q hq s hpacket)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.garsideWeights.source_declaration:
/-- Pairwise simple support is preserved on actual subset realizations. -/
theorem garsideWeightsOn_retarget_iff (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
    (A : Set (IncomingVertex M B0)) (w : OrderWeights A) :
    weightMap (incomingRetargetOn M u A : A →o (incomingRetarget M u '' A)) w
      ∈ garsideWeightsOnSet M u.source (incomingRetarget M u '' A) ↔
        w ∈ garsideWeightsOnSet M B0 A := by
  classical
  let : DecidableEq A := Classical.decEq _
  let : DecidableEq (incomingRetarget M u '' A) := Classical.decEq _
  let e := incomingRetargetOn M u A
  have hs := weightMap_support_embedding (e : A →o (incomingRetarget M u '' A)) e.injective w
  constructor
  · intro h a ha b hb hab
    have ha' : e a ∈ (weightMap (e : A →o (incomingRetarget M u '' A)) w).weights.support := by
      rw [hs]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    have hb' : e b ∈ (weightMap (e : A →o (incomingRetarget M u '' A)) w).weights.support := by
      rw [hs]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    simpa only [e, incomingRetargetOn_val, incomingRetarget_source,
      incomingRetarget_difference] using h (e a) ha' (e b) hb' (e.monotone hab)
  · intro h a ha b hb hab
    rw [hs] at ha hb
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
    obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    change SimpleRibbon M a₀.val.source b₀.val.source
      ((incomingRetarget M u a₀.val).difference (incomingRetarget M u b₀.val))
    rw [incomingRetarget_difference]
    exact h a₀ ha₀ b₀ hb₀ (e.le_iff_le.mp hab)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.garsideWeights.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.garsideWeightsSet_shift_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.garsideWeights.source_declaration:
/-- The literal simple support condition is invariant under a common cofinal
shift. This does not assert chamber invariance for arbitrary target loops. -/
theorem garsideWeightsSet_shift_iff (n : ℕ) (w : OrderWeights (IncomingVertex M B0)) :
    weightMap (IncomingVertex.cofinalShift (M := M) (B0 := B0) n : IncomingVertex M B0 →o IncomingVertex M B0) w
      ∈ garsideWeightsSet M B0 ↔ w ∈ garsideWeightsSet M B0 := by
  classical
  let e := IncomingVertex.cofinalShift (M := M) (B0 := B0) n
  have hs := weightMap_support_embedding (e : IncomingVertex M B0 →o IncomingVertex M B0)
    e.injective w
  constructor
  · intro h u hu v hv huv
    have hu' : e u ∈ (weightMap (e : IncomingVertex M B0 →o IncomingVertex M B0) w).weights.support := by
      rw [hs]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hv' : e v ∈ (weightMap (e : IncomingVertex M B0 →o IncomingVertex M B0) w).weights.support := by
      rw [hs]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    simpa only [e, IncomingVertex.cofinalShift_source,
      IncomingVertex.cofinalShift_difference] using h (e u) hu' (e v) hv' (e.monotone huv)
  · intro h u hu v hv huv
    rw [hs] at hu hv
    obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
    obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    change SimpleRibbon M (e u₀).source (e v₀).source ((e u₀).difference (e v₀))
    simpa only [e, IncomingVertex.cofinalShift_source,
      IncomingVertex.cofinalShift_difference] using h u₀ hu₀ v₀ hv₀ (e.le_iff_le.mp huv)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.garside_genLoo.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.garside_genLoop_class_eq_const
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.garside_genLoo.source_declaration:
/-- Every actual based generalized loop is null in its genuine based homotopy
group. The separate basepoint summand also handles an empty cube index type. -/
theorem garside_genLoop_class_eq_const (N : Type*) [Finite N]
    (x : GarsideWeights M B0) (f : GenLoop N (GarsideWeights M B0) x) :
    (⟦f⟧ : HomotopyGroup N (GarsideWeights M B0) x) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ := by
  classical
  let f' : C(Unit ⊕ (I^N), GarsideWeights M B0) :=
    ⟨Sum.elim (fun _ => x) f, continuous_const.sumElim f.val.continuous⟩
  obtain ⟨n, B, _, _, _, hcontract, g, hg⟩ :=
    GarsideWeights.compact_map_contractible_carrier M B0 f'
  let Y := GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))
  let j : C(Y, GarsideWeights M B0) := unshiftedCarrierMap M B0 n B
  have hj : Function.Injective j := unshiftedCarrierMap_injective M B0 n B
  have hpoint (p : Unit ⊕ (I^N)) : j (g p) = f' p :=
    congrArg (fun F : C(Unit ⊕ (I^N), GarsideWeights M B0) => F p) hg
  let y : Y := g (Sum.inl Unit.unit)
  have hy : j y = x := hpoint (Sum.inl Unit.unit)
  let F : GenLoop N Y y :=
    ⟨⟨fun z => g (Sum.inr z), g.continuous.comp continuous_inr⟩, fun z hz => by
      apply hj

    apply GenLoop.ext
    intro z
    rw [GenLoop.map_apply]

  have hm := congrArg (HomotopyGroup.map (N := N) j hy) hzero
  rw [HomotopyGroup.map_mk, HomotopyGroup.map_mk, hmap, GenLoop.map_const] at hm

theorem garside_isAspherical (x : GarsideWeights M B0) :

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.garside_joined.source_declaration:
/-- Any two actual points lie in the image of one contractible finite carrier. -/
theorem garside_joined (x y : GarsideWeights M B0) : Joined x y := by
  let f : C(Bool, GarsideWeights M B0) :=
    ⟨fun b => if b then x else y, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩
  obtain ⟨n, B, _, _, _, hcontract, g, hg⟩ :=
    GarsideWeights.compact_map_contractible_carrier M B0 f
  let Y := GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (B : Set (IncomingVertex M B0))
  let : ContractibleSpace Y := hcontract
  let j : C(Y, GarsideWeights M B0) := unshiftedCarrierMap M B0 n B
  have hx : j (g true) = x := congrArg (fun F : C(Bool, GarsideWeights M B0) => F true) hg
  have hy : j (g false) = y := congrArg (fun F : C(Bool, GarsideWeights M B0) => F false) hg
  rw [← hx, ← hy]
  exact (PathConnectedSpace.joined (g true) (g false)).map j.continuous

/-- Retarget every genuine signed incoming arrow along the inverse of `u`. -/
def incomingRetarget (u : IncomingVertex M B0) :
    IncomingVertex M B0 ≃o IncomingVertex M u.source where
  toFun v := ⟨v.source, v.value * u.value⁻¹, .comp v.reduced (.inverse u.reduced)⟩
  invFun w := ⟨w.source, w.value * u.value, .comp w.reduced u.reduced⟩
  left_inv v := IncomingVertex.ext_value (by change (v.value * u.value⁻¹) * u.value = v.value; group)
  right_inv w := IncomingVertex.ext_value (by change (w.value * u.value) * u.value⁻¹ = w.value; group)
  map_rel_iff' := by
    intro v w
    change PositiveReducedArrow M v.source w.source
      ((v.value * u.value⁻¹) * (w.value * u.value⁻¹)⁻¹) ↔
        PositiveReducedArrow M v.source w.source (v.value * w.value⁻¹)
    have he : (v.value * u.value⁻¹) * (w.value * u.value⁻¹)⁻¹ = v.value * w.value⁻¹ := by group
    rw [he]

  map_rel_iff' := by

/-- Actual packet interval vertices belong to the literal packet carrier,
including its chosen component upstairs, rather than just all projected tubes. -/
theorem incomingVertexPoint_mem_canonicalPacketCarrier
    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
    {v : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
    (hv : v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
    incomingVertexPoint M J v ∈ canonicalPacketCarrier M J F := by
  have hover : (canonicalPacketOverlapSet M J F).Nonempty :=
    ⟨q, (mem_canonicalPacketOverlapSet_iff M J F q).mpr hq⟩
  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq_component_of_mem_cell M J F hF hover
    hF.choose hF.choose_spec q (hq hF.choose hF.choose_spec), canonicalPacketUpperIntersection_eq]
  let u := canonicalPacketJoin M J F hF
  have hu : u ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F :=
    canonicalPacketJoin_mem_admissible M J F hF q hq
  have hUF : (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F).Nonempty :=
    ⟨incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩⟩
  have hqI := common_mem_packetUpperTubeIntersection M J F hF q hq
  apply (mem_liftedTubeIntersectionComponent_iff M J hUF hqI
    (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u) ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ _).mpr
  exact ⟨incomingVertexPoint_mem_upperSheet M J
      (packet_interval_upper_simple M J F hF q hq hv hu).2.2.1,
    packet_interval_vertex_basePiece M J F hF q hq hv⟩

    ⟨0, Γ.source⟩ (by rintro y ⟨t, rfl⟩; exact hΓ t) ⟨1, Γ.target⟩

/-- A simple actual factor places the actual source fiber point in the
actual target sheet. This is a genuine path-gauge conclusion. -/
theorem incomingVertexPoint_mem_upperSheet
    {v u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
    (hs : SimpleRibbon M v.source u.source (v.difference u)) :
    incomingVertexPoint M J v ∈ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u := by
  let A := incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J v
  let B := incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u
  have hs' : SimpleRibbon M (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).source
      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B).source
      ((liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B)) := by
    simpa only [A, B, incomingLiftedTubeIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hs
  have hpB : complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (incomingVertexPoint M J v) ∈
      actualTubeSet M J B.chamber := by
    rw [incomingVertexPoint_projection]
    exact actualChamberBasepoint_mem_tube M J (actualChamberPointFamily M J) v.chamber B.chamber
  apply (mem_liftedTubeSheet_iff_connector M J A B (incomingVertexPoint M J v)
    (incomingVertexPoint_mem_ownSheet M J v) hpB).mpr
  have he : faceIntervalConnector (actualForms M J)
      (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (incomingVertexPoint M J v)).val.1
      A.chamber B.chamber = intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber := by
    rw [incomingVertexPoint_projection, show v.chamber = A.chamber from
      (incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber M J v).symm]
    have hf := congrArg (fun C : ActualChamber M J =>
      inv (intervalPositive C A.chamber) ≫ intervalPositive C B.chamber)
      (faceChamber_tubeBasepoint M J A.chamber)
    exact hf.trans (by simp only [intervalPositive_self, IsIso.inv_id, Category.id_comp])
  rw [he]
  exact liftedTubePathClass_comp_positive M J A B hs'

theorem incoming_chamberBetween {B0 : RibbonObject M} {u v w : IncomingVertex M B0}

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.incoming_signH.source_declaration:
/-- Actual chamber points along a simple incoming chain have one sign change
with strictly separated integer heights, including all repeated vertices. -/
theorem incoming_signHeightSeparated {B0 : RibbonObject M}
    {κ : Type*} [LinearOrder κ] (v : κ → IncomingVertex M B0)
    (hv : Monotone v)
    (hs : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → SimpleRibbon M (v i).source (v j).source
      ((v i).difference (v j)))
    (c : κ → relativeSubspace B0.indices) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ (v i).chamber.region)
    (R : RelativeRoot M B0.indices) :
    SignHeightSeparated (fun i => actualForms M B0.indices R (c i))
      (fun i => ((v i).height : ℝ)) := by
  let s : κ → Bool := fun i => (v i).chamber.signs R
  have hbool : ∀ i j k, i ≤ j → j ≤ k → s i = s k → s j = s i := by
    intro i j k hij hjk he
    exact incoming_chamberBetween M (hv hij) (hv hjk) (hs i k (hij.trans hjk)) R he
  have hheight {i j : κ} (hij : i < j) (hneq : s i ≠ s j) :
      ((v i).height : ℝ) < ((v j).height : ℝ) := by
    have hvne : v i ≠ v j := by
      intro he
      apply hneq
      exact congrArg (fun u : IncomingVertex M B0 => u.chamber.signs R) he
    have hlt : (v i).height < (v j).height :=
      IncomingVertex.height_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne (hv hij.le) hvne)
    exact_mod_cast hlt
  rcases bool_sign_order_separated s hbool with hn | hp
  · left
    intro i j hi hj
    have hsi : s i = false := chamber_sign_false_of_neg M B0.indices _ (hc i) R hi
    have hsj : s j = true := (chamber_sign_true_iff M B0.indices _ (hc j) R).mpr hj
    exact hheight (hn i j hsi hsj) (by rw [hsi, hsj]; decide)
  · right
    intro i j hi hj
    have hsi : s i = true := (chamber_sign_true_iff M B0.indices _ (hc i) R).mpr hi
    have hsj : s j = false := chamber_sign_false_of_neg M B0.indices _ (hc j) R hj
    exact hheight (hp i j hsi hsj) (by rw [hsi, hsj]; decide)

theorem intervalPositive_prefix_cofinalDelta (J : Set I) (C D : ActualChamber M J) :
    RibbonPrefix M (transporterPositiveLift M (relativeTransport M J C D))
      (cofinalDelta M (actualChamberIndices M J C)) := by
  let L := chamberRawLabel M J C
  have hinc : ChamberIncident (actualForms M J) (rawFacePoint M J L Set.univ) D := by
    rw [rawFacePoint_univ M J L]

      (0 : relativeSubspace J) D).mpr (by
      intro h hz
      exact False.elim (hz (map_zero (actualForms M J h))))
  have hpref := (rawFacePoint_incident_iff_ribbonPrefix M J L Set.univ D).mp hinc
  simpa only [L, chamberRawLabel_chamber, chamberRawLabel_indices, facePrefix,
    Set.union_univ, cofinalDelta] using hpref

/-- Conversely every incoming vertex of the actual simple interval labels
the original sheet through this lift. -/
theorem interval_implies_sheet_mem (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))
    (hau : sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ u) (hub : u ≤ sheetUpperVertex M J q) :
    q ∈ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u := by
  let A := pointTubeIndex M J q (sheetLowerChamber M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q))
    (mem_sheetLowerChamber M J _)
  let U := incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u
  have hgeom := incoming_chamberBetween M hau hub (sheetInterval_simple M J q)
  rw [sheetLowerVertex_chamber, sheetUpperVertex_chamber] at hgeom
  have hpU : complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q ∈ actualTubeSet M J U.chamber := by
    rw [incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber]
    exact (mem_actualTubeSet_iff_sheetBetween M J _ u.chamber).mpr hgeom
  have hs := IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval (sheetInterval_simple M J q) le_rfl hau hub
  have hs' : SimpleRibbon M (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).source
      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J U).source
      ((liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J U)) := by
    simpa only [sheetLowerVertex, A, U, incomingLiftedTubeIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hs
  have hpath := liftedTubePathClass_comp_positive M J A U hs'
  apply (mem_liftedTubeSheet_iff_connector M J A U q (mem_pointTubeIndex M J q _ _) hpU).mpr
  rw [faceConnector_eq_positive_of_between M J _ A.chamber U.chamber
    (mem_sheetLowerChamber M J _) (chamberBetween_left _ _)]
  exact hpath

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.isClosed_image.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.isClosed_image_of_finite_face_preimages
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.isClosed_image.source_declaration:
/-- Closedness can be tested on all admissible finite faces. The proof is
a genuine finite closed-face gluing argument inside every original chart. -/
theorem isClosed_image_of_finite_face_preimages (S : Finset P → Prop)
    (hS : SupportHereditary S) (T : Set (SubcomplexWeights S))
    (hT : ∀ (F : Finset P), IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P) → F.Nonempty →
      ∀ hF : S F, IsClosed ((subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hF) ⁻¹' T)) :
    IsClosed ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) '' T) := by
  classical
  rw [orderWeights_isClosed_iff]
  intro n simplex
  let x := nerveChain simplex
  let L := Finset.univ.image x
  let Families := L.powerset.filter (fun F => F.Nonempty ∧ S F)
  let Piece (F : Finset P) : Set (StdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n.len + 1))) :=
    if hF : S F then
      Subtype.val '' ((chainCarrierRestriction x F) ⁻¹'
        ((subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hF) ⁻¹' T))
    else ∅
  have hpiece (F : Finset P) (hFF : F ∈ Families) : IsClosed (Piece F) := by
    obtain ⟨hFL, hne, hSF⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hFF
    have hsub : F ⊆ L := Finset.mem_powerset.mp hFL
    have hchain : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (↑F : Set P) :=
      fun a ha b hb hne => chain_range_isChain x (hsub ha) (hsub hb) hne
    dsimp only [Piece]
    rw [dite_eq_left hSF]
    exact (isClosed_chainCarrierFace x F).isClosedMap_subtype_val _
      ((hT F hchain hne hSF).preimage (chainCarrierRestriction x F).continuous)
  have he : (fun z => orderWeightsOfChain x z) ⁻¹'
        ((Subtype.val : SubcomplexWeights S → OrderWeights P) '' T) =
      ⋃ F ∈ Families, Piece F := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hwT, hwz⟩
      change w.val = orderWeightsOfChain x z at hwz
      let F := (orderWeightsOfChain x z).weights.support
      have hSF : S F := by
        change S (orderWeightsOfChain x z).weights.support
        rw [← hwz]
        exact w.property
      have hFF : F ∈ Families := Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (chainWeights_support x z),
          (orderWeightsOfChain x z).support_nonempty, hSF⟩
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨F, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hFF, ?_⟩⟩
      dsimp only [Piece]
      rw [dite_eq_left hSF]
      let zF : chainCarrierFace x F := ⟨z, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩
      refine ⟨zF, ?_, rfl⟩
      have hpoint : subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hSF (chainCarrierRestriction x F zF) = w := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact (chainCarrierRestriction_map x F zF).trans hwz.symm
      change subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hSF (chainCarrierRestriction x F zF) ∈ T
      rwa [hpoint]
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨F, hFz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨hFF, hzF⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hFz
      have hSF : S F := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hFF).2.2
      dsimp only [Piece] at hzF
      rw [dite_eq_left hSF] at hzF
      obtain ⟨zF, hzFT, hzFz⟩ := hzF
      refine ⟨subcomplexFiniteInclusion S hS F hSF (chainCarrierRestriction x F zF), hzFT, ?_⟩
      exact (chainCarrierRestriction_map x F zF).trans
        (congrArg (orderWeightsOfChain x) hzFz)
  change IsClosed ((fun z => orderWeightsOfChain x z) ⁻¹' _)
  rw [he]
  exact isClosed_biUnion_finset hpiece

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.isClosed_subco.source_declaration:
/-- A bad finite support stays bad when all of its positive coordinates
remain positive. This proves actual closedness of the subcomplex. -/
theorem isClosed_subcomplexWeights (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S) :
    IsClosed ({w | S w.weights.support} : Set (OrderWeights P)) := by
  apply isOpen_compl_iff.mp
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  intro w hw
  let U : Set (OrderWeights P) := ⋂ p ∈ w.weights.support, {v | 0 < v.weights p}
  have hopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_biInter_finset fun p _ =>
    isOpen_lt continuous_const (weightEval_continuous p)
  have hwU : w ∈ U := by
    apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
    intro p
    apply Set.mem_iInter.mpr
    intro hp
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (w.nonneg p) (Ne.symm (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hp))
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset (hopen.mem_nhds hwU)
  intro v hv
  change ¬S v.weights.support
  intro hSv
  apply hw
  apply hS ?_ hSv
  intro p hp
  have hpos := Set.mem_iInter.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp hv p) hp
  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (ne_of_gt hpos)

/-- The genuine section restricted to the actual canonical cell is its sheet chart. -/
def liftedCanonicalHomeomorph (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J) :
    actualCanonicalTypeSet M J A.base ≃ₜ liftedCanonicalSet M J A where
  toFun x := ⟨restrictedTubeSection M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex _
      (actualCanonicalTypeSet_subset_actualTubeSet M J A.base) x,
    ⟨(liftedTubeHomeomorph M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex _).property,
      by
        change complementUniversalCoverProjection M J
          (restrictedTubeSection M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex _
            (actualCanonicalTypeSet_subset_actualTubeSet M J A.base) x) ∈
            actualCanonicalTypeSet M J A.base
        rw [restrictedTubeSection_projection M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex _
          (actualCanonicalTypeSet_subset_actualTubeSet M J A.base) x]
        exact x.property⟩⟩
  invFun z := ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J z.val, z.property.2⟩
  left_inv x := Subtype.ext (restrictedTubeSection_projection M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex _
    (actualCanonicalTypeSet_subset_actualTubeSet M J A.base) x)
  right_inv z := Subtype.ext (liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex _ z.property.1)
  continuous_toFun := (restrictedTubeSection M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex _
    (actualCanonicalTypeSet_subset_actualTubeSet M J A.base)).continuous.subtype_mk _
  continuous_invFun :=
    ((continuous_complementUniversalCoverProjection M J).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _

/-- Any phase upper bound of an incident canonical-cell label carries the
whole original lifted cell. This uses connected lift uniqueness, not merely
membership of its center. -/
theorem liftedCanonicalSet_subset_incomingSheet (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
    (v : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))
    (hAv : canonicalIncomingLabel M J A ≤ v) (hv : v ≤ sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q) :
    liftedCanonicalSet M J A ⊆ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J v := by
  have hA := canonicalIncomingLabel_phase_bounds M J A q hq
  have hav := incoming_chamberBetween M hA.1 hAv
    (IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval (sheetPhaseInterval_simple M J q)
      le_rfl (hA.1.trans hAv) hv)
  have hvb := incoming_chamberBetween M (hA.1.trans hAv) hv (sheetPhaseInterval_simple M J q)
  simp only [sheetLowerVertex_chamber, sheetPhaseUpperVertex_chamber,
    canonicalIncomingLabel_chamber] at hav hvb
  apply liftedCanonicalSet_subset_liftedTubeSheet M J A (incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J v)
  · rw [incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber]
    intro x hx
    exact canonicalCell_subset_tubeSet (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)
      (c := canonicalCenter (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J) A.base)
      (p := actualComplementHomeomorph M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q)) hq.2 v.chamber
      (by simpa only [sheetLowerChamber, actualCanonicalTypeChamber, canonicalTypeChamber] using hav)
      (by simpa only [sheetLowerChamber, sheetPhaseUpperChamber] using hvb) hx
  · exact ⟨q, hq, ((mem_sheet_phase_interval_iff M J q v).mp ⟨hA.1.trans hAv, hv⟩).1⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.liftedCanonica.source_declaration:
/-- A common point forces the whole connected lifted cell into a containing tube sheet. -/
theorem liftedCanonicalSet_subset_liftedTubeSheet (A : LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)
    (B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
    (hbase : actualCanonicalTypeSet M J A.base ⊆ actualTubeSet M J B.chamber)
    (hne : (liftedCanonicalSet M J A ∩ liftedTubeSheet M J B).Nonempty) :
    liftedCanonicalSet M J A ⊆ liftedTubeSheet M J B := by
  let := contractibleSpace_actualCanonicalTypeSet M J A.base
  obtain ⟨z, hzA, hzB⟩ := hne
  let x : actualCanonicalTypeSet M J A.base := ⟨_, hzA.2⟩
  have he := restrictedTubeSection_eq_of_eq M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex B
    (actualCanonicalTypeSet M J A.base)
    (actualCanonicalTypeSet_subset_actualTubeSet M J A.base) hbase x
    ((liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex z hzA.1).trans
      (liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J B z hzB).symm)
  intro w hw
  have hew := congrArg (fun f => f (⟨_, hw.2⟩ : actualCanonicalTypeSet M J A.base)) he
  have hwA := liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex w hw.1
  have hwB : restrictedTubeSection M J B (actualCanonicalTypeSet M J A.base) hbase
      ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J w, hw.2⟩ ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J B :=
    (liftedTubeHomeomorph M J B _).property
  rw [← hew] at hwB
  change (liftedTubeSection M J A.toLiftedTubeIndex
    ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J w, _⟩) ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J B at hwB
  rwa [hwA] at hwB

  rw [canonicalPacketCarrier_eq M J F hF, canonicalPacketCenter, ← he]

    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J F) :
    liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q ≃ₜ connectedComponentIn (liftedTubeIntersection M J F) q where
  toFun x := ⟨restrictedTubeSection M J hF.choose (liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q)
      (liftedTubeBasePiece_subset_tube M J F q hF.choose hF.choose_spec) x,
    restrictedTubeSection_basePiece_mem_component M J hF hq hF.choose hF.choose_spec x⟩
  invFun z := ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J z.val,
    component_projection_mem_basePiece M J hF hq z.property⟩
  left_inv x := Subtype.ext (restrictedTubeSection_projection M J hF.choose (liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q)
    (liftedTubeBasePiece_subset_tube M J F q hF.choose hF.choose_spec) x)
  right_inv z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J hF.choose z.val
    exact (mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J F z.val).mp
      (connectedComponentIn_subset (liftedTubeIntersection M J F) q z.property)
      hF.choose hF.choose_spec
  continuous_toFun := (restrictedTubeSection M J hF.choose (liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q)
    (liftedTubeBasePiece_subset_tube M J F q hF.choose hF.choose_spec)).continuous.subtype_mk _
  continuous_invFun :=
    ((continuous_complementUniversalCoverProjection M J).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.liftedTubePath.source_declaration:
/-- The exact pair gauge, for every signed interval arrow. Outgoing paths
have inverse incoming labels, giving `p_A = label(δ) * p_B` in traversal order. -/
theorem liftedTubePathClass_comp_iff (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
    (δ : intervalObject A.chamber ⟶ intervalObject B.chamber) :
    (show FundamentalGroupoid.mk (standardComplementPoint M J) ⟶
        FundamentalGroupoid.mk (tubeBasepoint M J B.chamber) from
      liftedTubePathClass M J A ≫ (actualIntervalForward M J).map δ) =
        liftedTubePathClass M J B ↔
      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).value =
        ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).val.val *
          (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B).value := by
  rw [liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_value, liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_value]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hδ : liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A ≫ δ = liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B := by
      apply (actualIntervalComplementEquivalence M J).fullyFaithfulFunctor.map_injective
      rw [actualIntervalComplementEquivalence_functor, Functor.map_comp,
        map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow, map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow]
      exact h
    have hv := congrArg (fun k : intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶
      intervalObject B.chamber => ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map k).val.val) hδ
    rw [Functor.map_comp] at hv
    change ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A)).val.val *
      ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).val.val =
        ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B)).val.val at hv
    rw [← hv]
    group
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg Inv.inv h
    simp only [inv_inv, mul_inv_rev] at hv
    have hδ : liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A ≫ δ = liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B := by
      apply (intervalRibbonFunctor_isCovering M J).faithful.map_injective
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [Functor.map_comp]
      change ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A)).val.val *
        ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).val.val =
          ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B)).val.val
      rw [hv]
      group
    rw [← map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J A, ← map_liftedTubeIntervalArrow M J B,
      ← Functor.map_comp, hδ]

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.liftedTubePath.source_declaration:
/-- An actual simple positive incoming factor is precisely the canonical
positive chamber connector in the literal universal-cover path gauge. -/
theorem liftedTubePathClass_comp_positive (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
    (hs : SimpleRibbon M (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).source
      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B).source
      ((liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B))) :
    (show FundamentalGroupoid.mk (standardComplementPoint M J) ⟶
        FundamentalGroupoid.mk (tubeBasepoint M J B.chamber) from
      liftedTubePathClass M J A ≫
        (actualIntervalForward M J).map (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)) =
      liftedTubePathClass M J B := by
  have hr := incoming_relativeTransport M hs
  rw [liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_chamber, liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_chamber] at hr
  have hv : ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)).val.val =
      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B) := by
    rw [intervalRibbonFunctor_positive, intervalRibbonPositive_value, hr]
    exact (SimpleRibbon.eq_simpleLift M hs).symm
  apply (liftedTubePathClass_comp_iff M J A B (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)).mpr
  rw [hv]
  dsimp only [IncomingVertex.difference]
  group

/-- The actual universal-cover index as its chamber and original path class. -/
def liftedTubePathEquiv : LiftedTubeIndex M J ≃
    Σ C : ActualChamber M J,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient (standardComplementPoint M J) (tubeBasepoint M J C) where
  toFun A := ⟨A.chamber, liftedTubePathClass M J A⟩
  invFun p := ⟨p.1, (universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses
    (standardComplementPoint M J) (tubeBasepoint M J p.1)).symm p.2⟩
  left_inv := by
    rintro ⟨C, e⟩
    change (⟨C, (universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses _ _).symm
      ((universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses _ _) e)⟩ : LiftedTubeIndex M J) = ⟨C, e⟩
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  right_inv := by
    rintro ⟨C, q⟩
    apply Sigma.ext rfl
    exact heq_of_eq ((universalCoverFiberEquivPathClasses _ _).apply_symm_apply q)

/-- Membership in an original sheet gives its actual stored path equation. -/
theorem liftedTubeSheet_pathClass (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (hp : complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q ∈ actualTubeSet M J A.chamber)
    (hq : q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A) :
    q.path = (liftedTubePathClass M J A).trans
      (actualClassInTube M J A.chamber (tubeBasepoint_mem M J A.chamber) hp) := by
  rcases A with ⟨C, ⟨⟨x, r⟩, hx⟩⟩
  change x = tubeBasepoint M J C at hx
  subst x
  let A : LiftedTubeIndex M J := ⟨C, ⟨⟨tubeBasepoint M J C, r⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  let S := liftedTubeSheet M J A
  let ξ : Path (⟨A.fiberPoint.val, fiberPoint_mem_liftedTubeSheet M J A⟩ : S) ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    PathConnectedSpace.somePath _ _
  let Γ := ξ.map continuous_subtype_val
  let γ := Γ.map (TauCeti.UniversalCover.continuous_proj (standardComplementPoint M J))
  have hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ actualTubeSet M J C := fun t =>
    liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J A (ξ t).property
  have hend := universalCover_path_endpoint Γ
  change q.path = r.trans (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ) at hend
  change q.path = r.trans (actualClassInTube M J C (tubeBasepoint_mem M J C) hp)
  rw [actualClassInTube_eq_path M J C _ _ γ hγ]
  exact hend

theorem lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ)
    (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (hp : ∀ i, p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i))
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    AffineMap.lineMap p.val (centerCombination ℓ c w) t ∈ complexComplementSet ℓ :=
  lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem_of_active ℓ c p w hw hwone (fun i _ => hp i) ht

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.lineMap_common.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem_of_active
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.lineMap_common.source_declaration:
/-- Straight affine return from the common point to any such barycenter
stays in the actual complexified complement. -/
theorem lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem_of_active (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ)
    (p : ComplexComplement ℓ)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hp : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    AffineMap.lineMap p.val (centerCombination ℓ c w) t ∈ complexComplementSet ℓ := by
  let v : Option ι → ℝ := fun o => o.elim (1 - t) (fun i => t * w i)
  have hv : ∀ o, 0 ≤ v o := by
    intro o
    cases o with
    | none => exact sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2
    | some i => exact mul_nonneg ht.1 (hw i)
  have hvone : ∑ o, v o = 1 := by
    simp only [v, Fintype.sum_option, Option.elim_none, Option.elim_some, ← Finset.mul_sum, hwone, mul_one]
    ring
  have hmem : ∀ o : Option ι, v o ≠ 0 →
      p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (o.elim p c) := by
    intro o ho
    cases o with
    | none => exact canonicalCell_self ℓ p
    | some i =>
      apply hp i
      intro hi
      apply ho
      change t * w i = 0
      rw [hi, mul_zero]
  have h := centerCombination_mem_complement_of_active ℓ (fun o : Option ι => o.elim p c)
    p v hv hvone hmem
  convert h using 1
  ext <;> simp only [centerCombination, v, Fintype.sum_option, Option.elim_none, Option.elim_some,
    AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
    mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum]

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.lineMap_common.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem_tubeSet_of_active
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.lineMap_common.source_declaration:
/-- The entire affine return is carried by a common tube, including at
zero barycentric coordinates and either endpoint of the segment. -/
theorem lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem_tubeSet_of_active
    (c : ι → ComplexComplement ℓ) (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hp : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (c i)) (D : Chamber ℓ)
    (hpD : p ∈ tubeSet D) (hD : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → c i ∈ tubeSet D)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (⟨AffineMap.lineMap p.val (centerCombination ℓ c w) t,
      lineMap_commonPoint_centerCombination_mem_of_active ℓ c p w hw hwone hp ht⟩ :
      ComplexComplement ℓ) ∈ tubeSet D := by
  let v : Option ι → ℝ := fun o => o.elim (1 - t) (fun i => t * w i)
  have hv : ∀ o, 0 ≤ v o := by
    intro o
    cases o with
    | none => exact sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2
    | some i => exact mul_nonneg ht.1 (hw i)
  have hvone : ∑ o, v o = 1 := by
    simp only [v, Fintype.sum_option, Option.elim_none, Option.elim_some,
      ← Finset.mul_sum, hwone, mul_one]
    ring
  have hi (i : ι) (hi : v (some i) ≠ 0) : w i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hi
    change t * w i = 0
    rw [hz, mul_zero]
  have hcell : ∀ o : Option ι, v o ≠ 0 → p ∈ canonicalCell ℓ (o.elim p c) := by
    intro o ho
    cases o with
    | none => exact canonicalCell_self ℓ p

      Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  have hout := centerCombination_mem_tubeSet_of_active ℓ
    (fun o : Option ι => o.elim p c) p v hv hvone hcell D htube

    Subtype.ext heq

  exact hout

/-- A single selected sheet and the base sign piece characterize the exact
upstairs component, independently of the section choice. -/
theorem mem_liftedTubeIntersectionComponent_iff
    {F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)} (hF : F.Nonempty)
    {q : ComplementUniversalCover M J} (hq : q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J F)
    (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F) (z : ComplementUniversalCover M J) :
    z ∈ connectedComponentIn (liftedTubeIntersection M J F) q ↔
      z ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A ∧
        complementUniversalCoverProjection M J z ∈ liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨(mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J F z).mp
      (connectedComponentIn_subset (liftedTubeIntersection M J F) q hz) A hA,
      component_projection_mem_basePiece M J hF hq hz⟩
  · rintro ⟨hz, hp⟩
    have hmem := restrictedTubeSection_basePiece_mem_component M J hF hq A hA
      ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J z, hp⟩
    change liftedTubeSection M J A ⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J z, _⟩ ∈ _ at hmem
    rwa [liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J A z hz] at hmem

/-- The exact local gauge for two original sheets over a common point. -/
theorem mem_liftedTubeSheet_iff_connector (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hA : q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A)
    (hpB : complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q ∈ actualTubeSet M J B.chamber) :
    q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J B ↔
      (show FundamentalGroupoid.mk (standardComplementPoint M J) ⟶
          FundamentalGroupoid.mk (tubeBasepoint M J B.chamber) from
        liftedTubePathClass M J A ≫ (actualIntervalForward M J).map
          (X := intervalObject A.chamber) (Y := intervalObject B.chamber)
          (faceIntervalConnector (actualForms M J)
            (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q).val.1 A.chamber B.chamber)) =
        liftedTubePathClass M J B := by
  have hpA := liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J A hA
  have hpathA := liftedTubeSheet_pathClass M J A q hpA hA
  rw [mem_liftedTubeSheet_iff_pathClass M J B q hpB,
    actualForward_faceIntervalConnector M J _ A.chamber B.chamber hpA hpB,
    ← actualClassInTube_inv M J B.chamber (tubeBasepoint_mem M J B.chamber) hpB]
  constructor
  · intro hpathB
    apply (cancel_mono (actualClassInTube M J B.chamber (tubeBasepoint_mem M J B.chamber) hpB)).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    exact hpathA.symm.trans hpathB
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun f : FundamentalGroupoid.mk (standardComplementPoint M J) ⟶
      FundamentalGroupoid.mk (tubeBasepoint M J B.chamber) =>
      f ≫ actualClassInTube M J B.chamber (tubeBasepoint_mem M J B.chamber) hpB) h
    simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id] at he
    exact hpathA.trans he

/-- The actual sheet condition is exactly its original path-class gauge. -/
theorem mem_liftedTubeSheet_iff_pathClass (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (hp : complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q ∈ actualTubeSet M J A.chamber) :
    q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A ↔ q.path = (liftedTubePathClass M J A).trans
      (actualClassInTube M J A.chamber (tubeBasepoint_mem M J A.chamber) hp) := by
  constructor
  · exact liftedTubeSheet_pathClass M J A q hp
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨⟨z, r⟩, hz, he⟩ := TauCeti.UniversalCover.proj_surjOn_sheet
      (isSimplyConnected_actualTube M J A.chamber).isPathConnected
      (tubeBasepoint_mem M J A.chamber) (liftedTubePathClass M J A) hp
    change z = complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q at he
    subst z
    have hpath := liftedTubeSheet_pathClass M J A
      (⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q, r⟩ : ComplementUniversalCover M J) hp hz
    have heq : (⟨complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q, r⟩ : ComplementUniversalCover M J) = q := by
      exact TauCeti.UniversalCover.ext_iff.mpr ⟨rfl, heq_of_eq (hpath.trans h.symm)⟩
    exact heq ▸ hz

theorem mem_sheetPhaseUpperChamber (p : Complement M J) :
    p ∈ actualTubeSet M J (sheetPhaseUpperChamber M J p) := by
  intro h hr
  have hi : actualForms M J h p.val.2 ≠ 0 := by
    exact fun hz => (actualComplementHomeomorph M J p).property h ⟨hr, hz⟩
  change p.val.2 ∈ signHalfSpace (actualForms M J h)
    ((faceChamber (actualForms M J) p.val.2 (sheetLowerChamber M J p)).signs h)
  rw [faceChamber_signs_nonzero (actualForms M J) p.val.2 _ hi]
  change (if decide (0 < actualForms M J h p.val.2) then
    0 < actualForms M J h p.val.2 else actualForms M J h p.val.2 < 0)
  split_ifs with hs
  · exact of_decide_eq_true hs
  · apply lt_of_le_of_ne _ hi
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hp
    exact hs (decide_eq_true hp)

/-- Within the phase interval, original sheet membership is equivalently
its actual chamber's phase betweenness. -/
theorem mem_sheet_phase_interval_iff (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :
    sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ u ∧ u ≤ sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q ↔
      q ∈ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u ∧
      ChamberBetween (sheetLowerChamber M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q))
        u.chamber (sheetPhaseUpperChamber M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hau, hub⟩
    have hB : q ∈ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J (sheetPhaseUpperVertex M J q) := by
      simpa only [sheetPhaseUpperVertex, incomingLiftedTubeSheet, incomingLiftedTubeIndex,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using (mem_pointTubeIndex M J q
          (sheetPhaseUpperChamber M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q))
          (mem_sheetPhaseUpperChamber M J _))
    have hfull := (sheet_mem_implies_interval M J q _ hB).2
    refine ⟨interval_implies_sheet_mem M J q u hau (hub.trans hfull), ?_⟩
    simpa only [sheetLowerVertex_chamber, sheetPhaseUpperVertex_chamber] using
      (incoming_chamberBetween M hau hub (sheetPhaseInterval_simple M J q))
  · rintro ⟨hu, hbet⟩
    let U := incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u
    let B := pointTubeIndex M J q
      (sheetPhaseUpperChamber M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q))
      (mem_sheetPhaseUpperChamber M J _)
    have hUB := sheet_simple_difference_of_between M J U B q hu
      (mem_pointTubeIndex M J q _ _) (by simpa only [U, B, pointTubeIndex_chamber, incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber] using hbet)
    refine ⟨(sheet_mem_implies_interval M J q u hu).1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [IncomingVertex.le_iff, IncomingVertex.difference, sheetPhaseUpperVertex,
      U, B, incomingLiftedTubeIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hUB.1

/-- Literal normalized M4 diagram, including both actual exact rows and both
commuting squares with identity on the same actual Coxeter quotient. -/
def normalizedNormalizerDiagram (x : Complement M J) : Prop :=
    Nonempty (Artin.pureNormalizerImage M J ≃* FundamentalGroup (Complement M J) x) ∧
    Nonempty (Artin.normalizerQuotient M J ≃*
      FundamentalGroup (OrbitSpace M J) (orbitProjection M J x)) ∧
    (Function.Injective (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J) ∧
      (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J).range = (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J)) ∧
    (Function.Injective (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x) ∧
      (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range = (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x)) ∧
    ((Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).comp
        (pureFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom =
      (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom.comp
        (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J)) ∧
    ((normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x).comp
        (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.numerableCarri.source_declaration:
/-- Monotone contractible carriers construct the actual numerable comparison
homotopy. The local face homotopies are produced by parameterized HEP and are
not input data. The original common-intersection spaces need not be contractible. -/
noncomputable def numerableCarrierHomotopy (W : ι → Set X)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W)
    (C : Finset ι → Set X)
    (hC : ∀ F, F.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W F → ContractibleSpace (C F))
    (hmono : ∀ {A B}, A ⊆ B → A.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W B → C A ⊆ C B)
    (hinter : ∀ F, F.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W F → coverFaceParameter W F ⊆ C F)
    (r : C(CoverWeights W, X))
    (hr : ∀ F, F.Nonempty → IsNerveFace W F → ∀ w : CoverWeights W,
      w.val.weights.support ⊆ F → r w ∈ C F) :
    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (r.comp (numerableCoverClassifier W ρ hρ)) (ContinuousMap.id X) := by
  let D : FiniteCarrierData ι X :=
    { admissible := IsNerveFace W
      hereditary := fun h hF ↦ hF.mono h
      carrier := C
      contractible := hC
      monotone := hmono }
  let R := coverFaceParameter W
  let hR : Antitone R := coverFaceParameter_antitone W
  let f₀ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR :=
    { map := fun F hne hF ↦
        ⟨fun p ↦ r (numerableFaceChart W F hF p.2),
          r.continuous.comp ((continuous_numerableFaceChart W F hne hF).comp continuous_snd)⟩
      carried := fun F hne hF _x z ↦
        hr F hne hF _ (numerableFaceChart_support_subset W F hF z)
      compatible := fun _ _ ha hb hAB _ z ↦
        congrArg r (numerableFaceChart_map W hAB ha hb z) }
  let f₁ : ParameterizedCarrierFamily D R hR :=
    { map := fun _ _ _ ↦ ⟨fun p ↦ p.1.val, continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst⟩
      carried := fun F hne hF x _ ↦ hinter F hne hF x.property
      compatible := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ↦ rfl }
  let H := f₀.homotopy f₁
  refine numerableFaceTracksHomotopy W hW ρ hρ r
    (fun F hne hF ↦ (H.hom F hne hF).toContinuousMap) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro A B hA hB ha hb hAB t x z
    exact H.compatible hA hB ha hb hAB t x z
  · intro F hne hF x z
    exact (H.hom F hne hF).apply_zero (x, z)
  · intro F hne hF x z
    exact (H.hom F hne hF).apply_one (x, z)

    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) : C(X, CoverWeights W) where

    (hF : IsNerveFace W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F) : CoverWeights W :=
  ⟨weightMap (weightInclusion (F : Set ι)) (numerableSimplexWeights F z), by
    apply hF.mono
    rw [weightMap_support_embedding _ Subtype.val_injective]
    intro i hi

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.numerableFaceC.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.numerableFaceChart_finiteChart
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.numerableFaceC.source_declaration:
/-- The chart retains every original partition coefficient, also when its
finite support window is larger than the positive support. -/
theorem numerableFaceChart_finiteChart (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (F : Finset ι) (hF : IsNerveFace W F)
    (x : chartDomain ρ F) :
    numerableFaceChart W F hF (finiteChart ρ F x) = numerableCoverClassifier W ρ hρ x.val := by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply OrderWeights.ext
  ext i
  change (numerableFaceChart W F hF (finiteChart ρ F x)).val.weights i =
    (partitionWeightsValue ρ x.val).weights i
  rw [partitionWeightsValue_apply]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ F
  · exact numerableFaceChart_apply_mem W F hF _ ⟨i, hi⟩
  · rw [numerableFaceChart_apply_not_mem W F hF _ hi]
    symm
    by_contra hn
    exact hi (x.property ((ρ.mem_finsupport x.val).mpr hn))

theorem numerableFaceChart_map (W : ι → Set X) {A B : Finset ι}
    (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hA : IsNerveFace W A) (hB : IsNerveFace W B)
    (z : StdSimplex ℝ A) :
    numerableFaceChart W B hB (z.map (numerableFaceInclusion hAB)) =
      numerableFaceChart W A hA z := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply OrderWeights.ext
  change (z.map (numerableFaceInclusion hAB)).weights.mapDomain (Subtype.val : B → ι) =
    z.weights.mapDomain (Subtype.val : A → ι)
  rw [StdSimplex.weights_map, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.numerableFaceT.source_declaration:
/-- Gluing already constructed coherent local tracks gives the genuine
global homotopy. The carrier theorem below constructs those tracks. -/
noncomputable def numerableFaceTracksHomotopy (W : ι → Set X)
    (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X) (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W)
    (r : C(CoverWeights W, X)) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W)
    (hH : NumerableFaceTracks.Compatible W H)
    (h₀ : ∀ F hne hF (x : coverFaceParameter W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F),
      H F hne hF (0, (x, z)) = r (numerableFaceChart W F hF z))
    (h₁ : ∀ F hne hF (x : coverFaceParameter W F) (z : StdSimplex ℝ F),
      H F hne hF (1, (x, z)) = x.val) :
    ContinuousMap.Homotopy (r.comp (numerableCoverClassifier W ρ hρ)) (ContinuousMap.id X) where
  toFun := partitionTrackValue W ρ hρ H
  continuous_toFun := continuous_partitionTrackValue W hW ρ hρ H hH
  map_zero_left x := by
    dsimp only [partitionTrackValue]
    rw [h₀]
    exact congrArg r (numerableFaceChart_finiteChart W ρ hρ (ρ.finsupport x)
      (partition_support_isNerveFace W ρ hρ x) ⟨x, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩)
  map_one_left x := by
    dsimp only [partitionTrackValue]
    exact h₁ _ _ _ _ _

/-- Packet admissible upper labels are simple upper labels of every
finite collection of vertices in the packet interval. -/
theorem packetUpper_subset_simpleUpper
    (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J)) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
    (s : Finset (IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)))
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ s, v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
    canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F ⊆ simpleUpperSet M J s := by
  intro u hu v hv
  have h := packet_interval_upper_simple M J F hF q hq (hs v hv) hu
  exact ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩
