ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interva.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interval_signs
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interva.source_declaration:
/-- Every interval vertex has the common point's real signs at every
actual disagreement among the full admissible upper family. -/
theorem packet_interval_signs (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
    {v : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
    (hv : v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) (R : RelativeRoot M J)
    (hd : tubeDisagreement (liftedTubeChambers M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F)) R) :
    v.chamber.signs R = liftedTubeRealSigns M J q R := by
  have hqI := common_mem_packetUpperTubeIntersection M J F hF q hq
  have hreal := tubeIntersection_real_ne_zero (projectionPoint_mem_tubeIntersection M J hqI) hd
  have hsign := sheetLowerVertex_signs_real M J q hreal
  obtain ⟨C, hC, D, hD, hCD⟩ := hd
  obtain ⟨A, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, hAC⟩ := hC
  obtain ⟨B, ⟨u', hu', rfl⟩, hBD⟩ := hD
  have hCu : u.chamber = C := (incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber M J u).symm.trans hAC
  have hDu : u'.chamber = D := (incomingLiftedTubeIndex_chamber M J u').symm.trans hBD
  subst C
  subst D
  have hbet := (packet_interval_upper_simple M J F hF q hq hv hu).2.2.2
  have hbet' := (packet_interval_upper_simple M J F hF q hq hv hu').2.2.2
  have he : v.chamber.signs R = (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R := by
    by_cases hs : (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R = u.chamber.signs R
    · exact hbet R hs
    · have hs' : (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R = u'.chamber.signs R := by
        cases ha : (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber.signs R <;>
          cases hb : u.chamber.signs R <;> cases hc : u'.chamber.signs R <;> simp_all
      exact hbet' R hs'
  exact he.trans hsign

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interva.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interval_upper_simple
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interva.source_declaration:
/-- Every interval vertex precedes every actual admissible upper label,
inside the one actual simple sheet interval through a common lift. -/
theorem packet_interval_upper_simple (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
    {v u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
    (hv : v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF)
    (hu : u ∈ canonicalPacketAdmissibleUpper M J F) :
    sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ v ∧ v ≤ u ∧
      SimpleRibbon M v.source u.source (v.difference u) ∧
      ChamberBetween (sheetLowerVertex M J q).chamber v.chamber u.chamber := by
  have hlabels : ∀ l ∈ canonicalPacketLabels M J F,
      sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ l := by
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hl
    exact (canonicalIncomingLabel_phase_bounds M J A q (hq A hAF)).1
  have hlower : sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ v :=
    (IncomingVertex.le_finiteMeet (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
      (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF) hlabels).trans hv.1
  have hupper : v ≤ u := hv.2.trans
    (IncomingVertex.finiteJoin_le (canonicalPacketLabels M J F)
      (canonicalPacketLabels_nonempty M J F hF) (by
        intro l hl
        obtain ⟨A, hAF, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hl
        exact (hu A hAF).1))
  have hqu : q ∈ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u :=
    (hu hF.choose hF.choose_spec).2.2 (hq hF.choose hF.choose_spec)
  have hub := (sheet_mem_implies_interval M J q u hqu).2
  have hsu := IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval (sheetInterval_simple M J q)
    le_rfl (hlower.trans hupper) hub
  exact ⟨hlower, hupper,
    IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval (sheetInterval_simple M J q) hlower hupper hub,
    incoming_chamberBetween M hlower hupper hsu⟩

source_range.basis: zero-based line and codepoint column; .ilean exact declaration range

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interva.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interval_vertex_basePiece
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.packet_interva.source_declaration:
/-- The projected actual vertex lies in the exact real sign component
selected by the common overlap point. -/
theorem packet_interval_vertex_basePiece (F : Finset (LiftedCanonicalIndex M J))
    (hF : F.Nonempty) (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (hq : ∀ A ∈ F, q ∈ liftedCanonicalSet M J A)
    {v : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)}
    (hv : v ∈ canonicalPacketVertexInterval M J F hF) :
    complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (incomingVertexPoint M J v) ∈
      liftedTubeBasePiece M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F) q := by
  change actualComplementHomeomorph M J
      (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J (incomingVertexPoint M J v)) ∈
    tubeIntersectionPiece (liftedTubeChambers M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F))
      (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q)
  rw [incomingVertexPoint_projection]
  change chamberBasepoint (actualChamberPointFamily M J) v.chamber ∈
    tubeIntersectionPiece (liftedTubeChambers M J (canonicalPacketUpperTubeFamily M J F))
      (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q)
  constructor
  · intro C _hC
    exact chamberBasepoint_mem_tubeSet (actualChamberPointFamily M J) v.chamber C
  · intro R hd
    have hs := packet_interval_signs M J F hF q hq hv R hd
    change (actualChamberPointFamily M J v.chamber).val ∈
      signHalfSpace (actualForms M J R) (liftedTubeRealSigns M J q R)
    rw [← hs]
    exact (actualChamberPointFamily M J v.chamber).property R

/-- Evaluate on precisely the original positive partition support. -/
noncomputable def partitionTrackValue (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W) (p : I × X) : X :=
  H (ρ.finsupport p.2) (partition_finsupport_nonempty ρ p.2)
    (partition_support_isNerveFace W ρ hρ p.2)
    (p.1, (⟨p.2, partition_mem_coverFaceParameter W ρ hρ p.2⟩,

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.partitionTrack.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.partitionTrackValue_eq_finite
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.partitionTrack.source_declaration:
/-- Exact face coherence permits any larger finite support window at the
same actual point, including the closed-support window. -/
theorem partitionTrackValue_eq_finite (W : ι → Set X) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity ι X)
    (hρ : ρ.IsSubordinate W) (H : NumerableFaceTracks W)
    (hH : NumerableFaceTracks.Compatible W H) (F : Finset ι) (hne : F.Nonempty)
    (hF : IsNerveFace W F) (t : I) (x : coverFaceParameter W F)
    (hx : ρ.finsupport x.val ⊆ F) :
    partitionTrackValue W ρ hρ H (t, x.val) =
      H F hne hF (t, (x, finiteChart ρ F ⟨x.val, hx⟩)) := by
  have h := hH (partition_finsupport_nonempty ρ x.val) hne
    (partition_support_isNerveFace W ρ hρ x.val) hF hx t x
    (finiteChart ρ (ρ.finsupport x.val) ⟨x.val, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩)
  change H F hne hF
    (t, (x, (finiteChart ρ (ρ.finsupport x.val) ⟨x.val, Finset.Subset.refl _⟩).map
      (finiteFaceInclusion hx))) = _ at h
  rw [finiteChart_map_inclusion] at h
  exact h.symm

theorem positiveHeadTail_spec (u : IncomingVertex M B0)
    (hu : IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 u) :
    IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu) ∧
      u ≤ positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu ∧
      SimpleRibbon M u.source (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu).source
        (u.difference (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu)) ∧
      (∀ q : IncomingVertex M B0, IncomingVertex.IsPositive M B0 q → u ≤ q →
        SimpleRibbon M u.source q.source (u.difference q) →
        q ≤ positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu ∧
          SimpleRibbon M q.source (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu).source
            (q.difference (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu))) ∧
      (u.value ≠ 1 → degree M (positiveHeadTail M B0 u hu).value < degree M u.value) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_positive_headTail M B0 u hu)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.positiveNormal.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.positiveNormalizerDiagram
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.positiveNormal.source_declaration:
/-- Literal positive-traversal M4 diagram on opposite fundamental groups,
retaining exactly the same actual quotient and original induced maps. -/
def positiveNormalizerDiagram (x : Complement M J) : Prop :=
    Nonempty (Artin.pureNormalizerImage M J ≃* (FundamentalGroup (Complement M J) x)ᵐᵒᵖ) ∧
    Nonempty (Artin.normalizerQuotient M J ≃*
      (FundamentalGroup (OrbitSpace M J) (orbitProjection M J x))ᵐᵒᵖ) ∧
    (Function.Injective (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J) ∧
      (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J).range = (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J)) ∧
    (Function.Injective (positiveOrbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x) ∧
      (positiveOrbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range = (positiveOrbitMonodromy M J x).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (positiveOrbitMonodromy M J x)) ∧

theorem projection_mem_liftedTubeBasePiece {F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)}
    {q : ComplementUniversalCover M J} (hq : q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J F) :
    complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q ∈ liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q := by
  refine ⟨projectionPoint_mem_tubeIntersection M J hq, ?_⟩
  intro h hd
  have hn := tubeIntersection_real_ne_zero (projectionPoint_mem_tubeIntersection M J hq) hd
  change (liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J q).val.1 ∈
    signHalfSpace (actualForms M J h)
      (decide (0 < actualForms M J h (liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J q).val.1))
  by_cases hp : 0 < actualForms M J h (liftedTubeProjectionPoint M J q).val.1
  · simpa only [signHalfSpace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, decide_eq_true hp, ↓reduceIte] using hp
  · have hm := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hp) hn
    simpa only [signHalfSpace, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, decide_eq_false hp, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using hm

theorem realInterpolation_aggregate (f : ι → κ) (w : ι → ℝ) (c : κ → E) :
    realInterpolation (aggregateWeights f w) c = realInterpolation w (fun i => c (f i)) := by
  classical
  unfold realInterpolation aggregateWeights
  calc
    (∑ k, (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = k), w i) • c k) =
        ∑ k, ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = k), w i • c (f i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      rw [Finset.sum_smul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2]
    _ = ∑ i, w i • c (f i) := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f _

/-- Reindex an already constructed partition through a genuine index equivalence. -/
def reindexPartitionOfUnity {X K L : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (e : K ≃ L) (ρ : PartitionOfUnity L X) : PartitionOfUnity K X where
  toFun k := ρ (e k)
  locallyFinite' := ρ.locallyFinite.comp_injective e.injective
  nonneg' k x := ρ.nonneg (e k) x
  sum_eq_one' x hx := by
    rw [finsum_comp (g := fun l => ρ l x) e e.bijective]
    exact ρ.sum_eq_one hx
  sum_le_one' x := by
    rw [finsum_comp (g := fun l => ρ l x) e e.bijective]
    exact ρ.sum_le_one x

/-- Strict head termination uses the actual ribbon degree, with no assumption
on the global degree of the chosen target. -/
theorem relativeHeadStep_degree_lt (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) (hv : v ≤ u) (hne : v ≠ u) :
    degree M (relativeHeadStep M u v).value < degree M v.value := by
  have hpos := (incomingRetarget_positive_iff M u v).2 hv
  have hval : (incomingRetarget M u v).value ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    apply hne
    exact IncomingVertex.ext_value (mul_inv_eq_one.mp he)
  have hlt := headStep_degree_lt M u.source (incomingRetarget M u v) hpos hval
  rw [← incomingRetarget_relativeHeadStep M u v hv] at hlt
  simp only [incomingRetarget_value, degree_mul, degree_inv] at hlt
  omega

/-- Every relative head lies in the actual order interval from its vertex to `u`. -/
theorem relativeHeadStep_interval (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) (hv : v ≤ u) :
    v ≤ relativeHeadStep M u v ∧ relativeHeadStep M u v ≤ u := by
  have hpos := (incomingRetarget_positive_iff M u v).2 hv
  constructor
  · apply (incomingRetarget M u).le_iff_le.mp
    rw [incomingRetarget_relativeHeadStep M u v hv]
    exact positive_le_headStep M _ hpos
  · apply (incomingRetarget M u).le_iff_le.mp
    rw [incomingRetarget_relativeHeadStep M u v hv, incomingRetarget_self]
    exact (incoming_le_root_iff M _).2 (headStep_positive M u.source _ hpos)

theorem relativeHeadStep_measure_lt (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) (hv : v ≤ u) (hne : v ≠ u) :
    relativeHeadMeasure M u (relativeHeadStep M u v) < relativeHeadMeasure M u v := by
  have hlt := relativeHeadStep_degree_lt M u v hv hne
  have hb := (relativeHeadStep_interval M u v hv).2
  have hn := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hb.positive
  simp only [IncomingVertex.difference, degree_mul, degree_inv] at hn
  unfold relativeHeadMeasure
  omega

theorem relativeHeadStep_terminates (u v : IncomingVertex M B0) :

/-- The actual chosen section image is connected and contains the common
point, so it lies in the indicated upstairs component. -/
theorem restrictedTubeSection_basePiece_mem_component {F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) {q : ComplementUniversalCover M J}
    (hq : q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J F) (A : LiftedTubeIndex M J) (hA : A ∈ F)
    (x : liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q) :
    restrictedTubeSection M J A (liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q)
      (liftedTubeBasePiece_subset_tube M J F q A hA) x ∈
      connectedComponentIn (liftedTubeIntersection M J F) q := by
  let := contractibleSpace_liftedTubeBasePiece M J hF hq
  let f := restrictedTubeSection M J A (liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q)
    (liftedTubeBasePiece_subset_tube M J F q A hA)
  have hqrange : q ∈ Set.range f :=
    ⟨⟨_, projection_mem_liftedTubeBasePiece M J hq⟩,
      liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J A q
        ((mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J F q).mp hq A hA)⟩
  have hsub : Set.range f ⊆ liftedTubeIntersection M J F := by
    rintro y ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact restrictedTubeSection_basePiece_mem_intersection M J hF hq A hA z
  exact (isPreconnected_range f.continuous).subset_connectedComponentIn hqrange hsub
    ⟨x, rfl⟩

  apply (mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J F _).mpr
  intro B hB

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.restrictedTube.source_declaration:
/-- On a preconnected actual base subspace, sections agreeing once agree everywhere.
This uses the genuine covering-map uniqueness theorem, not path-groupoid data. -/
theorem restrictedTubeSection_eq_of_eq (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
    (S : Set (Complement M J)) [PreconnectedSpace S]
    (hA : S ⊆ actualTubeSet M J A.chamber) (hB : S ⊆ actualTubeSet M J B.chamber)
    (x : S) (hx : restrictedTubeSection M J A S hA x = restrictedTubeSection M J B S hB x) :
    restrictedTubeSection M J A S hA = restrictedTubeSection M J B S hB := by
  apply ContinuousMap.coe_injective
  exact (isCoveringMap_complementUniversalCoverProjection M J).eq_of_comp_eq
    (restrictedTubeSection M J A S hA).continuous
    (restrictedTubeSection M J B S hB).continuous
    (funext fun y => (restrictedTubeSection_projection M J A S hA y).trans
      (restrictedTubeSection_projection M J B S hB y).symm) x hx

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.restrictedTube.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.restrictedTubeSection_eq_on_basePiece

/-- Sections over any selected member coincide on the entire actual base
piece. Agreement at the given total-space point is proved by sheet inverses. -/
theorem restrictedTubeSection_eq_on_basePiece {F : Set (LiftedTubeIndex M J)}
    (hF : F.Nonempty) {q : ComplementUniversalCover M J}
    (hq : q ∈ liftedTubeIntersection M J F) (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
    (hA : A ∈ F) (hB : B ∈ F) :
    restrictedTubeSection M J A (liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q)
      (liftedTubeBasePiece_subset_tube M J F q A hA) =
    restrictedTubeSection M J B (liftedTubeBasePiece M J F q)
      (liftedTubeBasePiece_subset_tube M J F q B hB) := by
  let := contractibleSpace_liftedTubeBasePiece M J hF hq
  apply restrictedTubeSection_eq_of_eq M J A B _ _ _
    ⟨_, projection_mem_liftedTubeBasePiece M J hq⟩
  exact (liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J A q
    ((mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J F q).mp hq A hA)).trans
    (liftedTubeSection_projection_eq M J B q
      ((mem_liftedTubeIntersection_iff M J F q).mp hq B hB)).symm

/-- On a wall where upper chambers disagree, the middle chamber retains
the lower chamber's sign. The family can be arbitrary or empty. -/
theorem sharedUpper_middle_sign (A B : Chamber ℓ) (U : Set (Chamber ℓ))
    (hb : ∀ C ∈ U, ChamberBetween A B C) {h : H}
    (hd : tubeDisagreement (insert B U) h) : B.signs h = A.signs h := by
  by_contra hne
  have hall : ∀ C ∈ insert B U, C.signs h = B.signs h := by
    intro C hC
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hC with rfl | hC
    · rfl
    · have hh := hb C hC h
      cases ha : A.signs h <;> cases hb' : B.signs h <;> cases hc : C.signs h <;>
        simp_all
  obtain ⟨C, hC, D, hD, hCD⟩ := hd
  exact hCD ((hall C hC).trans (hall D hD).symm)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.sheet_mem_impl.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.sheet_mem_implies_interval
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.sheet_mem_impl.source_declaration:
/-- Every sheet through the actual lift has incoming label in its one actual
simple interval. This direction uses actual path gauges, not only projection. -/
theorem sheet_mem_implies_interval (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J)
    (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) (hu : q ∈ incomingLiftedTubeSheet M J u) :
    sheetLowerVertex M J q ≤ u ∧ u ≤ sheetUpperVertex M J q := by
  let A := pointTubeIndex M J q (sheetLowerChamber M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q))
    (mem_sheetLowerChamber M J _)
  let B := pointTubeIndex M J q (sheetUpperChamber M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q))
    (mem_sheetUpperChamber M J _)
  let U := incomingLiftedTubeIndex M J u
  have hU : q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J U := hu
  have hAU := sheet_simple_difference_of_between M J A U q
    (mem_pointTubeIndex M J q _ _) hU (chamberBetween_left _ _)
  have hUB := sheet_simple_difference_of_between M J U B q hU
    (mem_pointTubeIndex M J q _ _)
    ((mem_actualTubeSet_iff_sheetBetween M J _ U.chamber).mp
      (liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J U hU))
  constructor
  · simpa only [sheetLowerVertex, IncomingVertex.le_iff, IncomingVertex.difference, A, U, incomingLiftedTubeIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hAU.1
  · simpa only [sheetUpperVertex, IncomingVertex.le_iff, IncomingVertex.difference, B, U, incomingLiftedTubeIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hUB.1

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.sheet_simple_d.name: ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.sheet_simple_difference_of_between
ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.sheet_simple_d.source_declaration:
/-- Shared sheet membership turns an ordered local chamber connector into
the actual simple positive ribbon factor between the incoming labels. -/
theorem sheet_simple_difference_of_between (A B : LiftedTubeIndex M J)
    (q : ComplementUniversalCover M J) (hA : q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J A)
    (hB : q ∈ liftedTubeSheet M J B)
    (hbet : ChamberBetween (sheetLowerChamber M J (complementUniversalCoverProjection M J q))
      A.chamber B.chamber) :
    SimpleRibbon M (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).source
      (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B).source
      ((liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B)) := by
  have hpA := liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J A hA
  have hpB := liftedTubeSheet_subset_projection_preimage M J B hB
  have hpath := (mem_liftedTubeSheet_iff_connector M J A B q hA hpB).mp hB
  rw [faceConnector_eq_positive_of_between M J _ A.chamber B.chamber hpA hbet] at hpath
  have hvalue := (liftedTubePathClass_comp_iff M J A B
    (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)).mp hpath
  have hdiff : (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J A).difference (liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming M J B) =
      ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map (intervalPositive A.chamber B.chamber)).val.val := by
    dsimp only [IncomingVertex.difference]
    rw [hvalue]
    group
  rw [hdiff, liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_source, liftedTubeIndexEquivIncoming_source,
    intervalRibbonFunctor_positive, intervalRibbonPositive_value]
  exact simpleRibbon_intervalPositive M J A.chamber B.chamber

/-- Repeating a labeled vertex and then aggregating its weights leaves the
actual quadratic interpolation unchanged, including on boundary faces. -/
theorem signInterpolation_aggregate (f : ι → κ) (w : ι → ℝ) (d : κ → ℝ) (c : κ → E) :
    signInterpolation (aggregateWeights f w) d c =
      signInterpolation w (fun i => d (f i)) (fun i => c (f i)) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact realInterpolation_aggregate f w c
  · exact imaginaryInterpolation_aggregate f w d c

/-- Heights are absolute up to a common translation; no choice of a
simplex-specific recentering enters the formula. -/
theorem signInterpolation_height_translate (w d : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → E) (t : ℝ)
    (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    signInterpolation w (fun i => d i + t) c = signInterpolation w d c := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  change imaginaryInterpolation w (fun i => d i + t) c = imaginaryInterpolation w d c
  unfold imaginaryInterpolation
  rw [meanHeight_translate w d t hwone]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  congr 1
  ring

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.signInterpolat.source_declaration:
/-- The concrete quadratic formula lands in the literal complement of the
specified continuous real forms, under proved scalar sign-height hypotheses. -/
theorem signInterpolation_mem_complexComplement {H : Type*} (ℓ : H → E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (w d : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → E) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ Chamber3.regularSet ℓ)
    (hsep : ∀ h, SignHeightSeparated (fun i => ℓ h (c i)) d) :
    signInterpolation w d c ∈ Chamber3.complexComplementSet ℓ := by
  intro h hzero
  have hx : ∑ i, w i * ℓ h (c i) = 0 := by
    simpa only [signInterpolation, eval_realInterpolation] using hzero.1
  have hy : (∑ i, w i * d i * ℓ h (c i)) = 0 := by
    have he := eval_imaginaryInterpolation (ℓ h) w d c
    rw [hx, mul_zero, sub_zero] at he
    exact he ▸ hzero.2
  exact weighted_height_sum_ne_zero w (fun i => ℓ h (c i)) d hw hwone
    (fun i => hc i h) hx (hsep h) hy

/-- Every weighted chain of a simple interval already satisfies the actual
simple-chain condition. The homeomorphism uses its genuine subspace topology. -/
noncomputable def simpleIntervalWeightsHomeomorph {a b : IncomingVertex M B0}
    (hs : SimpleRibbon M a.source b.source (a.difference b)) :
    OrderWeights (Set.Icc a b) ≃ₜ GarsideWeightsOn M B0 (Set.Icc a b) where
  toFun w := ⟨w, fun u _hu v _hv huv =>
    IncomingVertex.simple_difference_of_interval hs u.property.1 huv v.property.2⟩
  invFun w := w.val
  left_inv _w := rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.simpleRibbon_i.source_declaration:
/-- Actual simple positive generation is precisely the half-turn divisor
predicate; the converse uses an actual standard source chamber and endpoint. -/
theorem simpleRibbon_iff_positive_eq_simpleLift (X Y : RibbonObject M) (s : Artin.Group M) :
    SimpleRibbon M X Y s ↔ PositiveReducedArrow M X Y s ∧
      s = transporterPositiveLift M (Artin.projection M s) := by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    exact ⟨hs.1, SimpleRibbon.eq_simpleLift M hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hp, hs⟩
    let C : ChamberFiber M X.indices X :=
      ⟨standardActualChamber M X.indices, standardActualChamber_indices M X.indices⟩
    let D := fiberTarget M X.indices (Artin.projection M s)
      (isRibbon_projection_transporter M hp.isRibbon) C
    have hrel : relativeTransport M X.indices C.val D.val = Artin.projection M s :=
      relativeTransport_fiberTarget M X.indices _ _
        (simple_reduced_projection_minimal M hp.isRibbon hp.leftReduced hs) C
    refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
    have hprefix := intervalPositive_prefix_cofinalDelta M X.indices C.val D.val
    rw [hrel, ← hs] at hprefix
    simpa only [C, standardActualChamber_indices] using hprefix

/-- The canonical sorted simplex of one admissible finite chain. -/
noncomputable def subcomplexCanonicalChart (S : Finset P → Prop) (hS : SupportHereditary S)

theorem sum_height_mul_neg (b d : ι → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ i, b i = 0)
    (hne : ∃ i, b i ≠ 0) (hsep : PositiveBeforeNegative b d) :
    (∑ i, d i * b i) < 0 := by
  have h := sum_height_mul_pos b (fun i => -d i) hsum hne (by
    intro i j hi hj
    exact neg_lt_neg (hsep j i hj hi))
  simpa only [neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_pos] using h

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.sum_height_mul.source_declaration:
/-- A zero total of nontrivial signed coefficients has strictly positive
height-weighted total when negative heights precede positive heights. -/
theorem sum_height_mul_pos (b d : ι → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ i, b i = 0)
    (hne : ∃ i, b i ≠ 0) (hsep : NegativeBeforePositive b d) :
    0 < ∑ i, d i * b i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩⟩ := exists_pos_and_neg_of_sum_zero b hsum hne
  let N := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => b i < 0)
  have hN : N.Nonempty := ⟨k₀, by simp only [N, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]; exact hk₀⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image N d hN
  have hbk : b k < 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hk).2
  have hnonneg (i : ι) : 0 ≤ (d i - d k) * b i := by
    by_cases hi : b i < 0
    · have hdi := hmax i (by simp only [N, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]; exact hi)
      exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.2 hdi) hi.le
    · by_cases hip : 0 < b i
      · exact (mul_pos (sub_pos.2 (hsep k i hbk hip)) hip).le
      · have hiz : b i = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hip) (le_of_not_gt hi)
        rw [hiz, mul_zero]
  have hstrict : 0 < (d j - d k) * b j := mul_pos (sub_pos.2 (hsep k j hbk hj)) hj
  have hpositive : 0 < ∑ i, (d i - d k) * b i :=
    Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => hnonneg i) ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hstrict⟩
  have hcenter : (∑ i, (d i - d k) * b i) = ∑ i, d i * b i := by
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hsum, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  rwa [hcenter] at hpositive

/-- Equality of the actual transported fiber point is exactly the literal
path-composition equation, with no independently chosen path labels. -/

    (γ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (tubeBasepoint M J A.chamber) (tubeBasepoint M J B.chamber)) :

  · intro h

    exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj he).2
  · intro h
    apply (liftedTubePathEquiv M J).injective

    exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq h)

ArtinNormalisers.Deligne5.universalCover.source_declaration:
/-- Over a path connected and path-homotopy-trivial open set, the actual sheet
projection is a homeomorphism. The stronger simply connected tube hypothesis
will discharge both geometric premises in the application below. -/
def universalCoverSheetHomeomorph [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X]
    [TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hconn : IsPathConnected U) (htriv : IsPathHomotopyTrivial U) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
    TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet U hx q ≃ₜ U := by
  let f := universalCoverSheetProjection U hx q
  have hbij : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor
    · intro a b hab
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact TauCeti.UniversalCover.proj_injOn_sheet htriv hx q a.property b.property
        (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
    · intro y
      obtain ⟨z, hz, he⟩ := TauCeti.UniversalCover.proj_surjOn_sheet hconn hx q y.property
      exact ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, Subtype.ext he⟩
  have hopen : IsOpenMap f :=
    ((TauCeti.UniversalCover.isOpenMap_proj x₀).domRestrict
      (TauCeti.UniversalCover.isOpen_sheet U hU hx q)).subtype_mk _
  exact (Equiv.ofBijective f hbij).toHomeomorphOfContinuousOpen f.continuous hopen

/-- The endpoint class of a genuine path in the original universal cover.
This follows from the accepted explicit appended-path lift and uniqueness. -/
theorem universalCover_path_endpoint {e z : TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀} (Γ : Path e z) :
    z.path = e.path.trans (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
      (Γ.map (TauCeti.UniversalCover.continuous_proj x₀))) := by
  obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := TauCeti.UniversalCover.surjective_ofBasedPath x₀ e
  let γ := Γ.map (TauCeti.UniversalCover.continuous_proj x₀)
  have hΓ : Γ.toContinuousMap = (TauCeti.UniversalCover.isCoveringMap x₀).liftPath
      γ.toContinuousMap (TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath x₀ α) γ.source := by
    apply ((TauCeti.UniversalCover.isCoveringMap x₀).eq_liftPath_iff' γ.source).mpr
    exact ⟨rfl, Γ.source⟩
  have he : z = TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath x₀ (α.append γ) :=
    Γ.target.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun f : C(I, TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀) => f 1) hΓ).trans
      (TauCeti.UniversalCover.liftPath_apply_one_eq_ofBasedPath_append γ))
  rw [BasedPath.append, TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath_ofPath] at he
  change z.path = (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk α.toPath).trans (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk γ)
  exact (eq_of_heq (TauCeti.UniversalCover.ext_iff.mp he).2).trans
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans α.toPath γ)

noncomputable def weightFaceCoordinates (F : Finset P) (w : OrderWeights P)

    rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by intro; rfl)]
    change (∑ p : F, w.weights p.val) = 1
    rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort, ← w.total]
    symm
    exact Finset.sum_subset hw (fun p _ hp => Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hp)⟩

theorem weightFaceCoordinates_map_val (F : Finset P) (w : OrderWeights P)
    (hw : w.weights.support ⊆ F) :
    (weightFaceCoordinates F w hw).map (fun p : F => p.val) = orderWeightsSimplex w := by
  ext p
  by_cases hp : p ∈ F
  · have he : p = (⟨p, hp⟩ : F).val := rfl
    rw [he, StdSimplex.map_apply_injective Subtype.val_injective]
    rfl
  · have hn : p ∉ Set.range (fun q : F => q.val) := by
      rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact hp q.property
    change Finsupp.mapDomain (fun q : F => q.val) (weightFaceCoordinates F w hw).weights p = w.weights p
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ hn]
    exact (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (fun h => hp (hw h))).symm

theorem weightFaceCoordinates_natural {A B : Finset P} (hAB : A ⊆ B)

  rw [StdSimplex.map_map]
  change (weightFaceCoordinates A w hA).map (fun p : A => p.val) = _

/-- The scalar nonvanishing conclusion allows zero weights and either
orientation of strict opposite-sign height separation. -/
theorem weighted_height_sum_ne_zero (w a d : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1) (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0)
    (hzero : ∑ i, w i * a i = 0) (hsep : SignHeightSeparated a d) :
    (∑ i, w i * d i * a i) ≠ 0 := by
  rcases hsep with hsep | hsep
  · exact ne_of_gt (weighted_height_sum_pos w a d hw hwone ha hzero hsep)
  · exact ne_of_lt (weighted_height_sum_neg w a d hw hwone ha hzero hsep)

    (hwone : ∑ i, w i = 1) (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0)
    (hzero : ∑ i, w i * a i = 0) (hsep : PositiveBeforeNegative a d) :
    (∑ i, w i * d i * a i) < 0 := by
  have h := sum_height_mul_neg (fun i => w i * a i) d hzero
    (weighted_coefficients_nontrivial w a hwone ha) (by
      intro i j hi hj
      exact hsep i j (positive_of_weighted_positive _ _ (hw i) hi)
        (negative_of_weighted_negative _ _ (hw j) hj))
  convert h using 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi

/-- Every actual finite open cover member is convex for the actual connector. -/
theorem actualConvexCover_isConnectorConvex (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group]
    (J : Set I) (σ : RelativeRoot M J → Fin 4) :
    (actualLocalEquiconnection M J).IsConvex (actualConvexCoverSet M J σ) := by
  change (pullbackLocalEquiconnection (actualComplementHomeomorph M J)
    (convexLocalEquiconnection (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J))).IsConvex
      ((actualComplementHomeomorph M J) ⁻¹'
        convexCoverSet (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J) σ)
  exact isConvex_pullbackLocalEquiconnection (actualComplementHomeomorph M J)
    (convexLocalEquiconnection (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J))
    (convexCover_isConnectorConvex (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J) σ)

/-- The transported connector has exactly the original ambient straight-line values. -/
theorem actualLocalEquiconnection_connector_val (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group]
    (J : Set I) (p : (actualLocalEquiconnection M J).domain) (t : unitInterval) :
    ((actualLocalEquiconnection M J).connector (p, t)).val =
      (1 - (t : ℝ)) • p.val.1.val + (t : ℝ) • p.val.2.val := by
  have hi (z : ComplexComplement (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)) :
      ((actualComplementHomeomorph M J).symm z).val = z.val := by
    simpa only [Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply] using
      (actualComplementHomeomorph_val M J ((actualComplementHomeomorph M J).symm z)).symm
  change ((actualComplementHomeomorph M J).symm _).val = _
  rw [hi]
  rw [convexLocalEquiconnection_connector_val, actualComplementHomeomorph_val,
    actualComplementHomeomorph_val]

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.ambient_posit.source_declaration:
/-- The actual ambient positive lcm, expressed using genuine group labels and
positive quotients rather than changing the underlying monoid. -/
theorem ambient_positive_left_lcm {p q : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hq : q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ) :
    ∃ l : Artin.Group M, l ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ ∧
      RibbonPrefix M p l ∧ RibbonPrefix M q l ∧
      ∀ r, r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ →
        RibbonPrefix M p r → RibbonPrefix M q r → RibbonPrefix M l r := by
  obtain ⟨l, hpl, hql, hleast⟩ := actualPositive_lcm_left M ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩
  have unpack {a b : actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ}
      (h : ActualLeftDivides M a b) : RibbonPrefix M a.val b.val := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
    exact ⟨c.val, c.property, congrArg Subtype.val hc⟩
  refine ⟨l.val, l.property, unpack hpl, unpack hql, ?_⟩
  intro r hr hpr hqr
  apply unpack (hleast ⟨r, hr⟩ ?_ ?_)
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hea⟩ := hpr
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, Subtype.ext hea⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb, heb⟩ := hqr
    exact ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, Subtype.ext heb⟩

/-- A genuine root vanishes on the canonical face point exactly when its
support lies in the face's selected standard indices. -/
theorem canonicalDominant_root_zero_iff_support {U : Set I} {r : Vector I}
    (hr : r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots) :
    canonicalDominant U r = 0 ↔ ∀ i, i ∉ U → r i = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
    · exact nonneg_support_of_canonical_eval_zero U hp.le hz
    · have hs := nonneg_support_of_canonical_eval_zero U (neg_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
        (by simp only [map_neg, hz, neg_zero])
      intro i hi
      simpa only [Finsupp.neg_apply, neg_eq_zero] using hs i hi
  · exact canonical_eval_zero_of_supported U r

/-- A purely geometric interval is exactly agreement on the vanishing forms. -/
theorem chamberBetween_faceChamber_pos_neg_iff (x : E) (C D : Chamber ℓ) :
    ChamberBetween (faceChamber ℓ x C) D (faceChamber ℓ (-x) C) ↔
      ∀ h, ℓ h x = 0 → D.signs h = C.signs h := by

  · intro h h₀ hz
    have he := h h₀ ((faceChamber_pos_neg_sign_eq_iff ℓ x C h₀).2 hz)
    rwa [faceChamber_signs_zero ℓ x C hz] at he
  · intro h h₀ he
    have hz := (faceChamber_pos_neg_sign_eq_iff ℓ x C h₀).1 he
    rw [h h₀ hz, faceChamber_signs_zero ℓ x C hz]

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.chamberIncide.source_declaration:
/-- The actual incident chamber set is exactly the sign interval from an
incident chamber to its opposite at the face. -/
theorem chamberIncident_iff_between_oppositeAtFace [Finite H] {z : E} {C : Chamber ℓ}
    (hC : ChamberIncident ℓ z C) (D : Chamber ℓ) :
    ChamberIncident ℓ z D ↔ ChamberBetween C D (oppositeAtFace ℓ z C) := by
  classical
  have hCs := (chamberIncident_iff_signs ℓ z C).mp hC
  rw [chamberIncident_iff_signs]
  constructor
  · intro hD h hshared
    by_cases hz : ℓ h z = 0
    · rw [oppositeAtFace_signs_zero ℓ z C hz] at hshared
      cases hs : C.signs h <;> simp [hs] at hshared
    · exact (hD h hz).trans (hCs h hz).symm
  · intro hb h hz
    have hshared : C.signs h = (oppositeAtFace ℓ z C).signs h :=
      (hCs h hz).trans (oppositeAtFace_signs_nonzero ℓ z C hz).symm
    exact (hb h hshared).trans (hCs h hz)

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.closure_chamb.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.closure_chamber_region
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.closure_chamb.source_declaration:
/-- The closure of any nonempty central sign cell is exactly its weak sign
cell. No simpliciality or independence of the forms is needed. -/
theorem closure_chamber_region (C : Chamber ℓ) : closure C.region = chamberWeakRegion ℓ C := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro z hz h
    cases hs : C.signs h
    · change ℓ h z ≤ 0
      apply closure_minimal (t := {x | ℓ h x ≤ 0}) ?_
        (isClosed_le (ℓ h).continuous continuous_const) hz
      intro x hx
      exact (show ℓ h x < 0 from by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hx h).le
    · change 0 ≤ ℓ h z
      apply closure_minimal (t := {x | 0 ≤ ℓ h x}) ?_
        (isClosed_le continuous_const (ℓ h).continuous) hz
      intro x hx
      exact (show 0 < ℓ h x from by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hx h).le
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := C.region_nonempty
    have hseg : openSegment ℝ c z ⊆ C.region := by
      intro y hy h
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := (openSegment_eq_image_lineMap ℝ c z).le hy
      have hh := hc h
      have hzh := hz h
      cases hs : C.signs h
      · have hcn : ℓ h c < 0 := by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hh
        have hzn : ℓ h z ≤ 0 := by simpa [hs] using hzh
        change ℓ h (AffineMap.lineMap c z t) < 0
        rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
        exact add_neg_of_neg_of_nonpos
          (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.mpr ht.2) hcn) (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht.1.le hzn)
      · have hcp : 0 < ℓ h c := by simpa [signHalfSpace, hs] using hh
        have hzp : 0 ≤ ℓ h z := by simpa [hs] using hzh
        change 0 < ℓ h (AffineMap.lineMap c z t)
        rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
        exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
          (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht.2) hcp) (mul_nonneg ht.1.le hzp)
    exact closure_mono hseg (segment_subset_closure_openSegment (right_mem_segment ℝ c z))

      (convex_convexCell ℓ σ hx hy (sub_nonneg.mpr z.2.property.2)
        z.2.property.1 (sub_add_cancel 1 (z.2 : ℝ)))⟩
  continuous_toFun := by
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk

def convexLocalEquiconnection [Finite H] (ℓ : H → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    LocalEquiconnection (ComplexComplement ℓ) where
  domain := convexConnectorDomain ℓ
  isOpen_domain := isOpen_iUnion fun σ =>
    (isOpen_convexCoverSet ℓ σ).prod (isOpen_convexCoverSet ℓ σ)
  diagonal_mem x := by
    obtain ⟨σ, hx⟩ := exists_mem_convexCoverSet ℓ x
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨σ, hx, hx⟩

  connector_one p := by apply Subtype.ext; simp [convexConnector]
  connector_diagonal x t := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1 - (t : ℝ)) • x.val + (t : ℝ) • x.val = x.val

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.faceChamber_p.source_declaration:
/-- The signs of the two projected chambers agree exactly on forms vanishing
at the real point; all other signs are opposite. -/
theorem faceChamber_pos_neg_sign_eq_iff (x : E) (C : Chamber ℓ) (h : H) :
    (faceChamber ℓ x C).signs h = (faceChamber ℓ (-x) C).signs h ↔ ℓ h x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    by_contra hn
    have hneg : ℓ h (-x) ≠ 0 := by simpa only [map_neg, neg_ne_zero] using hn
    rw [faceChamber_signs_nonzero ℓ x C hn,
      faceChamber_signs_nonzero ℓ (-x) C hneg, map_neg] at he
    by_cases hp : 0 < ℓ h x
    · have hnp : ¬0 < -(ℓ h x) := not_lt.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr hp.le)
      simp [hp, hnp] at he
    · have ha : ℓ h x < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hp) hn
      have hna : 0 < -(ℓ h x) := neg_pos.mpr ha
      simp [hp, hna] at he
  · intro hz
    rw [faceChamber_signs_zero ℓ x C hz,
      faceChamber_signs_zero ℓ (-x) C (by simpa only [map_neg, neg_eq_zero] using hz)]

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefixLab.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefixLabel_eq_oppositeAtFace
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefixLab.source_declaration:
/-- The actual face-prefix endpoint is exactly opposition in the actual
geometric residue. Nonzero face signs are fixed and zero face signs reversed. -/
theorem facePrefixLabel_eq_oppositeAtFace (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (T : Set I) :
    actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (facePrefixLabel M J L T) =
      oppositeAtFace (actualForms M J) (rawFacePoint M J L T) (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) := by
  apply Chamber.ext
  funext R
  let r := M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative⁻¹ R.val
  have hRroot : R.val ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots := by
    obtain ⟨w, i, he⟩ := R.property.1
    exact M.toCoxeterSystem.mem_geometricRoots.mpr ⟨w, i, he⟩
  have hr : r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots :=
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff L.representative⁻¹).mpr hRroot
  have heR : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r = R.val := by
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
  have hface : actualForms M J R (rawFacePoint M J L T) = canonicalDominant (L.indices ∪ T) r := by
    calc
      _ = (rawFacePoint M J L T).val
          (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r) :=
        congrArg (rawFacePoint M J L T).val heR.symm
      _ = _ := rawFacePoint_pairing M J L T r
  have hbase : actualForms M J R (facetCanonicalPoint M L) = canonicalDominant L.indices r := by
    calc
      _ = (facetCanonicalPoint M L).val
          (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r) :=
        congrArg (facetCanonicalPoint M L).val heR.symm
      _ = _ := facetCanonicalPoint_pairing M L r
  have hCpoint : facetCanonicalPoint M L ∈ (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).region := by
    rw [actualChamberOfRawLabel_region]
    exact facetCanonicalPoint_mem M L
  have hsource : canonicalDominant L.indices r ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hbase]
    exact (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).region_subset_regularSet hCpoint R
  have hC : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R = true ↔ 0 < r := by
    simpa only [rawRelativeTransport_self, inv_one, map_one, one_apply_eq_self] using rawFacet_sign_iff M J L L R
  have hD := rawFacet_sign_iff M J L (facePrefixLabel M J L T) R
  rw [rawRelativeTransport_facePrefixLabel] at hD
  have hsourceNeg : canonicalDominant L.indices (-r) ≠ 0 := by simpa only [map_neg, neg_ne_zero] using hsource
  have hnegroot : -r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots := M.toCoxeterSystem.neg_mem_geometricRoots_iff.mpr hr
  by_cases hz : actualForms M J R (rawFacePoint M J L T) = 0
  · rw [oppositeAtFace_signs_zero _ _ _ hz]
    have hzr : canonicalDominant (L.indices ∪ T) r = 0 := hface.symm.trans hz
    rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
    · have hc := hC.mpr hp
      have hneg := facePrefix_inverse_negative_of_zero M ⟨L.indices⟩ T hr hp hsource hzr
      have hd : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (facePrefixLabel M J L T)).signs R = false := by
        cases hs : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (facePrefixLabel M J L T)).signs R
        · rfl
        · exact False.elim (lt_asymm (hD.mp hs) hneg)
      rw [hc, hd]
      rfl
    · have hc : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R = false := by
        cases hs : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R
        · rfl
        · exact False.elim (lt_asymm (hC.mp hs) hn)
      have hneg := facePrefix_inverse_negative_of_zero M ⟨L.indices⟩ T hnegroot
        (neg_pos.mpr hn) hsourceNeg (by simp only [map_neg, hzr, neg_zero])
      have hpos : 0 < M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation
          (Artin.projection M (facePrefix M ⟨L.indices⟩ T))⁻¹ r := by
        simpa only [map_neg, neg_lt_zero] using hneg
      rw [hD.mpr hpos, hc]
      rfl
  · rw [oppositeAtFace_signs_nonzero _ _ _ hz]
    have hsC := (chamberIncident_iff_signs _ _ _).mp (rawFacePoint_incident M J L T) R hz
    rw [← hsC]
    have hzr : canonicalDominant (L.indices ∪ T) r ≠ 0 := fun h => hz (hface.trans h)
    rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hr with hp | hn
    · have hpos := facePrefix_inverse_positive_of_nonzero M ⟨L.indices⟩ T hr hp hzr
      rw [hD.mpr hpos, hC.mpr hp]
    · have hc : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R = false := by
        cases hs : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L).signs R
        · rfl
        · exact False.elim (lt_asymm (hC.mp hs) hn)
      have hpos := facePrefix_inverse_positive_of_nonzero M ⟨L.indices⟩ T hnegroot
        (neg_pos.mpr hn) (by simpa only [map_neg, neg_ne_zero] using hzr)
      have hneg : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation
          (Artin.projection M (facePrefix M ⟨L.indices⟩ T))⁻¹ r < 0 := by
        simpa only [map_neg, neg_pos] using hpos
      have hd : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (facePrefixLabel M J L T)).signs R = false := by
        cases hs : (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (facePrefixLabel M J L T)).signs R
        · rfl
        · exact False.elim (lt_asymm (hD.mp hs) hneg)
      rw [hc, hd]

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefix_in.source_declaration:
/-- The inverse face-prefix projection reverses every positive source root
vanishing on the face, provided it does not vanish on the source flat. -/
theorem facePrefix_inverse_negative_of_zero (X : RibbonObject M) (T : Set I)
    {r : Vector I} (hr : r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots) (hp : 0 < r)
    (hsource : canonicalDominant X.indices r ≠ 0)
    (hz : canonicalDominant (X.indices ∪ T) r = 0) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (Artin.projection M (facePrefix M X T))⁻¹ r < 0 := by
  let U := X.indices ∪ T
  let v := M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (parabolicLongest M X.indices) r
  have hvroot : v ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots :=
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff _).mpr hr
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hri⟩ := positive_coefficient_outside hp hsource
  have hvpos : 0 < v := by
    rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hvroot with hv | hv
    · exact hv
    · have he := geometricRepresentation_apply_outside_parabolic M X.indices
        (parabolicLongest_mem_parabolic M X.indices) r hi
      have hnonpos := hv.le i
      change M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (parabolicLongest M X.indices) r i ≤ 0
        at hnonpos
      rw [he] at hnonpos
      exact False.elim (hri.not_ge hnonpos)
  have hrU := (canonicalDominant_root_zero_iff_support M hr).mp hz
  have hwXU : parabolicLongest M X.indices ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M U :=
    Subgroup.closure_mono (Set.image_mono Set.subset_union_left)
      (parabolicLongest_mem_parabolic M X.indices)
  have hvU : ∀ j, j ∉ U → v j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [show v j = r j from geometricRepresentation_apply_outside_parabolic M U hwXU r hj]
    exact hrU j hj
  have hneg := parabolicLongest_positive_supported_negative M U hvroot hvpos hvU
  rw [facePrefix_projection, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, parabolicLongest_inv,
    map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]
  exact hneg

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefix_in.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefix_inverse_positive_of_nonzero
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefix_in.source_declaration:
/-- A nonvanishing positive root keeps its sign: the inverse face-prefix
projection cannot change its positive coefficient outside the face indices. -/
theorem facePrefix_inverse_positive_of_nonzero (X : RibbonObject M) (T : Set I)
    {r : Vector I} (hr : r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots) (hp : 0 < r)
    (hz : canonicalDominant (X.indices ∪ T) r ≠ 0) :
    0 < M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (Artin.projection M (facePrefix M X T))⁻¹ r := by
  let U := X.indices ∪ T
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hri⟩ := positive_coefficient_outside hp hz
  have hwXU : parabolicLongest M X.indices ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M U :=
    Subgroup.closure_mono (Set.image_mono Set.subset_union_left)
      (parabolicLongest_mem_parabolic M X.indices)

    rw [facePrefix_projection]
    exact (Artin.coxeterParabolic M U).inv_mem
      ((Artin.coxeterParabolic M U).mul_mem ((Artin.coxeterParabolic M U).inv_mem hwXU)
        (parabolicLongest_mem_parabolic M U))
  have hroot := (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff
    (Artin.projection M (facePrefix M X T))⁻¹).mpr hr
  rcases M.toCoxeterSystem.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots hroot with h | h
  · exact h
  · have hnonpos := h.le i
    rw [geometricRepresentation_apply_outside_parabolic M U hdU r hi] at hnonpos
    exact False.elim (hri.not_ge hnonpos)

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefix_pr.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefix_prefix_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.facePrefix_pr.source_declaration:
/-- The face ratio is the actual positive lcm of its elementary prefixes.
Indices already in `X` are harmless: their elementary ratios are identities. -/
theorem facePrefix_prefix_iff (X : RibbonObject M) (T : Set I)
    {p : Artin.Group M} (hp : p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ) :
    RibbonPrefix M (facePrefix M X T) p ↔
      ∀ a ∈ T, RibbonPrefix M (elementaryMu M X.indices a) p := by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha
    exact (elementary_prefix_facePrefix M X T ha).trans M h
  · intro hall
    have hδ : parabolicDelta M X.indices ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
      selected_positive_univ M _ (parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M X.indices)
    have hsource : ∀ j ∈ X.indices, ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
        parabolicDelta M X.indices * p = Artin.generator M j * q := by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M X.indices j).2 hj
      exact ⟨q * p, Submonoid.mul_mem _ hq hp, by rw [heq, mul_assoc]⟩
    have hadded : ∀ a ∈ T, ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
        parabolicDelta M X.indices * p = Artin.generator M a * q := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := hall a ha
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hdelta⟩ :=
        (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M (insert a X.indices) a).2
          (Set.mem_insert a X.indices)
      refine ⟨r * q, Submonoid.mul_mem _ hr hq, ?_⟩
      rw [heq, elementaryMu]
      calc
        parabolicDelta M X.indices *
            ((parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M (insert a X.indices) * q) =
            parabolicDelta M (insert a X.indices) * q := by group
        _ = Artin.generator M a * (r * q) := by rw [hdelta, mul_assoc]
    obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := parabolicDelta_left_lcm M (X.indices ∪ T)
      (parabolicDelta M X.indices * p) (Submonoid.mul_mem _ hδ hp) (by
        intro j hj
        exact hj.elim (hsource j) (hadded j))
    refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
    unfold facePrefix
    calc
      p = (parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ * (parabolicDelta M X.indices * p) := by group
      _ = (parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ * (parabolicDelta M (X.indices ∪ T) * q) := by rw [heq]
      _ = _ := by group

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.geometricRepr.source_declaration:
/-- Every actual standard-parabolic element fixes all coefficients outside
its generating index set, for arbitrary finitely supported vectors. -/
theorem geometricRepresentation_apply_outside_parabolic (U : Set I)
    {w : M.Group} (hw : w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M U)
    (r : Vector I) {i : I} (hi : i ∉ U) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation w r i = r i := by
  let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
  obtain ⟨word, hword, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_wordProd_eq_of_mem_parabolic hw
  have key : ∀ word : List I, (∀ j ∈ word, j ∈ U) → ∀ v : Vector I,
      cs.geometricRepresentation (cs.wordProd word) v i = v i := by
    intro word
    induction word with
    | nil => intro _ v; simp
    | cons j word ih =>
      intro hjword v
      have hij : i ≠ j := fun he => hi (he ▸ hjword j List.mem_cons_self)
      rw [cs.wordProd_cons, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp,
        cs.geometricRepresentation_simple,
        M.geometricReflection_apply_apply_of_ne hij]
      exact ih (fun k hk => hjword k (List.mem_cons_of_mem j hk)) v
  exact key word hword r

/-- Greatest arbitrary simple ribbon prefix, rather than only a face prefix. -/
theorem greatest_simple_ribbon_prefix {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) :
    ∃ (U : RibbonObject M) (d : Artin.Group M), SimpleRibbon M X U d ∧ RibbonPrefix M d p ∧
      ∀ (V : RibbonObject M) (e : Artin.Group M), SimpleRibbon M X V e →
        RibbonPrefix M e p → RibbonPrefix M e d := by
  have hδ : PositiveReducedArrow M X ⟨cofinalTarget M X.indices⟩
      (cofinalDelta M X.indices) := positive_cofinalDelta M X.indices
  obtain ⟨U, d, hd, hdp, hdδ, hgreatest⟩ := positive_reduced_ribbon_gcd_left M hp hδ
  exact ⟨U, d, ⟨hd, hdδ⟩, hdp, fun V e he hep => hgreatest V e he.1 hep he.2⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.greatest_simp.source_declaration:
/-- A nonidentity positive generated ribbon has a nonidentity simple prefix.
Every outside atomic descent divides both it and the actual half-turn. -/
theorem greatest_simple_ribbon_prefix_ne_one {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p d : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (hpne : p ≠ 1)
    (hgreatest : ∀ (V : RibbonObject M) (e : Artin.Group M), SimpleRibbon M X V e →
      RibbonPrefix M e p → RibbonPrefix M e d) : d ≠ 1 := by
  obtain ⟨a, haX, hap⟩ := outsideAtomDescents_nonempty M hp hpne
  have hμ : PositiveReducedArrow M X (atomicNext M X a) (elementaryMu M X.indices a) :=
    .elementary a haX (elementaryMu_isRibbon M X.indices a)
  have hμδ : RibbonPrefix M (elementaryMu M X.indices a) (cofinalDelta M X.indices) :=
    parabolicDelta_ratio_elementary_prefix M X.indices Set.univ (Set.subset_univ _) a
      (Set.mem_univ a)
  have hprefix := hgreatest _ _ ⟨hμ, hμδ⟩ hap
  have hdegree := ribbonPrefix_degree_le M hprefix
  have hpositive := elementaryMu_degree_pos M X.indices a haX
  intro hd1
  rw [hd1, degree_one] at hdegree
  omega

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.greatest_simp.source_declaration:
/-- The greatest simple head leaves an actual generated tail. For a
nonidentity input that head is nontrivial and the tail has smaller degree. -/
theorem greatest_simple_ribbon_prefix_with_tail {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) :
    ∃ (U : RibbonObject M) (d a : Artin.Group M), SimpleRibbon M X U d ∧
      PositiveReducedArrow M U Y a ∧ p = d * a ∧
      (∀ (V : RibbonObject M) (e : Artin.Group M), SimpleRibbon M X V e →
        RibbonPrefix M e p → RibbonPrefix M e d) ∧
      (p ≠ 1 → d ≠ 1 ∧ degree M a < degree M p) := by
  obtain ⟨U, d, hd, hdp, hgreatest⟩ := greatest_simple_ribbon_prefix M hp
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hpa⟩ := positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M hd.1 hp hdp
  refine ⟨U, d, a, hd, ha, hpa, hgreatest, ?_⟩
  intro hpne
  have hdne := greatest_simple_ribbon_prefix_ne_one M hp hpne hgreatest
  have hdnonneg := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hd.1.positive
  have hddeg : degree M d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hdne ((degree_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hd.1.positive).mp hz)
  have hsum := congrArg (degree M) hpa
  rw [degree_mul] at hsum
  exact ⟨hdne, by omega⟩

theorem incidentSigns_iff_weak (z : E) (C : Chamber ℓ) :
    IncidentSigns ℓ z C ↔ z ∈ chamberWeakRegion ℓ C := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h h'
    cases hs : C.signs h'
    · change ℓ h' z ≤ 0
      by_contra hn
      have hp : 0 < ℓ h' z := lt_of_not_ge hn
      have he := h h' (ne_of_gt hp)
      rw [hs, decide_eq_true hp] at he
      contradiction
    · change 0 ≤ ℓ h' z
      by_contra hn
      have hp : ℓ h' z < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hn
      have he := h h' (ne_of_lt hp)
      rw [hs, decide_eq_false (not_lt_of_ge hp.le)] at he
      contradiction
  · intro h h' hz
    have hh := h h'
    cases hs : C.signs h'
    · have hn : ℓ h' z ≤ 0 := by simpa [hs] using hh
      simp only [decide_eq_false (not_lt_of_ge hn)]
    · have hn : 0 ≤ ℓ h' z := by simpa [hs] using hh
      have hp : 0 < ℓ h' z := lt_of_le_of_ne hn (Ne.symm hz)
      simp only [decide_eq_true hp]

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.isRibbon_of_a.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.isRibbon_of_ambient_positive_left_lcm
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.isRibbon_of_a.source_declaration:
/-- Any ambient positive lcm of two actual same-source ribbons is itself an
actual ribbon, with the explicit atom-transport endpoint. -/
theorem isRibbon_of_ambient_positive_left_lcm {X Y Z : RibbonObject M}
    {p q l : Artin.Group M} (hp : IsRibbon M X Y p) (hq : IsRibbon M X Z q)
    (hl : l ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hpl : RibbonPrefix M p l) (hql : RibbonPrefix M q l)
    (hleast : ∀ r, r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ →
      RibbonPrefix M p r → RibbonPrefix M q r → RibbonPrefix M l r) :
    IsRibbon M X ⟨ribbonLcmTargetIndices M X l⟩ l := by
  classical
  have hforward (i : X.indices) :
      ∃ k : I, l⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * l = Artin.generator M k := by
    have hpos : Artin.generator M i * l ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
      Submonoid.mul_mem _ (generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ (Set.mem_univ i)) hl
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hea⟩ := hleast _ hpos
      (ribbonPrefix_generator_mul M hp hpl i.property)
      (ribbonPrefix_generator_mul M hq hql i.property)
    have hd := congrArg (degree M) hea
    simp only [degree_mul, degree_generator] at hd
    obtain ⟨k, hak⟩ := positive_degree_one_generator M ha (by omega)
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    calc
      l⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * l = l⁻¹ * (Artin.generator M i * l) := by group
      _ = l⁻¹ * (l * a) := by rw [hea]
      _ = Artin.generator M k := by rw [inv_mul_cancel_left, hak]
  choose f hf using hforward
  have hrib := isRibbon_of_generator_conjugates M X.indices f l hf
  have htarget : Set.range f = ribbonLcmTargetIndices M X l := by
    ext k
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨i.val, i.property, ?_⟩
      calc
        Artin.generator M i * l = l * (l⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * l) := by group
        _ = l * Artin.generator M (f i) := by rw [hf i]
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, hrel⟩
      have he : Artin.generator M k = Artin.generator M (f ⟨i, hi⟩) := by
        calc
          Artin.generator M k = l⁻¹ * (Artin.generator M i * l) := by rw [hrel]; group
          _ = Artin.generator M (f ⟨i, hi⟩) := by simpa only [mul_assoc] using hf ⟨i, hi⟩
      have hik : k = f ⟨i, hi⟩ := M.toCoxeterSystem.simple_injective
        (by simpa only [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple, Artin.projection_generator]
          using congrArg (Artin.projection M) he)
      exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hik.symm⟩
  simpa only [htarget] using hrib

/-- The maximal face prefix has strictly positive actual degree whenever
there is a nontrivial positive ribbon to reduce. -/
theorem maximalFacePrefix_degree_pos {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (hne : p ≠ 1) :
    0 < degree M (facePrefix M X (maximalFaceType M X p)) := by
  obtain ⟨a, haX, ha⟩ := outsideAtomDescents_nonempty M hp hne
  have haD : a ∈ maximalFaceType M X p := ⟨haX, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := elementary_prefix_facePrefix M X _ haD
  have hdeg := congrArg (degree M) heq
  rw [degree_mul] at hdeg
  have hμ := elementaryMu_degree_pos M X.indices a haX
  have hqdeg := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hq
  omega

/-- Every face prefix of `p` positively divides its maximal face prefix.
The conclusion compares actual Artin elements with actual positive quotients. -/
theorem maximalFacePrefix_greatest {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (T : Set I)
    (hT : RibbonPrefix M (facePrefix M X T) p) :
    RibbonPrefix M (facePrefix M X T) (facePrefix M X (maximalFaceType M X p)) := by
  have hall := (facePrefix_prefix_iff M X T hp.positive).1 hT
  apply facePrefix_prefix_of_union_subset M X T _
  intro a ha
  rcases ha with haX | haT
  · exact Or.inl haX
  · by_cases haX : a ∈ X.indices
    · exact Or.inl haX
    · exact Or.inr ⟨haX, hall a haT⟩

/-- Removing the maximal actual face prefix strictly decreases the degree.
This is the algebraic termination input for a descending-cell argument. -/
theorem maximalFacePrefix_tail_degree_lt {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (hne : p ≠ 1) :
    ∃ q : Artin.Group M,
      PositiveReducedArrow M (facePrefixTarget M X (maximalFaceType M X p)) Y q ∧
      p = facePrefix M X (maximalFaceType M X p) * q ∧ degree M q < degree M p := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := maximalFacePrefix_tail M hp
  refine ⟨q, hq, heq, ?_⟩
  have hdeg := congrArg (degree M) heq
  rw [degree_mul] at hdeg
  have hpos := maximalFacePrefix_degree_pos M hp hne
  omega

/-- All chambers whose genuine tubes contain `p` form this precise interval.
In particular every such chamber has common actual simple interval bounds. -/
theorem mem_tubeSet_iff_chamberBetween (p : ComplexComplement ℓ) (D : Chamber ℓ) :
    p ∈ tubeSet D ↔ ChamberBetween (tubeLowerChamber ℓ p) D (tubeUpperChamber ℓ p) := by
  change p ∈ tubeSet D ↔ ChamberBetween (faceChamber ℓ p.val.1 (tubeWitness ℓ p)) D
    (faceChamber ℓ (-p.val.1) (tubeWitness ℓ p))
  rw [chamberBetween_faceChamber_pos_neg_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hp h hz
    exact halfSpace_sign_unique (ℓ h) (hp h hz) (mem_tubeWitness ℓ p h hz)
  · intro h h₀ hz
    rw [h h₀ hz]
    exact mem_tubeWitness ℓ p h₀ hz

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.outsideAtomDe.source_declaration:
theorem outsideAtomDescents_facePrefix (X : RibbonObject M) (T : Set I) :
    outsideAtomDescents M X (facePrefix M X T) = T \ X.indices := by
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨haX, q, hq, hprefix⟩
    have ha : a ∈ X.indices ∪ T := by
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hdelta⟩ :=
        (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M (insert a X.indices) a).2
          (Set.mem_insert a X.indices)
      apply (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M (X.indices ∪ T) a).1
      refine ⟨r * q, Submonoid.mul_mem _ hr hq, ?_⟩
      calc
        parabolicDelta M (X.indices ∪ T) =
            parabolicDelta M X.indices * facePrefix M X T := by unfold facePrefix; group
        _ = parabolicDelta M X.indices * (elementaryMu M X.indices a * q) := by rw [hprefix]
        _ = parabolicDelta M (insert a X.indices) * q := by unfold elementaryMu; group
        _ = Artin.generator M a * (r * q) := by rw [hdelta, mul_assoc]
    exact ⟨ha.resolve_left haX, haX⟩
  · rintro ⟨haT, haX⟩
    exact ⟨haX, elementary_prefix_facePrefix M X T haT⟩

/-- Every nonidentity positive generated ribbon has an actual outside
elementary prefix. -/
theorem outsideAtomDescents_nonempty {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (hne : p ≠ 1) :
    (outsideAtomDescents M X p).Nonempty := by

  | nil X => exact False.elim (hne (by simpa only [AtomicWord.eval_nil] using hw.symm))
  | cons a ha w =>

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.parabolicLong.source_declaration:
/-- The actual longest element of a standard parabolic makes every
positive root supported on that parabolic negative. -/
theorem parabolicLongest_positive_supported_negative (U : Set I)
    {r : Vector I} (hrroot : r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots)
    (hrpos : 0 < r) (hsupp : ∀ i, i ∉ U → r i = 0) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (parabolicLongest M U) r < 0 := by
  classical
  let cs := M.toCoxeterSystem
  let longest := parabolicLongest M U
  have simple_negative (i : I) (hi : i ∈ U) :
      cs.geometricRepresentation longest (Finsupp.single i 1) < 0 := by
    apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff longest i).2
    by_contra hdesc
    have hlen := cs.not_isRightDescent_iff.mp hdesc
    have hmem : longest * cs.simple i ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M U :=
      (Artin.coxeterParabolic M U).mul_mem (parabolicLongest_mem_parabolic M U)
        (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    have hmax := parabolicLongest_max M U hmem
    dsimp only [cs, longest] at hlen hmax
    omega
  have expand : r.sum (fun i a => a • Finsupp.single i (1 : ℝ)) = r := by
    simpa only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using r.sum_single
  have nonpositive : cs.geometricRepresentation longest r ≤ 0 := by
    rw [← expand]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, map_sum, map_smul]
    apply Finset.sum_nonpos
    intro i hi
    have hiU : i ∈ U := by
      by_contra hn
      exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hsupp i hn)
    exact smul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hrpos.le i) (simple_negative i hiU).le
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne nonpositive
  exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (cs.geometricRepresentation.apply_bijective longest).injective).2
    (cs.ne_zero_of_mem_geometricRoots hrroot)

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_redu.source_declaration:
/-- A specific power of the actual cofinal loop is a common positive reduced
upper bound for any two positive generated ribbons with the same source. -/
theorem positive_reduced_ribbon_common_upper_bound {X Y Z : RibbonObject M}
    {p q : Artin.Group M} (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p)
    (hq : PositiveReducedArrow M X Z q) :
    ∃ r : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M X X r ∧
      RibbonPrefix M p r ∧ RibbonPrefix M q r := by
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, hpa⟩ := hp.positive_complement M
  obtain ⟨m, b, hb, hqb⟩ := hq.positive_complement M
  refine ⟨cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ (n + m), positive_cofinalLoop_pow M X (n + m), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨a * cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ m,
      (PositiveReducedArrow.comp ha (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M X m)).positive, ?_⟩
    rw [← mul_assoc, hpa, ← pow_add]
  · refine ⟨b * cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ n,
      (PositiveReducedArrow.comp hb (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M X n)).positive, ?_⟩
    rw [← mul_assoc, hqb, ← pow_add, Nat.add_comm]

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_redu.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_reduced_ribbon_gcd_left
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_redu.source_declaration:
/-- Greatest common actual generated positive prefix, retaining its genuine
intermediate endpoint. Only finite Coxeter type is assumed. -/
theorem positive_reduced_ribbon_gcd_left {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} {p q : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (hq : PositiveReducedArrow M X Z q) :
    ∃ (U : RibbonObject M) (d : Artin.Group M),
      PositiveReducedArrow M X U d ∧ RibbonPrefix M d p ∧ RibbonPrefix M d q ∧
      ∀ (V : RibbonObject M) (e : Artin.Group M), PositiveReducedArrow M X V e →
        RibbonPrefix M e p → RibbonPrefix M e q → RibbonPrefix M e d := by
  classical
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n => ∃ (U : RibbonObject M) (d : Artin.Group M),
    PositiveReducedArrow M X U d ∧ RibbonPrefix M d p ∧ RibbonPrefix M d q ∧
      (degree M d).toNat = n
  have hzero : P 0 :=
    ⟨X, 1, .identity X, ⟨p, hp.positive, (one_mul p).symm⟩,
      ⟨q, hq.positive, (one_mul q).symm⟩, by rw [degree_one]; rfl⟩
  have hmax : P (Nat.findGreatest P (degree M p).toNat) :=
    Nat.findGreatest_spec (Nat.zero_le _) hzero
  obtain ⟨U, d, hd, hdp, hdq, hdegree⟩ := hmax
  refine ⟨U, d, hd, hdp, hdq, ?_⟩
  intro V e he hep heq
  obtain ⟨W, l, hl, ⟨a, ha, hla⟩, ⟨b, hb, hlb⟩, hleast⟩ :=
    positive_reduced_ribbon_lcm_left M hd he
  have hdl : RibbonPrefix M d l := ⟨a, ha.positive, hla⟩
  have hel : RibbonPrefix M e l := ⟨b, hb.positive, hlb⟩
  have hlp := hleast p hp.positive hdp hep
  have hlq := hleast q hq.positive hdq heq
  have hbound : (degree M l).toNat ≤ (degree M p).toNat := by
    have := ribbonPrefix_degree_le M hlp
    omega
  have hmaxl : (degree M l).toNat ≤ Nat.findGreatest P (degree M p).toNat :=
    Nat.le_findGreatest hbound ⟨W, l, hl, hlp, hlq, rfl⟩
  have hldeg : degree M l ≤ degree M d := by
    have := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hl.positive
    have := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hd.positive
    omega
  have hld : l = d := (ribbonPrefix_eq_of_degree_le M hdl hldeg).symm
  simpa only [hld] using hel

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_redu.source_declaration:
/-- The greatest common prefix has actual generated positive tails to both
original targets, and every other common prefix has a generated tail to it. -/
theorem positive_reduced_ribbon_gcd_left_with_tails {X Y Z : RibbonObject M}
    {p q : Artin.Group M} (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p)
    (hq : PositiveReducedArrow M X Z q) :
    ∃ (U : RibbonObject M) (d : Artin.Group M), PositiveReducedArrow M X U d ∧
      (∃ a : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M U Y a ∧ p = d * a) ∧
      (∃ b : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M U Z b ∧ q = d * b) ∧
      ∀ (V : RibbonObject M) (e : Artin.Group M), PositiveReducedArrow M X V e →
        RibbonPrefix M e p → RibbonPrefix M e q →
        ∃ t : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M V U t ∧ d = e * t := by
  obtain ⟨U, d, hd, hdp, hdq, hgreatest⟩ := positive_reduced_ribbon_gcd_left M hp hq
  refine ⟨U, d, hd, positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M hd hp hdp,
    positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M hd hq hdq, ?_⟩
  intro V e he hep heq
  exact positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M he hd (hgreatest V e he hep heq)

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_redu.source_declaration:
/-- Arbitrary same-source positive reduced ribbons have an actual left-lcm,
with actual positive generated tails and the ambient positive universal property.
No lattice structure or closure conclusion is supplied as a hypothesis. -/
theorem positive_reduced_ribbon_lcm_left {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} {p q : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (hq : PositiveReducedArrow M X Z q) :
    ∃ (U : RibbonObject M) (l : Artin.Group M),
      PositiveReducedArrow M X U l ∧
      (∃ a : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M Y U a ∧ l = p * a) ∧
      (∃ b : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M Z U b ∧ l = q * b) ∧
      ∀ r, r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ →
        RibbonPrefix M p r → RibbonPrefix M q r → RibbonPrefix M l r := by
  obtain ⟨l, hlpos, hpl, hql, hleast⟩ := ambient_positive_left_lcm M hp.positive hq.positive
  let U : RibbonObject M := ⟨ribbonLcmTargetIndices M X l⟩
  have hlrib : IsRibbon M X U l :=
    isRibbon_of_ambient_positive_left_lcm M hp.isRibbon hq.isRibbon hlpos hpl hql hleast
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr, hqr⟩ := positive_reduced_ribbon_common_upper_bound M hp hq
  have hlred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices l :=
    ribbonPrefix_leftReduced M (hr.leftReduced M) (hleast r hr.positive hpr hqr)
  have hlgen := positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated M hlpos hlred hlrib
  exact ⟨U, l, hlgen, positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M hp hlgen hpl,
    positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M hq hlgen hql, hleast⟩

/-- The least ambient prefix also factors every common positive ribbon upper
bound through a positive generated tail at the genuine lcm endpoint. -/
theorem positive_reduced_ribbon_lcm_left_with_tails {X Y Z : RibbonObject M}
    {p q : Artin.Group M} (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p)
    (hq : PositiveReducedArrow M X Z q) :
    ∃ (U : RibbonObject M) (l : Artin.Group M),
      PositiveReducedArrow M X U l ∧
      (∃ a : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M Y U a ∧ l = p * a) ∧
      (∃ b : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M Z U b ∧ l = q * b) ∧
      ∀ (V : RibbonObject M) (r : Artin.Group M), PositiveReducedArrow M X V r →
        RibbonPrefix M p r → RibbonPrefix M q r →
        ∃ t : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M U V t ∧ r = l * t := by
  obtain ⟨U, l, hl, hp', hq', hleast⟩ := positive_reduced_ribbon_lcm_left M hp hq
  refine ⟨U, l, hl, hp', hq', ?_⟩
  intro V r hr hpr hqr
  exact positive_ribbon_prefix_tail M hl hr (hleast r hr.positive hpr hqr)

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_ribb.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_ribbon_face_tail
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_ribb.source_declaration:
/-- Removing an actual positive face prefix leaves an actual positive reduced
ribbon with its genuine intermediate endpoint. -/
theorem positive_ribbon_face_tail {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (T : Set I)
    (hprefix : RibbonPrefix M (facePrefix M X T) p) :
    ∃ q : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M (facePrefixTarget M X T) Y q ∧
      p = facePrefix M X T * q := by
  obtain ⟨q, hqpos, hfactor⟩ := hprefix
  let η := facePrefix M X T
  let Z := facePrefixTarget M X T
  have hη : IsRibbon M X Z η := facePrefix_isRibbon M X T
  have hηpos : η ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ := facePrefix_positive M X T
  have hqRibbon : IsRibbon M Z Y q := by
    have h := IsRibbon.mul M (IsRibbon.inv M hη) hp.isRibbon
    have he : η⁻¹ * p = q := by rw [hfactor]; dsimp only [η]; group
    simpa only [he] using h
  have hqred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M Z.indices q := by
    intro j hj s hs he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hrel⟩ := IsRibbon.generator_reverse M hη hj
    apply (hp.leftReduced M) i hi (η * s) (Submonoid.mul_mem _ hηpos hs)
    rw [← mul_assoc, hrel, mul_assoc, he]
    exact hfactor.symm
  exact ⟨q, positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated M hqpos hqred hqRibbon, hfactor⟩

theorem positive_ribbon_face_tail_of_elementary_prefixes {X Y : RibbonObject M}
    {p : Artin.Group M} (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (T : Set I)
    (hall : ∀ a ∈ T, RibbonPrefix M (elementaryMu M X.indices a) p) :
    ∃ q : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M (facePrefixTarget M X T) Y q ∧
      p = facePrefix M X T * q :=
  positive_ribbon_face_tail M hp T ((facePrefix_prefix_iff M X T hp.positive).2 hall)

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_ribb.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_ribbon_prefix_tail
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.positive_ribb.source_declaration:
/-- Removing any positive generated ribbon prefix leaves a positive generated
ribbon at its actual intermediate endpoint. -/
theorem positive_ribbon_prefix_tail {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} {p r : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (hr : PositiveReducedArrow M X Z r)
    (hpr : RibbonPrefix M p r) :
    ∃ a : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M Y Z a ∧ r = p * a := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hra⟩ := hpr
  have harib : IsRibbon M Y Z a := by
    have h := (hp.isRibbon.inv M).mul M hr.isRibbon
    have he : p⁻¹ * r = a := by rw [hra]; group
    simpa only [he] using h
  have hared : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M Y.indices a := by
    intro j hj b hb he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hrel⟩ := hp.isRibbon.generator_reverse M hj
    apply (hr.leftReduced M) i hi (p * b) (Submonoid.mul_mem _ hp.positive hb)
    rw [← mul_assoc, hrel, mul_assoc, he]
    exact hra.symm
  exact ⟨a, positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated M ha hared harib, hra⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.pullbackLocal.source_declaration:
/-- Transport genuine local connector data through an actual homeomorphism. -/
def pullbackLocalEquiconnection (h : A ≃ₜ B) (F : LocalEquiconnection B) :
    LocalEquiconnection A where
  domain := (fun p : A × A => (h p.1, h p.2)) ⁻¹' F.domain
  isOpen_domain := F.isOpen_domain.preimage
    ((h.continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk (h.continuous.comp continuous_snd))
  diagonal_mem x := F.diagonal_mem (h x)
  connector :=
    { toFun := fun z => h.symm (F.connector (⟨(h z.1.val.1, h z.1.val.2), z.1.property⟩, z.2))
      continuous_toFun := by fun_prop }
  connector_zero p := by simp [F.connector_zero]
  connector_one p := by simp [F.connector_one]
  connector_diagonal x t := by simp [F.connector_diagonal]

on all other outside simple coordinates, then transported by the raw label. -/

  facetFlatEquiv L ⟨canonicalDominant (L.indices ∪ T), by

    (i : {i : I // i ∉ L.indices}) :
    rawFacetCoordinates L (rawFacePoint M J L T) i = if i.val ∈ T then 0 else 1 := by
  classical
  unfold rawFacetCoordinates rawFacePoint
  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.trans_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    flatComplementCoordinates_apply,
    canonicalDominant_apply_simpleRoot]

theorem rawFacePoint_incident (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (T : Set I) :
    ChamberIncident (actualForms M J) (rawFacePoint M J L T) (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) := by
  have he : translatedFacet L = (rawFacetCoordinates L) ⁻¹'
      positiveOrthant {i : I // i ∉ L.indices} :=
    Set.ext (mem_translatedFacet_iff_coordinates_pos L)
  have hc : (rawFacetCoordinates L) ⁻¹' closure (positiveOrthant {i : I // i ∉ L.indices}) =
      closure ((rawFacetCoordinates L) ⁻¹' positiveOrthant {i : I // i ∉ L.indices}) :=
    (rawFacetCoordinates L).toHomeomorph.preimage_closure _
  rw [ChamberIncident, actualChamberOfRawLabel_region, he, ← hc, closure_positiveOrthant]
  intro i
  rw [rawFacePoint_coordinates]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

/-- Actual residue incidence is precisely the chamber interval ending at
the actual face-prefix endpoint. -/
theorem rawFacePoint_incident_iff_between_facePrefix (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (T : Set I)
    (D : ActualChamber M J) :
    ChamberIncident (actualForms M J) (rawFacePoint M J L T) D ↔
      ChamberBetween (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D
        (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (facePrefixLabel M J L T)) := by
  rw [facePrefixLabel_eq_oppositeAtFace]
  exact chamberIncident_iff_between_oppositeAtFace _ (rawFacePoint_incident M J L T) D

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.rawFacePoint_.source_declaration:
/-- Residue incidence is equivalent to actual positive left divisibility
of the face prefix by the chamber's canonical simple ribbon. -/
theorem rawFacePoint_incident_iff_ribbonPrefix (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (T : Set I)
    (D : ActualChamber M J) :
    ChamberIncident (actualForms M J) (rawFacePoint M J L T) D ↔
      RibbonPrefix M (transporterPositiveLift M
        (relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D)) (facePrefix M ⟨L.indices⟩ T) := by
  rw [rawFacePoint_incident_iff_between_facePrefix, chamberBetween_iff_relativeTransport_length,
    relativeTransport_eq_raw M J L (facePrefixLabel M J L T), rawRelativeTransport_facePrefixLabel]
  have hη := facePrefix_eq_simpleLift_projection M (⟨L.indices⟩ : RibbonObject M) T
  simpa only [← hη] using
    (ribbonPrefix_simpleLift_iff M
      (relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D)
      (Artin.projection M (facePrefix M ⟨L.indices⟩ T))).symm

    (rawFacePoint M J L T).val
      (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation L.representative r) =

theorem rawRelativeTransport_facePrefixLabel (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (T : Set I) :
    rawRelativeTransport M L (facePrefixLabel M J L T) =
      Artin.projection M (facePrefix M ⟨L.indices⟩ T) := by
  unfold rawRelativeTransport
  change M.toCoxeterSystem.minimalCosetRep (facePrefixTarget M ⟨L.indices⟩ T).indices
    (L.representative⁻¹ * (L.representative * Artin.projection M (facePrefix M ⟨L.indices⟩ T))) = _
  rw [inv_mul_cancel_left]
  exact (facePrefix_projection_minimal M ⟨L.indices⟩ T).minimalCosetRep_eq _

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.residueToFace.source_declaration:
noncomputable def residueToFaceDivisor (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (T : Set I)
    (D : FaceResidue M J L T) : SimpleFaceDivisor M ⟨L.indices⟩ T := by
  let d := relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D.val
  refine ⟨transporterPositiveLift M d, ⟨⟨actualChamberIndices M J D.val⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · simpa only [actualChamberIndices_rawLabel] using transporterPositiveLift_generated M
      (relativeTransport_conjugacy M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D.val)
      (relativeTransport_minimal M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D.val)
  · rw [projection_transporterPositiveLift]
  · exact (rawFacePoint_incident_iff_ribbonPrefix M J L T D.val).mp D.property

ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.residueToFace.source_declaration:
theorem residueToFaceDivisor_injective (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (T : Set I) :
    Function.Injective (residueToFaceDivisor M J L T) := by
  intro D E h
  have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
  change transporterPositiveLift M (relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D.val) =
    transporterPositiveLift M (relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) E.val) at hv
  have hd := congrArg (Artin.projection M) hv
  simp only [projection_transporterPositiveLift] at hd
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact relativeTransport_injective M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) hd
