ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.residueToFace.name: ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.residueToFaceDivisor_surjective
ArtinNormalisers.Homotopy5.residueToFace.source_declaration:
theorem residueToFaceDivisor_surjective (L : RawFacetLabel M J) (T : Set I) :
    Function.Surjective (residueToFaceDivisor M J L T) := by
  rintro ⟨p, ⟨Y, hp, hs, hpref⟩⟩
  let C : ChamberFiber M J (⟨L.indices⟩ : RibbonObject M) :=
    ⟨actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L, actualChamberIndices_rawLabel M J L⟩
  let D : ChamberFiber M J Y := fiberTarget M J (X := ⟨L.indices⟩) (Y := Y)
    (Artin.projection M p) (isRibbon_projection_transporter M hp.isRibbon) C
  have hmin := simple_reduced_projection_minimal M hp.isRibbon hp.leftReduced hs
  have hrel : relativeTransport M J C.val D.val = Artin.projection M p :=
    relativeTransport_fiberTarget M J _ _ hmin C
  have hvalue : transporterPositiveLift M
      (relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D.val) = p := by
    rw [show relativeTransport M J (actualChamberOfRawLabel M J L) D.val =
      Artin.projection M p from hrel]
    exact hs.symm
  have hinc : ChamberIncident (actualForms M J) (rawFacePoint M J L T) D.val := by
    apply (rawFacePoint_incident_iff_ribbonPrefix M J L T D.val).mpr
    rw [hvalue]
    exact hpref
  refine ⟨⟨D.val, hinc⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hvalue

theorem ribbonPrefix_degree_le {a b : Artin.Group M} (hab : RibbonPrefix M a b) :
    degree M a ≤ degree M b := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hab

/-- A positive quotient with no degree increase is one. -/
theorem ribbonPrefix_eq_of_degree_le {a b : Artin.Group M} (hab : RibbonPrefix M a b)
    (hdeg : degree M b ≤ degree M a) : a = b := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hbc⟩ := hab
  have hnonneg := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hc
  have hsum := congrArg (degree M) hbc
  rw [degree_mul] at hsum
  have hc0 : degree M c = 0 := by omega
  have hc1 := (degree_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hc).mp hc0
  simpa only [hc1, mul_one] using hbc.symm

/-- An atom transported across a ribbon also transports across any positive
extension of that ribbon. -/
theorem ribbonPrefix_generator_mul {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p l : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : IsRibbon M X Y p) (hpl : RibbonPrefix M p l) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ X.indices) :
    RibbonPrefix M p (Artin.generator M i * l) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hpl
  obtain ⟨j, _, hrel⟩ := hp.generator_forward M hi
  refine ⟨Artin.generator M j * a, Submonoid.mul_mem _
    (generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ (Set.mem_univ j)) ha, ?_⟩
  rw [hla, ← mul_assoc, hrel, mul_assoc]

/-- Positive prefixes inherit source left reduction from an actual upper bound. -/
theorem ribbonPrefix_leftReduced {X : RibbonObject M} {l r : Artin.Group M}
    (hr : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices r) (hlr : RibbonPrefix M l r) :
    IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices l := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hrb⟩ := hlr
  intro i hi a ha hea
  apply hr i hi (a * b) (Submonoid.mul_mem _ ha hb)
  rw [← mul_assoc, hea]
  exact hrb.symm

theorem ribbonPrefix_simpleLift_iff (u v : M.Group) :
    RibbonPrefix M (transporterPositiveLift M u) (transporterPositiveLift M v) ↔
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length v = M.toCoxeterSystem.length u +
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (u⁻¹ * v) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  exact (positivePrefix_iff_parentQuotient M _ _).symm.trans
    (OAI.HarmonicArtin.positivePrefix_simple_iff M u v)

/-- The full ambient Coxeter stabilizer of both coordinates of an actual
complement point is exactly the generated parabolic. -/
theorem complement_pair_stabilizer_iff [Finite M.Group]
    (p : Complement M J) (g : M.Group) :
    (dualAction M g p.val.1.val = p.val.1.val ∧
      dualAction M g p.val.2.val = p.val.2.val) ↔
      g ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_regular_linearCombination M J p
    apply (realRelativeRegular_fixed_iff M J _ hab g).1
    change dualAction M g (a • p.val.1.val + b • p.val.2.val) = _
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hx, hy]
    rfl
  · intro hg
    exact ⟨(mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M J _).1 p.val.1.property g hg,
      (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M J _).1 p.val.2.property g hg⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.dominant_fixe.name: ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.dominant_fixed_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.dominant_fixe.source_declaration:
/-- The stabilizer of a dominant dual point is its actual generated standard
parabolic. No stabilizer or freeness theorem is assumed. -/
theorem dominant_fixed_iff (M : CoxeterMatrix I) {φ : Dual I} (hφ : IsDominant φ)
    (w : M.Group) :
    dualAction M w φ = φ ↔ w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M (zeroIndices φ) := by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have key : ∀ n (u : M.Group), M.toCoxeterSystem.length u = n →
        dualAction M u φ = φ → u ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M (zeroIndices φ) := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | ind n ih =>
        intro u hn hu
        by_cases hu1 : u = 1
        · subst u
          exact Subgroup.one_mem _
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := M.toCoxeterSystem.exists_leftDescent_of_ne_one hu1
        have hneg :
            M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation u⁻¹ (simpleRoot i) < 0 :=
          (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff u⁻¹ i).2
            (M.toCoxeterSystem.isRightDescent_inv_iff.mpr hi)
        have hnonpos := evaluation_nonpos_of_nonpos hφ hneg.le
        have heval :
            φ (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation u⁻¹ (simpleRoot i)) =
              φ (simpleRoot i) :=
          congrArg (fun ψ : Dual I => ψ (simpleRoot i)) hu
        have hzero : φ (simpleRoot i) = 0 :=
          le_antisymm (heval ▸ hnonpos) (hφ i)
        have hsimple := (dualAction_simple_fixed_iff M i φ).2 hzero
        have hshortFixed : dualAction M (M.simple i * u) φ = φ := by
          rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, hu, hsimple]
        have hshortLt : M.toCoxeterSystem.length (M.simple i * u) < n := by
          have hlen := M.toCoxeterSystem.isLeftDescent_iff.mp hi
          change M.toCoxeterSystem.length (M.simple i * u) + 1 =
            M.toCoxeterSystem.length u at hlen
          omega
        have hshort := ih (M.toCoxeterSystem.length (M.simple i * u))
          hshortLt (M.simple i * u) rfl hshortFixed
        have hsimpleMem : M.simple i ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M (zeroIndices φ) :=
          Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hzero, rfl⟩
        have hcancel : M.simple i * (M.simple i * u) = u :=
          M.toCoxeterSystem.simple_mul_simple_cancel_left i
        exact hcancel ▸ Subgroup.mul_mem _ hsimpleMem hshort
    exact key _ w rfl hw
  · intro hw
    exact (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M (zeroIndices φ) φ).1
      (fun _ hi => hi) w hw

ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.evaluation_no.source_declaration:
/-- A dominant functional is nonpositive on coordinatewise nonpositive
vectors. Only the finite support of the input vector is summed. -/
theorem evaluation_nonpos_of_nonpos {φ : Dual I} (hφ : IsDominant φ)
    {v : Vector I} (hv : v ≤ 0) : φ v ≤ 0 := by
  classical
  have he : φ = Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ (fun i => φ (simpleRoot i)) :=
    (dualCoordinates (I := I)).symm_apply_apply φ |>.symm
  rw [he, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_nonpos fun i _ => mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hv i) (hφ i)

ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.exists_domina.name: ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.exists_dominant_dualAction
ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.exists_domina.source_declaration:
/-- A finite actual dual orbit has a representative in the closed dominant chamber. -/
theorem exists_dominant_dualAction [Finite M.Group] (φ : Dual I) :
    ∃ u : M.Group, IsDominant (dualAction M u φ) := by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite M.Group
  obtain ⟨u, _, hu⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
    (fun w : M.Group => dualAction M w φ (positiveRootSum M)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨u, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hle := hu (M.simple i * u) (Finset.mem_univ _)
  have hsimple : M.toCoxeterSystem.simple i = M.simple i := by
    rw [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple]
  have heval : dualAction M (M.simple i * u) φ (positiveRootSum M) =
      dualAction M u φ (positiveRootSum M) - 2 * dualAction M u φ (simpleRoot i) := by
    rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, dualAction_apply, ← hsimple,
      M.toCoxeterSystem.inv_simple, M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_simple,
      geometricReflection_positiveRootSum, map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [heval] at hle
  linarith

ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.exists_regula.name: ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.exists_regular_linearCombination
ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.exists_regula.source_declaration:
/-- An actual complement point has a real regular linear combination of its
two coordinates. No chamber point or positive dimension is assumed. -/
theorem exists_regular_linearCombination [Finite M.Group] (p : Complement M J) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, realRelativeRegular M J (a • p.val.1 + b • p.val.2) := by
  classical
  let := (retainedRoots_finite M J).fintype
  let f : retainedRoots M J → (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    fun r => coefficientEvaluation J p.val r.val
  have hf : ∀ r, ∃ c, f r c ≠ 0 := by
    intro r
    by_cases hx : p.val.1.val r.val = 0
    · refine ⟨(0, 1), ?_⟩
      have hy : p.val.2.val r.val ≠ 0 := fun hy => p.property r.val r.property ⟨hx, hy⟩
      simpa [f, coefficientEvaluation] using hy
    · exact ⟨(1, 0), by simpa [f, coefficientEvaluation] using hx⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Module.Dual.exists_forall_ne_zero_of_forall_exists f hf
  refine ⟨c.1, c.2, fun r hr => ?_⟩
  simpa [f, coefficientEvaluation, mul_comm] using hc ⟨r, hr⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.geometricRefl.name: ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.geometricReflection_positiveRootSum
ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.geometricRefl.source_declaration:
/-- Reflecting the positive-root sum subtracts twice the simple root. -/
theorem geometricReflection_positiveRootSum [Finite M.Group] (i : I) :
    M.geometricReflection i (positiveRootSum M) = positiveRootSum M - (2 : ℝ) • simpleRoot i := by
  classical
  let S := (positiveRoots_finite M).toFinset
  let a := simpleRoot i
  have hmem (r : Vector I) : r ∈ S ↔ r ∈ roots M ∧ 0 < r := by
    simp only [S, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, positiveRoots, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  have ha : a ∈ S := by
    apply (hmem a).2
    refine ⟨⟨1, i, root_one M i⟩, ?_⟩
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr zero_le_one)
      (Finsupp.single_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero).symm
  have hbij := M.toCoxeterSystem.bijOn_geometricReflection_geometricRoots i
  have herase (r : Vector I) : r ∈ S.erase a ↔
      r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < r ∧ r ≠ Finsupp.single i 1 := by
    rw [Finset.mem_erase, hmem, roots_eq_geometricRoots]
    change (r ≠ Finsupp.single i 1 ∧ r ∈ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < r) ↔ _
    tauto
  have hsum : (∑ r ∈ S.erase a, M.geometricReflection i r) = ∑ r ∈ S.erase a, r := by
    apply Finset.sum_bij (fun r _ => M.geometricReflection i r)
    · intro r hr
      exact (herase _).2 (hbij.mapsTo ((herase r).1 hr))
    · intro r hr s hs hrs
      exact hbij.injOn ((herase r).1 hr) ((herase s).1 hs) hrs
    · intro r hr
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩ := hbij.surjOn ((herase r).1 hr)
      exact ⟨s, (herase s).2 hs, hsr⟩
    · intro r hr
      rfl
  have hdecomp : positiveRootSum M = a + ∑ r ∈ S.erase a, r := by
    exact (Finset.add_sum_erase S (fun r => r) ha).symm
  have harefl : M.geometricReflection i a = -a :=
    M.geometricReflection_apply_single_self i
  rw [hdecomp, map_add, map_sum, hsum, harefl]
  change -a + ∑ r ∈ S.erase a, r = (a + ∑ r ∈ S.erase a, r) - (2 : ℝ) • a
  module

/-- The pointwise stabilizer of the actual relative dual flat is exactly the
actual standard parabolic. This is valid in arbitrary Coxeter type. -/
theorem pointwise_flat_fixed_iff (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I) (w : M.Group) :
    (∀ φ : relativeSubspace J, dualAction M w φ.val = φ.val) ↔
      w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    exact (canonicalDominant_fixed_iff M J w).1
      (hw ⟨canonicalDominant J, canonicalDominant_mem_relativeSubspace J⟩)
  · intro hw φ
    exact (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M J φ.val).1 φ.property w hw

ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.quotientCompl.source_declaration:
/-- The actual action of `N_W(W_J)/W_J` on the actual complex complement is free. -/
theorem quotientComplement_smul_fixed_iff [Finite M.Group]
    (q : Artin.coxeterNormalizerQuotient M J) (p : Complement M J) :
    q • p = p ↔ q = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hq
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
      ((Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf (CoxeterNormalizer M J)) q
    have hx := congrArg (fun z : Complement M J => z.val.1.val) hq
    have hy := congrArg (fun z : Complement M J => z.val.2.val) hq
    change dualAction M w.val p.val.1.val = p.val.1.val at hx
    change dualAction M w.val p.val.2.val = p.val.2.val at hy
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff w).2
      ((complement_pair_stabilizer_iff M J p w.val).1 ⟨hx, hy⟩)
  · rintro rfl
    exact one_smul _ _

ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.realRelativeR.name: ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.realRelativeRegular_fixed_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Landmark1.realRelativeR.source_declaration:
/-- The full Coxeter stabilizer of a real regular relative point is the
actual generated parabolic, without assuming that an element normalizes it. -/
theorem realRelativeRegular_fixed_iff [Finite M.Group]
    (φ : relativeSubspace J) (hφ : realRelativeRegular M J φ) (g : M.Group) :
    dualAction M g φ.val = φ.val ↔ g ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_dominant_dualAction M φ.val
    let ψ := dualAction M u φ.val
    have hconj : dualAction M (u * g * u⁻¹) ψ = ψ := by
      dsimp only [ψ]
      rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul]
      have heq : u * g * u⁻¹ * u = u * g := by group
      rw [heq, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, hg]
    have hpar := (dominant_fixed_iff M hu (u * g * u⁻¹)).1 hconj
    have hle : Artin.coxeterParabolic M (zeroIndices ψ) ≤
        (flatPointwiseStabilizer M J).comap (MulAut.conj u⁻¹).toMonoidHom := by
      change Subgroup.closure (M.simple '' zeroIndices ψ) ≤ _
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
      rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      have hβroot : root M u⁻¹ i ∈ roots M := ⟨u⁻¹, i, rfl⟩
      have hβzero : φ.val (root M u⁻¹ i) = 0 := hi
      have hβann : ∀ f : relativeSubspace J, f.val (root M u⁻¹ i) = 0 := by
        intro f
        by_contra hf
        exact (hφ _ ⟨hβroot, f, hf⟩) hβzero
      intro f
      have hsf : dualAction M (M.simple i) (dualAction M u f.val) =
          dualAction M u f.val := by
        apply (dualAction_simple_fixed_iff M i _).2
        exact hβann f
      have h := congrArg (fun a => dualAction M u⁻¹ a) hsf
      change dualAction M (u⁻¹ * M.simple i * (u⁻¹)⁻¹) f.val = f.val
      simpa only [inv_inv, ← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, mul_assoc,
        map_one, one_apply_eq_self] using h
    have hgflat := hle hpar
    have heq : u⁻¹ * (u * g * u⁻¹) * (u⁻¹)⁻¹ = g := by group
    change ∀ f : relativeSubspace J,
      dualAction M (u⁻¹ * (u * g * u⁻¹) * (u⁻¹)⁻¹) f.val = f.val at hgflat
    rw [heq] at hgflat
    exact (pointwise_flat_fixed_iff M J g).1 hgflat
  · intro hg
    exact (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M J φ.val).1 φ.property g hg

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.AtomicRelation.source_declaration:
/-- The congruence generated by fixed actual pair-lcm words. -/
inductive AtomicRelation : {X Y : RibbonObject M} → AtomicWord M X Y → AtomicWord M X Y → Prop
  | refl {X Y} (p : AtomicWord M X Y) : AtomicRelation p p
  | symm {X Y} {p q : AtomicWord M X Y} : AtomicRelation p q → AtomicRelation q p
  | trans {X Y} {p q r : AtomicWord M X Y} :
      AtomicRelation p q → AtomicRelation q r → AtomicRelation p r
  | lcm (X : RibbonObject M) (a b : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices) (hb : b ∉ X.indices) (hab : a ≠ b) :
      AtomicRelation
        (.cons a ha (chosenLcmLeftTail M X a b ha hb hab))
        (.cons b hb (chosenLcmRightTail M X a b ha hb hab))
  | precontext {X Y Z} (p : AtomicWord M X Y) {q r : AtomicWord M Y Z} :
      AtomicRelation q r → AtomicRelation (p.append q) (p.append r)
  | postcontext {X Y Z} {p q : AtomicWord M X Y} : AtomicRelation p q →
      (r : AtomicWord M Y Z) → AtomicRelation (p.append r) (q.append r)

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.AtomicRelation..name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.AtomicRelation.cons
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.AtomicRelation..source_declaration:
theorem cons {X Y : RibbonObject M} (a : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices)
    {p q : AtomicWord M (atomicNext M X a) Y} (h : AtomicRelation M p q) :

/-- Every actual pair-lcm relation word has length-additive Coxeter evaluation.
The geometric consequence that its gallery is geodesic belongs to landmark 3. -/
theorem pairLcm_coxeter_length_additive {X Y : RibbonObject M}

    parabolicLongest M (insert b (insert a X.indices)), ?_⟩
  rw [he]
  exact parabolicDelta_ratio_eq_simpleLift M X.indices
    (insert b (insert a X.indices)) (fun _ h => Set.mem_insert_of_mem b (Set.mem_insert_of_mem a h))

to `A⁺_X β = β A⁺_Y`. -/

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.IsRibbon.cofina.source_declaration:
/-- Actual ribbon transport makes these concrete loops natural. -/
theorem IsRibbon.cofinalLoop_mul {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r : Artin.Group M}
    (h : IsRibbon M X Y r) :
    r * cofinalLoop M Y.indices = cofinalLoop M X.indices * r := by
  have hc := IsRibbon.parabolicDelta_conjugate M h
  have hm : r * (parabolicDelta M Y.indices)⁻¹ =
      (parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ * r := by
    rw [← hc]
    group
  have hz := (globalDelta_square_commute M r).eq
  unfold cofinalLoop
  calc
    _ = (r * (parabolicDelta M Y.indices)⁻¹) *
        (parabolicDelta M Y.indices)⁻¹ * (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2 := by group
    _ = ((parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ * r) *
        (parabolicDelta M Y.indices)⁻¹ * (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2 := by rw [hm]
    _ = (parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ *
        (r * (parabolicDelta M Y.indices)⁻¹) * (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2 := by group
    _ = (parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ *
        ((parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ * r) * (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2 := by rw [hm]
    _ = ((parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹)^2 *
        (r * (parabolicDelta M Set.univ)^2) := by group
    _ = _ := by rw [← hz]; group

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.IsRibbon.conjug.source_declaration:
/-- A ribbon conjugates the actual Coxeter parabolics by its canonical
projection, rather than by an independently chosen Coxeter element. -/
theorem IsRibbon.conjugates_coxeterParabolic {X Y : RibbonObject M}
    {β : Artin.Group M} (hβ : IsRibbon M X Y β) (w : M.Group) :
    w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M X.indices ↔
      (Artin.projection M β)⁻¹ * w * Artin.projection M β ∈
        Artin.coxeterParabolic M Y.indices := by
  have forward {U V : RibbonObject M} {b : Artin.Group M}
      (hb : IsRibbon M U V b) {v : M.Group}
      (hv : v ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M U.indices) :
      (Artin.projection M b)⁻¹ * v * Artin.projection M b ∈
        Artin.coxeterParabolic M V.indices := by
    rw [← Artin.map_parabolic M U.indices] at hv
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hpa⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hv
    have hm : Artin.projection M (b⁻¹ * a * b) ∈
        (Artin.parabolic M V.indices).map (Artin.projection M) := Subgroup.mem_map.mpr
      ⟨b⁻¹ * a * b, (hb.conjugates_parabolic M a).mp ha, rfl⟩
    rw [Artin.map_parabolic M V.indices] at hm
    simpa only [map_mul, map_inv, hpa] using hm
  constructor
  · exact forward hβ
  · intro hw
    simpa [map_inv, mul_assoc] using forward (hβ.inv M) hw

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.IsRibbon.conjug.source_declaration:
/-- Conjugation by a ribbon also transports the generated parabolic groups.
This uses the proved subgroup closure of the actual positive parabolic. -/
theorem IsRibbon.conjugates_parabolic {X Y : RibbonObject M} {β : Artin.Group M}
    (hβ : IsRibbon M X Y β) (a : Artin.Group M) :
    a ∈ Artin.parabolic M X.indices ↔ β⁻¹ * a * β ∈ Artin.parabolic M Y.indices := by
  have forward {U V : RibbonObject M} {b : Artin.Group M}
      (hb : IsRibbon M U V b) {c : Artin.Group M}
      (hc : c ∈ Artin.parabolic M U.indices) :
      b⁻¹ * c * b ∈ Artin.parabolic M V.indices := by
    have hle : Artin.parabolic M U.indices ≤
        (Artin.parabolic M V.indices).comap (MulAut.conj b⁻¹).toMonoidHom := by
      rw [← subgroupClosure_actualPositiveParabolic M U.indices]
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
      intro c hc
      change b⁻¹ * c * (b⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ Artin.parabolic M V.indices
      simpa only [inv_inv, Subgroup.mem_toSubmonoid] using
        actualPositiveParabolic_le_parabolic M V.indices ((hb c).mp hc)
    have hmem := hle hc
    change b⁻¹ * c * (b⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ Artin.parabolic M V.indices at hmem
    simpa only [inv_inv] using hmem
  constructor
  · exact forward hβ
  · intro ha
    simpa [mul_assoc] using forward (hβ.inv M) ha

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.IsRibbon.genera.source_declaration:
/-- Every source generator has an actual target-generator transport relation. -/
theorem IsRibbon.generator_forward {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r : Artin.Group M}
    (h : IsRibbon M X Y r) {i : I} (hi : i ∈ X.indices) :
    ∃ j ∈ Y.indices, Artin.generator M i * r = r * Artin.generator M j := by
  have hmem := (h (Artin.generator M i)).1
    (generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M X.indices hi)
  have hdeg : degree M (r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * r) = 1 := by
    rw [degree_mul, degree_mul, degree_inv, degree_generator]
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, hj, heq⟩ := positive_degree_one_selected M Y.indices hmem hdeg
  refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
  calc
    Artin.generator M i * r = r * (r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * r) := by group
    _ = r * Artin.generator M j := by rw [heq]

/-- The reverse direction follows from the inverse ribbon, with the same
source and target convention as right-composed ribbon paths. -/
theorem IsRibbon.generator_reverse {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r : Artin.Group M}
    (h : IsRibbon M X Y r) {j : I} (hj : j ∈ Y.indices) :
    ∃ i ∈ X.indices, Artin.generator M i * r = r * Artin.generator M j := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, heq⟩ := IsRibbon.generator_forward M (h.inv M) hj
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
  have h' := congrArg (fun a => r * a * r) heq
  simpa [mul_assoc] using h'.symm

/-- Every actual ribbon transports the fundamental element of its source
to that of its target. The proof compares internal positive lcm divisibility
in both directions, without assuming equal longest-root counts. -/
theorem IsRibbon.parabolicDelta_conjugate {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r : Artin.Group M}
    (h : IsRibbon M X Y r) :
    r⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M X.indices * r = parabolicDelta M Y.indices := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hforward⟩ := delta_leftDivides_conjugate M h
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbackward⟩ := delta_leftDivides_conjugate M (h.inv M)
  have hda := congrArg (degree M) hforward
  have hdb := congrArg (degree M) hbackward
  simp only [degree_mul, degree_inv] at hda hdb
  have ha0 : degree M a = 0 := by
    have ha' := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ ha
    have hb' := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hb
    omega
  have ha1 := (degree_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ ha).1 ha0
  simpa only [ha1, mul_one] using hforward

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.PositiveReduced.source_declaration:
/-- Every positive generated path divides a power of the concrete source
loop, with a positive generated complementary path. -/
theorem PositiveReducedArrow.positive_complement {X Y : RibbonObject M} {β : Artin.Group M}
    (h : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y β) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (q : Artin.Group M), PositiveReducedArrow M Y X q ∧
      β * q = cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ n := by
  induction h with
  | identity X =>
    exact ⟨0, 1, .identity X, by simp⟩
  | elementary a ha hr =>
    obtain ⟨q, hq, he⟩ := elementaryMu_positive_complement M a ha hr
    exact ⟨1, q, hq, by simpa only [pow_one] using he⟩
  | @comp X Y Z β γ hβ hγ ihβ ihγ =>
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp, hprodβ⟩ := ihβ
    obtain ⟨m, q, hq, hprodγ⟩ := ihγ
    refine ⟨m + n, q * p, .comp hq hp, ?_⟩
    calc
      (β * γ) * (q * p) = β * (γ * q) * p := by group
      _ = β * cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ m * p := by rw [hprodγ]
      _ = (cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ m * β) * p := by
        rw [IsRibbon.cofinalLoop_pow_mul M hβ.isRibbon m]
      _ = cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ m * (β * p) := by group
      _ = cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ m * cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ n := by rw [hprodβ]
      _ = cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ (m + n) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm

/-- Finite generation by the actual outside `Δ_J⁻¹ Δ_(J+a)` morphisms.
The ribbon condition supplies the arrow's endpoints. Every outside ratio
must separately be proved to have its actual endpoint; none is postulated. -/
inductive ReducedArrow : RibbonObject M → RibbonObject M → Artin.Group M → Prop
  | identity (X) : ReducedArrow X X 1
  | elementary {X Y} (a : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices)
      (hr : IsRibbon M X Y (elementaryMu M X.indices a)) :
      ReducedArrow X Y (elementaryMu M X.indices a)
  | comp {X Y Z} {β γ} (hβ : ReducedArrow X Y β) (hγ : ReducedArrow Y Z γ) :
      ReducedArrow X Z (β * γ)
  | inverse {X Y} {β} (hβ : ReducedArrow X Y β) : ReducedArrow Y X β⁻¹

  induction h with
  | identity X => exact isRibbon_one M X
  | elementary a ha hr => exact hr

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.ReducedArrow.po.source_declaration:
/-- Every signed generated ribbon is a fraction of two actual positive
generated paths, with a canonical target-loop power as denominator. -/
theorem ReducedArrow.positive_fraction {X Y : RibbonObject M} {β : Artin.Group M}
    (h : ReducedArrow M X Y β) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : Artin.Group M), PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p ∧
      β = p * (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n)⁻¹ := by
  induction h with
  | identity X =>
    exact ⟨0, 1, .identity X, by simp⟩
  | elementary a ha hr =>
    exact ⟨0, _, .elementary a ha hr, by simp⟩
  | @comp X Y Z β γ hβ hγ ihβ ihγ =>
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp, hprodβ⟩ := ihβ
    obtain ⟨m, q, hq, hprodγ⟩ := ihγ
    have hmove : (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n)⁻¹ * q =
        q * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ n)⁻¹ := by
      have hqn := IsRibbon.cofinalLoop_pow_mul M hq.isRibbon n
      calc
        _ = (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n)⁻¹ *
            (q * cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ n) * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ n)⁻¹ := by group
        _ = (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n)⁻¹ *
            (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n * q) * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ n)⁻¹ := by rw [hqn]
        _ = _ := by group
    refine ⟨m + n, p * q, .comp hp hq, ?_⟩
    rw [hprodβ, hprodγ]
    calc
      (p * (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n)⁻¹) *
          (q * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ m)⁻¹) =
        p * ((cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n)⁻¹ * q) *
          (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ m)⁻¹ := by group
      _ = p * (q * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ n)⁻¹) *
          (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ m)⁻¹ := by rw [hmove]
      _ = (p * q) * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ (m + n))⁻¹ := by
        simp only [pow_add, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]
  | @inverse X Y β h ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp, hprod⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨m, q, hq, hcomp⟩ := PositiveReducedArrow.positive_complement M hp
    have hinv : p⁻¹ = q * (cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ m)⁻¹ := by
      calc
        p⁻¹ = p⁻¹ * (p * q) * (cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ m)⁻¹ := by rw [hcomp]; group
        _ = _ := by group
    refine ⟨m, q * cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ n,
      .comp hq (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M X n), ?_⟩
    rw [hprod, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, hinv]
    have hqn := IsRibbon.cofinalLoop_pow_mul M hq.isRibbon n
    calc
      cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n * (q * (cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ m)⁻¹) =
        (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n * q) * (cofinalLoop M X.indices ^ m)⁻¹ := by group
      _ = _ := by rw [← hqn]

def RespectsLcm : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : RibbonObject M) (a b : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices) (hb : b ∉ X.indices) (hab : a ≠ b),
    D.wordImage (.cons a ha (chosenLcmLeftTail M X a b ha hb hab)) =

/-- The fixed chosen pair-lcm relations present the actual generated
groupoid in the universal groupoid-valued sense. -/
theorem exists_unique_extension (hD : D.RespectsLcm) :
    ∃! F : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M ⥤ C,
      F.obj = (fun X => D.obj X.val) ∧
      ∀ (X : RibbonObject M) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices),
        HEq (F.map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha)) (D.atom X a ha) := by
  refine ⟨D.extensionFunctor hD, ⟨rfl, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro X a ha
    exact heq_of_eq (D.extensionFunctor_atom hD X a ha)
  · intro F hF
    exact D.extensionFunctor_unique hD F hF.1 hF.2

  map f := D.signedImage f.property
  map_id X := D.signedImage_identity hD X.val

/-- Every assigned atomic image is the image of its actual generated arrow. -/
theorem extensionFunctor_atom (hD : D.RespectsLcm)
    (X : RibbonObject M) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices) :
    (D.extensionFunctor hD).map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha) = D.atom X a ha := by

    .elementary a ha (elementaryMu_isRibbon M X.indices a)

  rw [D.signedImage_eq_positive hD hp.toReducedArrow hp,
    D.positiveImage_eq_wordImage hD hp (.cons a ha (.nil _)) (by simp)]

    {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M} (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) :

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonGenerator.source_declaration:
/-- Uniqueness is among genuine functors on the actual subgroupoid. Object
maps are specified literally; heterogeneous generator equalities only account
for the supplied equality of object functions. -/
theorem extensionFunctor_unique (hD : D.RespectsLcm)
    (F : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M ⥤ C)
    (hobj : F.obj = fun X => D.obj X.val)
    (hatom : ∀ (X : RibbonObject M) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices),
      HEq (F.map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha)) (D.atom X a ha)) :
    F = D.extensionFunctor hD := by
  cases F with
  | mk fobj fmap fid fcomp =>
    dsimp only at hobj
    subst fobj
    let F : ActualReducedRibbonGroupoid M ⥤ C :=
      { obj := fun X => D.obj X.val
        map := fmap
        map_id := fid
        map_comp := fcomp }
    change F = D.extensionFunctor hD
    have hatom' (X : RibbonObject M) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ X.indices) :
        F.map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha) = D.atom X a ha := eq_of_heq (hatom X a ha)
    have hword : ∀ {X Y : RibbonObject M} (p : AtomicWord M X Y),
        F.map (actualReducedHom M p.toPositiveReducedArrow.toReducedArrow) = D.wordImage p := by
      intro X Y p
      induction p with
      | nil X => exact F.map_id (actualRibbonObject M X)
      | @cons X Y a ha p ih =>
        change F.map (actualAtomicHom M X a ha ≫
          actualReducedHom M p.toPositiveReducedArrow.toReducedArrow) = _
        rw [F.map_comp, hatom', ih, D.wordImage_cons]
        rfl
    have hpositive : ∀ {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
        (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p),
        F.map (actualReducedHom M hp.toReducedArrow) = D.positiveImage hp := by
      intro X Y p hp
      let w := hp.atomicWord M
      have he : actualReducedHom M hp.toReducedArrow =
          actualReducedHom M w.toPositiveReducedArrow.toReducedArrow := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact (hp.atomicWord_eval M).symm
      rw [he]
      exact hword w
    apply CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (F := F) (G := D.extensionFunctor hD) (fun _ => rfl)
    intro X Y f
    apply heq_of_eq
    rcases X with ⟨X, hX⟩
    rcases Y with ⟨Y, hY⟩
    change actualRibbonObject M X ⟶ actualRibbonObject M Y at f
    let h : ReducedArrow M X Y f.val.val := f.property
    let a := chooseRibbonFraction M h
    have hhom : f = actualReducedHom M a.positive.toReducedArrow ≫
        inv (actualReducedHom M (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M Y a.power).toReducedArrow) := by
      rw [← actualReducedHom_inverse, ← actualReducedHom_comp]
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact a.value_eq
    change F.map f = D.signedImage h
    conv_lhs => rw [hhom, F.map_comp, F.map_inv]
    simp only [hpositive a.positive, hpositive (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M Y a.power)]
    rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonGenerator.source_declaration:
theorem fractionImage_eq (hD : D.RespectsLcm)
    {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p q : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (hq : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y q) (n m : ℕ)
    (he : p * (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n)⁻¹ =
      q * (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ m)⁻¹) :
    D.fractionImage hp n = D.fractionImage hq m := by
  have hcross : p * cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ m = q * cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n := by
    calc
      _ = (p * (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ n)⁻¹) *
          cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ (n + m) := by rw [pow_add]; group
      _ = (q * (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ m)⁻¹) *
          cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ (m + n) := by rw [he, Nat.add_comm n m]
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_add]; group
  have him := D.positiveImage_congr
    (.comp hp (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M Y m))
    (.comp hq (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M Y n)) hcross
  have him' : D.positiveImage hp ≫ D.loopImage Y m =
      D.positiveImage hq ≫ D.loopImage Y n := by
    calc
      _ = D.positiveImage (.comp hp (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M Y m)) :=
        (D.positiveImage_comp hD hp _).symm
      _ = D.positiveImage (.comp hq (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M Y n)) := him
      _ = _ := D.positiveImage_comp hD hq _
  rw [D.fractionImage_expand hD hp n m, D.fractionImage_expand hD hq m n,
    him', Nat.add_comm m n]

theorem positiveImage_loop_inverse_naturality (hD : D.RespectsLcm)
    {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (n : ℕ) :
    inv (D.loopImage X n) ≫ D.positiveImage hp =
      D.positiveImage hp ≫ inv (D.loopImage Y n) := by
  apply (IsIso.inv_comp_eq (D.loopImage X n)).mpr
  calc
    D.positiveImage hp = (D.positiveImage hp ≫ D.loopImage Y n) ≫ inv (D.loopImage Y n) := by simp
    _ = (D.loopImage X n ≫ D.positiveImage hp) ≫ inv (D.loopImage Y n) := by
      rw [D.positiveImage_loop_naturality hD hp n]
    _ = _ := Category.assoc _ _ _

theorem positiveImage_loop_naturality (hD : D.RespectsLcm)
    {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p : Artin.Group M}
    (hp : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y p) (n : ℕ) :
    D.positiveImage hp ≫ D.loopImage Y n = D.loopImage X n ≫ D.positiveImage hp := by
  have he := IsRibbon.cofinalLoop_pow_mul M hp.isRibbon n
  have hf := D.positiveImage_congr
    (.comp hp (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M Y n))
    (.comp (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M X n) hp) he
  calc
    _ = D.positiveImage (.comp hp (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M Y n)) :=
      (D.positiveImage_comp hD hp _).symm
    _ = D.positiveImage (.comp (positive_cofinalLoop_pow M X n) hp) := hf
    _ = _ := D.positiveImage_comp hD _ hp

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.RibbonGenerator.source_declaration:
theorem signedImage_comp (hD : D.RespectsLcm)
    {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} {β γ : Artin.Group M}
    (hβ : ReducedArrow M X Y β) (hγ : ReducedArrow M Y Z γ) :
    D.signedImage (.comp hβ hγ) = D.signedImage hβ ≫ D.signedImage hγ := by
  let f := chooseRibbonFraction M hβ
  let g := chooseRibbonFraction M hγ
  have hmove : (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹ * g.numerator =
      g.numerator * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹ := by
    have hn := IsRibbon.cofinalLoop_pow_mul M g.positive.isRibbon f.power
    calc
      _ = (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹ *
          (g.numerator * cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ f.power) *
            (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹ := by group
      _ = (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹ *
          (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ f.power * g.numerator) *
            (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹ := by rw [hn]
      _ = _ := by group
  have he : β * γ = (f.numerator * g.numerator) *
      (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ (g.power + f.power))⁻¹ := by
    calc
      β * γ = (f.numerator * (cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹) *
          (g.numerator * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ g.power)⁻¹) :=
        congrArg₂ (· * ·) f.value_eq g.value_eq
      _ = f.numerator * ((cofinalLoop M Y.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹ * g.numerator) *
          (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ g.power)⁻¹ := by group
      _ = f.numerator * (g.numerator * (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ f.power)⁻¹) *
          (cofinalLoop M Z.indices ^ g.power)⁻¹ := by rw [hmove]
      _ = _ := by simp only [pow_add, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]
  rw [D.signedImage_eq_fraction hD (.comp hβ hγ) (.comp f.positive g.positive) _ he,
    D.signedImage_eq_fraction hD hβ f.positive _ f.value_eq,
    D.signedImage_eq_fraction hD hγ g.positive _ g.value_eq]
  unfold fractionImage
  rw [D.positiveImage_comp hD f.positive g.positive]
  simp only [loopImage_add D hD, IsIso.inv_comp]
  have hi := congrArg
    (fun t => D.positiveImage f.positive ≫ t ≫ inv (D.loopImage Z g.power))
    (D.positiveImage_loop_inverse_naturality hD g.positive f.power)
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using hi.symm

theorem wordImage_eq_of_relation (hD : D.RespectsLcm)
    {X Y : RibbonObject M} {p q : AtomicWord M X Y} (h : AtomicRelation M p q) :
    D.wordImage p = D.wordImage q := by
  induction h with
  | refl p => rfl

  | trans h₁ h₂ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂
  | lcm X a b ha hb hab => exact hD X a b ha hb hab
  | precontext p h ih => simp only [wordImage_append, ih]

theorem actualPositive_gcd_left (a b : actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ) :
    ∃ g : actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, ActualLeftDivides M g a ∧ ActualLeftDivides M g b ∧
      ∀ e, ActualLeftDivides M e a → ActualLeftDivides M e b → ActualLeftDivides M e g := by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (positiveActualEquiv M).surjective a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (positiveActualEquiv M).surjective b
  obtain ⟨g, hga, hgb, hg⟩ := positive_gcd_left M a b
  refine ⟨positiveActualEquiv M g, (positiveActualEquiv_leftDivides_iff M g a).mpr hga,
    (positiveActualEquiv_leftDivides_iff M g b).mpr hgb, ?_⟩
  intro e hea heb
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := (positiveActualEquiv M).surjective e
  exact (positiveActualEquiv_leftDivides_iff M e g).mpr (hg e
    ((positiveActualEquiv_leftDivides_iff M e a).mp hea)
    ((positiveActualEquiv_leftDivides_iff M e b).mp heb))

theorem actualPositive_lcm_left (a b : actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ) :
    ∃ c : actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, ActualLeftDivides M a c ∧ ActualLeftDivides M b c ∧
      ∀ d, ActualLeftDivides M a d → ActualLeftDivides M b d → ActualLeftDivides M c d := by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (positiveActualEquiv M).surjective a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (positiveActualEquiv M).surjective b
  obtain ⟨c, hac, hbc, hc⟩ := positive_lcm_left M a b
  refine ⟨positiveActualEquiv M c, (positiveActualEquiv_leftDivides_iff M a c).mpr hac,
    (positiveActualEquiv_leftDivides_iff M b c).mpr hbc, ?_⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.atomicRelation_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.atomicRelation_of_eval_eq
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.atomicRelation_.source_declaration:
/-- All equal evaluations of positive atomic words follow from the fixed
pair-lcm relations. The proof descends on the actual positive exponent sum,
using cancellation at a common first atom and an actual lcm otherwise. -/
theorem atomicRelation_of_eval_eq {X Y : RibbonObject M} (p q : AtomicWord M X Y)
    (he : p.eval = q.eval) : AtomicRelation M p q := by
  have core : ∀ n (X Y : RibbonObject M) (p q : AtomicWord M X Y),
      (degree M p.eval).toNat = n → p.eval = q.eval → AtomicRelation M p q := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | ind n ih =>
      intro X Y p q hn he
      cases p with
      | nil X =>
        cases q with
        | nil X => exact .refl _
        | cons b hb q => exact False.elim (q.cons_eval_ne_one b hb he.symm)
      | cons a ha p =>
        cases q with
        | nil X => exact False.elim (p.cons_eval_ne_one a ha he)
        | cons b hb q =>
          by_cases hab : a = b
          · subst b
            have htail : p.eval = q.eval := mul_left_cancel he
            have hlt := p.degree_tail_lt a ha
            rw [hn] at hlt
            exact .cons a ha (ih _ hlt _ _ p q rfl htail)
          · let L := pairAtomicTarget M X a b
            let l := pairRibbonLcm M X.indices a b
            let u := chosenLcmLeftTail M X a b ha hb hab
            let v := chosenLcmRightTail M X a b ha hb hab
            obtain ⟨s, hspos, hs⟩ := (pairRibbonLcm_is_left_lcm M X.indices a b).2.2
              (AtomicWord.cons a ha p).eval (AtomicWord.cons a ha p).positive
              ⟨p.eval, p.positive, rfl⟩ ⟨q.eval, q.positive, he⟩
            have hsgen : PositiveReducedArrow M L Y s := positive_ribbon_factor_tail M
              (pairRibbonLcm_positive M X.indices a b) (pairRibbonLcm_isRibbon M X.indices a b)
              (AtomicWord.cons a ha p).leftReduced (AtomicWord.cons a ha p).isRibbon hspos hs
            let t := hsgen.atomicWord M
            have ht : t.eval = s := hsgen.atomicWord_eval M
            have hu : elementaryMu M X.indices a * u.eval = l := chosenLcmLeft_eval M X a b ha hb hab
            have hv : elementaryMu M X.indices b * v.eval = l := chosenLcmRight_eval M X a b ha hb hab
            have hp : p.eval = (u.append t).eval := by
              apply mul_left_cancel (a := elementaryMu M X.indices a)
              rw [AtomicWord.eval_append, ← mul_assoc, hu, ht]
              exact hs
            have hq : q.eval = (v.append t).eval := by
              apply mul_left_cancel (a := elementaryMu M X.indices b)
              rw [AtomicWord.eval_append, ← mul_assoc, hv, ht]
              exact he.symm.trans hs
            have hltp := p.degree_tail_lt a ha
            rw [hn] at hltp
            have hltq := q.degree_tail_lt b hb
            rw [← he, hn] at hltq
            have hpRel := ih _ hltp _ _ p (u.append t) rfl hp
            have hqRel := ih _ hltq _ _ q (v.append t) rfl hq
            exact .trans (.cons a ha hpRel)
              (.trans (.postcontext (.lcm X a b ha hb hab) t) (.symm (.cons b hb hqRel)))
  exact core _ X Y p q rfl he

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.braidRelators_e.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.braidRelators_eq
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.braidRelators_e.source_declaration:
/-- The two presentations have exactly the same relator set. Odd matrix
entries exchange the ordered pair, and even entries keep it. -/
theorem braidRelators_eq (M : CoxeterMatrix I) :
    OAI.HarmonicArtin.braidRelators M = TauCeti.artinRelationsSet M := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro r ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    change OAI.HarmonicArtin.alternating i j (M i j) * (OAI.HarmonicArtin.alternating j i (M i j))⁻¹ ∈ _
    rw [relator_eq]
    split
    · exact TauCeti.artinRelation_mem_artinRelationsSet M i j
    · exact TauCeti.artinRelation_mem_artinRelationsSet M j i
  · rintro r ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    by_cases hm : Even (M i j)
    · refine ⟨(i, j), ?_⟩
      change OAI.HarmonicArtin.alternating i j (M i j) * (OAI.HarmonicArtin.alternating j i (M i j))⁻¹ =
        TauCeti.artinRelation M i j
      rw [relator_eq, ite_eq_left hm]
    · refine ⟨(j, i), ?_⟩
      change OAI.HarmonicArtin.alternating j i (M j i) * (OAI.HarmonicArtin.alternating i j (M j i))⁻¹ =
        TauCeti.artinRelation M i j
      rw [relator_eq]
      simp only [M.symmetric j i, hm, ite_false]

theorem cofinalDelta_mul_cofinalDelta (J : Set I) :
    cofinalDelta M J * cofinalDelta M (cofinalTarget M J) = cofinalLoop M J := by
  have h := IsRibbon.parabolicDelta_mul M (cofinalDelta_isRibbon M J)
  have hd : parabolicDelta M Set.univ =
      cofinalDelta M J * parabolicDelta M (cofinalTarget M J) := by
    simpa only [cofinalDelta, mul_inv_cancel_left] using h
  have hm : parabolicDelta M Set.univ *
      (parabolicDelta M (cofinalTarget M J))⁻¹ = cofinalDelta M J := by
    rw [hd]
    group
  unfold cofinalDelta cofinalLoop
  calc
    _ = (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ *
        (parabolicDelta M Set.univ * (parabolicDelta M (cofinalTarget M J))⁻¹) *
          parabolicDelta M Set.univ := by group
    _ = (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * cofinalDelta M J * parabolicDelta M Set.univ := by rw [hm]
    _ = _ := by unfold cofinalDelta; simp only [pow_two]; group

    parabolicTwistIndex_involutive M Set.univ
  ext i

  · rintro ⟨u, ⟨v, hv, hvu⟩, hui⟩

    refine ⟨parabolicTwist M Set.univ ⟨i, Set.mem_univ i⟩,
      ⟨⟨i, Set.mem_univ i⟩, hi, rfl⟩, ?_⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.degree_eq_zero_.source_declaration:
/-- On the actual positive monoid, zero exponent sum forces the identity;
this follows from word length and does not require positive injectivity. -/
theorem degree_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I)
    {a : Artin.Group M} (ha : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J) : degree M a = 0 ↔ a = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hfull : a ∈ Submonoid.closure (Set.range (Artin.generator M)) := by
      apply Submonoid.closure_mono (s := Artin.generator M '' J) ?_ ha
      rintro _ ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← positiveToParent_mrange] at hfull
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hfull
    have hb : OAI.HarmonicArtin.positiveDegree M b = 0 := by

theorem degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I)
    {a : Artin.Group M} (ha : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J) : 0 ≤ degree M a := by
  let N : Submonoid (Artin.Group M) :=
    { carrier := {a | 0 ≤ degree M a}
      one_mem' := by simp
      mul_mem' := by
        intro a b ha hb
        change 0 ≤ degree M (a * b)
        rw [degree_mul]
        exact add_nonneg ha hb }
  have hle : actualPositiveParabolic M J ≤ N := by
    apply Submonoid.closure_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
    change 0 ≤ degree M (Artin.generator M i)
    simp
  exact hle ha

/-- For an outside generator, the endpoint is exactly the source formula
`(J+a) - ι_(J+a)(a)`. -/
theorem elementaryMu_endpoint (J : Set I) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ J) :
    parabolicTwistImage M (insert a J) J =
      insert a J \ {(parabolicTwist M (insert a J) ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a J⟩ : I)} := by
  classical
  let e := parabolicTwist M (insert a J)
  ext k
  change k ∈ (fun i : ↥(insert a J) => (e i : I)) '' {i : ↥(insert a J) | (i : I) ∈ J} ↔ _
  simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(e i).property, ?_⟩
    intro heq
    have hi' : i = ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a J⟩ := e.injective (Subtype.ext heq)
    have himem : (i : I) ∈ J := hi
    rw [hi'] at himem
    exact ha himem
  · rintro ⟨hk, hne⟩
    let i := e.symm ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hik : (e i : I) = k := congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply ⟨k, hk⟩)
    have hi : (i : I) ∈ J := by
      rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp i.property with hia | hi
      · have hi' : i = ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a J⟩ := Subtype.ext hia
        rw [hi'] at hik
        exact False.elim (hne hik.symm)
      · exact hi
    exact ⟨i, hi, hik⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.elementaryMu_po.source_declaration:
/-- Each actual outside generator has a positive generated complement in
the concrete cofinal loop at its source. -/
theorem elementaryMu_positive_complement {X Y : RibbonObject M} (a : I)
    (ha : a ∉ X.indices) (hr : IsRibbon M X Y (elementaryMu M X.indices a)) :
    ∃ t : Artin.Group M, PositiveReducedArrow M Y X t ∧
      elementaryMu M X.indices a * t = cofinalLoop M X.indices := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hD⟩ := parabolicDelta_prefix_of_subset M (insert a X.indices)
    Set.univ (Set.subset_univ _)
  have hprod : elementaryMu M X.indices a * q = cofinalDelta M X.indices := by
    unfold elementaryMu cofinalDelta
    rw [hD]
    group
  have hqrib : IsRibbon M Y ⟨cofinalTarget M X.indices⟩ q := by
    have h := (IsRibbon.inv M hr).mul M (cofinalDelta_isRibbon M X.indices)
    have he : (elementaryMu M X.indices a)⁻¹ * cofinalDelta M X.indices = q := by
      rw [← hprod]
      group
    simpa only [he] using h
  have hμ : PositiveReducedArrow M X Y (elementaryMu M X.indices a) :=
    .elementary a ha hr
  have hqred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M Y.indices q := by
    intro j hj s hs he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hrel⟩ := IsRibbon.generator_reverse M hr hj
    apply (parabolicDelta_ratio_leftReduced M X.indices Set.univ
      (Set.subset_univ X.indices)) i hi
      (elementaryMu M X.indices a * s)
      ((actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hμ.positive hs)
    change Artin.generator M i * (elementaryMu M X.indices a * s) = cofinalDelta M X.indices
    rw [← mul_assoc, hrel, mul_assoc, he, hprod]
  have hqgen := positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated M hq hqred hqrib
  have hδ := positive_cofinalDelta M (cofinalTarget M X.indices)
  rw [cofinalTarget_involutive] at hδ
  refine ⟨q * cofinalDelta M (cofinalTarget M X.indices),
    PositiveReducedArrow.comp hqgen hδ, ?_⟩
  rw [← mul_assoc, hprod, cofinalDelta_mul_cofinalDelta]

  toFun β := MulOpposite.op ⟨β.asHom.1, β.asHom.2⟩
  invFun β := End.of ⟨β.unop.1, β.unop.2⟩
  left_inv _β := End.ext rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.exists_paraboli.source_declaration:
/-- Every actual normalizer element is a selected parabolic element times an
actual signed path of outside ribbons. -/
theorem exists_parabolic_reducedRibbon_factorization (X : RibbonObject M)
    (β : Artin.Group M)
    (hβ : β ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M X.indices : Set (Artin.Group M))) :
    ∃ a ∈ Artin.parabolic M X.indices,
      ∃ r ∈ reducedRibbonLoops M X, β = a * r := by
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp, hfrac⟩ := positive_fraction_globalDelta_square M β
  let Ω := (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2
  have hΩN : Ω ^ n ∈
      Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M X.indices : Set (Artin.Group M)) := by
    apply Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff.2
    intro a
    have hcomm := (globalDelta_square_commute M a).pow_left n
    have he : Ω ^ n * a * (Ω ^ n)⁻¹ = a := by rw [hcomm.eq, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    rw [he]
  have hpN : p ∈
      Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M X.indices : Set (Artin.Group M)) := by
    have he : p = β * Ω ^ n := by rw [hfrac]; dsimp only [Ω]; group
    rw [he]
    exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hβ hΩN
  obtain ⟨a, r, b, ha, hr, hb, hprod, hrleft, hrright, hrN⟩ :=
    exists_positive_normalizer_double_reduction M X.indices p hp hpN
  have hrib : IsRibbon M X X r := reduced_normalizer_isRibbon M X.indices hr hrright hrN
  have hrgen : PositiveReducedArrow M X X r :=
    positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated M hr hrleft hrib
  let D := ((parabolicDelta M X.indices) ^ 2) ^ n
  let t := b * D⁻¹
  have hD : D ∈ Artin.parabolic M X.indices :=
    Subgroup.pow_mem _ (Subgroup.pow_mem _
      (actualPositiveParabolic_le_parabolic M X.indices
        (parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M X.indices)) 2) n
  have ht : t ∈ Artin.parabolic M X.indices :=
    Subgroup.mul_mem _ (actualPositiveParabolic_le_parabolic M X.indices hb)
      (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hD)
  have ha' : a * (r * t * r⁻¹) ∈ Artin.parabolic M X.indices :=
    Subgroup.mul_mem _ (actualPositiveParabolic_le_parabolic M X.indices ha)
      ((Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff.1 hrN t).1 ht)
  have hcgen := positive_cofinalLoop_pow M X n
  have hR : r * ((cofinalLoop M X.indices) ^ n)⁻¹ ∈ reducedRibbonLoops M X :=
    ReducedArrow.comp hrgen.toReducedArrow (ReducedArrow.inverse hcgen.toReducedArrow)
  refine ⟨a * (r * t * r⁻¹), ha', r * ((cofinalLoop M X.indices) ^ n)⁻¹, hR, ?_⟩
  rw [hfrac, hprod, globalDelta_square_pow_decompose M X.indices n, mul_inv_rev]
  dsimp only [t, D]
  group

/-- The positive double reduction of an actual normalizer element has an
actual middle normalizer element, with no Garside or splitting hypothesis. -/
theorem exists_positive_normalizer_double_reduction (p : Artin.Group M)
    (hp : p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hpN : p ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M J : Set (Artin.Group M))) :
    ∃ a r b : Artin.Group M,
      a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ ∧
      b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      p = a * r * b ∧
      IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J r ∧
      IsRightParabolicallyReduced M J r ∧
      r ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M J : Set (Artin.Group M)) := by
  obtain ⟨a, r, b, ha, hr, hb, hprod, hleft, hright⟩ :=
    exists_positive_parabolic_double_reduction M J p hp
  exact ⟨a, r, b, ha, hr, hb, hprod, hleft, hright,
    middle_mem_normalizer_of_parabolic_factors M J
      (actualPositiveParabolic_le_parabolic M J ha)
      (actualPositiveParabolic_le_parabolic M J hb) hpN hprod⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.exists_positive.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.exists_positive_parabolic_double_reduction
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.exists_positive.source_declaration:
/-- Strip actual positive parabolic factors on both sides, leaving an actual
positive element with no selected generator as a positive divisor on either end. -/
theorem exists_positive_parabolic_double_reduction (p : Artin.Group M)
    (hp : p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ) :
    ∃ a r b : Artin.Group M,
      a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ ∧
      b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      p = a * r * b ∧
      IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J r ∧ IsRightParabolicallyReduced M J r := by
  classical
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n => ∃ a r b : Artin.Group M,
    a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
    r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ ∧
    b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧ p = a * r * b ∧ (degree M r).toNat = n
  have hex : ∃ n, P n := by
    refine ⟨(degree M p).toNat, 1, p, 1, (actualPositiveParabolic M J).one_mem,
      hp, (actualPositiveParabolic M J).one_mem, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp
  obtain ⟨a, r, b, ha, hr, hb, hprod, hdeg⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  refine ⟨a, r, b, ha, hr, hb, hprod, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi s hs heq
    have hnew : P (degree M s).toNat := by
      refine ⟨a * Artin.generator M i, s, b,
        (actualPositiveParabolic M J).mul_mem ha
          (generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J hi), hs, hb, ?_, rfl⟩
      simpa only [← heq, mul_assoc] using hprod
    have hmin := Nat.find_min' hex hnew
    have hsdeg := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hs

    ∃ d c z, a = c * d ∧ b = z * d ∧ RightCoprime M c z := by
  obtain ⟨d, ⟨c, hc⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩, hd⟩ := positive_gcd_right M a b
  refine ⟨d, c, z, hc, hz, ?_⟩

  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := he
  have hdeg := congrArg (positiveDegree M) hq
  simp only [positiveDegree_mul] at hdeg

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.globalDelta_squ.source_declaration:
/-- The global fundamental square is central in the unchanged Artin group. -/
theorem globalDelta_square_commute (a : Artin.Group M) :
    Commute ((parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2) a := by
  have ha : a ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (Artin.generator M)) := by
    rw [Artin.closure_range_generator M]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top a
  induction ha using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem g hg =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hg
    let j := parabolicTwist M Set.univ ⟨i, Set.mem_univ i⟩
    have h₁ := parabolicTwist_relation M Set.univ ⟨i, Set.mem_univ i⟩
    have h₂ := parabolicTwist_relation M Set.univ j
    have hji : (parabolicTwist M Set.univ j : I) = i := by
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (parabolicTwistIndex_involutive M Set.univ
        ⟨i, Set.mem_univ i⟩)
    change parabolicDelta M Set.univ * Artin.generator M i =
      Artin.generator M j * parabolicDelta M Set.univ at h₁
    rw [hji] at h₂
    change (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2 * Artin.generator M i =
      Artin.generator M i * (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2
    calc
      _ = parabolicDelta M Set.univ *
          (parabolicDelta M Set.univ * Artin.generator M i) := by simp only [pow_two]; group
      _ = parabolicDelta M Set.univ *
          (Artin.generator M j * parabolicDelta M Set.univ) := by rw [h₁]
      _ = (parabolicDelta M Set.univ * Artin.generator M j) *
          parabolicDelta M Set.univ := by group
      _ = (Artin.generator M i * parabolicDelta M Set.univ) *
          parabolicDelta M Set.univ := by rw [h₂]
      _ = _ := by simp only [pow_two]; group
  | one => exact Commute.one_right _
  | mul a b ha hb hca hcb => exact hca.mul_right hcb
  | inv a ha hca => exact hca.inv_right

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.globalDelta_squ.source_declaration:
/-- Separate a global central denominator into a reduced cofinal factor and
a factor in the actual selected parabolic. -/
theorem globalDelta_square_pow_decompose (J : Set I) (n : ℕ) :
    ((parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2) ^ n =
      (cofinalLoop M J) ^ n * ((parabolicDelta M J) ^ 2) ^ n := by
  let d := parabolicDelta M J
  let Ω := (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2
  have hΩd : Ω * d ^ 2 = d ^ 2 * Ω := (globalDelta_square_commute M (d ^ 2)).eq
  have hc : Commute (cofinalLoop M J) (d ^ 2) := by
    change ((d⁻¹) ^ 2 * Ω) * d ^ 2 = d ^ 2 * ((d⁻¹) ^ 2 * Ω)
    calc
      _ = (d⁻¹) ^ 2 * (Ω * d ^ 2) := by group
      _ = (d⁻¹) ^ 2 * (d ^ 2 * Ω) := by rw [hΩd]
      _ = _ := by group
  have hprod : cofinalLoop M J * d ^ 2 = Ω := by
    change ((d⁻¹) ^ 2 * Ω) * d ^ 2 = Ω
    calc
      _ = (d⁻¹) ^ 2 * (Ω * d ^ 2) := by group
      _ = (d⁻¹) ^ 2 * (d ^ 2 * Ω) := by rw [hΩd]
      _ = _ := by group
  calc
    Ω ^ n = (cofinalLoop M J * d ^ 2) ^ n := by rw [hprod]
    _ = (cofinalLoop M J) ^ n * (d ^ 2) ^ n := hc.mul_pow n

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.isRibbon_iff_po.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.isRibbon_iff_positiveCosets_eq
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.isRibbon_iff_po.source_declaration:
/-- The conjugation condition is exactly the positive coset equality used
in Definition 5.1. -/
theorem isRibbon_iff_positiveCosets_eq (X Y : RibbonObject M) (β : Artin.Group M) :
    IsRibbon M X Y β ↔
      (fun a : Artin.Group M => a * β) ''
          (actualPositiveParabolic M X.indices : Set (Artin.Group M)) =
        (fun a : Artin.Group M => β * a) ''
          (actualPositiveParabolic M Y.indices : Set (Artin.Group M)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨β⁻¹ * a * β, (h a).mp ha, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨β * a * β⁻¹, (h _).mpr ?_, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩
      simpa [mul_assoc] using ha
  · intro h a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      have hz : a * β ∈ (fun b : Artin.Group M => β * b) ''
          (actualPositiveParabolic M Y.indices : Set (Artin.Group M)) := by
        rw [← h]
        exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := hz
      have heq : β⁻¹ * a * β = b := by
        calc
          β⁻¹ * a * β = β⁻¹ * (a * β) := mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ = β⁻¹ * (β * b) := congrArg (fun z => β⁻¹ * z) hba.symm
          _ = b := by simp
      rwa [heq]
    · intro ha
      have hz : a * β ∈ (fun b : Artin.Group M => b * β) ''
          (actualPositiveParabolic M X.indices : Set (Artin.Group M)) := by
        rw [h]
        exact ⟨β⁻¹ * a * β, ha, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := hz
      have hba' : b = a := mul_right_cancel hba
      subst b
      exact hb

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.isRibbon_of_gen.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.isRibbon_of_generator_conjugates
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.isRibbon_of_gen.source_declaration:
theorem isRibbon_of_generator_conjugates (J : Set I) (f : J → I) (β : Artin.Group M)
    (hf : ∀ i : J, β⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * β = Artin.generator M (f i)) :
    IsRibbon M ⟨J⟩ ⟨Set.range f⟩ β := by
  let c := (MulAut.conj β⁻¹).toMonoidHom
  have hs : c '' (Artin.generator M '' J) = Artin.generator M '' Set.range f := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨f ⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change Artin.generator M (f ⟨i, hi⟩) = β⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * (β⁻¹)⁻¹
      simpa only [inv_inv] using (hf ⟨i, hi⟩).symm
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨Artin.generator M i, ⟨i, i.property, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change β⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * (β⁻¹)⁻¹ = Artin.generator M (f i)
      simpa only [inv_inv] using hf i
  have hm : (actualPositiveParabolic M J).map c = actualPositiveParabolic M (Set.range f) := by
    rw [actualPositiveParabolic, MonoidHom.map_mclosure, hs]
    rfl
  intro a
  constructor
  · intro ha
    have h : c a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M (Set.range f) := by
      rw [← hm]
      exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    change β⁻¹ * a * (β⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M (Set.range f) at h
    simpa only [inv_inv] using h
  · intro ha
    have ha' : c a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M (Set.range f) := by
      change β⁻¹ * a * (β⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M (Set.range f)
      simpa only [inv_inv] using ha
    rw [← hm] at ha'
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := ha'
    have he : b = a := (MulAut.conj β⁻¹).injective hba
    exact he ▸ hb

/-- The actual positive conjugation condition determines the target index
set uniquely. This does not discard elementary labels without an endpoint. -/
theorem isRibbon_target_indices_unique {X Y Z : RibbonObject M} {β : Artin.Group M}
    (hY : IsRibbon M X Y β) (hZ : IsRibbon M X Z β) : Y.indices = Z.indices := by
  have sub {U V : RibbonObject M} (hU : IsRibbon M X U β) (hV : IsRibbon M X V β) :
      U.indices ⊆ V.indices := by
    intro i hi
    have hgen := generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M U.indices hi
    let a := β * Artin.generator M i * β⁻¹
    have ha : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M X.indices :=
      (hU a).mpr (by simpa [a, mul_assoc] using hgen)
    have hgen' : Artin.generator M i ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M V.indices := by
      simpa [a, mul_assoc] using (hV a).mp ha
    exact (generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic_iff M V.indices i).mp hgen'
  exact Set.Subset.antisymm (sub hY hZ) (sub hZ hY)

parabolic, with the original canonical Coxeter projection preserved. -/
theorem landmark_2 (J : Set I) :
    Function.Bijective (reducedRibbonQuotientMap M ⟨J⟩) ∧
      Nonempty (Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M J : Set (Artin.Group M)) ≃*
        (Artin.parabolic M J) ⋊[reducedRibbonParabolicAction M ⟨J⟩]
          (reducedRibbonLoops M ⟨J⟩)) ∧
      (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J).comp
          (reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩).toMonoidHom =
        reducedRibbonCoxeterProjection M ⟨J⟩ :=
  ⟨⟨reducedRibbonQuotientMap_injective M ⟨J⟩,
      reducedRibbonQuotientMap_surjective M ⟨J⟩⟩,

/-- A coprime left fraction of a parabolic element is supported on that parabolic. -/
theorem left_coprime_fraction_parabolic (J : Set I) (a b : PositiveArtin M)
    (hab : LeftCoprime M a b)
    (hg : (positiveToParent M a)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M b ∈ Artin.parabolic M J) :
    positiveToParent M a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      positiveToParent M b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J := by
  obtain ⟨c, z, hc, hz, hfrac⟩ := parabolic_positive_left_fraction M J hg
  obtain ⟨d, c', z', hdc, hdz, hcop⟩ := exists_left_reduced_pair M c z
  have hc' := (positive_factors_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J d c' (hdc ▸ hc)).2
  have hz' := (positive_factors_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J d z' (hdz ▸ hz)).2
  have he : (positiveToParent M a)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M b =
      (positiveToParent M c')⁻¹ * positiveToParent M z' := by
    rw [hfrac, hdc, hdz, map_mul, map_mul]
    group
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := left_coprime_fraction_unique M a b c' z' hab hcop he
  exact ⟨hc', hz'⟩

/-- Actual coprime left fractions have unique numerator and denominator. -/
theorem left_coprime_fraction_unique (a b c z : PositiveArtin M)
    (hab : LeftCoprime M a b) (hcz : LeftCoprime M c z)
    (heq : (positiveToParent M a)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M b =
      (positiveToParent M c)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M z) : a = c ∧ b = z := by
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨d, hd⟩, ⟨e, he⟩⟩ := positive_common_multiple_right M a c
  have hda : d * a = e * c := hd.symm.trans he
  have hdb : d * b = e * z := by
    apply positiveToParent_injective M
    have hm := congrArg (positiveToParent M) hda
    simp only [map_mul] at hm
    simp only [map_mul]
    calc
      positiveToParent M d * positiveToParent M b =
          (positiveToParent M d * positiveToParent M a) *
            ((positiveToParent M a)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M b) := by group
      _ = (positiveToParent M e * positiveToParent M c) *
            ((positiveToParent M c)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M z) := by rw [hm, heq]
      _ = positiveToParent M e * positiveToParent M z := by group
  have hed : PositivePrefix M e d := leftCoprime_common_prefix M a b hab d e
    ⟨c, hda⟩ ⟨z, hdb⟩
  have hde : PositivePrefix M d e := leftCoprime_common_prefix M c z hcz e d
    ⟨a, hda.symm⟩ ⟨b, hdb.symm⟩
  have h := positivePrefix_antisymm M hde hed
  rw [← h] at hda hdb
  exact ⟨positive_cancel_left M d a c hda, positive_cancel_left M d b z hdb⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.mem_positivePar.source_declaration:
theorem mem_positiveParabolic_iff_support (J : Set I) (a : PositiveArtin M) :
    a ∈ positiveParabolic M J ↔ positiveSupport M a ⊆ J := by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    let N : Submonoid (PositiveArtin M) :=
      { carrier := {b | positiveSupport M b ⊆ J}
        one_mem' := by simp
        mul_mem' := by
          intro b c hb hc
          change positiveSupport M (b * c) ⊆ J
          rw [positiveSupport_mul]
          exact Set.union_subset hb hc }
    have hle : positiveParabolic M J ≤ N := by
      apply Submonoid.closure_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      change positiveSupport M (positiveGenerator M i) ⊆ J
      simpa only [positiveSupport_generator, Set.singleton_subset_iff] using hi
    exact hle ha
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := positive_word_surjective M a
    have hw : ∀ i ∈ w, i ∈ J := by rw [positiveSupport_word] at ha; exact ha
    clear ha
    induction w with
    | nil => exact Submonoid.one_mem _
    | cons i w ih =>
      change positiveGenerator M i * wordPositive M w ∈ _
      exact Submonoid.mul_mem _ (Submonoid.subset_closure ⟨i, hw i (by simp), rfl⟩)
        (ih (fun j hj => hw j (List.mem_cons_of_mem i hj)))

/-- Removing parabolic group factors from a normalizer element preserves
normalizer membership. The factors here need not be positive. -/
theorem middle_mem_normalizer_of_parabolic_factors {p a r b : Artin.Group M}
    (ha : a ∈ Artin.parabolic M J) (hb : b ∈ Artin.parabolic M J)
    (hp : p ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M J : Set (Artin.Group M)))
    (hprod : p = a * r * b) :
    r ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M J : Set (Artin.Group M)) := by
  have haN := (Artin.parabolic M J).le_normalizer ha
  have hbN := (Artin.parabolic M J).le_normalizer hb
  have hr : a⁻¹ * p * b⁻¹ = r := by
    rw [hprod]
    group
  rw [← hr]
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ haN) hp)
    (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hbN)

parabolic and its actual generated reduced ribbon loop subgroup. -/
noncomputable def normalizerSemidirectEquiv (X : RibbonObject M) :
    Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M X.indices : Set (Artin.Group M)) ≃*
      (Artin.parabolic M X.indices) ⋊[reducedRibbonParabolicAction M X]
        (reducedRibbonLoops M X) :=

/-- Multiplication of the actual two factors, with its codomain restricted
to the actual normalizer. -/
def normalizerSemidirectMap (X : RibbonObject M) :
    (Artin.parabolic M X.indices) ⋊[reducedRibbonParabolicAction M X]
      (reducedRibbonLoops M X) →*
        Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M X.indices : Set (Artin.Group M)) := by
  let f : (Artin.parabolic M X.indices) ⋊[reducedRibbonParabolicAction M X]
      (reducedRibbonLoops M X) →* Artin.Group M :=
    SemidirectProduct.lift (Artin.parabolic M X.indices).subtype
      (reducedRibbonLoops M X).subtype (by intro r; ext a; rfl)
  exact f.codRestrict _ (fun x => Subgroup.mul_mem _
    ((Artin.parabolic M X.indices).le_normalizer x.left.property)
    (reducedRibbonLoop_mem_normalizer M X x.right))

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.normalizerSemid.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.normalizerSemidirectMap_bijective
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.normalizerSemid.source_declaration:
theorem normalizerSemidirectMap_bijective (X : RibbonObject M) :
    Function.Bijective (normalizerSemidirectMap M X) := by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have he := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
    change (x.left : Artin.Group M) * (x.right : Artin.Group M) =
      (y.left : Artin.Group M) * (y.right : Artin.Group M) at he
    have hloop : (x.right : Artin.Group M) * (y.right : Artin.Group M)⁻¹ ∈
        reducedRibbonLoops M X := Subgroup.mul_mem _ x.right.property
          (Subgroup.inv_mem _ y.right.property)
    have hprod : (x.right : Artin.Group M) * (y.right : Artin.Group M)⁻¹ =
        (x.left : Artin.Group M)⁻¹ * (y.left : Artin.Group M) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun a : Artin.Group M =>
        (x.left : Artin.Group M)⁻¹ * a * (y.right : Artin.Group M)⁻¹) he
      simpa [mul_assoc] using h
    have hpar : (x.right : Artin.Group M) * (y.right : Artin.Group M)⁻¹ ∈
        Artin.parabolic M X.indices := by
      rw [hprod]
      exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ x.left.property) y.left.property
    have heq := reducedRibbonLoop_parabolic_eq_one M X hloop hpar
    have hright : x.right = y.right := Subtype.ext (mul_inv_eq_one.1 heq)
    have hleft : x.left = y.left := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hright] at he
      exact mul_right_cancel he
    exact SemidirectProduct.ext hleft hright
  · intro β
    obtain ⟨a, ha, r, hr, hprod⟩ :=
      exists_parabolic_reducedRibbon_factorization M X β.val β.property
    exact ⟨⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩, Subtype.ext hprod.symm⟩

/-- Two concrete decorated atomic paths of the same actual lcm, beginning
with the prescribed distinct outside labels. All intermediate objects and
labels remain part of the words. -/
theorem pairRibbonLcm_atomicWords (J : Set I) (a b : I)
    (ha : a ∉ J) (hb : b ∉ J) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ∃ wa : AtomicWord M (atomicNext M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M) a)
        ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert b (insert a J)) J⟩,
    ∃ wb : AtomicWord M (atomicNext M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M) b)
        ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert b (insert a J)) J⟩,
      (AtomicWord.cons a ha wa).eval = pairRibbonLcm M J a b ∧
      (AtomicWord.cons b hb wb).eval = pairRibbonLcm M J a b := by
  obtain ⟨qa, qb, hqa, hqb, hea, heb⟩ := pairRibbonLcm_factorizations M J a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨wa, hwa⟩ := (positiveReducedArrow_iff_exists_atomicWord M).mp hqa
  obtain ⟨wb, hwb⟩ := (positiveReducedArrow_iff_exists_atomicWord M).mp hqb
  refine ⟨wa, wb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change elementaryMu M J a * wa.eval = pairRibbonLcm M J a b
    rw [hwa]
    exact hea.symm
  · change elementaryMu M J b * wb.eval = pairRibbonLcm M J a b
    rw [hwb]
    exact heb.symm

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.pairRibbonLcm_f.source_declaration:
/-- Distinct outside labels yield two positive generated factorizations of
the actual same lcm, with first labels `a` and `b` and an actual common target.
The tails may be identity arrows. -/
theorem pairRibbonLcm_factorizations (J : Set I) (a b : I)
    (ha : a ∉ J) (hb : b ∉ J) (_hab : a ≠ b) :
    ∃ qa qb : Artin.Group M,
      PositiveReducedArrow M ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert a J) J⟩
        ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert b (insert a J)) J⟩ qa ∧
      PositiveReducedArrow M ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert b J) J⟩
        ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert b (insert a J)) J⟩ qb ∧
      pairRibbonLcm M J a b = elementaryMu M J a * qa ∧
      pairRibbonLcm M J a b = elementaryMu M J b * qb := by
  obtain ⟨hpa, hpb, -⟩ := pairRibbonLcm_is_left_lcm M J a b
  obtain ⟨qa, hqa, hea⟩ := positive_ribbon_elementary_tail M
    (pairRibbonLcm_positive M J a b) (pairRibbonLcm_leftReduced M J a b)
    (pairRibbonLcm_isRibbon M J a b) a ha hpa
  obtain ⟨qb, hqb, heb⟩ := positive_ribbon_elementary_tail M
    (pairRibbonLcm_positive M J a b) (pairRibbonLcm_leftReduced M J a b)
    (pairRibbonLcm_isRibbon M J a b) b hb hpb
  exact ⟨qa, qb, hqa, hqb, hea, heb⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.pairRibbonLcm_i.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.pairRibbonLcm_is_left_lcm
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.pairRibbonLcm_i.source_declaration:
/-- The ratio is the left-lcm of the two actual elementary ribbons in the
entire positive monoid; no lcm structure or completeness hypothesis is assumed. -/
theorem pairRibbonLcm_is_left_lcm (J : Set I) (a b : I) :
    (∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
      pairRibbonLcm M J a b = elementaryMu M J a * q) ∧
    (∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
      pairRibbonLcm M J a b = elementaryMu M J b * q) ∧
    ∀ p : Artin.Group M, p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ →
      (∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, p = elementaryMu M J a * q) →
      (∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, p = elementaryMu M J b * q) →
      ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, p = pairRibbonLcm M J a b * q := by
  refine ⟨parabolicDelta_ratio_elementary_prefix M J _ (source_subset_pair J a b) a
      (Set.mem_insert_of_mem b (Set.mem_insert a J)),
    parabolicDelta_ratio_elementary_prefix M J _ (source_subset_pair J a b) b
      (Set.mem_insert b _), ?_⟩
  intro p hp hpa hpb
  have hδ : parabolicDelta M J ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
    selected_positive_univ M J (parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M J)
  have hJ : ∀ j ∈ J, ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
      parabolicDelta M J * p = Artin.generator M j * q := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨q, hq, he⟩ := (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M J j).mpr hj
    exact ⟨q * p, (actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hq hp,
      by rw [he, mul_assoc]⟩
  have hadded : ∀ c : I,
      (∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, p = elementaryMu M J c * q) →
      ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
        parabolicDelta M J * p = Artin.generator M c * q := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨q, hq, he⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hd⟩ :=
      (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M (insert c J) c).mpr (Set.mem_insert c J)
    refine ⟨r * q, (actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hr hq, ?_⟩
    rw [he, elementaryMu]
    calc
      parabolicDelta M J * ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M (insert c J) * q) =
          parabolicDelta M (insert c J) * q := by group
      _ = Artin.generator M c * (r * q) := by rw [hd, mul_assoc]
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqeq⟩ := parabolicDelta_left_lcm M (insert b (insert a J))
    (parabolicDelta M J * p) ((actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hδ hp) (by
      intro j hj
      rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hj with hjb | hj
      · simpa only [hjb] using hadded b hpb
      · rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hj with hja | hj
        · simpa only [hja] using hadded a hpa
        · exact hJ j hj)
  refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
  unfold pairRibbonLcm
  calc
    p = (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * (parabolicDelta M J * p) := by group
    _ = (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * (parabolicDelta M (insert b (insert a J)) * q) := by rw [hqeq]
    _ = (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M (insert b (insert a J)) * q := by group

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.pairRibbonLcm_w.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.pairRibbonLcm_weakPrefix_join
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.pairRibbonLcm_w.source_declaration:
/-- The Coxeter projection of the actual ribbon lcm is the weak-prefix join
of the projections of its two elementary prefixes, with the full universal
property. No lattice instance is assumed. -/
theorem pairRibbonLcm_weakPrefix_join (J : Set I) (a b : I) :
    let u := (parabolicLongest M J)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M (insert a J)
    let v := (parabolicLongest M J)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M (insert b J)
    let l := (parabolicLongest M J)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M (insert b (insert a J))
    WeakPrefix M.toCoxeterSystem u l ∧ WeakPrefix M.toCoxeterSystem v l ∧
      ∀ w, WeakPrefix M.toCoxeterSystem u w → WeakPrefix M.toCoxeterSystem v w →
        WeakPrefix M.toCoxeterSystem l w := by
  dsimp only
  have ha := parabolicDelta_ratio_eq_simpleLift M J (insert a J) (Set.subset_insert a J)
  change elementaryMu M J a = _ at ha
  have hb := parabolicDelta_ratio_eq_simpleLift M J (insert b J) (Set.subset_insert b J)
  change elementaryMu M J b = _ at hb
  have hl := parabolicDelta_ratio_eq_simpleLift M J (insert b (insert a J))
    (source_subset_pair J a b)
  change pairRibbonLcm M J a b = _ at hl
  obtain ⟨hpa, hpb, hleast⟩ := pairRibbonLcm_is_left_lcm M J a b
  refine ⟨(simpleLift_actual_prefix_iff M _ _).mp ?_,
    (simpleLift_actual_prefix_iff M _ _).mp ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hl, ← ha]
    exact hpa
  · rw [← hl, ← hb]
    exact hpb
  · intro w huw hvw
    apply (simpleLift_actual_prefix_iff M _ _).mp
    rw [← hl]
    apply hleast _ (positiveActualHom M (positiveSimpleLift M w)).property
    · have h := (simpleLift_actual_prefix_iff M _ _).mpr huw
      rwa [← ha] at h
    · have h := (simpleLift_actual_prefix_iff M _ _).mpr hvw
      rwa [← hb] at h

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.parabolicDelta.source_declaration:

/-- The longest parabolic element acts on selected generators by an
actual permutation relation, transported to the unchanged parent group. -/
theorem parabolicDelta_generator_permutation (J : Set I) (i : J) :
    ∃ j : J, parabolicDelta M J * Artin.generator M i =
      Artin.generator M j * parabolicDelta M J := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨j, hij⟩ := longest_conjugates_simple (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem
    (parabolicLongestRestricted M J) (parabolicLongestRestricted_max M J) i

    (parabolicLongestRestricted M J) (parabolicLongestRestricted_max M J) i j hij
  have he := congrArg (fun a => toParent M (restrictedArtinHom M J a)) h
  simpa only [map_mul, restrictedArtinHom_generator, toParent_generator, parabolicDelta] using he

/-- The inverse direction uses involutivity of the longest Coxeter element
and the same positive lift, rather than identifying a positive inverse lift
with the inverse Artin element. -/
theorem parabolicDelta_generator_permutation_reverse (J : Set I) (i : J) :
    ∃ j : J, Artin.generator M i * parabolicDelta M J =
      parabolicDelta M J * Artin.generator M j := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let z := parabolicLongestRestricted M J
  have hz := parabolicLongestRestricted_max M J
  obtain ⟨j, hij⟩ := longest_conjugates_simple (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem z hz i
  have hzz := longest_mul_self (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem z hz
  have hji : z * (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.simple j * z =
      (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.simple i := by
    rw [← hij]
    calc
      z * (z * (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.simple i * z) * z =
          (z * z) * (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.simple i * (z * z) := by group
      _ = _ := by rw [hzz, one_mul, mul_one]
  have h := positiveLift_longest_conjugate (restrictedMatrix M J) z hz j i hji
  have he := congrArg (fun a => toParent M (restrictedArtinHom M J a)) h
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  simpa only [map_mul, restrictedArtinHom_generator, toParent_generator, parabolicDelta, z] using he.symm

theorem parabolicDelta_insert_left_lcm (J : Set I) (a : I) (p : Artin.Group M)
    (hp : p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hJ : ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, p = parabolicDelta M J * q)
    (ha : ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, p = Artin.generator M a * q) :
    ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, p = parabolicDelta M (insert a J) * q := by
  apply parabolicDelta_left_lcm M _ p hp
  intro j hj
  rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hj with rfl | hj
  · exact ha
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, hprod⟩ := hJ
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hd⟩ := (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M J j).mpr hj
    exact ⟨r * q, (actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hr hq,
      by rw [hprod, hd, mul_assoc]⟩
