ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.parabolicDelta_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.parabolicDelta_isRibbon
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.parabolicDelta_.source_declaration:
theorem parabolicDelta_isRibbon (J : Set I) :
    IsRibbon M ⟨J⟩ ⟨J⟩ (parabolicDelta M J) := by
  let d := parabolicDelta M J
  have hf : actualPositiveParabolic M J ≤
      (actualPositiveParabolic M J).comap (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom := by
    apply Submonoid.closure_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := parabolicDelta_generator_permutation M J ⟨i, hi⟩
    change d * Artin.generator M i * d⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J
    rw [hj, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    exact generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J j.property
  have hb : actualPositiveParabolic M J ≤
      (actualPositiveParabolic M J).comap (MulAut.conj d⁻¹).toMonoidHom := by
    apply Submonoid.closure_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := parabolicDelta_generator_permutation_reverse M J ⟨i, hi⟩
    change d⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * (d⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J
    have he : d⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * d = Artin.generator M j := by
      rw [mul_assoc, hj]
      simp [d]
    simpa only [inv_inv, he] using generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J j.property
  intro b
  constructor
  · intro hb'
    have h := hb hb'
    change d⁻¹ * b * (d⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J at h
    simpa only [inv_inv] using h
  · intro hb'
    have h := hf hb'
    change d * (d⁻¹ * b * d) * d⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J at h
    simpa [mul_assoc] using h

/-- The same global left-lcm statement, with actual elements and actual
positive quotients in the unchanged parent Artin group. -/
theorem parabolicDelta_left_lcm (J : Set I) (p : Artin.Group M)
    (hp : p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (h : ∀ j ∈ J, ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
      p = Artin.generator M j * q) :
    ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ, p = parabolicDelta M J * q := by

    intro j hj
    apply (positivePrefix_iff_parentQuotient M _ _).mpr
    simpa only [positiveToParent_generator] using h j hj
  simpa only [positiveToParent_positiveDelta] using
    (positivePrefix_iff_parentQuotient M _ _).mp (positiveDelta_left_lcm M J p hall)

theorem parabolicDelta_ratio_conjugates_generator (J K : Set I) (hJK : J ⊆ K) (i : J) :
    ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K)⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i *
        ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K) =
      Artin.generator M (parabolicTwist M K
        ⟨parabolicTwist M J i, hJK (parabolicTwist M J i).property⟩) := by
  let j : K := ⟨parabolicTwist M J i, hJK (parabolicTwist M J i).property⟩
  calc
    ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K)⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i *
        ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K) =
      (parabolicDelta M K)⁻¹ *
        (parabolicDelta M J * Artin.generator M i * (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹) *
          parabolicDelta M K := by group
    _ = (parabolicDelta M K)⁻¹ * Artin.generator M j * parabolicDelta M K := by
      rw [parabolicTwist_relation, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    _ = Artin.generator M (parabolicTwist M K j) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, parabolicTwist_relation_reverse]
      simp

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.parabolicDelta_.source_declaration:
/-- A nested fundamental ratio is the actual positive lift of its Coxeter
projection. This follows from the proved simple-prefix divisibility bridge. -/
theorem parabolicDelta_ratio_eq_simpleLift (J K : Set I) (hJK : J ⊆ K) :
    (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K =
      positiveToParent M (positiveSimpleLift M
        ((parabolicLongest M J)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M K)) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hp := positiveDelta_prefix_of_subset M J K hJK
  change PositivePrefix M (positiveSimpleLift M (parabolicLongest M J))
    (positiveSimpleLift M (parabolicLongest M K)) at hp
  have hweak := (positivePrefix_simple_iff M _ _).mp hp
  have hmul := positiveSimpleLift_mul M (parabolicLongest M J)
    ((parabolicLongest M J)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M K)
    (by simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using
      (show M.toCoxeterSystem.length (parabolicLongest M K) =
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (parabolicLongest M J) +
          M.toCoxeterSystem.length ((parabolicLongest M J)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M K)
        from hweak))
  rw [mul_inv_cancel_left] at hmul
  have h := congrArg (positiveToParent M) hmul
  rw [map_mul] at h
  have hJ : positiveToParent M (positiveSimpleLift M (parabolicLongest M J)) =
      parabolicDelta M J := positiveToParent_positiveDelta M J
  have hK : positiveToParent M (positiveSimpleLift M (parabolicLongest M K)) =
      parabolicDelta M K := positiveToParent_positiveDelta M K
  rw [hJ, hK] at h
  rw [h]
  group

/-- Every nested-parabolic ratio has its genuine conjugated-index endpoint.
No elementary labels are discarded by imposing this as a selection filter. -/
theorem parabolicDelta_ratio_isRibbon (J K : Set I) (hJK : J ⊆ K) :
    IsRibbon M ⟨J⟩ ⟨parabolicTwistImage M K J⟩
      ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K) := by
  let f : J → I := fun i => parabolicTwist M K
    ⟨parabolicTwist M J i, hJK (parabolicTwist M J i).property⟩
  have heq : Set.range f = parabolicTwistImage M K J := by
    ext k
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨parabolicTwist M J i, hJK (parabolicTwist M J i).property⟩,
        (parabolicTwist M J i).property, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, hik⟩
      let j : J := ⟨i, hi⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (parabolicTwist M J).surjective j
      refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
      have hsub : (⟨parabolicTwist M J s, hJK (parabolicTwist M J s).property⟩ : K) = i := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg (fun t : J => (t : I)) hs
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [hsub]
      exact hik
  have h := isRibbon_of_generator_conjugates M J f
    ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K)
      (parabolicDelta_ratio_conjugates_generator M J K hJK)
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

/-- A selected atom cannot left-divide a fundamental-element ratio. Such a
divisor would make `Δ_J σ_i` simple, contradicting maximal parabolic length.
The nestedness premise is retained for the positive-ratio interface. -/
theorem parabolicDelta_ratio_leftReduced (J K : Set I) (_hJK : J ⊆ K) :
    IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  intro i hi q hq he
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual] at hq
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hq
  have hfactor : (positiveDelta M J * positiveGenerator M i) * q = positiveDelta M K := by
    apply positiveToParent_injective M
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, positiveToParent_positiveDelta, positiveToParent_generator,
      positiveToParent_positiveDelta]
    calc
      parabolicDelta M J * Artin.generator M i * positiveToParent M q =
          parabolicDelta M J * (Artin.generator M i * positiveToParent M q) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = parabolicDelta M J * ((parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K) := by rw [he]
      _ = parabolicDelta M K := by group
  have hs := (positive_simple_factors M (positiveDelta M J * positiveGenerator M i) q
    (parabolicLongest M K) hfactor).1
  have hd := congrArg (positiveDegree M) hs
  simp only [positiveDegree_mul, positiveDelta, positiveDegree_simpleLift,
    positiveDegree_generator, map_mul, positiveToCoxeter_simpleLift,
    positiveToCoxeter_generator] at hd
  have hw : parabolicLongest M J * M.toCoxeterSystem.simple i ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J :=
    (Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).mul_mem (parabolicLongest_mem_parabolic M J)
      (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
  have hmax := parabolicLongest_max M J hw
  omega

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.parabolicDelta_.source_declaration:
theorem parabolicDelta_ratio_positive (J K : Set I) (hJK : J ⊆ K) :
    (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M K := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hmono : Artin.coxeterParabolic M J ≤ Artin.coxeterParabolic M K :=
    Subgroup.closure_mono (Set.image_mono hJK)
  have hwJ := hmono (parabolicLongest_mem_parabolic M J)
  have hlen := parabolicLongest_left_length M K hwJ
  have he := positiveLift_mul M (parabolicLongest M J)
    ((parabolicLongest M J)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M K) (by
      simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using hlen.symm)
  simp only [mul_inv_cancel_left] at he
  have hw : (parabolicLongest M J)⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M K ∈
      Artin.coxeterParabolic M K := (Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).mul_mem
        ((Artin.coxeterParabolic M K).inv_mem hwJ) (parabolicLongest_mem_parabolic M K)
  rw [← restrictionHom_range M K] at hw
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hw
  have hd : (parabolicDelta M J)⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M K =
      toParent M (restrictedArtinHom M K (positiveLift (restrictedMatrix M K) v)) := by
    rw [restrictedArtinHom_positiveLift, hv, parabolicDelta_eq_globalPositiveLift,
      parabolicDelta_eq_globalPositiveLift, he, map_mul]
    simp
  rw [hd]
  change toParent M (restrictedArtinHom M K
    (wordArtin (restrictedMatrix M K) (reducedExpression (restrictedMatrix M K) v))) ∈ _
  rw [restrictedArtinHom_word]
  rw [show toParent M (wordArtin M
    ((reducedExpression (restrictedMatrix M K) v).map Subtype.val)) =
      Artin.wordProd M ((reducedExpression (restrictedMatrix M K) v).map Subtype.val) from
        presentationEquiv_word M _]
  apply wordProd_mem_actualPositiveParabolic
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hi
  exact j.property

/-- Every parabolic element is a length-additive left factor of its
parabolic longest element, in the ambient Coxeter length. -/
theorem parabolicLongest_left_length (J : Set I) {w : M.Group}
    (hw : w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.length w +
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (w⁻¹ * parabolicLongest M J) =
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (parabolicLongest M J) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  rw [← restrictionHom_range M J] at hw
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hw
  let z := parabolicLongestRestricted M J
  have hz := parabolicLongestRestricted_max M J
  have hzz := longest_mul_self (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem z hz
  have hzi : z⁻¹ = z := by
    calc
      z⁻¹ = z⁻¹ * (z * z) := by rw [hzz, mul_one]
      _ = z := by group
  have h := length_mul_of_all_descents (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem z
    (all_descents_of_longest (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem z hz) v
  have hinv : (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.length (v⁻¹ * z) =
      (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.length (z * v) := by
    rw [← (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.length_inv (z * v)]
    simp only [mul_inv_rev, hzi]
  simp only [parabolicLongest, ← map_inv, ← map_mul, restriction_length]
  change (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.length v +
    (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.length (v⁻¹ * z) =
      (restrictedMatrix M J).toCoxeterSystem.length z
  rw [hinv]
  omega

    parabolicLongest M J * parabolicLongest M J = 1 := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M

theorem parabolicTwistIndex_involutive (J : Set I) :
    Function.Involutive (parabolicTwistIndex M J) := by
  intro i
  have hrel (j : J) : parabolicLongest M J * M.simple j * parabolicLongest M J =
      M.simple (parabolicTwistIndex M J j) := by
    have h := congrArg (Artin.projection M) (parabolicTwistIndex_relation M J j)
    simp only [map_mul, projection_parabolicDelta, Artin.projection_generator] at h
    rw [h, mul_assoc, parabolicLongest_mul_self, mul_one]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply M.toCoxeterSystem.simple_injective
  change M.simple (parabolicTwistIndex M J (parabolicTwistIndex M J i) : I) = M.simple i
  rw [← hrel, ← hrel]
  calc
    parabolicLongest M J * (parabolicLongest M J * M.simple i * parabolicLongest M J) *
        parabolicLongest M J =
      (parabolicLongest M J * parabolicLongest M J) * M.simple i *
        (parabolicLongest M J * parabolicLongest M J) := by group
    _ = M.simple i := by rw [parabolicLongest_mul_self, one_mul, mul_one]

/-- Positive fractions inside the actual generated parabolic. -/
theorem parabolic_positive_fraction (J : Set I) {g : Artin.Group M}
    (hg : g ∈ Artin.parabolic M J) :
    ∃ a b : PositiveArtin M,
      positiveToParent M a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      positiveToParent M b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      g = positiveToParent M a * (positiveToParent M b)⁻¹ := by
  classical
  let := Theorem18.finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hJ : IsSpherical M J := by unfold IsSpherical; infer_instance
  have hg' : (presentationEquiv M).symm g ∈ artinParabolic M J := by
    have : g ∈ (artinParabolic M J).map (presentationEquiv M).toMonoidHom := by
      rwa [presentationEquiv_parabolic]
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := this
    change presentationEquiv M x = g at hxe
    rw [← hxe, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he⟩ := sphericalParabolic_positive_fraction M J hJ hg'
  refine ⟨wordPositive M u, wordPositive M v, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [positiveToParent_word]
    exact wordProd_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J u hu
  · rw [positiveToParent_word]
    exact wordProd_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J v hv
  · have h := congrArg (presentationEquiv M) he
    simpa only [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_mul, map_inv,
      presentationEquiv_word, positiveToParent_word] using h

theorem parabolic_positive_left_fraction (J : Set I) {g : Artin.Group M}
    (hg : g ∈ Artin.parabolic M J) :
    ∃ a b : PositiveArtin M,
      positiveToParent M a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      positiveToParent M b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      g = (positiveToParent M a)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M b := by
  classical

  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hJ : IsSpherical M J := by unfold IsSpherical; infer_instance
  have hg' : (presentationEquiv M).symm g ∈ artinParabolic M J := by
    have : g ∈ (artinParabolic M J).map (presentationEquiv M).toMonoidHom := by
      rwa [presentationEquiv_parabolic]
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := this
    change presentationEquiv M x = g at hxe
    rw [← hxe, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hx
  rw [← restrictedArtinHom_range M J] at hg'
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hg'
  let := OAI.HarmonicArtin.Geometric.restricted_finite M J hJ
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := finiteArtin_positive_left_fraction (restrictedMatrix M J) x
  refine ⟨wordPositive M (u.map Subtype.val), wordPositive M (v.map Subtype.val), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [positiveToParent_word]
    apply wordProd_mem_actualPositiveParabolic
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hi
    exact j.property
  · rw [positiveToParent_word]
    apply wordProd_mem_actualPositiveParabolic
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hi
    exact j.property
  · have he := congrArg (presentationEquiv M)
      (hx.symm.trans (congrArg (restrictedArtinHom M J) huv))
    simpa only [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_mul, map_inv,
      restrictedArtinHom_word, presentationEquiv_word, positiveToParent_word] using he

/-- The same index map on the unchanged parent Artin-group presentations. -/
def parentArtinMap (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (N : CoxeterMatrix K) (f : I → K)
    (hf : ∀ i j, N (f i) (f j) = M i j) : Artin.Group M →* Artin.Group N :=

    intro i j
    have h := TauCeti.ArtinGroup.prod_map_gen_braidWord N (f i) (f j)
    simp only [CoxeterSystem.braidWord, hf i j, hf j i] at h ⊢
    simpa only [Artin.generator, ← map_alternatingWord f i j (M i j),
      ← map_alternatingWord f j i (M j i), List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using h

/-- The positive presentation is canonically isomorphic to the actual positive
submonoid. Its underlying map is the canonical generator map. -/
noncomputable def positiveActualEquiv (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] :
    PositiveArtin M ≃* actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
  MulEquiv.ofBijective (positiveActualHom M) ⟨
    fun _ _ h => positiveToParent_injective M (congrArg Subtype.val h), by
      intro a
      have ha : (a : Artin.Group M) ∈ MonoidHom.mrange (positiveToParent M) := by
        simpa only [positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual] using a.property
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha
      exact ⟨b, Subtype.ext hb⟩⟩

theorem positiveDelta_insert_is_left_lcm (J : Set I) (a : I) :
    PositivePrefix M (positiveDelta M J) (positiveDelta M (insert a J)) ∧
    PositivePrefix M (positiveGenerator M a) (positiveDelta M (insert a J)) ∧
    ∀ p : PositiveArtin M, PositivePrefix M (positiveDelta M J) p →
      PositivePrefix M (positiveGenerator M a) p →
      PositivePrefix M (positiveDelta M (insert a J)) p := by
  refine ⟨positiveDelta_prefix_of_subset M J _ (Set.subset_insert a J),
    positiveGenerator_prefix_positiveDelta_of_mem M _ (Set.mem_insert a J), ?_⟩
  intro p hJ ha
  apply positiveDelta_left_lcm M _ p
  intro j hj
  rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hj with rfl | hj
  · exact ha
  · exact positivePrefix_trans M (positiveGenerator_prefix_positiveDelta_of_mem M J hj) hJ

/-- The parabolic fundamental lift is the global positive left-lcm of all
selected atoms, not just an lcm computed inside the selected parabolic. -/
theorem positiveDelta_left_lcm (J : Set I) (p : PositiveArtin M)
    (hp : ∀ j ∈ J, PositivePrefix M (positiveGenerator M j) p) :
    PositivePrefix M (positiveDelta M J) p := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  obtain ⟨g, hgp, hg⟩ := positive_head M p
  have hdesc : ∀ j ∈ J,
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j * g) <
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length g := by
    intro j hj
    have hjp : PositivePrefix M (positiveSimpleLift M (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j)) p := by
      simpa only [positiveSimpleLift_simple] using hp j hj
    have hw := (positivePrefix_simple_iff M _ _).mp (hg _ hjp)
    have hl := (weakPrefix_simple_iff M.toCoxeterSystem j g).mp hw
    omega
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqg⟩ := positive_longest_descent_prefix M J g hdesc
  have heq : q = parabolicLongestRestricted M J :=
    longest_unique (restrictedMatrix M J) q (parabolicLongestRestricted M J) hq
      (parabolicLongestRestricted_max M J)
  rw [heq] at hqg
  exact positivePrefix_trans M hqg hgp

/-- An actual multiplicative equivalence of positive presentations along a
label-preserving equivalence of index types, possibly in different universes. -/
def positiveEquivOfLabels (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (N : CoxeterMatrix K) (e : I ≃ K)
    (he : ∀ i j, N (e i) (e j) = M i j) : PositiveArtin M ≃* PositiveArtin N :=
  MonoidHom.toMulEquiv (positiveMap M N e he)
    (positiveMap N M e.symm (inverse_label_eq M N e he))
    (by
      apply PresentedMonoid.ext
      intro i
      change positiveMap N M e.symm (inverse_label_eq M N e he)
        (positiveMap M N e he (positiveGenerator M i)) = positiveGenerator M i
      simp)
    (by
      apply PresentedMonoid.ext
      intro i
      change positiveMap M N e he
        (positiveMap N M e.symm (inverse_label_eq M N e he) (positiveGenerator N i)) =
          positiveGenerator N i
      simp)

/-- Exactly the selected atoms left-divide the fundamental element. -/
theorem positiveGenerator_prefix_positiveDelta_iff (J : Set I) (j : I) :
    PositivePrefix M (positiveGenerator M j) (positiveDelta M J) ↔ j ∈ J := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    have hm : positiveToParent M (positiveGenerator M j * c) ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J := by
      rw [← hc, positiveToParent_positiveDelta]
      exact parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M J
    have ha := (positive_factors_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J _ _ hm).1
    have hs := (positiveToParent_mem_iff_support M J (positiveGenerator M j)).mp ha
    simpa only [positiveSupport_generator, Set.singleton_subset_iff] using hs
  · exact positiveGenerator_prefix_positiveDelta_of_mem M J

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.positiveGenerat.source_declaration:
theorem positiveGenerator_prefix_positiveDelta_of_mem (J : Set I) {j : I} (hj : j ∈ J) :
    PositivePrefix M (positiveGenerator M j) (positiveDelta M J) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hm : M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J :=
    Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  have hl := parabolicLongest_left_length M J hm
  have hp : PositivePrefix M (positiveSimpleLift M (M.toCoxeterSystem.simple j))
      (positiveDelta M J) :=
    (positivePrefix_simple_iff M _ _).mpr hl.symm
  simpa only [positiveSimpleLift_simple] using hp

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.positiveGenerat.source_declaration:
/-- Exactly the selected atoms right-divide the same actual fundamental
element; no positive inverse of a Coxeter lift is substituted. -/
theorem positiveGenerator_suffix_positiveDelta_iff (J : Set I) (j : I) :
    PositiveSuffix M (positiveGenerator M j) (positiveDelta M J) ↔ j ∈ J := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    have hm : positiveToParent M (c * positiveGenerator M j) ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J := by

theorem positiveReducedArrow_iff_exists_atomicWord {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r : Artin.Group M} :

  constructor
  · intro h

    | @elementary X Y a ha hr =>

      subst Y

    | comp hβ hγ ihβ ihγ =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ihβ

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.positiveSimpleL.source_declaration:
theorem positiveSimpleLift_suffix_positiveDelta_iff (J : Set I) (w : M.Group) :
    PositiveSuffix M (positiveSimpleLift M w) (positiveDelta M J) ↔
      w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    apply selected_of_simpleLift_mem M J w
    apply (positive_factors_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J c _ ?_).2
    rw [← hc, positiveToParent_positiveDelta]
    exact parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M J
  · intro hw
    let z := parabolicLongest M J
    have hzz : z * z = 1 := parabolicLongest_mul_self M J
    have hzi : z⁻¹ = z := by
      calc
        z⁻¹ = z⁻¹ * (z * z) := by rw [hzz, mul_one]
        _ = z := by group
    have hl := parabolicLongest_left_length M J ((Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).inv_mem hw)
    simp only [inv_inv, M.toCoxeterSystem.length_inv] at hl
    change M.toCoxeterSystem.length w + M.toCoxeterSystem.length (w * z) =
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length z at hl
    have hi : M.toCoxeterSystem.length (z * w⁻¹) =
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (w * z) := by
      rw [← M.toCoxeterSystem.length_inv (z * w⁻¹)]
      simp only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, hzi]
    have hlen : M.toCoxeterSystem.length ((z * w⁻¹) * w) =
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (z * w⁻¹) + M.toCoxeterSystem.length w := by
      rw [inv_mul_cancel_right, hi]
      exact (by omega : M.toCoxeterSystem.length z =
        M.toCoxeterSystem.length (w * z) + M.toCoxeterSystem.length w)
    exact ⟨positiveSimpleLift M (z * w⁻¹), by
      simpa only [inv_mul_cancel_right, positiveDelta, z] using
        positiveSimpleLift_mul M (z * w⁻¹) w hlen⟩

/-- The actual positive presentation embeds in the unchanged parent Artin
group for every spherical Coxeter matrix, in any index universe. -/
theorem positiveToParent_injective (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] :
    Function.Injective (positiveToParent M) := by
  classical
  let : Finite I := Finite.of_injective M.toCoxeterSystem.simple
    M.toCoxeterSystem.simple_injective
  let : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let e : I ≃ Fin (Fintype.card I) := Fintype.equivFin I
  let N : CoxeterMatrix (Fin (Fintype.card I)) := M.reindex e
  let : Finite N.Group := Finite.of_equiv M.Group (M.reindexGroupEquiv e).symm.toEquiv
  exact positiveToParent_injective_of_labels M N e
    (by intro i j; simp [N, CoxeterMatrix.reindex_apply])
    (positiveToParent_injective_typeZero N)

/-- Injectivity of the actual positive presentation map transports through
an index equivalence and its explicitly proved commuting diagram. -/
theorem positiveToParent_injective_of_labels (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (N : CoxeterMatrix K)
    (e : I ≃ K) (he : ∀ i j, N (e i) (e j) = M i j)
    (hN : Function.Injective (positiveToParent N)) :
    Function.Injective (positiveToParent M) := by
  intro a b hab
  apply (positiveEquivOfLabels M N e he).injective
  change positiveMap M N e he a = positiveMap M N e he b
  apply hN
  change ((positiveToParent N).comp (positiveMap M N e he)) a =
    ((positiveToParent N).comp (positiveMap M N e he)) b
  rw [positiveToParent_map]
  exact congrArg (parentArtinMap M N e he) hab

/-- The lcm of an atom and a positive reduced transporter is obtained by
transporting that atom across the ribbon. The statement gives its universal
property directly in the positive presentation. -/
theorem positive_atom_ribbon_lcm (J : Set I) (r : PositiveArtin M) (i j : I)
    (hi : i ∈ J) (hred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J (positiveToParent M r))
    (hrel : positiveGenerator M i * r = r * positiveGenerator M j)
    (a : PositiveArtin M) (hia : PositivePrefix M (positiveGenerator M i) a)
    (hra : PositivePrefix M r a) : PositivePrefix M (r * positiveGenerator M j) a := by
  obtain ⟨l, hil, hrl, hl⟩ := positive_lcm_left M (positiveGenerator M i) r
  have hlbound := hl (r * positiveGenerator M j) ⟨r, hrel.symm⟩ ⟨positiveGenerator M j, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hrl
  have hvj : PositivePrefix M v (positiveGenerator M j) :=
    (positivePrefix_mul_left_iff M (positive_cancel_left M) r v (positiveGenerator M j)).1
      (hv ▸ hlbound)
  have hvne : v ≠ 1 := by
    intro hv1
    have hlr : l = r := by rw [hv, hv1, mul_one]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hil
    apply hred i hi (positiveToParent M c) (positiveActualHom M c).property
    have h := congrArg (positiveToParent M) (hlr.symm.trans hc)
    simpa only [map_mul, positiveToParent_generator] using h.symm
  have hdeg := positivePrefix_degree M hvj
  rw [positiveDegree_generator] at hdeg
  have hvdeg : positiveDegree M v = 1 := by
    have hn : positiveDegree M v ≠ 0 := mt (positiveDegree_zero_iff M v).1 hvne
    omega
  have hveq : v = positiveGenerator M j :=
    positivePrefix_eq_of_degree M hvj (by rw [hvdeg, positiveDegree_generator])
  have hleq : l = r * positiveGenerator M j := by rw [hv, hveq]
  simpa only [hleq] using hl a hia hra

/-- Two positives have a common right multiple, obtained from actual group
fractions and reflected through the proved injective canonical map. -/
theorem positive_common_multiple_left (a b : PositiveArtin M) :
    ∃ c : PositiveArtin M, PositivePrefix M a c ∧ PositivePrefix M b c := by
  let f := positiveToParent M
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := positive_fraction M ((f a)⁻¹ * f b)
  have he : f (a * x) = f (b * y) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
    have hm := eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq.mp hxy
    rw [mul_assoc] at hm
    exact (inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp hm).symm
  have hp := positiveToParent_injective M he
  exact ⟨a * x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, ⟨y, hp⟩⟩

theorem positive_common_multiple_right (a b : PositiveArtin M) :
    ∃ c : PositiveArtin M, PositiveSuffix M a c ∧ PositiveSuffix M b c := by
  let f := positiveToParent M
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := positive_left_fraction M (f a * (f b)⁻¹)
  change f a * (f b)⁻¹ = (f x)⁻¹ * f y at hxy
  have he : f (x * a) = f (y * b) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
    calc
      f x * f a = (f x * (f a * (f b)⁻¹)) * f b := by group
      _ = f y * f b := by rw [hxy]; group
  have hp := positiveToParent_injective M he
  exact ⟨x * a, ⟨x, rfl⟩, ⟨y, hp⟩⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.positive_fracti.source_declaration:
/-- Every group element has a positive numerator over a power of the actual
central global fundamental square. -/
theorem positive_fraction_globalDelta_square (β : Artin.Group M) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : Artin.Group M), p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ ∧
      β = p * (((parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
  let Ω := (parabolicDelta M Set.univ) ^ 2
  have hβ : β ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (Artin.generator M)) := by
    rw [Artin.closure_range_generator M]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top β
  change ∃ n p, p ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ ∧ β = p * (Ω ^ n)⁻¹
  induction hβ using Subgroup.closure_induction_left with
  | one => exact ⟨0, 1, Submonoid.one_mem _, by simp⟩
  | mul_left a ha y hy ih =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp, rfl⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨n, Artin.generator M i * p,
      Submonoid.mul_mem _ (generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ (Set.mem_univ i)) hp,
      ?_⟩
    group
  | inv_mul_cancel a ha y hy ih =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp, rfl⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hdelta⟩ :=
      (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M Set.univ i).2 (Set.mem_univ i)
    let v := q * parabolicDelta M Set.univ
    have hv : v ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
      Submonoid.mul_mem _ hq (parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    have hprod : Artin.generator M i * v = Ω := by
      dsimp only [v, Ω]
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← hdelta, pow_two]
    have hinv : (Artin.generator M i)⁻¹ = v * Ω⁻¹ := by
      apply (eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq).2
      rw [← hprod]
      group
    have hcomm : Ω⁻¹ * p = p * Ω⁻¹ :=
      ((globalDelta_square_commute M p).inv_left).eq
    refine ⟨n + 1, v * p, Submonoid.mul_mem _ hv hp, ?_⟩
    calc
      (Artin.generator M i)⁻¹ * (p * (Ω ^ n)⁻¹) =
          v * (Ω⁻¹ * p) * (Ω ^ n)⁻¹ := by rw [hinv]; group
      _ = v * (p * Ω⁻¹) * (Ω ^ n)⁻¹ := by rw [hcomm]
      _ = (v * p) * (Ω ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ := by rw [pow_succ, mul_inv_rev]; group

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.positive_lcm_ri.source_declaration:
/-- The suffix version of the source's minimal-degree/gcd argument. -/
theorem positive_lcm_right (a b : PositiveArtin M) :
    ∃ c : PositiveArtin M, PositiveSuffix M a c ∧ PositiveSuffix M b c ∧
      ∀ d : PositiveArtin M, PositiveSuffix M a d → PositiveSuffix M b d →
        PositiveSuffix M c d := by
  classical
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n => ∃ c : PositiveArtin M,
    PositiveSuffix M a c ∧ PositiveSuffix M b c ∧ positiveDegree M c = n
  have hex : ∃ n, P n := by
    obtain ⟨c, hac, hbc⟩ := positive_common_multiple_right M a b
    exact ⟨positiveDegree M c, c, hac, hbc, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hac, hbc, hc⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  refine ⟨c, hac, hbc, ?_⟩
  intro d had hbd
  obtain ⟨e, hec, hed, he⟩ := positive_gcd_right M c d
  have hae := he a hac had
  have hbe := he b hbc hbd
  have hmin : positiveDegree M c ≤ positiveDegree M e := by
    rw [hc]
    exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨e, hae, hbe, rfl⟩
  have hedeg : positiveDegree M e ≤ positiveDegree M c := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hec
    rw [hu, positiveDegree_mul]
    omega
  have heq : e = c := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hec
    have hu0 : positiveDegree M u = 0 := by
      have hedeg' := Nat.le_antisymm hedeg hmin
      rw [hu, positiveDegree_mul] at hedeg'
      omega
    rw [(positiveDegree_zero_iff M u).mp hu0, one_mul] at hu
    exact hu.symm
  rwa [heq] at hed

/-- Two positive left-reduced representatives of one parabolic coset agree. -/
theorem positive_leftReduced_fraction_parabolic_eq (J : Set I) {a b : Artin.Group M}
    (ha : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hb : b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hared : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J a)
    (hbred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J b)
    (hpar : a * b⁻¹ ∈ Artin.parabolic M J) : a = b := by
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual M] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨d, c, z, hc, hz, hcop⟩ := exists_right_reduced_pair M a b
  have hmem : positiveToParent M c * (positiveToParent M z)⁻¹ ∈ Artin.parabolic M J := by
    have he : positiveToParent M a * (positiveToParent M b)⁻¹ =
        positiveToParent M c * (positiveToParent M z)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hc, hz, map_mul, map_mul]
      group
    rwa [he] at hpar
  obtain ⟨hcJ, hzJ⟩ := right_coprime_fraction_parabolic M J c z hcop hmem
  have hc1 := selected_prefix_eq_one_of_reduced M J hared c d hcJ
    (by rw [hc, map_mul])
  have hz1 := selected_prefix_eq_one_of_reduced M J hbred z d hzJ
    (by rw [hz, map_mul])
  rw [hc, hz, hc1, hz1]

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.positive_leftRe.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.positive_leftRe.source_declaration:
/-- Positive source-left-reduced ribbons are generated by the actual outside
elementary labels. The identity case proves equality of its actual endpoints. -/
theorem positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r : Artin.Group M}
    (hpos : r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices r) (hrib : IsRibbon M X Y r) :
    PositiveReducedArrow M X Y r := by
  have core : ∀ n (X Y : RibbonObject M) (r : Artin.Group M), (degree M r).toNat = n →
      r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ → IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices r →
      IsRibbon M X Y r → PositiveReducedArrow M X Y r := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | ind n ih =>
      intro X Y r hn hp hred hrib
      by_cases hr1 : r = 1
      · subst r
        have hXY := isRibbon_one_objects_eq M hrib
        subst Y
        exact .identity X
      have hrpos := hp
      rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual] at hp
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hp
      have hp1 : p ≠ 1 := by
        intro he
        apply hr1
        rw [← hp, he, map_one]
      obtain ⟨a, hat⟩ := exists_positive_first M hp1
      obtain ⟨t, hpt⟩ := hat
      have hfirst : r = Artin.generator M a * positiveToParent M t := by
        rw [← hp, hpt, map_mul, positiveToParent_generator]
      have ha : a ∉ X.indices := by
        intro hai
        exact hred a hai (positiveToParent M t) (positiveActualHom M t).property hfirst.symm
      let μ := elementaryMu M X.indices a
      let Z : RibbonObject M := ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert a X.indices) X.indices⟩
      have hμ : IsRibbon M X Z μ := elementaryMu_isRibbon M X.indices a
      have hμpos : μ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
        positive_univ_of_selected M _ (elementaryMu_positive M X.indices a)
      have hδX : parabolicDelta M X.indices ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
        positive_univ_of_selected M _ (parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M X.indices)
      have hδY : parabolicDelta M Y.indices ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
        positive_univ_of_selected M _ (parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M Y.indices)
      have hAtom : ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
          parabolicDelta M X.indices * r = Artin.generator M a * q := by
        refine ⟨positiveToParent M t * parabolicDelta M Y.indices,
          (actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem (positiveActualHom M t).property hδY, ?_⟩
        rw [IsRibbon.parabolicDelta_mul M hrib, hfirst, mul_assoc]
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hproduct⟩ := parabolicDelta_insert_left_lcm M X.indices a
        (parabolicDelta M X.indices * r)
        ((actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hδX hrpos) ⟨r, hrpos, rfl⟩ hAtom
      have hfactor : r = μ * c := by
        calc
          r = (parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ * (parabolicDelta M X.indices * r) := by group
          _ = (parabolicDelta M X.indices)⁻¹ * (parabolicDelta M (insert a X.indices) * c) := by
            rw [hproduct]
          _ = μ * c := by dsimp [μ, elementaryMu]; group
      have hcRibbon : IsRibbon M Z Y c := by
        have h := IsRibbon.mul M (IsRibbon.inv M hμ) hrib
        have he : μ⁻¹ * r = c := by rw [hfactor]; group
        simpa only [he] using h
      have hcReduced : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M Z.indices c := by
        intro j hj s hs he
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hrel⟩ := IsRibbon.generator_reverse M hμ hj
        apply hred i hi (μ * s) ((actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hμpos hs)
        rw [← mul_assoc, hrel, mul_assoc, he, ← hfactor]
      have hμdeg : 0 < degree M μ := elementaryMu_degree_pos M X.indices a ha
      have hcdeg := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hc
      have hrdeg := degree_nonneg_of_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ hrpos
      have hdeg : degree M r = degree M μ + degree M c := by rw [hfactor, degree_mul]
      have hlt : (degree M c).toNat < n := by omega
      have hgenerated := ih _ hlt Z Y c rfl hc hcReduced hcRibbon
      have hstep : PositiveReducedArrow M X Z μ := .elementary a ha hμ
      simpa only [← hfactor] using PositiveReducedArrow.comp hstep hgenerated
  exact core _ X Y r rfl hpos hred hrib

/-- All left divisors, not merely the atoms, are exactly the selected simple
positive lifts. -/
theorem positive_prefix_positiveDelta_iff (J : Set I) (p : PositiveArtin M) :
    PositivePrefix M p (positiveDelta M J) ↔
      ∃ w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J, p = positiveSimpleLift M w := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hp
    have he := (positive_simple_factors M p c (parabolicLongest M J) hc.symm).1
    refine ⟨positiveToCoxeter M p, ?_, he⟩
    apply (positiveSimpleLift_prefix_positiveDelta_iff M J _).mp
    rw [← he]
    exact ⟨c, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact (positiveSimpleLift_prefix_positiveDelta_iff M J w).mpr hw

/-- An elementary prefix of a positive left-reduced ribbon leaves a positive
left-reduced ribbon tail with the genuine intermediate endpoint. -/
theorem positive_ribbon_elementary_tail {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r : Artin.Group M}
    (_hrpos : r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hrred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices r) (hrib : IsRibbon M X Y r)
    (a : I) (_ha : a ∉ X.indices)
    (hprefix : ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
      r = elementaryMu M X.indices a * q) :
    ∃ q : Artin.Group M,
      PositiveReducedArrow M ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert a X.indices) X.indices⟩ Y q ∧
      r = elementaryMu M X.indices a * q := by
  obtain ⟨q, hqpos, hfactor⟩ := hprefix
  let μ := elementaryMu M X.indices a
  let Z : RibbonObject M := ⟨parabolicTwistImage M (insert a X.indices) X.indices⟩
  have hμ : IsRibbon M X Z μ := elementaryMu_isRibbon M X.indices a
  have hμpos : μ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ :=
    selected_positive_univ M _ (elementaryMu_positive M X.indices a)
  have hqRibbon : IsRibbon M Z Y q := by
    have h := IsRibbon.mul M (IsRibbon.inv M hμ) hrib
    have he : μ⁻¹ * r = q := by rw [hfactor]; dsimp [μ]; group
    simpa only [he] using h
  have hqred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M Z.indices q := by
    intro j hj s hs he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hrel⟩ := IsRibbon.generator_reverse M hμ hj
    apply hrred i hi (μ * s) ((actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hμpos hs)
    rw [← mul_assoc, hrel, mul_assoc, he]
    exact hfactor.symm
  exact ⟨q, positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated M hqpos hqred hqRibbon, hfactor⟩

/-- A positive ribbon left factor leaves a positive generated ribbon tail
when the full product is source-left-reduced. -/
theorem positive_ribbon_factor_tail {X Z Y : RibbonObject M} {l r s : Artin.Group M}
    (hlpos : l ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ) (hl : IsRibbon M X Z l)
    (hrred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices r) (hr : IsRibbon M X Y r)
    (hspos : s ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ) (hfac : r = l * s) :
    PositiveReducedArrow M Z Y s := by
  have hsr : IsRibbon M Z Y s := by
    have h := (hl.inv M).mul M hr
    have he : l⁻¹ * r = s := by rw [hfac]; group
    simpa only [he] using h
  have hsred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M Z.indices s := by
    intro j hj t ht he
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hrel⟩ := IsRibbon.generator_reverse M hl hj
    apply hrred i hi (l * t) ((actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ).mul_mem hlpos ht)
    rw [← mul_assoc, hrel, mul_assoc, he]
    exact hfac.symm
  exact positive_leftReduced_ribbon_generated M hspos hsred hsr

/-- Multiplication of positive left-reduced ribbons preserves left reduction.
Only the first factor's transporter relation is needed for this divisor step. -/
theorem positive_ribbon_mul_leftReduced {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r s : Artin.Group M}
    (hr : r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices r)
    (hribbon : IsRibbon M X Y r)
    (hs : s ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hsred : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M Y.indices s) :
    IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M X.indices (r * s) := by
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual M] at hr hs
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hs
  intro i hi t ht heq
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual M] at ht
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := ht
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hrel⟩ := IsRibbon.generator_forward M hribbon hi
  have hrelP : positiveGenerator M i * p = p * positiveGenerator M j := by
    apply positiveToParent_injective M
    simpa only [map_mul, positiveToParent_generator] using hrel
  have hprefix : PositivePrefix M (positiveGenerator M i) (p * q) := by
    refine ⟨u, positiveToParent_injective M ?_⟩
    simpa only [map_mul, positiveToParent_generator] using heq.symm
  have hlcm := positive_atom_ribbon_lcm M X.indices p i j hi hred hrelP (p * q)
    hprefix ⟨q, rfl⟩
  have hjq := (positivePrefix_mul_left_iff M (positive_cancel_left M)
    p (positiveGenerator M j) q).1 hlcm
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hjq
  apply hsred j hj (positiveToParent M v) (positiveActualHom M v).property
  have h := congrArg (positiveToParent M) hv
  simpa only [map_mul, positiveToParent_generator] using h.symm

theorem positive_suffix_positiveDelta_iff (J : Set I) (p : PositiveArtin M) :
    PositiveSuffix M p (positiveDelta M J) ↔
      ∃ w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J, p = positiveSimpleLift M w := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hp
    have he := (positive_simple_factors M c p (parabolicLongest M J) hc.symm).2
    refine ⟨positiveToCoxeter M p, ?_, he⟩
    apply (positiveSimpleLift_suffix_positiveDelta_iff M J _).mp
    rw [← he]
    exact ⟨c, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact (positiveSimpleLift_suffix_positiveDelta_iff M J w).mpr hw

/-- The canonical equivalence sends every standard generator to the same
standard generator. Its inverse is another proved presentation homomorphism. -/
def presentationEquiv (M : CoxeterMatrix I) : OAI.HarmonicArtin.Artin M ≃* Artin.Group M :=
  MonoidHom.toMulEquiv (toParent M) (fromParent M)
    (by
      apply PresentedGroup.ext
      intro i
      change fromParent M (toParent M (OAI.HarmonicArtin.generator M i)) = OAI.HarmonicArtin.generator M i
      simp)
    (by
      apply PresentedGroup.ext
      intro i
      change toParent M (fromParent M (Artin.generator M i)) = Artin.generator M i
      simp)

/-- The actual reduced ribbon loop subgroup meets the actual parabolic
trivially. This uses the proved signed positive ribbon fractions. -/
theorem reducedRibbonLoop_parabolic_eq_one (X : RibbonObject M) {β : Artin.Group M}
    (hβ : ReducedArrow M X X β) (hpar : β ∈ Artin.parabolic M X.indices) : β = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp, hfrac⟩ := ReducedArrow.positive_fraction M hβ
  have hc := positive_cofinalLoop_pow M X n
  have hmem : p * ((cofinalLoop M X.indices) ^ n)⁻¹ ∈ Artin.parabolic M X.indices := by
    rwa [← hfrac]
  have heq := positive_leftReduced_fraction_parabolic_eq M X.indices
    hp.positive hc.positive hp.leftReduced hc.leftReduced hmem
  rw [hfrac, heq, mul_inv_cancel]

using ordinary Artin multiplication, as in the article. -/

  carrier := {β | ReducedArrow M X X β}
  one_mem' := ReducedArrow.identity X
  mul_mem' := ReducedArrow.comp
  inv_mem' := ReducedArrow.inverse

theorem reducedRibbonQuotientMap_surjective (X : RibbonObject M) :
    Function.Surjective (reducedRibbonQuotientMap M X) := by
  intro q
  let A := Artin.parabolic M X.indices
  let N := Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set (Artin.Group M))
  obtain ⟨β, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (A.subgroupOf N) q
  obtain ⟨a, ha, r, hr, hprod⟩ :=
    exists_parabolic_reducedRibbon_factorization M X β.val β.property
  let aN : N := ⟨a, A.le_normalizer ha⟩
  let rN : N := reducedRibbonLoopsToNormalizer M X ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hβ : β = aN * rN := Subtype.ext hprod
  refine ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, ?_⟩
  change QuotientGroup.mk' (A.subgroupOf N) rN = QuotientGroup.mk' (A.subgroupOf N) β
  have ha1 : QuotientGroup.mk' (A.subgroupOf N) aN = 1 :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff aN).2 ha
  rw [hβ, map_mul, ha1, one_mul]

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.reduced_normali.source_declaration:
/-- The stripped positive normalizer conjugates each selected atom to a
selected atom. Right reduction is the essential extra hypothesis. -/
theorem reduced_normalizer_conjugates_generator (J : Set I) {r : Artin.Group M}
    (hr : r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hred : IsRightParabolicallyReduced M J r)
    (hn : r ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M J : Set (Artin.Group M)))
    {i : I} (hi : i ∈ J) :
    ∃ j ∈ J, r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * r = Artin.generator M j := by
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual M] at hr
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨d, c, z, hc, hz, hcz⟩ :=
    exists_left_reduced_pair M p (positiveGenerator M i * p)
  have he : (positiveToParent M c)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M z =
      (positiveToParent M p)⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * positiveToParent M p := by
    calc
      (positiveToParent M c)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M z =
          (positiveToParent M p)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M (positiveGenerator M i * p) := by
        rw [hz, hc, map_mul, map_mul]
        group
      _ = _ := by rw [map_mul, positiveToParent_generator]; group
  have hmem : (positiveToParent M c)⁻¹ * positiveToParent M z ∈ Artin.parabolic M J := by
    rw [he]
    exact (Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff''.1 hn _).1 (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨hcJ, hzJ⟩ := left_coprime_fraction_parabolic M J c z hcz hmem
  have hc1 : c = 1 := selected_suffix_eq_one_of_reduced M J hred c d hcJ
    (by rw [hc, map_mul])
  have he' : (positiveToParent M p)⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * positiveToParent M p =
      positiveToParent M z := by simpa only [hc1, map_one, inv_one, one_mul] using he.symm
  have hzdeg : positiveDegree M z = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (degree M) he'
    rw [degree_mul, degree_mul, degree_inv, degree_generator,
      degree_positiveToParent, degree_positiveToParent] at h
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := positiveDegree_one_generator M z hzdeg
  refine ⟨j, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (positiveToParent_mem_iff_support M J _).1 hzJ (by simp)
  · simpa only [positiveToParent_generator] using he'

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.reduced_normali.name: ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.reduced_normalizer_isRibbon
ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.reduced_normali.source_declaration:
/-- A right-reduced positive normalizer is an actual positive-parabolic
transporter, rather than an assumed ribbon factor. -/
theorem reduced_normalizer_isRibbon (J : Set I) {r : Artin.Group M}
    (hr : r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ)
    (hred : IsRightParabolicallyReduced M J r)
    (hn : r ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.parabolic M J : Set (Artin.Group M))) :
    IsRibbon M ⟨J⟩ ⟨J⟩ r := by
  classical
  let := Theorem18.finite_index M
  have hgen (i : I) (hi : i ∈ J) := reduced_normalizer_conjugates_generator M J hr hred hn hi
  let f : J → J := fun i => ⟨(hgen i.val i.property).choose,
    (hgen i.val i.property).choose_spec.1⟩
  have hf (i : J) : r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i.val * r = Artin.generator M (f i).val :=
    (hgen i.val i.property).choose_spec.2
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply actualGenerator_injective M
    have h : r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i.val * r =
        r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M j.val * r := by rw [hf i, hf j, hij]
    have h' := congrArg (fun a => r * a * r⁻¹) h
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left, inv_mul_cancel_left,
      mul_inv_cancel_right, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one] using h'
  have hsurj := Finite.surjective_of_injective hinj
  have hforward : ∀ i ∈ J,
      r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * r ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hf ⟨i, hi⟩]
    exact generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J (f ⟨i, hi⟩).property
  have hbackward : ∀ i ∈ J,
      (r⁻¹)⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * r⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsurj ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h := hf j
    rw [hj] at h
    have heq : (r⁻¹)⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * r⁻¹ = Artin.generator M j.val := by
      rw [← h]
      simp only [inv_inv]
      group
    rw [heq]
    exact generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J j.property
  intro a
  constructor
  · exact conjugate_positive_mem M J r hforward
  · intro ha
    have h := conjugate_positive_mem M J r⁻¹ hbackward ha
    simpa [mul_assoc] using h

/-- Positive lifting commutes with the actual parabolic inclusion, proved
by the reduced-word and length-preservation theorems. -/
theorem restrictedArtinHom_positiveLift (J : Set I) (w : (restrictedMatrix M J).Group) :
    restrictedArtinHom M J (positiveLift (restrictedMatrix M J) w) =
      positiveLift M (restrictionHom M J w) := by
  classical
  let := fundamental_finite_index M
  let := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let u := reducedExpression (restrictedMatrix M J) w
  have hr : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsReduced (u.map Subtype.val) :=
    (restriction_reduced_iff M J u).mpr (reducedExpression_reduced _ _)
  have he : wordCoxeter M (u.map Subtype.val) = restrictionHom M J w := by
    change M.toCoxeterSystem.wordProd (u.map Subtype.val) = restrictionHom M J w
    rw [← restriction_wordProd]
    exact congrArg (restrictionHom M J) (wordCoxeter_reducedExpression _ _)
  rw [← he, positiveLift_word M _ hr]
  exact restrictedArtinHom_word M J u

instance ribbonGroupoid : Groupoid (RibbonObject M) where
  Hom X Y := RibbonHom M X Y
  id X := ⟨1, isRibbon_one M X⟩
  comp β γ := ⟨β.1 * γ.1, β.2.mul M γ.2⟩
  id_comp β := Subtype.ext (one_mul β.1)
  comp_id β := Subtype.ext (mul_one β.1)
  assoc β γ δ := Subtype.ext (mul_assoc β.1 γ.1 δ.1)
  inv β := ⟨β.1⁻¹, β.2.inv M⟩
  inv_comp β := Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel β.1)
  comp_inv β := Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel β.1)

ordinary multiplication. No quotient or reduced-ribbon generation is used. -/

  carrier := {β | IsRibbon M X X β}

theorem right_coprime_fraction_parabolic (J : Set I) (a b : PositiveArtin M)
    (hab : RightCoprime M a b)
    (hg : positiveToParent M a * (positiveToParent M b)⁻¹ ∈ Artin.parabolic M J) :
    positiveToParent M a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J ∧
      positiveToParent M b ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J := by
  obtain ⟨c, z, hc, hz, hfrac⟩ := parabolic_positive_fraction M J hg
  obtain ⟨d, c', z', hdc, hdz, hcop⟩ := exists_right_reduced_pair M c z
  have hc' := (positive_factors_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J c' d (hdc ▸ hc)).1
  have hz' := (positive_factors_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J z' d (hdz ▸ hz)).1
  have he : positiveToParent M a * (positiveToParent M b)⁻¹ =
      positiveToParent M c' * (positiveToParent M z')⁻¹ := by
    rw [hfrac, hdc, hdz, map_mul, map_mul]
    group
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := right_coprime_fraction_unique M a b c' z' hab hcop he
  exact ⟨hc', hz'⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Ribbon2.right_coprime_f.source_declaration:
/-- Actual coprime right fractions have unique numerator and denominator. -/
theorem right_coprime_fraction_unique (a b c z : PositiveArtin M)
    (hab : RightCoprime M a b) (hcz : RightCoprime M c z)
    (heq : positiveToParent M a * (positiveToParent M b)⁻¹ =
      positiveToParent M c * (positiveToParent M z)⁻¹) : a = c ∧ b = z := by
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨d, hd⟩, ⟨e, he⟩⟩ := positive_common_multiple_left M b z
  have hbd : b * d = z * e := hd.symm.trans he
  have had : a * d = c * e := by
    apply positiveToParent_injective M
    have hm := congrArg (positiveToParent M) hbd
    simp only [map_mul] at hm
    simp only [map_mul]
    calc
      positiveToParent M a * positiveToParent M d =
          (positiveToParent M a * (positiveToParent M b)⁻¹) *
            (positiveToParent M b * positiveToParent M d) := by group
      _ = (positiveToParent M c * (positiveToParent M z)⁻¹) *
            (positiveToParent M z * positiveToParent M e) := by rw [heq, hm]
      _ = positiveToParent M c * positiveToParent M e := by group
  have hed : PositiveSuffix M e d := rightCoprime_common_suffix M a b hab d e
    ⟨c, had⟩ ⟨z, hbd⟩
  have hde : PositiveSuffix M d e := rightCoprime_common_suffix M c z hcz e d
    ⟨a, had.symm⟩ ⟨b, hbd.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hed
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hde
  have hdeg := congrArg (positiveDegree M) hx
  have hdeg' := congrArg (positiveDegree M) hy
  simp only [positiveDegree_mul] at hdeg hdeg'
  have hxy : x = 1 := (positiveDegree_zero_iff M x).1 (by omega)
  have h : d = e := by simpa only [hxy, one_mul] using hx
  rw [← h] at had hbd
  exact ⟨positive_cancel_right M d a c had, positive_cancel_right M d b z hbd⟩

/-- A selected positive suffix of a right reduced element is trivial. -/
theorem selected_suffix_eq_one_of_reduced (J : Set I) {r : Artin.Group M}
    (hr : IsRightParabolicallyReduced M J r) (c d : PositiveArtin M)
    (hc : positiveToParent M c ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J)
    (hprod : r = positiveToParent M d * positiveToParent M c) : c = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := positive_word_surjective M c
  induction w using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => rfl
  | append_singleton w i _ =>
    have hsupport := (positiveToParent_mem_iff_support M J _).1 hc
    have hi : i ∈ J := hsupport (by simp)
    have hp : positiveToParent M (d * wordPositive M w) ∈
        actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ := (positiveActualHom M _).property
    apply False.elim
    apply hr i hi _ hp
    simpa [map_mul, positiveToParent_word, Artin.wordProd, mul_assoc] using hprod.symm

    (c : C) {x : X} (hF : F.obj c = FundamentalGroupoid.mk x)

/-- Naturality with the actual fundamental-group map of a continuous map. -/
theorem basedEndHom_map (F : C ⥤ FundamentalGroupoid X) (c : C) {x : X}
    (h : F.obj c = FundamentalGroupoid.mk x) (f : C(X, Y)) :
    (FundamentalGroup.map f x).comp (basedEndHom F c h) =
      basedEndHom (F ⋙ FundamentalGroupoid.map f) c
        (congrArg (FundamentalGroupoid.map f).obj h) := by
  ext e
  change (FundamentalGroupoid.map f).map (basedEndHom F c h e).asHom =
    eqToHom (congrArg (FundamentalGroupoid.map f).obj h).symm ≫
      (FundamentalGroupoid.map f).map (F.map e.asHom) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (FundamentalGroupoid.map f).obj h)
  simp only [basedEndHom_apply_asHom, Functor.map_comp, eqToHom_map]

/-- A strict square of genuine groupoid functors induces the corresponding
strict square on based vertex groups, with the given object identifications. -/
theorem basedEndHom_square (F : C ⥤ FundamentalGroupoid X) (Q : C ⥤ D)
    (G : D ⥤ FundamentalGroupoid Y) (f : C(X, Y))
    (hsquare : F ⋙ FundamentalGroupoid.map f = Q ⋙ G)
    (c : C) {x : X} (hF : F.obj c = FundamentalGroupoid.mk x)
    (hG : G.obj (Q.obj c) = FundamentalGroupoid.mk (f x)) :
    (FundamentalGroup.map f x).comp (basedEndHom F c hF) =
      (basedEndHom G (Q.obj c) hG).comp (Q.mapEnd c) := by
  rw [basedEndHom_map]
  exact (basedEndHom_congr hsquare c _ hG).trans (basedEndHom_comp Q G c hG)

/-- Any actual path class projecting to the specified based loop computes
its raw endpoint monodromy, with the literal quotient action at its endpoint. -/
theorem endpointMonodromy_eq_of_path_map_heq
    (hp : IsQuotientCoveringMap p Q) (e : E) (q : Q)
    (γ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient e (q • e)) (α : FundamentalGroup X (p e))
    (hmap : HEq
      ((FundamentalGroupoid.map ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩).map
        (show FundamentalGroupoid.mk e ⟶ FundamentalGroupoid.mk (q • e) from γ)) α.asHom) :
    hp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite ⟨e, rfl⟩ α = MulOpposite.op q := by
  have hclasses : HEq (γ.map ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩) α.asHom := hmap
  have hcast := Path.Homotopic.Quotient.cast_heq
    (γ := (α.asHom : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (p e) (p e))) rfl (hp.map_smul q)
  have heq : γ.map ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩ =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.cast (α.asHom : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (p e) (p e))
        rfl (hp.map_smul q) :=
    eq_of_heq (hclasses.trans hcast.symm)
  have hm := hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy_eq_of_map_eq
    (ex := ⟨e, rfl⟩) (ey := ⟨q • e, hp.map_smul q⟩) γ heq
  apply hp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite_apply_eq_iff.mpr
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hm.symm

ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.fundamentalGr.source_declaration:
/-- Change of basepoint commutes with the actual map of fundamental groups
under a continuous map, so compatible paths can transport a strict square. -/
theorem fundamentalGroup_map_changeBasepoint (f : C(X, Y)) {x x' : X} (p : Path x x')
    (g : FundamentalGroup X x) :
    FundamentalGroup.map f x' (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath p g) =
      FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath (p.map f.continuous)
        (FundamentalGroup.map f x g) := by
  apply End.ext
  let α : FundamentalGroupoid.mk x ≅ FundamentalGroupoid.mk x' :=
    (Groupoid.isoEquivHom ..).symm (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p)
  let β : FundamentalGroupoid.mk (f x) ≅ FundamentalGroupoid.mk (f x') :=
    (Groupoid.isoEquivHom ..).symm (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (p.map f.continuous))
  have hiso : (FundamentalGroupoid.map f).mapIso α = β := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_map p f).symm
  change (FundamentalGroupoid.map f).map (α.conj g).asHom =
    (β.conj ((FundamentalGroupoid.map f).mapEnd (FundamentalGroupoid.mk x) g)).asHom
  rw [← hiso]
  exact (FundamentalGroupoid.map f).map_conj α g

/-- The first kernel is canonically compared to the domain of the actual
injective homomorphism realizing the second kernel. -/
noncomputable def kernelComparison (E : A ≃* B) (ρA : A →* Q) (ρB : B →* Q)
    (hcomm : ρB.comp E.toMonoidHom = ρA) (j : H →* B)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hrange : j.range = ρB.ker) : ρA.ker ≃* H :=
  (kernelEquivOfCompatible E ρA ρB hcomm).trans (rangeEquivKernel ρB j hj hrange).symm

/-- The comparison square holds on the actual ambient group elements. -/
theorem kernelComparison_apply (E : A ≃* B) (ρA : A →* Q) (ρB : B →* Q)
    (hcomm : ρB.comp E.toMonoidHom = ρA) (j : H →* B)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hrange : j.range = ρB.ker) (a : ρA.ker) :
    j (kernelComparison E ρA ρB hcomm j hj hrange a) = E a := by
  let F := rangeEquivKernel ρB j hj hrange
  let b := kernelEquivOfCompatible E ρA ρB hcomm a
  calc
    j (kernelComparison E ρA ρB hcomm j hj hrange a) = (F (F.symm b) : B) := rfl
    _ = (b : B) := congrArg Subtype.val (F.apply_symm_apply b)
    _ = E a := rfl

    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hrange : j.range = ρB.ker) :

      E.toMonoidHom.comp ρA.ker.subtype := by

theorem kernelComparison_symm_apply (E : A ≃* B) (ρA : A →* Q) (ρB : B →* Q)
    (hcomm : ρB.comp E.toMonoidHom = ρA) (j : H →* B)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hrange : j.range = ρB.ker) (h : H) :

  apply E.injective

/-- Landmark 4 is precisely the full actual-map statement above, at every
basepoint; no asphericity is included in its scope. -/
theorem landmark_4 (x : Complement M J) :
    Nonempty (Artin.pureNormalizerImage M J ≃* FundamentalGroup (Complement M J) x) ∧
    Nonempty (Artin.normalizerQuotient M J ≃*
      FundamentalGroup (OrbitSpace M J) (orbitProjection M J x)) ∧
    (Function.Injective (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J) ∧
      (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J).range = (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J)) ∧
    (Function.Injective (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x) ∧
      (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range = (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x)) ∧
    ((Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).comp
        (pureFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom =
      (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom.comp
        (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J)) ∧
    ((normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x).comp
        (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J) :=
  theorem_6_7 M J x

ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.map_kernel_of.name: ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.map_kernel_of_compatible
ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.map_kernel_of.source_declaration:
/-- A compatible actual middle equivalence maps the first kernel exactly
onto the second kernel. -/
theorem map_kernel_of_compatible (E : A ≃* B) (ρA : A →* Q) (ρB : B →* Q)
    (hcomm : ρB.comp E.toMonoidHom = ρA) :
    ρA.ker.map E.toMonoidHom = ρB.ker := by
  ext b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    change ρA a = 1 at ha
    change ρB (E a) = 1
    exact (congrArg (fun f : A →* Q => f a) hcomm).trans ha
  · intro hb
    change ρB b = 1 at hb
    refine ⟨E.symm b, ?_, E.apply_symm_apply b⟩
    change ρA (E.symm b) = 1
    have hc := congrArg (fun f : A →* Q => f (E.symm b)) hcomm
    change ρB (E (E.symm b)) = ρA (E.symm b) at hc
    rw [E.apply_symm_apply] at hc
    exact hc.symm.trans hb

    (hp : IsQuotientCoveringMap p Q) (e : E) (q : Q)

/-- The exact row uses the original actual covering map and the explicit
normalized endpoint homomorphism to the same Coxeter normalizer quotient. -/
theorem normalizedOrbitFundamentalGroup_shortExact (x : Complement M J) :
    Function.Injective (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x) ∧
      (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range =
        (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x) := by
  obtain ⟨hinj, hrange, hsurj⟩ := Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroup_shortExact M J x
  refine ⟨hinj, hrange.trans (normalizedOrbitMonodromy_ker M J x).symm, ?_⟩
  intro q
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hsurj ((oppositeInverseEquiv _).symm q)
  refine ⟨α, ?_⟩
  change oppositeInverseEquiv _ (Landmark1.orbitMonodromy M J x α) = q
  rw [hα, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

/-- The right square has identity on the same actual Coxeter quotient, for
every choice of an upstairs path and its actual projected path. -/
theorem normalizerComparisonAlong_monodromy {x : Complement M J}

    (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x).comp (normalizerComparisonAlong M J θ).toMonoidHom =

  intro a
  change normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x
      (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath (projectedBasepointPath M J θ)
        (standardNormalizerEquiv M J a)) = Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J a

/-- The raw, unnormalized endpoint formula displays the inverse label
required by mathlib's fundamental-group multiplication convention. -/
theorem normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv_rawMonodromy (x : Complement M J)
    (a : Artin.normalizerQuotient M J) :
    Landmark1.orbitMonodromy M J x (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x a) =
      MulOpposite.op ((Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J a)⁻¹) := by
  apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv_monodromy M J x) a
  change (Landmark1.orbitMonodromy M J x (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x a)).unop⁻¹ =
    Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J a at h
  simpa only [inv_inv, MulOpposite.unop_op] using congrArg Inv.inv h

This uses mathlib's genuine change-of-basepoint equivalence. -/

    (hF : F.FullyFaithful) (c : C) {x y : X}
    (h : F.obj c = FundamentalGroupoid.mk x) (p : Path x y) :

theorem pathBasedEndEquiv_apply_asHom (F : C ⥤ FundamentalGroupoid X)
    (hF : F.FullyFaithful) (c : C) {x y : X}

/-- The actual positive ribbon path comparison at every basepoint. Its
underlying path class is the standard positive Artin-labelled ribbon image,
transported along the projection of the same actual upstairs basepoint path. -/
theorem positiveNormalizerEquiv_label (x : Complement M J)
    (r : reducedRibbonLoops M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :
    (positiveNormalizerEquiv M J x (reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩ r)).unop =
      FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath
        (projectedBasepointPath M J (standardBasepointPath M J x))
        (standardRibbonVertexEquiv M J (componentEndOfLoop M J r)) := by
  change (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath
    (projectedBasepointPath M J (standardBasepointPath M J x))
    (standardNormalizerEquiv M J (reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩ r)))⁻¹ = _
  rw [← map_inv]
  exact congrArg (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath
    (projectedBasepointPath M J (standardBasepointPath M J x)))
    (standardPositiveNormalizerEquiv_label M J r)

ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.positiveOrbit.source_declaration:
/-- Short exactness of the actual positive-traversal geometric row. -/
theorem positiveOrbitFundamentalGroup_shortExact (x : Complement M J) :
    Function.Injective (positiveOrbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x) ∧
      (positiveOrbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range = (positiveOrbitMonodromy M J x).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (positiveOrbitMonodromy M J x) := by
  obtain ⟨hinj, hrange, hsurj⟩ := Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroup_shortExact M J x
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b hab
    apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
    exact hinj (congrArg MulOpposite.unop hab)
  · ext β
    have hmem : β ∈ (positiveOrbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range ↔
        β.unop ∈ (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
        exact ⟨α.unop, congrArg MulOpposite.unop hα⟩
      · rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
        exact ⟨MulOpposite.op α, MulOpposite.unop_injective hα⟩
    rw [hmem, hrange]
    simp only [MonoidHom.mem_ker, positiveOrbitMonodromy_apply]
    exact ⟨fun h => congrArg MulOpposite.unop h,
      fun h => MulOpposite.unop_injective h⟩
  · intro q
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hsurj (MulOpposite.op q)
    refine ⟨MulOpposite.op γ, ?_⟩
    rw [positiveOrbitMonodromy_op, hγ]
    rfl

/-- The first square commutes for every actual choice of the paired paths. -/
theorem pureComparisonAlong_inclusion {x : Complement M J}
    (θ : Path (standardComplementPoint M J) x) :
    (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).comp (pureComparisonAlong M J θ).toMonoidHom =
      (normalizerComparisonAlong M J θ).toMonoidHom.comp (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro a
  change Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x
      (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath θ (standardPureEquiv M J a)) =
    FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath (projectedBasepointPath M J θ)
      (standardNormalizerEquiv M J (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J a))
  have h := coveringMapOfEq_basepointTransport
    (Landmark1.isCoveringMap_orbitProjection M J) θ (standardPureEquiv M J a)
  change Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x
      (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath θ (standardPureEquiv M J a)) =
    FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath (projectedBasepointPath M J θ)
      (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J (standardComplementPoint M J)
        (standardPureEquiv M J a)) at h
  exact h.trans (congrArg
    (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath (projectedBasepointPath M J θ))
    (standardPureEquiv_apply M J a))

ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.rawMonodromy_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.rawMonodromy_basepointTransport
ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.rawMonodromy_.source_declaration:
/-- Raw endpoint labels in the same `Qᵐᵒᵖ` are preserved by transport along
an actual total-space path and precisely its projected base path. -/
theorem rawMonodromy_basepointTransport (hp : IsQuotientCoveringMap p Q)
    (θ : Path e₀ e₁) (α : FundamentalGroup X (p e₀)) :
    hp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite ⟨e₁, rfl⟩
        (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath (θ.map hp.continuous) α) =
      hp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite ⟨e₀, rfl⟩ α := by
  let σ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (p e₀) (p e₁) := .mk (θ.map hp.continuous)
  let g : Q := (hp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite ⟨e₀, rfl⟩ α).unop
  have hσ : hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy σ ⟨e₀, rfl⟩ = ⟨e₁, rfl⟩ :=
    hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy_map (.mk θ)
  have hσinv : hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy σ.symm ⟨e₁, rfl⟩ = ⟨e₀, rfl⟩ :=
    hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy_map (.mk θ.symm)
  have hloop : hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy α.asHom ⟨e₀, rfl⟩ =
      hp.toPermFiber (p e₀) g ⟨e₀, rfl⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hp.toPermFiber_apply_apply_coe]
    exact (hp.unop_fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite_smul (e := ⟨e₀, rfl⟩) (γ := α)).symm
  apply hp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite_apply_eq_iff.mpr
  rw [FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath_apply]
  change g • e₁ =
    (hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy (σ.symm.trans (α.asHom.trans σ)) ⟨e₁, rfl⟩).val
  rw [hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy_trans_apply, hσinv,
    hp.isCoveringMap.monodromy_trans_apply, hloop, hp.monodromy_toPermFiber, hσ,
    hp.toPermFiber_apply_apply_coe]

theorem rawMonodromy_basepointTransport_comp (hp : IsQuotientCoveringMap p Q)

      (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath (θ.map hp.continuous)).toMonoidHom =
      hp.fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite ⟨e₀, rfl⟩ := by

opposite of categorical `End`. This includes every signed actual ribbon loop. -/

/-- The standard geometric comparison commutes with the original algebraic
normalizer-quotient projection, over the identity on that actual quotient. -/

        (standardNormalizerEquiv M J).toMonoidHom = Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro a

  change normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J (standardComplementPoint M J)
      (standardReducedRibbonEquiv M J
        ((reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩).symm
          (reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩ r))) = _
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply, standardReducedRibbonEquiv_monodromy]

  change Landmark1.orbitMonodromy M J (standardComplementPoint M J)
      (standardReducedRibbonEquiv M J
        ((reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩).symm

  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply, standardReducedRibbonEquiv_rawMonodromy]

/-- The positive comparison carries the original, rather than inverse, actual
ribbon label through the specified bottom geometric functor. -/
theorem standardPositiveNormalizerEquiv_label
    (r : reducedRibbonLoops M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :
    (standardPositiveNormalizerEquiv M J (reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩ r)).unop =
      standardRibbonVertexEquiv M J (componentEndOfLoop M J r) := by
  change (standardNormalizerEquiv M J
    (reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩ r))⁻¹ = _
  change (standardReducedRibbonEquiv M J
    ((reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩).symm
      (reducedRibbonNormalizerQuotientEquiv M ⟨J⟩ r)))⁻¹ = _
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply, ← map_inv]
  change standardRibbonVertexEquiv M J ((reducedLoopsEquivComponentEnd M J) r⁻¹) = _
  congr 1
  apply componentEndValue_injective M J
  simp only [componentEndValue, reducedLoopsEquivComponentEnd_asHom_value,
    Subgroup.coe_inv, inv_inv, componentEndOfLoop_asHom_value]

ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.standardRibbo.name: ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.standardRibbonVertexEquiv_rawMonodromy
ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.standardRibbo.source_declaration:
/-- Positive traversal of the actual reduced loop has its original Coxeter
quotient label as raw endpoint monodromy, in the explicit opposite group. -/
theorem standardRibbonVertexEquiv_rawMonodromy
    (r : reducedRibbonLoops M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M)) :
    Landmark1.orbitMonodromy M J (standardComplementPoint M J)
        (standardRibbonVertexEquiv M J (componentEndOfLoop M J r)) =
      MulOpposite.op (reducedRibbonCoxeterProjection M ⟨J⟩ r) := by
  let C0 := standardActualChamber M J
  let β := actualReducedHom M r.property
  let s := standardActualChamberFiber M J
  let D := (ribbonLiftEndpoint M J β s).val
  let δ := ribbonLiftArrow M J β s
  let e := componentEndOfLoop M J r
  let α := standardRibbonVertexEquiv M J e
  let q := reducedRibbonCoxeterProjection M ⟨J⟩ r
  let z := actualChamberBasepoint M J (actualChamberPointFamily M J) D
  let γ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (standardComplementPoint M J) z :=
    (actualIntervalForward M J).map δ
  have htarget : (componentRibbonFunctor M J).obj (intervalObject D) =
      standardComponentRibbonObject M J := by
    apply ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.ext
    exact (ribbonLiftSource_eq M J (ribbonLiftEndpoint M J β s)).trans
      (standardComponentRibbonObject_underlying M J).symm
  have hvalue : ((componentRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).hom.val.val = e.asHom.hom.val.val := by
    change ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ).val.val = r.val
    exact ribbonLiftArrow_ribbon_value M J β s
  have hβ : HEq ((componentRibbonFunctor M J).map δ) e.asHom :=
    componentHom_heq_of_value M J rfl htarget hvalue
  have hsq := functor_map_heq_of_eq (actualComparison_square M J) δ
  have hgeom : HEq ((orbitFundamentalGroupoidFunctor M J).map γ)
      ((actualRibbonOrbitEquivalence M J).functor.map e.asHom) :=
    hsq.symm.trans (functor_map_heq (actualRibbonOrbitEquivalence M J).functor rfl htarget hβ)
  have hloop : HEq ((actualRibbonOrbitEquivalence M J).functor.map e.asHom) α.asHom := by
    rw [standardRibbonVertexEquiv_asHom]
    exact hom_heq_eqToHom_conjugate (standardRibbonImage_eq M J) _
  have hz : z = q • standardComplementPoint M J := by
    have hD := ribbonLiftEndpoint_reducedLoop M J r
    change actualChamberBasepoint M J (actualChamberPointFamily M J) D = _
    rw [show D = q • C0 from hD]
    exact actualChamberBasepoint_smul_of_coordinates M J (actualChamberPointFamily M J) q
      (actualChamberPointFamily_equivariant M J q) C0
  exact endpointMonodromy_eq_of_path_map_heq_of_endpoint
    (Landmark1.isQuotientCoveringMap_orbitProjection M J)
    (standardComplementPoint M J) z q hz γ α (hgeom.trans hloop)

/-- Transport through an actual subgroup equality, suitable for a pure
normalizer image that has already been proved equal to the first kernel. -/
noncomputable def subgroupKernelComparison (E : A ≃* B) (ρA : A →* Q) (ρB : B →* Q)
    (hcomm : ρB.comp E.toMonoidHom = ρA) (j : H →* B)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hrange : j.range = ρB.ker)
    (K : Subgroup A) (hK : K = ρA.ker) : K ≃* H :=
  (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hK).trans (kernelComparison E ρA ρB hcomm j hj hrange)

theorem subgroupKernelComparison_apply (E : A ≃* B) (ρA : A →* Q) (ρB : B →* Q)
    (hcomm : ρB.comp E.toMonoidHom = ρA) (j : H →* B)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hrange : j.range = ρB.ker)
    (K : Subgroup A) (hK : K = ρA.ker) (a : K) :
    j (subgroupKernelComparison E ρA ρB hcomm j hj hrange K hK a) = E a :=
  kernelComparison_apply E ρA ρB hcomm j hj hrange (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hK a)

theorem subgroupKernelComparison_square (E : A ≃* B) (ρA : A →* Q) (ρB : B →* Q)
    (hcomm : ρB.comp E.toMonoidHom = ρA) (j : H →* B)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hrange : j.range = ρB.ker)
    (K : Subgroup A) (hK : K = ρA.ker) :
    j.comp (subgroupKernelComparison E ρA ρB hcomm j hj hrange K hK).toMonoidHom =
      E.toMonoidHom.comp K.subtype := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro a

ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.subgroupKerne.source_declaration:
/-- The commuting inclusion square uniquely determines the comparison,
so no unspecified automorphism of the pure term remains. -/
theorem subgroupKernelComparison_unique (E : A ≃* B) (ρA : A →* Q) (ρB : B →* Q)
    (hcomm : ρB.comp E.toMonoidHom = ρA) (j : H →* B)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (hrange : j.range = ρB.ker)
    (K : Subgroup A) (hK : K = ρA.ker) (F : K ≃* H)
    (hF : j.comp F.toMonoidHom = E.toMonoidHom.comp K.subtype) :
    F = subgroupKernelComparison E ρA ρB hcomm j hj hrange K hK := by
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  apply hj
  exact (congrArg (fun f : K →* B => f a) hF).trans
    (subgroupKernelComparison_apply E ρA ρB hcomm j hj hrange K hK a).symm

ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.theorem_6_7.source_declaration:
/-- **Theorem 6.7**, in the explicitly normalized mathlib fundamental-group
convention, for the original groups, original spaces and original induced maps. -/
theorem theorem_6_7 (x : Complement M J) :
    Nonempty (Artin.pureNormalizerImage M J ≃* FundamentalGroup (Complement M J) x) ∧
    Nonempty (Artin.normalizerQuotient M J ≃*
      FundamentalGroup (OrbitSpace M J) (orbitProjection M J x)) ∧
    (Function.Injective (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J) ∧
      (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J).range = (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J)) ∧
    (Function.Injective (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x) ∧
      (Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range = (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x)) ∧
    ((Landmark1.orbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).comp
        (pureFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom =
      (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom.comp
        (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J)) ∧
    ((normalizedOrbitMonodromy M J x).comp
        (normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J) :=
  ⟨⟨pureFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x⟩,
    ⟨normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv M J x⟩,
    Artin.lemma_2_8 M J,
    normalizedOrbitFundamentalGroup_shortExact M J x,
    pureFundamentalGroupEquiv_inclusion M J x,
    normalizerFundamentalGroupEquiv_monodromy M J x⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Sequence4.theorem_6_7_p.source_declaration:
/-- The same actual diagram in positive path-traversal order, implemented by
the opposite of mathlib's fundamental group. The positive endpoint map sends
the literal lifted path to its original quotient label. -/
theorem theorem_6_7_positive (x : Complement M J) :
    Nonempty (Artin.pureNormalizerImage M J ≃* (FundamentalGroup (Complement M J) x)ᵐᵒᵖ) ∧
    Nonempty (Artin.normalizerQuotient M J ≃*
      (FundamentalGroup (OrbitSpace M J) (orbitProjection M J x))ᵐᵒᵖ) ∧
    (Function.Injective (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J) ∧
      (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J).range = (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J)) ∧
    (Function.Injective (positiveOrbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x) ∧
      (positiveOrbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).range = (positiveOrbitMonodromy M J x).ker ∧
      Function.Surjective (positiveOrbitMonodromy M J x)) ∧
    ((positiveOrbitFundamentalGroupMap M J x).comp (positivePureEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom =
      (positiveNormalizerEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom.comp (Artin.pureNormalizerInclusion M J)) ∧
    ((positiveOrbitMonodromy M J x).comp (positiveNormalizerEquiv M J x).toMonoidHom =
      Artin.normalizerQuotientMap M J) :=
  ⟨⟨positivePureEquiv M J x⟩, ⟨positiveNormalizerEquiv M J x⟩,
    Artin.lemma_2_8 M J, positiveOrbitFundamentalGroup_shortExact M J x,
    positivePureEquiv_inclusion M J x, positiveNormalizerEquiv_monodromy M J x⟩

  intro i

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.continuous_ev.source_declaration:
/-- Evaluation at every vector is continuous for this dual topology. -/
theorem continuous_evaluation (v : Vector I) : Continuous (fun φ : Dual I => φ v) := by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : Dual I => (0 : ℝ)))
  | add u v hu hv =>
    simpa only [map_add, Function.comp_def] using
      continuous_add.comp (hu.prodMk hv)
  | single i a =>
    have hc : Continuous (fun φ : Dual I => φ (simpleRoot i)) :=
      (continuous_apply i).comp dualCoordinatesHomeomorph.continuous_toFun
    simpa only [← Finsupp.smul_single_one i a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, simpleRoot] using
      hc.const_mul a

/-- Conjugation, rather than a root classification, proves flat preservation. -/
theorem dualAction_mem_relativeSubspace
    {w : M.Group}
    (hw : w ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (Artin.coxeterParabolic M J : Set M.Group))
    {φ : Dual I} (hφ : φ ∈ relativeSubspace J) :
    dualAction M w φ ∈ relativeSubspace J := by
  apply (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M J _).2
  intro u hu
  have hc := (Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff''.mp hw u).mp hu
  have hf := (mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed M J φ).1 hφ _ hc
  calc
    dualAction M u (dualAction M w φ) =
        dualAction M w (dualAction M (w⁻¹ * u * w) φ) := by
      simp only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul]
      congr 2
      group
    _ = dualAction M w φ := by rw [hf]
