theorem dualAction_simple_fixed_iff (i : I) (φ : Dual I) :
    dualAction M (M.simple i) φ = φ ↔ φ (simpleRoot i) = 0 := by
  have hsimple : M.toCoxeterSystem.simple i = M.simple i := by
    rw [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple]
  have heval (v : Vector I) :
      dualAction M (M.simple i) φ v =
        φ v - (2 * M.geometricForm (simpleRoot i) v) * φ (simpleRoot i) := by
    rw [dualAction_apply, ← hsimple, M.toCoxeterSystem.inv_simple,
      M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation_simple,
      M.geometricReflection_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg (fun f : Dual I => f (simpleRoot i)) h
    have hform : M.geometricForm (simpleRoot i) (simpleRoot i) = 1 :=
      M.geometricForm_single_self i
    rw [heval, hform] at hv
    linarith
  · intro h
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro v
    rw [heval, h, mul_zero, sub_zero]

/-- The coordinate identification uses the actual dual basis. -/
noncomputable def dualCoordinates : Dual I ≃ₗ[ℝ] (I → ℝ) where
  toFun φ i := φ (simpleRoot i)
  invFun a := Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ a
  left_inv φ := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro i a
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
    change a * φ (simpleRoot i) = φ (Finsupp.single i a)
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one i a, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  right_inv a := by
    funext i
    simp [simpleRoot, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

/-- The retained root condition, including omission of hyperplanes containing
the whole relative flat, is preserved by the normalizer. -/

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.isOpen_comple.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.isOpen_complementSet
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.isOpen_comple.source_declaration:
/-- In finite Coxeter type the source complement is an open subset of the
relative real-pair vector space. -/
theorem isOpen_complementSet (M : CoxeterMatrix I) [Finite M.Group] (J : Set I) :
    IsOpen (complementSet M J) := by
  have he : complementSet M J =
      ⋂ r ∈ retainedRoots M J,
        {p : relativeSubspace J × relativeSubspace J |
          ¬(p.1.val r = 0 ∧ p.2.val r = 0)} := by
    ext p
    simp [complementSet]
  rw [he]
  apply (retainedRoots_finite M J).isOpen_biInter
  intro r _
  have h1 : Continuous (fun p : relativeSubspace J × relativeSubspace J => p.1.val r) :=
    (continuous_evaluation r).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)
  have h2 : Continuous (fun p : relativeSubspace J × relativeSubspace J => p.2.val r) :=
    (continuous_evaluation r).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)
  exact ((isClosed_eq h1 continuous_const).inter
    (isClosed_eq h2 continuous_const)).isOpen_compl

  let := (retainedRoots_finite M J).fintype
  rw [← pairComplement_retainedEvaluation]

    (retainedEvaluation M J) (fun r => r.property.2)

/-- The actual pair complexification complement of finitely many proper real
linear hyperplanes is path connected, including the empty arrangement. -/
theorem isPathConnected_pairComplement {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (f : ι → E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hf : ∀ a, ∃ x, f a x ≠ 0) :
    IsPathConnected (pairComplement f) := by
  rw [isPathConnected_iff]
  exact ⟨pairComplement_nonempty f hf, fun _ hp _ hq => joinedIn_pairComplement f hp hq⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.joinedIn_pair.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.joinedIn_pairComplement
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.joinedIn_pair.source_declaration:
/-- Any two existing points of a finite real arrangement complement can be
joined inside that actual complement. Properness is needed only for existence. -/
theorem joinedIn_pairComplement {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (f : ι → E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    {p q : E × E} (hp : p ∈ pairComplement f) (hq : q ∈ pairComplement f) :
    JoinedIn (pairComplement f) p q := by
  let bad : Set ℂ := {z | ∃ a, pairEvaluation (f a) (pairAffineLine p q z) = 0}
  have hfinite : bad.Finite := by
    have he : bad = ⋃ a, {z | pairEvaluation (f a) (pairAffineLine p q z) = 0} := by
      ext z
      simp [bad]
    rw [he]
    apply Set.finite_iUnion
    intro a
    apply Set.Subsingleton.finite
    intro z hz z' hz'
    change pairEvaluation (f a) (pairAffineLine p q z) = 0 at hz
    change pairEvaluation (f a) (pairAffineLine p q z') = 0 at hz'
    rw [pairEvaluation_affineLine] at hz hz'
    have hdelta : pairEvaluation (f a) q - pairEvaluation (f a) p ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      rw [heq, mul_zero, add_zero] at hz
      exact hp a hz
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hdelta (add_left_cancel (hz.trans hz'.symm))
  have hpath : IsPathConnected badᶜ :=
    hfinite.countable.isPathConnected_compl_of_one_lt_rank (by
      rw [Complex.rank_real_complex]
      norm_num)
  have hzero : (0 : ℂ) ∈ badᶜ := by
    rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact hp a (by simpa using ha)
  have hone : (1 : ℂ) ∈ badᶜ := by
    rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact hq a (by simpa using ha)
  have hmap := (hpath.joinedIn 0 hzero 1 hone).map
    (continuous_pairAffineLine p q).continuousOn
  have hsub : pairAffineLine p q '' badᶜ ⊆ pairComplement f := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ a ha
    exact hz ⟨a, ha⟩
  simpa using hmap.mono hsub

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.mem_relativeS.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.mem_relativeS.source_declaration:
/-- The relative flat is precisely the fixed space of the generated parabolic. -/
theorem mem_relativeSubspace_iff_fixed (φ : Dual I) :
    φ ∈ relativeSubspace J ↔
      ∀ w ∈ Artin.coxeterParabolic M J, dualAction M w φ = φ := by
  constructor
  · intro hφ
    have hclosed : Artin.coxeterParabolic M J ≤
        { carrier := {w | dualAction M w φ = φ}
          one_mem' := by simp
          mul_mem' := by
            intro a b ha hb
            simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at *
            rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, hb, ha]
          inv_mem' := by
            intro a ha
            simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at *
            have h := congrArg (fun f => dualAction M a⁻¹ f) ha
            simpa only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel,
              map_one, one_apply_eq_self] using h.symm } := by
      change Subgroup.closure (M.simple '' J) ≤ _
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
      rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact (dualAction_simple_fixed_iff M i φ).2 (hφ i hi)
    exact fun w hw => hclosed hw
  · intro h i hi
    apply (dualAction_simple_fixed_iff M i φ).1
    exact h _ (Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.normalizerCom.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.normalizerComplementAction
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.normalizerCom.source_declaration:
/-- The actual normalizer action as permutations of the complement. -/
noncomputable def normalizerComplementAction :
    CoxeterNormalizer M J →* Equiv.Perm (Complement M J) where
  toFun w :=
    { toFun p := ⟨(normalizerRepresentation M J w p.val.1,
          normalizerRepresentation M J w p.val.2),
        normalizer_preserves_complement M J w p.property⟩
      invFun p := ⟨(normalizerRepresentation M J w⁻¹ p.val.1,
          normalizerRepresentation M J w⁻¹ p.val.2),
        normalizer_preserves_complement M J w⁻¹ p.property⟩
      left_inv p := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Prod.ext <;>
          simp only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel,
            map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
      right_inv p := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Prod.ext <;>
          simp only [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel,
            map_one, one_apply_eq_self] }
  map_one' := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro p
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (normalizerRepresentation M J 1 p.val.1,
      normalizerRepresentation M J 1 p.val.2) = p.val
    rw [map_one]
    rfl
  map_mul' w z := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro p
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (normalizerRepresentation M J (w * z) p.val.1,
      normalizerRepresentation M J (w * z) p.val.2) =
      (normalizerRepresentation M J w (normalizerRepresentation M J z p.val.1),
       normalizerRepresentation M J w (normalizerRepresentation M J z p.val.2))
    rw [map_mul]
    rfl

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.normalizerRep.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.normalizerRepresentation
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.normalizerRep.source_declaration:
/-- Restriction of the actual contragredient representation to the flat. -/
noncomputable def normalizerRepresentation :
    Representation ℝ (CoxeterNormalizer M J) (relativeSubspace J) where
  toFun w :=
    { toFun φ := ⟨dualAction M w φ, dualAction_mem_relativeSubspace M J w.property φ.property⟩
      map_add' φ ψ := Subtype.ext (map_add (dualAction M w) φ.val ψ.val)
      map_smul' c φ := Subtype.ext (map_smul (dualAction M w) c φ.val) }
  map_one' := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro φ
    apply Subtype.ext
    change dualAction M 1 φ.val = φ.val
    rw [map_one, one_apply_eq_self]
  map_mul' w z := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro φ
    apply Subtype.ext
    change dualAction M (w.val * z.val) φ.val =
      dualAction M w.val (dualAction M z.val φ.val)
    rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]

/-- The diagonal normalizer action preserves the actual real-pair complement. -/
theorem normalizer_preserves_complement (w : CoxeterNormalizer M J)
    {p : relativeSubspace J × relativeSubspace J} (hp : p ∈ complementSet M J) :

  apply hp _ (geometricAction_mem_retainedRoots M J w⁻¹ hr)

/-- A finite family of proper kernels has a nonempty real-pair complement. -/
theorem pairComplement_nonempty {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (f : ι → E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ a, ∃ x, f a x ≠ 0) : (pairComplement f).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Module.Dual.exists_forall_ne_zero_of_forall_exists f hf
  refine ⟨(x, 0), ?_⟩
  rw [mem_pairComplement_iff]
  intro a ha
  exact hx a ha.1

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.pairComplemen.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.pairComplement_retainedEvaluation
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.pairComplemen.source_declaration:
/-- The generic pair complement agrees with the source's actual relative complement. -/
theorem pairComplement_retainedEvaluation (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I) :
    pairComplement (retainedEvaluation M J) = complementSet M J := by
  ext p
  rw [mem_pairComplement_iff]
  change (∀ r : retainedRoots M J, ¬(p.1.val r.val = 0 ∧ p.2.val r.val = 0)) ↔
    ∀ r ∈ retainedRoots M J, ¬(p.1.val r = 0 ∧ p.2.val r = 0)
  exact ⟨fun h r hr => h ⟨r, hr⟩, fun h r => h r.val r.property⟩

theorem pairEvaluation_affineLine (f : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (p q : E × E) (z : ℂ) :
    pairEvaluation f (pairAffineLine p q z) =
      pairEvaluation f p + z * (pairEvaluation f q - pairEvaluation f p) := by

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.parabolic_le_.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.parabolic_le_normalizerComplementAction_ker
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.parabolic_le_.source_declaration:
theorem parabolic_le_normalizerComplementAction_ker :
    (Artin.coxeterParabolic M J).subgroupOf (CoxeterNormalizer M J) ≤
      (normalizerComplementAction M J).ker := by
  intro w hw
  have h := parabolic_le_normalizerRepresentation_ker M J hw
  change normalizerRepresentation M J w = 1 at h
  apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (normalizerRepresentation M J w p.val.1,
    normalizerRepresentation M J w p.val.2) = p.val
  rw [h]

total space:
`1 → π₁(E,e) → π₁(X,x) → Gᵐᵒᵖ → 1`.
The first arrow is induced by the given covering and the second is its
actual endpoint-monodromy homomorphism. -/
theorem quotientCovering_fundamentalGroup_shortExact [PathConnectedSpace E] :
    Function.Injective (FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩ e.2) ∧
      (FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨p, hp.continuous⟩ e.2).range =

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.retainedRoots.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.retainedRoots_empty
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.retainedRoots.source_declaration:
@[simp]
theorem retainedRoots_empty (M : CoxeterMatrix I) : retainedRoots M ∅ = roots M := by
  classical
  ext r
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.1
  · intro hr
    obtain ⟨w, i, rfl⟩ := hr
    have hn := root_ne_zero M w i
    have hex : ∃ j, root M w i j ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hn (Finsupp.ext h)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hex
    exact ⟨⟨w, i, rfl⟩, ⟨Finsupp.lapply j, by simp⟩, hj⟩

ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.retainedRoots.name: ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.retainedRoots_iff
ArtinNormalisers.Theorem18.retainedRoots.source_declaration:
theorem retainedRoots_iff (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (J : Set I) (r : Vector I) :
    r ∈ retainedRoots M J ↔ r ∈ roots M ∧ restrictedHyperplane J r ≠ ⊤ := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, φ, hφ⟩
    refine ⟨hr, fun htop => ?_⟩
    have hm : φ ∈ restrictedHyperplane J r := htop.symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    exact hφ hm
  · rintro ⟨hr, hproper⟩
    refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    apply hproper
    apply top_unique
    intro φ _
    exact hn φ

theorem retainedRoots_univ (M : CoxeterMatrix I) : retainedRoots M Set.univ = ∅ := by

  intro _
  rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
  have hz : φ.val = 0 := by
    apply (dualCoordinates (I := I)).injective
    funext i
    exact φ.property i (Set.mem_univ i)
  exact hφ (by simp [hz])

theorem root_ne_zero (M : CoxeterMatrix I) (w : M.Group) (i : I) : root M w i ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have he : M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation w (simpleRoot i) =
      M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation w 0 := by simpa [root] using h
  have hz := (Representation.apply_bijective M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation w).injective he
  have := congrArg (fun v : Vector I => v i) hz
  simp [simpleRoot] at this

/-- The ambient-intersection image agrees with the image of the subgroup in the normalizer. -/
theorem articleKernelImage_eq (f : G →* H) (A : Subgroup G) :
    articleKernelImage f A =
      (f.ker.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G))).map
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (A.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G)))) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨n, n.property.2⟩, n.property.1, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hx
    exact ⟨⟨n, hn, n.property⟩, rfl⟩

      (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G)) ⧸ A.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G)) :=

    { toFun := fun n => ⟨n, n.property.2⟩
      map_one' := rfl

    (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G)) →* (Subgroup.normalizer (A.map f : Set H)) where
  toFun n := ⟨f n, A.le_normalizer_map f (Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨n, n.property, rfl⟩)⟩
  map_one' := Subtype.ext (f.map_one)

def quotientMap (f : G →* H) (A : Subgroup G) :

theorem quotientMapTo_mk (f : G →* H) (A : Subgroup G) (B : Subgroup H)

ArtinNormalisers.quotientMap_mem_ker_iff.source_declaration:
/-- A kernel coset has a representative in the kernel of the original map. -/
theorem quotientMap_mem_ker_iff (f : G →* H) (A : Subgroup G)
    (x : (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G)) ⧸ A.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G))) :
    x ∈ (quotientMap f A).ker ↔
      ∃ n : (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G)), QuotientGroup.mk' (A.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G))) n = x ∧
        f (n : G) = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (A.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G))) x
    have hg : f (g : G) ∈ A.map f := by
      apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff
        (N := (A.map f).subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A.map f : Set H)))
        (normalizerMap f A g)).mp
      exact hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hg
    let aN : (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G)) := ⟨a, A.le_normalizer ha⟩
    have haC : aN ∈ A.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G)) := ha
    have hqa : QuotientGroup.mk' (A.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G))) aN = 1 :=
      (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff aN).mpr haC
    refine ⟨g * aN⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [map_mul, map_inv, hqa, inv_one, mul_one]
    · change f ((g : G) * a⁻¹) = 1
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, hfa, mul_inv_cancel]
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl, hn⟩
    change quotientMap f A (QuotientGroup.mk' (A.subgroupOf (Subgroup.normalizer (A : Set G))) n) = 1
    rw [quotientMap_mk]
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (normalizerMap f A n)).mpr
    change f (n : G) ∈ A.map f
    rw [hn]
    exact (A.map f).one_mem

private theorem canonical_eval_zero_support (K : Set I) {r : Vector I}
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hz : canonicalDominant K r = 0) :
    ∀ i ∉ K, r i = 0 := by
  classical
  have he : canonicalDominant K = Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ
      (fun i => canonicalDominant K (simpleRoot i)) :=
    (dualCoordinates (I := I)).symm_apply_apply (canonicalDominant K) |>.symm
  rw [he, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum] at hz
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hz
  intro i hi
  by_cases hmem : i ∈ r.support
  · have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j (_ : j ∈ r.support) => mul_nonneg (hr j) (canonicalDominant_isDominant K j)) hmem
    rw [hz] at hle
    have hri : r i ≤ 0 := by
      simpa only [canonicalDominant_apply_simpleRoot, ite_eq_right hi, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
        using hle
    exact le_antisymm hri (hr i)
  · exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hmem

private theorem minimal_suffix_of_length_add {K : Set I} {d f : M.Group}
    (hmin : M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep K f)
    (hlen : M.toCoxeterSystem.length f = M.toCoxeterSystem.length d +
      M.toCoxeterSystem.length (d⁻¹ * f)) :
    M.toCoxeterSystem.IsMinimalCosetRep K (d⁻¹ * f) := by
  refine M.toCoxeterSystem.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mpr ?_
  intro i hi hd
  have hlong := M.toCoxeterSystem.not_isRightDescent_iff.mp
    (M.toCoxeterSystem.isMinimalCosetRep_iff.mp hmin i hi)
  have hshort := M.toCoxeterSystem.isRightDescent_iff.mp hd
  simp only [CoxeterMatrix.toCoxeterSystem_simple] at hlong hshort
  have hbound := M.toCoxeterSystem.length_mul_le d ((d⁻¹ * f) * M.simple i)
  have he : d * ((d⁻¹ * f) * M.simple i) = f * M.simple i := by group
  rw [he] at hbound
  omega

private theorem representation_nonneg_of_supported (w : M.Group) (K : Set I)
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ K, 0 ≤ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation w (simpleRoot i))
    {r : Vector I} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : ∀ i ∉ K, r i = 0) :
    0 ≤ M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation w r := by
  classical
  have he : (∑ i ∈ r.support, r i • simpleRoot i) = r := by
    simpa only [simpleRoot, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finsupp.sum]
      using r.sum_single
  rw [← he, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i hi
  rw [map_smul]
  have hiK : i ∈ K := by
    by_contra hn
    exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hs i hn)
  exact smul_nonneg (hr i) (hw i hiK)

_private.ArtinChambers.PositiveTransport.source_declaration:
private theorem isRibbon_of_two_generator_relations (J K : Set I) (β : Artin.Group M)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ K, ∃ j ∈ J, β * Artin.generator M i = Artin.generator M j * β)
    (hb : ∀ j ∈ J, ∃ i ∈ K, Artin.generator M j * β = β * Artin.generator M i) :
    IsRibbon M ⟨J⟩ ⟨K⟩ β := by
  have hforward : actualPositiveParabolic M J ≤
      (actualPositiveParabolic M K).comap (MulAut.conj β⁻¹).toMonoidHom := by
    apply Submonoid.closure_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := hb j hj
    change β⁻¹ * Artin.generator M j * (β⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M K
    rw [inv_inv, mul_assoc, he]
    simpa using generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M K hi
  have hbackward : actualPositiveParabolic M K ≤
      (actualPositiveParabolic M J).comap (MulAut.conj β).toMonoidHom := by
    apply Submonoid.closure_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := hf i hi
    change β * Artin.generator M i * β⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J
    rw [he, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    exact generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M J hj
  intro a
  constructor
  · intro ha
    have h := hforward ha
    change β⁻¹ * a * (β⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M K at h
    simpa only [inv_inv] using h
  · intro ha
    have h := hbackward ha
    change β * (β⁻¹ * a * β) * β⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J at h
    simpa [mul_assoc] using h

_private.ArtinChambers.RibbonLiftUniquen.source_declaration:
private theorem intervalLiftRecovers_comp
    {X Y Z : IntervalGroupoid (E := relativeSubspace J) (actualForms M J)}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hf : IntervalLiftRecovers M J f) (hg : IntervalLiftRecovers M J g) :
    IntervalLiftRecovers M J (f ≫ g) := by
  change FamilyRecovery.Recovers
    ((intervalRibbonFunctor M J ⋙ ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map (f ≫ g))
    (distinguishedRibbonIndex M J X) (distinguishedRibbonIndex M J Z) (f ≫ g)
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
  exact FamilyRecovery.comp
    (f := (intervalRibbonFunctor M J ⋙ ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map f)
    (g := (intervalRibbonFunctor M J ⋙ ribbonLiftingFunctor M J).map g)

_private.ArtinDeligne.LiftedTubeLabels.0.source_declaration:
private theorem incoming_chamber_of_interval_map (C : ActualChamber M J)
    (δ : intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J) ⟶ intervalObject C)
    (β : (intervalRibbonFunctor M J).obj (intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J)) ⟶
      (intervalRibbonFunctor M J).obj (intervalObject C))
    (hβ : (intervalRibbonFunctor M J).map δ = β)
    (u : IncomingVertex M (⟨J⟩ : RibbonObject M))
    (hus : u.source = (⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩ : RibbonObject M))
    (huv : u.value = β.val.val⁻¹) : u.chamber = C := by
  let w := Artin.projection M β.val.val
  have hrib : IsRibbon M ⟨actualChamberIndices M J (standardActualChamber M J)⟩
      ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩ β.val.val := β.val.property
  have hw := isRibbon_projection_transporter M hrib
  have hwJ : (Artin.coxeterParabolic M (actualChamberIndices M J C)).map
      (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom = Artin.coxeterParabolic M J := by
    simpa only [standardActualChamber_indices] using hw
  have hchosen : actualChamberOfRawLabel M J
      (chamberRawLabel M J (standardActualChamber M J)) =
        actualChamberOfRawLabel M J (standardRawFacetLabel M J) :=
    chamberRawLabel_chamber M J _
  have hreplace := rightTransportRawLabel_independent M J hchosen
    (actualChamberIndices M J C) w
    (by simpa only [chamberRawLabel_indices] using hw)
    hwJ
  have hend := congrArg Subtype.val (ribbonLiftInterval_endpoint_all M J δ)
  rw [hβ, ribbonLiftEndpoint_projection] at hend
  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M J
    (fiberTargetLabel M J
      (X := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J (standardActualChamber M J)⟩)
      (Y := ⟨actualChamberIndices M J C⟩) w hw (distinguishedRibbonIndex M J
      (intervalObject (standardActualChamber M J)))) = C at hend
  have hlabel : u.rawFacetLabel =
      rightTransportRawLabel M J (standardRawFacetLabel M J)
        (actualChamberIndices M J C) w hwJ := by
    apply rawFacetLabel_ext M J
    · change u.source.indices = _
      rw [hus]
      rfl
    · change (Artin.projection M u.value)⁻¹ = 1 * w
      rw [huv, map_inv, inv_inv, one_mul]
  change actualChamberOfRawLabel M J u.rawFacetLabel = C
  rw [hlabel]
  exact hreplace.symm.trans hend

private theorem exists_pos_and_neg_of_sum_zero (b : ι → ℝ)
    (hsum : ∑ i, b i = 0) (hne : ∃ i, b i ≠ 0) :
    (∃ i, 0 < b i) ∧ ∃ i, b i < 0 := by

  · by_contra h
    have hnonpos (i : ι) : b i ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt (fun hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩)
    have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hnonpos i)).1 hsum
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
    exact hi (hz i (Finset.mem_univ i))
  · by_contra h
    have hnonneg (i : ι) : 0 ≤ b i := le_of_not_gt (fun hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩)
    have hz := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hnonneg i)).1 hsum
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
    exact hi (hz i (Finset.mem_univ i))

  change (D.signs R = true ↔ 0 < M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation
    (relativeTransport M J C D)⁻¹
      (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (chamberRawLabel M J C).representative⁻¹ R.val)) at hd
  change (E.signs R = true ↔ 0 < M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation
    (relativeTransport M J C E)⁻¹
      (M.toCoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation (chamberRawLabel M J C).representative⁻¹ R.val)) at he
  rw [h] at hd

  cases s <;> cases t <;> try rfl

    exact False.elim (lt_asymm ht hs)

  carrier := {w | ∀ φ : relativeSubspace J, dualAction M w φ.val = φ.val}

    {x : Group M} (hx : x ∈ parabolic M J) :
    a * x * a⁻¹ ∈ parabolic M J := by

_private.ArtinRibbons.DeltaDivisibility..source_declaration:
private theorem longest_unique {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (N : CoxeterMatrix K)
    (q z : N.Group)
    (hq : ∀ w, N.toCoxeterSystem.length w ≤ N.toCoxeterSystem.length q)
    (hz : ∀ w, N.toCoxeterSystem.length w ≤ N.toCoxeterSystem.length z) : q = z := by
  classical
  have h := length_mul_of_all_descents N.toCoxeterSystem q
    (all_descents_of_longest N.toCoxeterSystem q hq) z
  have hqz : q * z = 1 := N.toCoxeterSystem.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by
    have h1 := hq z
    have h2 := hz q
    omega)
  have hzz := longest_mul_self N.toCoxeterSystem z hz
  calc
    q = q * (z * z) := by rw [hzz, mul_one]
    _ = z := by rw [← mul_assoc, hqz, one_mul]

private theorem conjugate_positive_mem (J : Set I) (q : Artin.Group M)
    (hgen : ∀ i ∈ J, q⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J)
    {a : Artin.Group M} (ha : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J) :
    q⁻¹ * a * q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J := by
  have hle : actualPositiveParabolic M J ≤
      (actualPositiveParabolic M J).comap (MulAut.conj q⁻¹).toMonoidHom := by
    apply Submonoid.closure_le.mpr

    change q⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * (q⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J
    simpa only [inv_inv] using hgen i hi
  have h := hle ha
  change q⁻¹ * a * (q⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J at h
  simpa only [inv_inv] using h

private theorem leftCoprime_common_prefix (a b : PositiveArtin M)
    (h : LeftCoprime M a b) (d e : PositiveArtin M)
    (hea : PositivePrefix M e (d * a)) (heb : PositivePrefix M e (d * b)) :
    PositivePrefix M e d := by
  obtain ⟨k, hka, hkb, hk⟩ := positive_gcd_left M (d * a) (d * b)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hk d ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  have hqa := (positivePrefix_mul_left_iff M (positive_cancel_left M) d q a).1
    (hq ▸ hka)
  have hqb := (positivePrefix_mul_left_iff M (positive_cancel_left M) d q b).1
    (hq ▸ hkb)
  have hq1 := h q hqa hqb
  have hkd : k = d := by rw [hq, hq1, mul_one]
  simpa only [hkd] using hk e hea heb

private theorem selected_prefix_eq_one_of_reduced (J : Set I) {r : Artin.Group M}
    (hr : IsLeftParabolicallyReduced M J r) (c d : PositiveArtin M)
    (hc : positiveToParent M c ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J)
    (hprod : r = positiveToParent M c * positiveToParent M d) : c = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := positive_word_surjective M c
  cases w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i w =>
    have hsupport := (positiveToParent_mem_iff_support M J _).1 hc
    have hi : i ∈ J := hsupport (by simp)
    apply False.elim
    apply hr i hi (positiveToParent M (wordPositive M w * d)) (positiveActualHom M _).property
    simpa [map_mul, positiveToParent_word, Artin.wordProd, mul_assoc] using hprod.symm

    (M : CoxeterMatrix S) [Finite M.Group] : Function.Injective (positiveToParent M) := by
  have hT : IsSpherical M Set.univ := by

    infer_instance
  have hinj : Function.Injective (positiveToParent (restrictedMatrix M Set.univ)) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply spherical_positiveToArtin_injective M Set.univ hT
    apply (presentationEquiv (restrictedMatrix M Set.univ)).injective
    exact hab

    (Equiv.Set.univ S).symm (fun _ _ => rfl) hinj

  constructor
  · exact CoxeterExchange.mem_altList i j n k
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, n = l + 2 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
    simp only [CoxeterExchange.altList_succ, List.mem_cons]

private instance : CommMonoid (SupportValue I) where
  mul a b := ⟨a.carrier ∪ b.carrier⟩

  mul_assoc a b c := by ext i; exact or_assoc
  one_mul a := by ext i; change (False ∨ i ∈ a.carrier) ↔ i ∈ a.carrier; tauto
  mul_one a := by ext i; change (i ∈ a.carrier ∨ False) ↔ i ∈ a.carrier; tauto
  mul_comm a b := by ext i; exact or_comm

private theorem supportValue_word (w : List I) (i : I) :
    i ∈ ((w.map (fun j => (⟨{j}⟩ : SupportValue I))).prod).carrier ↔ i ∈ w := by
  induction w with
  | nil => change False ↔ i ∈ ([] : List I); simp
  | cons j w ih =>
    change (i = j ∨ i ∈ ((w.map (fun j => (⟨{j}⟩ : SupportValue I))).prod).carrier) ↔ _

_private.ArtinRibbons.PositiveSupport.0..source_declaration:
private theorem support_relations :
    ∀ a b : FreeMonoid I, positiveBraidRelations M a b →
      FreeMonoid.lift (fun i => (⟨{i}⟩ : SupportValue I)) a =
        FreeMonoid.lift (fun i => (⟨{i}⟩ : SupportValue I)) b := by
  rintro a b ⟨i, j, rfl, rfl⟩
  simp only [FreeMonoid.lift_ofList]
  ext k
  rw [supportValue_word, supportValue_word]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · rw [hij]
  by_cases hn : M i j = 0
  · simp only [hn, CoxeterExchange.altList_zero]
  · have hge : 2 ≤ M i j := by have := M.off_diagonal i j hij; omega
    rw [altList_support i j k _ hge, altList_support j i k _ hge, or_comm]

_private.ArtinRibbons.RibbonPositiveCalc.source_declaration:
private theorem delta_leftDivides_conjugate {X Y : RibbonObject M} {r : Artin.Group M}
    (h : IsRibbon M X Y r) :
    ∃ q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ,
      r⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M X.indices * r = parabolicDelta M Y.indices * q := by
  have hp := (h (parabolicDelta M X.indices)).1
    (parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M X.indices)
  apply parabolicDelta_left_lcm M Y.indices _ (positive_mem_univ M Y.indices hp)
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hrel⟩ := IsRibbon.generator_reverse M h hj
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hdelta⟩ := (generator_leftDivides_parabolicDelta_iff M X.indices i).2 hi
  have hqi : q ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M X.indices :=
    (actual_positive_factors_mem M X.indices
      (positive_mem_univ M X.indices (generator_mem_actualPositiveParabolic M X.indices hi))
      hq (hdelta ▸ parabolicDelta_mem_positiveParabolic M X.indices)).2
  refine ⟨r⁻¹ * q * r, positive_mem_univ M Y.indices ((h q).1 hqi), ?_⟩
  have hgen : r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * r = Artin.generator M j := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hrel]
    simp
  calc
    r⁻¹ * parabolicDelta M X.indices * r =
        (r⁻¹ * Artin.generator M i * r) * (r⁻¹ * q * r) := by rw [hdelta]; group
    _ = Artin.generator M j * (r⁻¹ * q * r) := by rw [hgen]

private theorem positive_degree_one_selected (J : Set I) {a : Artin.Group M}
    (ha : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M J) (hdeg : degree M a = 1) :
    ∃ j ∈ J, a = Artin.generator M j := by
  have hfull : a ∈ actualPositiveParabolic M Set.univ := by
    apply Submonoid.closure_mono (s := Artin.generator M '' J) ?_ ha
    exact Set.image_mono (Set.subset_univ J)
  rw [← positiveToParent_mrange_eq_actual M] at hfull
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hfull
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := positive_word_surjective M b
  have hw : w.length = 1 := by
    rw [positiveToParent_word, degree_wordProd] at hdeg
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.1 hw
  refine ⟨j, ?_, rfl⟩
  exact (positiveToParent_mem_iff_support M J (positiveGenerator M j)).1 ha (by simp)

private theorem componentHom_heq_of_value
    {X Y X' Y' : AssociateReducedRibbonObject M J} (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y')
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X' ⟶ Y'} (hv : f.hom.val.val = g.hom.val.val) : HEq f g := by
  subst X'
  subst Y'
  apply heq_of_eq
  apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Subtype.ext hv

private theorem functor_map_heq {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) {X Y X' Y' : C} (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y')
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X' ⟶ Y'} (h : HEq f g) : HEq (F.map f) (F.map g) := by
  subst X'
  subst Y'
  cases h
  rfl
